verses.textZh: 乌斯地有一个人，名叫约伯。这人完全、正直，敬畏神，远离罪恶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 乌斯地有一个人，名叫约伯。这人完全、正直，敬畏神，远离罪恶。
verses.textZhCuv: 乌斯地有一个人名叫约伯；那人完全正直，敬畏神，远离恶事。
verses.textEnNiv: In the land of Uz there lived a man whose name was Job. This man was blameless and upright; he feared God and shunned evil.
verses.textEnEsv: There was a man in the land of Uz whose name was Job, and that man was blameless and upright, one who feared God and turned away from evil.
verses.textEnNkjv: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job; and that man was blameless and upright, and one who feared God and shunned evil.
verses.textEnNlt: There once was a man named Job who lived in the land of Uz. He was blameless—a man of complete integrity. He feared God and stayed away from evil.
verses.textEnNasb: There was a man in the land of Uz whose name was Job; and that man was blameless, upright, fearing God and turning away from evil.
verses.textEn: In the land of Uz there lived a man whose name was Job. This man was blameless and upright; he feared God and shunned evil.

verses.textZh: 他生了七男三女。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他生了七男三女。
verses.textZhCuv: 他生了七个儿子，三个女儿。
verses.textEnNiv: He had seven sons and three daughters,
verses.textEnEsv: There were born to him seven sons and three daughters.
verses.textEnNkjv: And seven sons and three daughters were born to him.
verses.textEnNlt: He had seven sons and three daughters.
verses.textEnNasb: Seven sons and three daughters were born to him.
verses.textEn: He had seven sons and three daughters,

verses.textZh: 他的家产有七千只羊、三千匹骆驼、五百对牛、五百头母驴，并且有许多仆婢。这人在全东方的人中至为尊贵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的家产有七千只羊、三千匹骆驼、五百对牛、五百头母驴，并且有许多仆婢。这人在全东方的人中至为尊贵。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的家产有七千羊，三千骆驼，五百对牛，五百母驴，并有许多仆婢。这人在东方人中就为至大。
verses.textEnNiv: and he owned seven thousand sheep, three thousand camels, five hundred yoke of oxen and five hundred donkeys, and had a large number of servants. He was the greatest man among all the people of the East.
verses.textEnEsv: He possessed 7,000 sheep, 3,000 camels, 500 yoke of oxen, and 500 female donkeys, and very many servants, so that this man was the greatest of all the people of the east.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also, his possessions were seven thousand sheep, three thousand camels, five hundred yoke of oxen, five hundred female donkeys, and a very large household, so that this man was the greatest of all the people of the East.
verses.textEnNlt: He owned 7,000 sheep, 3,000 camels, 500 teams of oxen, and 500 female donkeys. He also had many servants. He was, in fact, the richest person in that entire area.
verses.textEnNasb: His possessions were seven thousand sheep, three thousand camels, five hundred yoke of oxen, five hundred female donkeys, and very many servants; and that man was the greatest of all the men of the east.
verses.textEn: and he owned seven thousand sheep, three thousand camels, five hundred yoke of oxen and five hundred donkeys, and had a large number of servants. He was the greatest man among all the people of the East.

verses.textZh: 他的儿子素常轮流各按自己的日子在家摆设筵席，并且打发人去邀请他们的三个姊妹来一同吃喝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的儿子素常轮流各按自己的日子在家摆设筵席，并且打发人去邀请他们的三个姊妹来一同吃喝。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的儿子按着日子各在自己家里设摆筵宴，就打发人去，请了他们的三个姊妹来，与他们一同吃喝。
verses.textEnNiv: His sons used to hold feasts in their homes on their birthdays, and they would invite their three sisters to eat and drink with them.
verses.textEnEsv: His sons used to go and hold a feast in the house of each one on his day, and they would send and invite their three sisters to eat and drink with them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And his sons would go and feast intheir houses, each on his appointed day, and would send and invite their three sisters to eat and drink with them.
verses.textEnNlt: Job’s sons would take turns preparing feasts in their homes, and they would also invite their three sisters to celebrate with them.
verses.textEnNasb: His sons used to go and hold a feast in the house of each one on his day, and they would send word and invite their three sisters to eat and drink with them.
verses.textEn: His sons used to hold feasts in their homes on their birthdays, and they would invite their three sisters to eat and drink with them.

verses.textZh: 轮流设宴的日子一过，约伯就差人去叫他们自洁。他清早起来，按他们的数目献上燔祭。因为他心里想："说不定孩子犯了罪，心中亵渎了神。"约伯经常这样作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 轮流设宴的日子一过，约伯就差人去叫他们自洁。他清早起来，按他们的数目献上燔祭。因为他心里想："说不定孩子犯了罪，心中亵渎了神。"约伯经常这样作。
verses.textZhCuv: 筵宴的日子过了，约伯打发人去叫他们自洁。他清早起来，按着他们众人的数目献燔祭；因为他说：「恐怕我儿子犯了罪，心中弃掉神。」约伯常常这样行。
verses.textEnNiv: When a period of feasting had run its course, Job would make arrangements for them to be purified. Early in the morning he would sacrifice a burnt offering for each of them, thinking, "Perhaps my children have sinned and cursed God in their hearts." This was Job’s regular custom.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the days of the feast had run their course, Job would send and consecrate them, and he would rise early in the morning and offer burnt offerings according to the number of them all. For Job said, "It may be that my children have sinned, and cursed God in their hearts." Thus Job did continually.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, when the days of feasting had run their course, that Job would send and sanctify them, and he would rise early in the morning and offer burnt offerings accordingto the number of them all. For Job said, "It may be that my sons have sinned and cursed God in their hearts." Thus Job did regularly.
verses.textEnNlt: When these celebrations ended—sometimes after several days—Job would purify his children. He would get up early in the morning and offer a burnt offering for each of them. For Job said to himself, "Perhaps my children have sinned and have cursed God in their hearts." This was Job’s regular practice.
verses.textEnNasb: When the days of feasting had completed their cycle, Job would send word to them and consecrate them, getting up early in the morning and offering burnt offerings according to the number of them all; for Job said, "Perhaps my sons have sinned and cursed God in their hearts." Job did so continually.
verses.textEn: When a period of feasting had run its course, Job would make arrangements for them to be purified. Early in the morning he would sacrifice a burnt offering for each of them, thinking, "Perhaps my children have sinned and cursed God in their hearts." This was Job’s regular custom.

verses.textZh: 有一天，神的众子都来侍立在耶和华面前，撒但也来到他们中间。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一天，神的众子都来侍立在耶和华面前，撒但也来到他们中间。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一天，神的众子来侍立在耶和华面前，撒但也来在其中。
verses.textEnNiv: One day the angels came to present themselves before the Lord , and Satan also came with them.
verses.textEnEsv: Now there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the Lord , and Satan also came among them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the Lord, and Satan also came among them.
verses.textEnNlt: One day the members of the heavenly court came to present themselves before the Lord , and the Accuser, Satan, came with them.
verses.textEnNasb: Now there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the Lord, and Satan also came among them.
verses.textEn: One day the angels came to present themselves before the Lord , and Satan also came with them.

verses.textZh: 耶和华问撒但："你从哪里来？"撒但回答耶和华说："我在地上徘徊，走来走去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华问撒但："你从哪里来？"撒但回答耶和华说："我在地上徘徊，走来走去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华问撒但说：「你从哪里来？」撒但回答说：「我从地上走来走去，往返而来。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Satan, "Where have you come from?" Satan answered the Lord , "From roaming throughout the earth, going back and forth on it."
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord said to Satan, "From where have you come?" Satan answered the Lord and said, "From going to and fro on the earth, and from walking up and down on it."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said to Satan, "From where do you come?" So Satan answered the Lord and said, "From going to and fro on the earth, and from walking back and forth on it."
verses.textEnNlt: "Where have you come from?" the Lord asked Satan. Satan answered the Lord , "I have been patrolling the earth, watching everything that’s going on."
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord said to Satan, "From where do you come?" Satan answered the Lord and said, "From roaming about on the earth and walking around on it."
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Satan, "Where have you come from?" Satan answered the Lord , "From roaming throughout the earth, going back and forth on it."

verses.textZh: 耶和华问撒但："你有没有注意到我的仆人约伯？世上再也没有一个人像他那样完全、正直，敬畏神，远离罪恶。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华问撒但："你有没有注意到我的仆人约伯？世上再也没有一个人像他那样完全、正直，敬畏神，远离罪恶。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华问撒但说：「你曾用心察看我的仆人约伯没有？地上再没有人像他完全正直，敬畏神，远离恶事。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Satan, "Have you considered my servant Job? There is no one on earth like him; he is blameless and upright, a man who fears God and shuns evil."
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Satan, "Have you considered my servant Job, that there is none like him on the earth, a blameless and upright man, who fears God and turns away from evil?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to Satan, "Have you considered My servant Job, that thereis none like him on the earth, a blameless and upright man, one who fears God and shuns evil?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord asked Satan, "Have you noticed my servant Job? He is the finest man in all the earth. He is blameless—a man of complete integrity. He fears God and stays away from evil."
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord said to Satan, "Have you considered My servant Job? For there is no one like him on the earth, a blameless and upright man, fearing God and turning away from evil."
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Satan, "Have you considered my servant Job? There is no one on earth like him; he is blameless and upright, a man who fears God and shuns evil."

verses.textZh: 撒但回答耶和华说："约伯敬畏神，难道是无缘无故的吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒但回答耶和华说："约伯敬畏神，难道是无缘无故的吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 撒但回答耶和华说：「约伯敬畏神，岂是无故呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "Does Job fear God for nothing?" Satan replied.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Satan answered the Lord and said, "Does Job fear God for no reason?
verses.textEnNkjv: So Satan answered the Lord and said, "Does Job fear God for nothing?
verses.textEnNlt: Satan replied to the Lord , "Yes, but Job has good reason to fear God.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Satan answered the Lord, "Does Job fear God for nothing?
verses.textEn: "Does Job fear God for nothing?" Satan replied.

verses.textZh: 你不是在他四周围上篱笆保护他吗？他的家和他所有的一切，以及他手所作的，你都赐福，他的家产也在地上增添。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不是在他四周围上篱笆保护他吗？他的家和他所有的一切，以及他手所作的，你都赐福，他的家产也在地上增添。
verses.textZhCuv: 你岂不是四面圈上篱笆围护他和他的家，并他一切所有的吗？他手所做的都蒙你赐福；他的家产也在地上增多。
verses.textEnNiv: "Have you not put a hedge around him and his household and everything he has? You have blessed the work of his hands, so that his flocks and herds are spread throughout the land.
verses.textEnEsv: Have you not put a hedge around him and his house and all that he has, on every side? You have blessed the work of his hands, and his possessions have increased in the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: Have You not made a hedge around him, around his household, and around all that he has on every side? You have blessed the work of his hands, and his possessions have increased in the land.
verses.textEnNlt: You have always put a wall of protection around him and his home and his property. You have made him prosper in everything he does. Look how rich he is!
verses.textEnNasb: Have You not made a fence around him and his house and all that he has, on every side? You have blessed the work of his hands, and his possessions have increased in the land.
verses.textEn: "Have you not put a hedge around him and his household and everything he has? You have blessed the work of his hands, so that his flocks and herds are spread throughout the land.

verses.textZh: 只要你伸手打击他所有的一切，他一定当面亵渎你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 只要你伸手打击他所有的一切，他一定当面亵渎你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你且伸手毁他一切所有的；他必当面弃掉你。」
verses.textEnNiv: But now stretch out your hand and strike everything he has, and he will surely curse you to your face."
verses.textEnEsv: But stretch out your hand and touch all that he has, and he will curse you to your face."
verses.textEnNkjv: But now, stretch out Your hand and touch all that he has, and he will surely curse You to Your face!"
verses.textEnNlt: But reach out and take away everything he has, and he will surely curse you to your face!"
verses.textEnNasb: But reach out with Your hand now and touch all that he has; he will certainly curse You to Your face."
verses.textEn: But now stretch out your hand and strike everything he has, and he will surely curse you to your face."

verses.textZh: 耶和华对撒但说："好吧，他所有的一切都交在你手中，只是不可以伸手害他。"于是撒但从耶和华面前退去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对撒但说："好吧，他所有的一切都交在你手中，只是不可以伸手害他。"于是撒但从耶和华面前退去。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对撒但说：「凡他所有的都在你手中；只是不可伸手加害于他。」于是撒但从耶和华面前退去。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Satan, "Very well, then, everything he has is in your power, but on the man himself do not lay a finger." Then Satan went out from the presence of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Satan, "Behold, all that he has is in your hand. Only against him do not stretch out your hand." So Satan went out from the presence of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said to Satan, "Behold, all that he has is in your power; only do not lay a hand on his person." So Satan went out from the presence of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "All right, you may test him," the Lord said to Satan. "Do whatever you want with everything he possesses, but don’t harm him physically." So Satan left the Lord ’s presence.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to Satan, "Behold, all that he has is in your power; only do not reach out and put your hand on him." So Satan departed from the presence of the Lord.
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Satan, "Very well, then, everything he has is in your power, but on the man himself do not lay a finger." Then Satan went out from the presence of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 有一天，约伯的儿女正在他们长兄的家里吃饭喝酒的时候，
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一天，约伯的儿女正在他们长兄的家里吃饭喝酒的时候，
verses.textZhCuv: 有一天，约伯的儿女正在他们长兄的家里吃饭喝酒，
verses.textEnNiv: One day when Job’s sons and daughters were feasting and drinking wine at the oldest brother’s house,
verses.textEnEsv: Now there was a day when his sons and daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother’s house,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now there was a day when his sons and daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother’s house;
verses.textEnNlt: One day when Job’s sons and daughters were feasting at the oldest brother’s house,
verses.textEnNasb: Now on the day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother’s house,
verses.textEn: One day when Job’s sons and daughters were feasting and drinking wine at the oldest brother’s house,

verses.textZh: 有报信的来见约伯，说："牛正在耕田，母驴在附近吃草的时候，
verses.textZhCnvs: 有报信的来见约伯，说："牛正在耕田，母驴在附近吃草的时候，
verses.textZhCuv: 有报信的来见约伯，说：「牛正耕地，驴在旁边吃草，
verses.textEnNiv: a messenger came to Job and said, "The oxen were plowing and the donkeys were grazing nearby,
verses.textEnEsv: and there came a messenger to Job and said, "The oxen were plowing and the donkeys feeding beside them,
verses.textEnNkjv: and a messenger came to Job and said, "The oxen were plowing and the donkeys feeding beside them,
verses.textEnNlt: a messenger arrived at Job’s home with this news: "Your oxen were plowing, with the donkeys feeding beside them,
verses.textEnNasb: a messenger came to Job and said, "The oxen were plowing and the female donkeys feeding beside them,
verses.textEn: a messenger came to Job and said, "The oxen were plowing and the donkeys were grazing nearby,

verses.textZh: 示巴人忽然来侵袭，把牛驴掳去，又用刀杀了仆人，只有我一个人逃脱，来向你报告。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 示巴人忽然来侵袭，把牛驴掳去，又用刀杀了仆人，只有我一个人逃脱，来向你报告。"
verses.textZhCuv: 示巴人忽然闯来，把牲畜掳去，并用刀杀了仆人；惟有我一人逃脱，来报信给你。」
verses.textEnNiv: and the Sabeans attacked and made off with them. They put the servants to the sword, and I am the only one who has escaped to tell you!"
verses.textEnEsv: and the Sabeans fell upon them and took them and struck down the servants with the edge of the sword, and I alone have escaped to tell you."
verses.textEnNkjv: when the Sabeans raided them and took them away—indeed they have killed the servants with the edge of the sword; and I alone have escaped to tell you!"
verses.textEnNlt: when the Sabeans raided us. They stole all the animals and killed all the farmhands. I am the only one who escaped to tell you."
verses.textEnNasb: and the Sabeans attacked and took them. They also killed the servants with the edge of the sword, and I alone have escaped to tell you."
verses.textEn: and the Sabeans attacked and made off with them. They put the servants to the sword, and I am the only one who has escaped to tell you!"

verses.textZh: 这个人还在说话的时候，又有人来说："神的火从天上降下来，把群羊和仆人都烧光了，只有我一个人逃脱，来向你报告。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这个人还在说话的时候，又有人来说："神的火从天上降下来，把群羊和仆人都烧光了，只有我一个人逃脱，来向你报告。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他还说话的时候，又有人来说：「神从天上降下火来，将群羊和仆人都烧灭了；惟有我一人逃脱，来报信给你。」
verses.textEnNiv: While he was still speaking, another messenger came and said, "The fire of God fell from the heavens and burned up the sheep and the servants, and I am the only one who has escaped to tell you!"
verses.textEnEsv: While he was yet speaking, there came another and said, "The fire of God fell from heaven and burned up the sheep and the servants and consumed them, and I alone have escaped to tell you."
verses.textEnNkjv: While he was still speaking, another also came and said, "The fire of God fell from heaven and burned up the sheep and the servants, and consumed them; and I alone have escaped to tell you!"
verses.textEnNlt: While he was still speaking, another messenger arrived with this news: "The fire of God has fallen from heaven and burned up your sheep and all the shepherds. I am the only one who escaped to tell you."
verses.textEnNasb: While he was still speaking, another came and said, "The fire of God fell from heaven and burned up the sheep and the servants and consumed them, and I alone have escaped to tell you."
verses.textEn: While he was still speaking, another messenger came and said, "The fire of God fell from the heavens and burned up the sheep and the servants, and I am the only one who has escaped to tell you!"

verses.textZh: 他还在说话的时候，又有人来说："迦勒底人分成三队突袭骆驼，把牠们掳去，又用刀杀了仆人，只有我一个人逃脱，来向你报告。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他还在说话的时候，又有人来说："迦勒底人分成三队突袭骆驼，把牠们掳去，又用刀杀了仆人，只有我一个人逃脱，来向你报告。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他还说话的时候，又有人来说：「迦勒底人分作三队忽然闯来，把骆驼掳去，并用刀杀了仆人；惟有我一人逃脱，来报信给你。」
verses.textEnNiv: While he was still speaking, another messenger came and said, "The Chaldeans formed three raiding parties and swept down on your camels and made off with them. They put the servants to the sword, and I am the only one who has escaped to tell you!"
verses.textEnEsv: While he was yet speaking, there came another and said, "The Chaldeans formed three groups and made a raid on the camels and took them and struck down the servants with the edge of the sword, and I alone have escaped to tell you."
verses.textEnNkjv: While he was still speaking, another also came and said, "The Chaldeans formed three bands, raided the camels and took them away, yes, and killed the servants with the edge of the sword; and I alone have escaped to tell you!"
verses.textEnNlt: While he was still speaking, a third messenger arrived with this news: "Three bands of Chaldean raiders have stolen your camels and killed your servants. I am the only one who escaped to tell you."
verses.textEnNasb: While he was still speaking, another came and said, "The Chaldeans formed three units and made a raid on the camels and took them, and killed the servants with the edge of the sword, and I alone have escaped to tell you."
verses.textEn: While he was still speaking, another messenger came and said, "The Chaldeans formed three raiding parties and swept down on your camels and made off with them. They put the servants to the sword, and I am the only one who has escaped to tell you!"

verses.textZh: 他还在说话的时候，又有人来说："你的儿女正在他们长兄的家里吃饭喝酒的时候，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他还在说话的时候，又有人来说："你的儿女正在他们长兄的家里吃饭喝酒的时候，
verses.textZhCuv: 他还说话的时候，又有人来说：「你的儿女正在他们长兄的家里吃饭喝酒，
verses.textEnNiv: While he was still speaking, yet another messenger came and said, "Your sons and daughters were feasting and drinking wine at the oldest brother’s house,
verses.textEnEsv: While he was yet speaking, there came another and said, "Your sons and daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother’s house,
verses.textEnNkjv: While he was still speaking, another also came and said, "Your sons and daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother’s house,
verses.textEnNlt: While he was still speaking, another messenger arrived with this news: "Your sons and daughters were feasting in their oldest brother’s home.
verses.textEnNasb: While he was still speaking, another also came and said, "Your sons and your daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother’s house,
verses.textEn: While he was still speaking, yet another messenger came and said, "Your sons and daughters were feasting and drinking wine at the oldest brother’s house,

verses.textZh: 没想到有一阵狂风，从旷野那边刮来，吹袭房屋的四角，房屋倒塌在年轻人身上，他们就都死了，只有我一个人逃脱，来向你报告。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 没想到有一阵狂风，从旷野那边刮来，吹袭房屋的四角，房屋倒塌在年轻人身上，他们就都死了，只有我一个人逃脱，来向你报告。"
verses.textZhCuv: 不料，有狂风从旷野刮来，击打房屋的四角，房屋倒塌在少年人身上，他们就都死了；惟有我一人逃脱，来报信给你。」
verses.textEnNiv: when suddenly a mighty wind swept in from the desert and struck the four corners of the house. It collapsed on them and they are dead, and I am the only one who has escaped to tell you!"
verses.textEnEsv: and behold, a great wind came across the wilderness and struck the four corners of the house, and it fell upon the young people, and they are dead, and I alone have escaped to tell you."
verses.textEnNkjv: and suddenly a great wind came from across the wilderness and struck the four corners of the house, and it fell on the young people, and they are dead; and I alone have escaped to tell you!"
verses.textEnNlt: Suddenly, a powerful wind swept in from the wilderness and hit the house on all sides. The house collapsed, and all your children are dead. I am the only one who escaped to tell you."
verses.textEnNasb: and behold, a great wind came from across the wilderness and struck the four corners of the house, and it fell on the young people and they died, and I alone have escaped to tell you."
verses.textEn: when suddenly a mighty wind swept in from the desert and struck the four corners of the house. It collapsed on them and they are dead, and I am the only one who has escaped to tell you!"

verses.textZh: 于是约伯起来，撕裂外袍，剃了头，俯伏在地上敬拜，
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是约伯起来，撕裂外袍，剃了头，俯伏在地上敬拜，
verses.textZhCuv: 约伯便起来，撕裂外袍，剃了头，伏在地上下拜，
verses.textEnNiv: At this, Job got up and tore his robe and shaved his head. Then he fell to the ground in worship
verses.textEnEsv: Then Job arose and tore his robe and shaved his head and fell on the ground and worshiped.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Job arose, tore his robe, and shaved his head; and he fell to the ground and worshiped.
verses.textEnNlt: Job stood up and tore his robe in grief. Then he shaved his head and fell to the ground to worship.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Job got up, tore his robe, and shaved his head; then he fell to the ground and worshiped.
verses.textEn: At this, Job got up and tore his robe and shaved his head. Then he fell to the ground in worship

verses.textZh: 说： "我赤身出于母胎， 也必赤身归去。 赏赐的是耶和华，收回的也是耶和华； 耶和华的名是应当称颂的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 说： "我赤身出于母胎， 也必赤身归去。 赏赐的是耶和华，收回的也是耶和华； 耶和华的名是应当称颂的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 说：「我赤身出于母胎，也必赤身归回；赏赐的是耶和华，收取的也是耶和华。耶和华的名是应当称颂的。」
verses.textEnNiv: and said: "Naked I came from my mother’s womb, and naked I will depart. The Lord gave and the Lord has taken away; may the name of the Lord be praised."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "Naked I came from my mother’s womb, and naked shall I return. The Lord gave, and the Lord has taken away; blessed be the name of the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said: "Naked I came from my mother’s womb, And naked shall I return there. The Lord gave, and the Lord has taken away; Blessed be the name of the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: He said, "I came naked from my mother’s womb, and I will be naked when I leave. The Lord gave me what I had, and the Lord has taken it away. Praise the name of the Lord !"
verses.textEnNasb: He said, "Naked I came from my mother’s womb, And naked I shall return there. The Lord gave and the Lord has taken away. Blessed be the name of the Lord."
verses.textEn: and said: "Naked I came from my mother’s womb, and naked I will depart. The Lord gave and the Lord has taken away; may the name of the Lord be praised."

verses.textZh: 在这一切事上，约伯并没有犯罪，也没有归咎于神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在这一切事上，约伯并没有犯罪，也没有归咎于神。
verses.textZhCuv: 在这一切的事上约伯并不犯罪，也不以神为愚妄 。
verses.textEnNiv: In all this, Job did not sin by charging God with wrongdoing.
verses.textEnEsv: In all this Job did not sin or charge God with wrong.
verses.textEnNkjv: In all this Job did not sin nor charge God with wrong.
verses.textEnNlt: In all of this, Job did not sin by blaming God.
verses.textEnNasb: Despite all this, Job did not sin, nor did he blame God.
verses.textEn: In all this, Job did not sin by charging God with wrongdoing.

verses.textZh: 又有一天，神的众子都来侍立在耶和华面前，撒但也来到他们中间，侍立在耶和华面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有一天，神的众子都来侍立在耶和华面前，撒但也来到他们中间，侍立在耶和华面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 又有一天，神的众子来侍立在耶和华面前，撒但也来在其中。
verses.textEnNiv: On another day the angels came to present themselves before the Lord , and Satan also came with them to present himself before him.
verses.textEnEsv: Again there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the Lord , and Satan also came among them to present himself before the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Again there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the Lord, and Satan came also among them to present himself before the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: One day the members of the heavenly court came again to present themselves before the Lord , and the Accuser, Satan, came with them.
verses.textEnNasb: Again, there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the Lord, and Satan also came among them to present himself before the Lord.
verses.textEn: On another day the angels came to present themselves before the Lord , and Satan also came with them to present himself before him.

verses.textZh: 耶和华问撒但："你从哪里来？"撒但回答说："我在地上徘徊，走来走去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华问撒但："你从哪里来？"撒但回答说："我在地上徘徊，走来走去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华问撒但说：「你从哪里来？」撒但回答说：「我从地上走来走去，往返而来。」
verses.textEnNiv: And the Lord said to Satan, "Where have you come from?" Satan answered the Lord , "From roaming throughout the earth, going back and forth on it."
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Satan, "From where have you come?" Satan answered the Lord and said, "From going to and fro on the earth, and from walking up and down on it."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said to Satan, "From where do you come?" Satan answered the Lord and said, "From going to and fro on the earth, and from walking back and forth on it."
verses.textEnNlt: "Where have you come from?" the Lord asked Satan. Satan answered the Lord , "I have been patrolling the earth, watching everything that’s going on."
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord said to Satan, "Where have you come from?" Then Satan answered the Lord and said, "From roaming about on the earth and walking around on it."
verses.textEn: And the Lord said to Satan, "Where have you come from?" Satan answered the Lord , "From roaming throughout the earth, going back and forth on it."

verses.textZh: 耶和华问撒但："你有没有注意到我的仆人约伯？世上再也没有一个人像他那样完全、正直，敬畏神，远离罪恶。虽然你挑拨我与他作对，无缘无故使他倾家荡产，他还是坚守自己的纯全。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华问撒但："你有没有注意到我的仆人约伯？世上再也没有一个人像他那样完全、正直，敬畏神，远离罪恶。虽然你挑拨我与他作对，无缘无故使他倾家荡产，他还是坚守自己的纯全。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华问撒但说：「你曾用心察看我的仆人约伯没有？地上再没有人像他完全正直，敬畏神，远离恶事。你虽激动我攻击他，无故地毁灭他，他仍然持守他的纯正。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Satan, "Have you considered my servant Job? There is no one on earth like him; he is blameless and upright, a man who fears God and shuns evil. And he still maintains his integrity, though you incited me against him to ruin him without any reason."
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Satan, "Have you considered my servant Job, that there is none like him on the earth, a blameless and upright man, who fears God and turns away from evil? He still holds fast his integrity, although you incited me against him to destroy him without reason."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to Satan, "Have you considered My servant Job, that thereis none like him on the earth, a blameless and upright man, one who fears God and shuns evil? And still he holds fast to his integrity, although you incited Me against him, to destroy him without cause."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord asked Satan, "Have you noticed my servant Job? He is the finest man in all the earth. He is blameless—a man of complete integrity. He fears God and stays away from evil. And he has maintained his integrity, even though you urged me to harm him without cause."
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord said to Satan, "Have you considered My servant Job? For there is no one like him on the earth, a blameless and upright man fearing God and turning away from evil. And he still holds firm to his integrity, although you incited Me against him to ruin him without cause."
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Satan, "Have you considered my servant Job? There is no one on earth like him; he is blameless and upright, a man who fears God and shuns evil. And he still maintains his integrity, though you incited me against him to ruin him without any reason."

verses.textZh: 撒但回答耶和华说："人以皮换皮，宁可付出他所有的一切去保命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒但回答耶和华说："人以皮换皮，宁可付出他所有的一切去保命。
verses.textZhCuv: 撒但回答耶和华说：「人以皮代皮，情愿舍去一切所有的，保全性命。
verses.textEnNiv: "Skin for skin!" Satan replied. "A man will give all he has for his own life.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Satan answered the Lord and said, "Skin for skin! All that a man has he will give for his life.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Satan answered the Lord and said, "Skin for skin! Yes, all that a man has he will give for his life.
verses.textEnNlt: Satan replied to the Lord , "Skin for skin! A man will give up everything he has to save his life.
verses.textEnNasb: Satan answered the Lord and said, "Skin for skin! Yes, all that a man has, he will give for his life.
verses.textEn: "Skin for skin!" Satan replied. "A man will give all he has for his own life.

verses.textZh: 只要你伸手伤害他的骨和肉，他一定当面亵渎你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 只要你伸手伤害他的骨和肉，他一定当面亵渎你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你且伸手伤他的骨头和他的肉，他必当面弃掉你。」
verses.textEnNiv: But now stretch out your hand and strike his flesh and bones, and he will surely curse you to your face."
verses.textEnEsv: But stretch out your hand and touch his bone and his flesh, and he will curse you to your face."
verses.textEnNkjv: But stretch out Your hand now, and touch his bone and his flesh, and he will surely curse You to Your face!"
verses.textEnNlt: But reach out and take away his health, and he will surely curse you to your face!"
verses.textEnNasb: However, reach out with Your hand now, and touch his bone and his flesh; he will curse You to Your face!"
verses.textEn: But now stretch out your hand and strike his flesh and bones, and he will surely curse you to your face."

verses.textZh: 耶和华对撒但说："好吧，他在你手中，不过，要留存他的命。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对撒但说："好吧，他在你手中，不过，要留存他的命。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对撒但说：「他在你手中，只要存留他的性命。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Satan, "Very well, then, he is in your hands; but you must spare his life."
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Satan, "Behold, he is in your hand; only spare his life."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said to Satan, "Behold, he is in your hand, but spare his life."
verses.textEnNlt: "All right, do with him as you please," the Lord said to Satan. "But spare his life."
verses.textEnNasb: So the Lord said to Satan, "Behold, he is in your power, only spare his life."
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Satan, "Very well, then, he is in your hands; but you must spare his life."

verses.textZh: 于是撒但从耶和华面前退去，击打约伯，使他从脚掌到头顶都生了毒疮。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是撒但从耶和华面前退去，击打约伯，使他从脚掌到头顶都生了毒疮。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是撒但从耶和华面前退去，击打约伯，使他从脚掌到头顶长毒疮。
verses.textEnNiv: So Satan went out from the presence of the Lord and afflicted Job with painful sores from the soles of his feet to the crown of his head.
verses.textEnEsv: So Satan went out from the presence of the Lord and struck Job with loathsome sores from the sole of his foot to the crown of his head.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Satan went out from the presence of the Lord, and struck Job with painful boils from the sole of his foot to the crown of his head.
verses.textEnNlt: So Satan left the Lord ’s presence, and he struck Job with terrible boils from head to foot.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Satan went out from the presence of the Lord and struck Job with severe boils from the sole of his foot to the top of his head.
verses.textEn: So Satan went out from the presence of the Lord and afflicted Job with painful sores from the soles of his feet to the crown of his head.

verses.textZh: 约伯坐在灰烬中，拿瓦片刮自己。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约伯坐在灰烬中，拿瓦片刮自己。
verses.textZhCuv: 约伯就坐在炉灰中，拿瓦片刮身体。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Job took a piece of broken pottery and scraped himself with it as he sat among the ashes.
verses.textEnEsv: And he took a piece of broken pottery with which to scrape himself while he sat in the ashes.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he took for himself a potsherd with which to scrape himself while he sat in the midst of the ashes.
verses.textEnNlt: Job scraped his skin with a piece of broken pottery as he sat among the ashes.
verses.textEnNasb: And Job took a piece of pottery to scrape himself while he was sitting in the ashes.
verses.textEn: Then Job took a piece of broken pottery and scraped himself with it as he sat among the ashes.

verses.textZh: 他妻子对他说："难道你还要坚守自己的纯全吗？你不如放弃神，死掉算了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他妻子对他说："难道你还要坚守自己的纯全吗？你不如放弃神，死掉算了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他的妻子对他说：「你仍然持守你的纯正吗？你弃掉神，死了吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: His wife said to him, "Are you still maintaining your integrity? Curse God and die!"
verses.textEnEsv: Then his wife said to him, "Do you still hold fast your integrity? Curse God and die."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then his wife said to him, "Do you still hold fast to your integrity? Curse God and die!"
verses.textEnNlt: His wife said to him, "Are you still trying to maintain your integrity? Curse God and die."
verses.textEnNasb: Then his wife said to him, "Do you still hold firm your integrity? Curse God and die!"
verses.textEn: His wife said to him, "Are you still maintaining your integrity? Curse God and die!"

verses.textZh: 可是约伯对她说："你说话像个愚妄的女人。难道我们从神得福，也不应当受祸吗？"在这一切事上，约伯并没有用口犯罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是约伯对她说："你说话像个愚妄的女人。难道我们从神得福，也不应当受祸吗？"在这一切事上，约伯并没有用口犯罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 约伯却对她说：「你说话像愚顽的妇人一样。嗳！难道我们从神手里得福，不也受祸吗？」在这一切的事上约伯并不以口犯罪。
verses.textEnNiv: He replied, "You are talking like a foolish woman. Shall we accept good from God, and not trouble?" In all this, Job did not sin in what he said.
verses.textEnEsv: But he said to her, "You speak as one of the foolish women would speak. Shall we receive good from God, and shall we not receive evil?" In all this Job did not sin with his lips.
verses.textEnNkjv: But he said to her, "You speak as one of the foolish women speaks. Shall we indeed accept good from God, and shall we not accept adversity?" In all this Job did not sin with his lips.
verses.textEnNlt: But Job replied, "You talk like a foolish woman. Should we accept only good things from the hand of God and never anything bad?" So in all this, Job said nothing wrong.
verses.textEnNasb: But he said to her, "You are speaking as one of the foolish women speaks. Shall we actually accept good from God but not accept adversity?" Despite all this, Job did not sin with his lips.
verses.textEn: He replied, "You are talking like a foolish woman. Shall we accept good from God, and not trouble?" In all this, Job did not sin in what he said.

verses.textZh: 约伯的三个朋友，提幔人以利法、书亚人比勒达、拿玛人琐法，听到这一切降在他身上的灾祸，就各从自己的地方出发，相约而来对他表同情，安慰他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约伯的三个朋友，提幔人以利法、书亚人比勒达、拿玛人琐法，听到这一切降在他身上的灾祸，就各从自己的地方出发，相约而来对他表同情，安慰他。
verses.textZhCuv: 约伯的三个朋友－提幔人以利法、书亚人比勒达、拿玛人琐法－听说有这一切的灾祸临到他身上，各人就从本处约会同来，为他悲伤，安慰他。
verses.textEnNiv: When Job’s three friends, Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite, heard about all the troubles that had come upon him, they set out from their homes and met together by agreement to go and sympathize with him and comfort him.
verses.textEnEsv: Now when Job’s three friends heard of all this evil that had come upon him, they came each from his own place, Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite. They made an appointment together to come to show him sympathy and comfort him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when Job’s three friends heard of all this adversity that had come upon him, each one came from his own place—Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite. For they had made an appointment together to come and mourn with him, and to comfort him.
verses.textEnNlt: When three of Job’s friends heard of the tragedy he had suffered, they got together and traveled from their homes to comfort and console him. Their names were Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when Job’s three friends heard about all this adversity that had come upon him, they came, each one from his own place—Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite; and they made an appointment together to come to sympathize with him and comfort him.
verses.textEn: When Job’s three friends, Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite, heard about all the troubles that had come upon him, they set out from their homes and met together by agreement to go and sympathize with him and comfort him.

verses.textZh: 他们从远处举目观望，竟认不出他来，就放声大哭，各自撕裂外袍，向天扬起尘土，落在自己头上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们从远处举目观望，竟认不出他来，就放声大哭，各自撕裂外袍，向天扬起尘土，落在自己头上。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们远远地举目观看，认不出他来，就放声大哭。各人撕裂外袍，把尘土向天扬起来，落在自己的头上。
verses.textEnNiv: When they saw him from a distance, they could hardly recognize him; they began to weep aloud, and they tore their robes and sprinkled dust on their heads.
verses.textEnEsv: And when they saw him from a distance, they did not recognize him. And they raised their voices and wept, and they tore their robes and sprinkled dust on their heads toward heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when they raised their eyes from afar, and did not recognize him, they lifted their voices and wept; and each one tore his robe and sprinkled dust on his head toward heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: When they saw Job from a distance, they scarcely recognized him. Wailing loudly, they tore their robes and threw dust into the air over their heads to show their grief.
verses.textEnNasb: When they looked from a distance and did not recognize him, they raised their voices and wept. And each of them tore his robe, and they threw dust over their heads toward the sky.
verses.textEn: When they saw him from a distance, they could hardly recognize him; they began to weep aloud, and they tore their robes and sprinkled dust on their heads.

verses.textZh: 他们就七天七夜与他一起坐在地上，没有人向他说一句话，因为他们看出他极其痛苦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就七天七夜与他一起坐在地上，没有人向他说一句话，因为他们看出他极其痛苦。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就同他七天七夜坐在地上，一个人也不向他说句话，因为他极其痛苦。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they sat on the ground with him for seven days and seven nights. No one said a word to him, because they saw how great his suffering was.
verses.textEnEsv: And they sat with him on the ground seven days and seven nights, and no one spoke a word to him, for they saw that his suffering was very great.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they sat down with him on the ground seven days and seven nights, and no one spoke a word to him, for they saw that his grief was very great.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they sat on the ground with him for seven days and nights. No one said a word to Job, for they saw that his suffering was too great for words.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they sat down on the ground with him for seven days and seven nights, with no one speaking a word to him, for they saw that his pain was very great.
verses.textEn: Then they sat on the ground with him for seven days and seven nights. No one said a word to him, because they saw how great his suffering was.

verses.textZh: 后来，约伯开口咒诅自己的生日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来，约伯开口咒诅自己的生日。
verses.textZhCuv: 此后，约伯开口咒诅自己的生日，
verses.textEnNiv: After this, Job opened his mouth and cursed the day of his birth.
verses.textEnEsv: After this Job opened his mouth and cursed the day of his birth.
verses.textEnNkjv: After this Job opened his mouth and cursed the day of his birth.
verses.textEnNlt: At last Job spoke, and he cursed the day of his birth.
verses.textEnNasb: Afterward Job opened his mouth and cursed the day of his birth.
verses.textEn: After this, Job opened his mouth and cursed the day of his birth.

verses.textZh: 约伯说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 约伯说：
verses.textZhCuv: 说：
verses.textEnNiv: He said:
verses.textEnEsv: And Job said:
verses.textEnNkjv: And Job spoke, and said:
verses.textEnNlt: He said:
verses.textEnNasb: And Job said,
verses.textEn: He said:

verses.textZh: "愿我生的那日泯灭， 人说怀男胎的那夜灭没。
verses.textZhCnvs: "愿我生的那日泯灭， 人说怀男胎的那夜灭没。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿我生的那日 和说怀了男胎的那夜都灭没。
verses.textEnNiv: "May the day of my birth perish, and the night that said, ‘A boy is conceived!’
verses.textEnEsv: "Let the day perish on which I was born, and the night that said, ‘A man is conceived.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "May the day perish on which I was born, And the night inwhich it was said, ‘A male child is conceived.’
verses.textEnNlt: "Let the day of my birth be erased, and the night I was conceived.
verses.textEnNasb: "May the day on which I was to be born perish, As well as the night which said, ‘A boy is conceived.’
verses.textEn: "May the day of my birth perish, and the night that said, ‘A boy is conceived!’

verses.textZh: 愿那日变成黑暗， 愿神不从上面眷顾， 愿光明不照耀在其上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿那日变成黑暗， 愿神不从上面眷顾， 愿光明不照耀在其上。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿那日变为黑暗； 愿神不从上面寻找它； 愿亮光不照于其上。
verses.textEnNiv: That day—may it turn to darkness; may God above not care about it; may no light shine on it.
verses.textEnEsv: Let that day be darkness! May God above not seek it, nor light shine upon it.
verses.textEnNkjv: May that day be darkness; May God above not seek it, Nor the light shine upon it.
verses.textEnNlt: Let that day be turned to darkness. Let it be lost even to God on high, and let no light shine on it.
verses.textEnNasb: "May that day be darkness; May God above not care for it, Nor light shine on it.
verses.textEn: That day—may it turn to darkness; may God above not care about it; may no light shine on it.

verses.textZh: 愿黑暗与死荫索讨那日， 愿密云停留在上面， 愿白天的昏黑惊吓它。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿黑暗与死荫索讨那日， 愿密云停留在上面， 愿白天的昏黑惊吓它。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿黑暗和死荫索取那日； 愿密云停在其上； 愿日蚀恐吓它。
verses.textEnNiv: May gloom and utter darkness claim it once more; may a cloud settle over it; may blackness overwhelm it.
verses.textEnEsv: Let gloom and deep darkness claim it. Let clouds dwell upon it; let the blackness of the day terrify it.
verses.textEnNkjv: May darkness and the shadow of death claim it; May a cloud settle on it; May the blackness of the day terrify it.
verses.textEnNlt: Let the darkness and utter gloom claim that day for its own. Let a black cloud overshadow it, and let the darkness terrify it.
verses.textEnNasb: "May darkness and black gloom claim it; May a cloud settle on it; May the blackness of the day terrify it.
verses.textEn: May gloom and utter darkness claim it once more; may a cloud settle over it; may blackness overwhelm it.

verses.textZh: 愿那夜被幽暗夺去， 不让它连在平日之中，列入月数之内。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿那夜被幽暗夺去， 不让它连在平日之中，列入月数之内。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿那夜被幽暗夺取， 不在年中的日子同乐， 也不入月中的数目。
verses.textEnNiv: That night—may thick darkness seize it; may it not be included among the days of the year nor be entered in any of the months.
verses.textEnEsv: That night—let thick darkness seize it! Let it not rejoice among the days of the year; let it not come into the number of the months.
verses.textEnNkjv: Asfor that night, may darkness seize it; May it not rejoice among the days of the year, May it not come into the number of the months.
verses.textEnNlt: Let that night be blotted off the calendar, never again to be counted among the days of the year, never again to appear among the months.
verses.textEnNasb: "As for that night, may darkness seize it; May it not rejoice among the days of the year; May it not come into the number of the months.
verses.textEn: That night—may thick darkness seize it; may it not be included among the days of the year nor be entered in any of the months.

verses.textZh: 愿那夜没有生育， 也没有欢乐的声音。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿那夜没有生育， 也没有欢乐的声音。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿那夜没有生育， 其间也没有欢乐的声音。
verses.textEnNiv: May that night be barren; may no shout of joy be heard in it.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, let that night be barren; let no joyful cry enter it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, may that night be barren! May no joyful shout come into it!
verses.textEnNlt: Let that night be childless. Let it have no joy.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, may that night be barren; May no joyful shout enter it.
verses.textEn: May that night be barren; may no shout of joy be heard in it.

verses.textZh: 那些咒诅日子、善于惹动海怪的， 愿他们咒诅那夜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些咒诅日子、善于惹动海怪的， 愿他们咒诅那夜。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿那咒诅日子且能惹动鳄鱼的 咒诅那夜。
verses.textEnNiv: May those who curse days curse that day, those who are ready to rouse Leviathan.
verses.textEnEsv: Let those curse it who curse the day, who are ready to rouse up Leviathan.
verses.textEnNkjv: May those curse it who curse the day, Those who are ready to arouse Leviathan.
verses.textEnNlt: Let those who are experts at cursing— whose cursing could rouse Leviathan — curse that day.
verses.textEnNasb: "May those curse it who curse the day, Who are prepared to disturb Leviathan.
verses.textEn: May those who curse days curse that day, those who are ready to rouse Leviathan.

verses.textZh: 愿那夜黎明的星星变成黑暗， 愿那夜等候发光却不亮，见不到清晨的曙光。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿那夜黎明的星星变成黑暗， 愿那夜等候发光却不亮，见不到清晨的曙光。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿那夜黎明的星宿变为黑暗， 盼亮却不亮， 也不见早晨的光线 ；
verses.textEnNiv: May its morning stars become dark; may it wait for daylight in vain and not see the first rays of dawn,
verses.textEnEsv: Let the stars of its dawn be dark; let it hope for light, but have none, nor see the eyelids of the morning,
verses.textEnNkjv: May the stars of its morning be dark; May it look for light, but have none, And not see the dawning of the day;
verses.textEnNlt: Let its morning stars remain dark. Let it hope for light, but in vain; may it never see the morning light.
verses.textEnNasb: "May the stars of its twilight be darkened; May it wait for light but have none, And may it not see the breaking dawn;
verses.textEn: May its morning stars become dark; may it wait for daylight in vain and not see the first rays of dawn,

verses.textZh: 因为那夜没有把我母胎的门关闭， 也没有把苦难隐藏，使我看不见。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为那夜没有把我母胎的门关闭， 也没有把苦难隐藏，使我看不见。
verses.textZhCuv: 因没有把怀我胎的门关闭， 也没有将患难对我的眼隐藏。
verses.textEnNiv: for it did not shut the doors of the womb on me to hide trouble from my eyes.
verses.textEnEsv: because it did not shut the doors of my mother’s womb, nor hide trouble from my eyes.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because it did not shut up the doors of my mother’s womb, Nor hide sorrow from my eyes.
verses.textEnNlt: Curse that day for failing to shut my mother’s womb, for letting me be born to see all this trouble.
verses.textEnNasb: Because it did not shut the opening of my mother’s womb, Or hide trouble from my eyes.
verses.textEn: for it did not shut the doors of the womb on me to hide trouble from my eyes.

verses.textZh: 我为甚么不一离母胎就死去？ 我为甚么不一出母腹就断气？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我为甚么不一离母胎就死去？ 我为甚么不一出母腹就断气？
verses.textZhCuv: 我为何不出母胎而死？ 为何不出母腹绝气？
verses.textEnNiv: "Why did I not perish at birth, and die as I came from the womb?
verses.textEnEsv: "Why did I not die at birth, come out from the womb and expire?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Why did I not die at birth? Why did I not perish when I came from the womb?
verses.textEnNlt: "Why wasn’t I born dead? Why didn’t I die as I came from the womb?
verses.textEnNasb: "Why did I not die at birth, Come out of the womb and pass away?
verses.textEn: "Why did I not perish at birth, and die as I came from the womb?

verses.textZh: 为甚么有膝承接我？ 为甚么有乳哺养我？
verses.textZhCnvs: 为甚么有膝承接我？ 为甚么有乳哺养我？
verses.textZhCuv: 为何有膝接收我？ 为何有奶哺养我？
verses.textEnNiv: Why were there knees to receive me and breasts that I might be nursed?
verses.textEnEsv: Why did the knees receive me? Or why the breasts, that I should nurse?
verses.textEnNkjv: Why did the knees receive me? Or why the breasts, that I should nurse?
verses.textEnNlt: Why was I laid on my mother’s lap? Why did she nurse me at her breasts?
verses.textEnNasb: "Why were the knees there in front of me, And why the breasts, that I would nurse?
verses.textEn: Why were there knees to receive me and breasts that I might be nursed?

verses.textZh: 不然，我早已躺下安息，
verses.textZhCnvs: 不然，我早已躺下安息，
verses.textZhCuv: 不然，我就早已躺卧安睡，
verses.textEnNiv: For now I would be lying down in peace; I would be asleep and at rest
verses.textEnEsv: For then I would have lain down and been quiet; I would have slept; then I would have been at rest,
verses.textEnNkjv: For now I would have lain still and been quiet, I would have been asleep; Then I would have been at rest
verses.textEnNlt: Had I died at birth, I would now be at peace. I would be asleep and at rest.
verses.textEnNasb: "For now I would have lain down and been quiet; I would have slept then, I would have been at rest,
verses.textEn: For now I would be lying down in peace; I would be asleep and at rest

verses.textZh: 与世上那些为自己建造陵墓的君王和谋士同睡，
verses.textZhCnvs: 与世上那些为自己建造陵墓的君王和谋士同睡，
verses.textZhCuv: 和地上为自己重造荒邱的君王、谋士，
verses.textEnNiv: with kings and rulers of the earth, who built for themselves places now lying in ruins,
verses.textEnEsv: with kings and counselors of the earth who rebuilt ruins for themselves,
verses.textEnNkjv: With kings and counselors of the earth, Who built ruins for themselves,
verses.textEnNlt: I would rest with the world’s kings and prime ministers, whose great buildings now lie in ruins.
verses.textEnNasb: With kings and counselors of the earth, Who rebuilt ruins for themselves;
verses.textEn: with kings and rulers of the earth, who built for themselves places now lying in ruins,

verses.textZh: 或与那些拥有黄金，房屋装满银子的王侯同眠。
verses.textZhCnvs: 或与那些拥有黄金，房屋装满银子的王侯同眠。
verses.textZhCuv: 或与有金子、将银子装满了房屋的王子 一同安息；
verses.textEnNiv: with princes who had gold, who filled their houses with silver.
verses.textEnEsv: or with princes who had gold, who filled their houses with silver.
verses.textEnNkjv: Or with princes who had gold, Who filled their houses with silver;
verses.textEnNlt: I would rest with princes, rich in gold, whose palaces were filled with silver.
verses.textEnNasb: Or with rulers who had gold, Who were filling their houses with silver.
verses.textEn: with princes who had gold, who filled their houses with silver.

verses.textZh: 我为甚么不像暗中流产的胎，未见天日的婴孩，归于无有呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我为甚么不像暗中流产的胎，未见天日的婴孩，归于无有呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 或像隐而未现、不到期而落的胎， 归于无有，如同未见光的婴孩。
verses.textEnNiv: Or why was I not hidden away in the ground like a stillborn child, like an infant who never saw the light of day?
verses.textEnEsv: Or why was I not as a hidden stillborn child, as infants who never see the light?
verses.textEnNkjv: Or why was I not hidden like a stillborn child, Like infants who never saw light?
verses.textEnNlt: Why wasn’t I buried like a stillborn child, like a baby who never lives to see the light?
verses.textEnNasb: "Or like a miscarriage which is hidden, I would not exist, As infants that never saw light.
verses.textEn: Or why was I not hidden away in the ground like a stillborn child, like an infant who never saw the light of day?

verses.textZh: 在那里，恶人止息搅扰， 筋疲力尽的得安息；
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那里，恶人止息搅扰， 筋疲力尽的得安息；
verses.textZhCuv: 在那里恶人止息搅扰， 困乏人得享安息，
verses.textEnNiv: There the wicked cease from turmoil, and there the weary are at rest.
verses.textEnEsv: There the wicked cease from troubling, and there the weary are at rest.
verses.textEnNkjv: There the wicked cease from troubling, And there the weary are at rest.
verses.textEnNlt: For in death the wicked cause no trouble, and the weary are at rest.
verses.textEnNasb: "There the wicked cease from raging, And there the weary are at rest.
verses.textEn: There the wicked cease from turmoil, and there the weary are at rest.

verses.textZh: 被囚的同享安宁； 听不见督工的声音；
verses.textZhCnvs: 被囚的同享安宁； 听不见督工的声音；
verses.textZhCuv: 被囚的人同得安逸， 不听见督工的声音。
verses.textEnNiv: Captives also enjoy their ease; they no longer hear the slave driver’s shout.
verses.textEnEsv: There the prisoners are at ease together; they hear not the voice of the taskmaster.
verses.textEnNkjv: There the prisoners rest together; They do not hear the voice of the oppressor.
verses.textEnNlt: Even captives are at ease in death, with no guards to curse them.
verses.textEnNasb: "The prisoners are at ease together; They do not hear the voice of the taskmaster.
verses.textEn: Captives also enjoy their ease; they no longer hear the slave driver’s shout.

verses.textZh: 老少尊卑都在那里， 奴仆脱离主人的辖制。
verses.textZhCnvs: 老少尊卑都在那里， 奴仆脱离主人的辖制。
verses.textZhCuv: 大小都在那里； 奴仆脱离主人的辖制。
verses.textEnNiv: The small and the great are there, and the slaves are freed from their owners.
verses.textEnEsv: The small and the great are there, and the slave is free from his master.
verses.textEnNkjv: The small and great are there, And the servant is free from his master.
verses.textEnNlt: Rich and poor are both there, and the slave is free from his master.
verses.textEnNasb: "The small and the great are there, And the slave is free from his master.
verses.textEn: The small and the great are there, and the slaves are freed from their owners.

verses.textZh: 为甚么有光明赐给劳碌的人， 有生命赐给苦命的人呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 为甚么有光明赐给劳碌的人， 有生命赐给苦命的人呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 受患难的人为何有光赐给他呢？ 心中愁苦的人为何有生命赐给他呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "Why is light given to those in misery, and life to the bitter of soul,
verses.textEnEsv: "Why is light given to him who is in misery, and life to the bitter in soul,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Why is light given to him who is in misery, And life to the bitter of soul,
verses.textEnNlt: "Oh, why give light to those in misery, and life to those who are bitter?
verses.textEnNasb: "Why is light given to one burdened with grief, And life to the bitter of soul,
verses.textEn: "Why is light given to those in misery, and life to the bitter of soul,

verses.textZh: 他们想死却死不了，找死胜于找宝藏；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们想死却死不了，找死胜于找宝藏；
verses.textZhCuv: 他们切望死，却不得死； 求死，胜于求隐藏的珍宝。
verses.textEnNiv: to those who long for death that does not come, who search for it more than for hidden treasure,
verses.textEnEsv: who long for death, but it comes not, and dig for it more than for hidden treasures,
verses.textEnNkjv: Who long for death, but it does not come, And search for it more than hidden treasures;
verses.textEnNlt: They long for death, and it won’t come. They search for death more eagerly than for hidden treasure.
verses.textEnNasb: Who long for death, but there is none, And dig for it more than for hidden treasures;
verses.textEn: to those who long for death that does not come, who search for it more than for hidden treasure,

verses.textZh: 他们找到坟墓就高兴，非常欢喜快乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们找到坟墓就高兴，非常欢喜快乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们寻见坟墓就快乐， 极其欢喜。
verses.textEnNiv: who are filled with gladness and rejoice when they reach the grave?
verses.textEnEsv: who rejoice exceedingly and are glad when they find the grave?
verses.textEnNkjv: Who rejoice exceedingly, And are glad when they can find the grave?
verses.textEnNlt: They’re filled with joy when they finally die, and rejoice when they find the grave.
verses.textEnNasb: Who are filled with jubilation, And rejoice when they find the grave?
verses.textEn: who are filled with gladness and rejoice when they reach the grave?

verses.textZh: 为甚么有生命赐给前途茫茫，又被神四面围困的人呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 为甚么有生命赐给前途茫茫，又被神四面围困的人呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 人的道路既然遮隐，神又把他四面围困， 为何有光赐给他呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Why is life given to a man whose way is hidden, whom God has hedged in?
verses.textEnEsv: Why is light given to a man whose way is hidden, whom God has hedged in?
verses.textEnNkjv: Whyislightgiven to a man whose way is hidden, And whom God has hedged in?
verses.textEnNlt: Why is life given to those with no future, those God has surrounded with difficulties?
verses.textEnNasb: "Why is light given to a man whose way is hidden, And whom God has shut off?
verses.textEn: Why is life given to a man whose way is hidden, whom God has hedged in?

verses.textZh: 我以叹息代替食物， 我唉哼的声音如水涌出。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我以叹息代替食物， 我唉哼的声音如水涌出。
verses.textZhCuv: 我未曾吃饭就发出叹息； 我唉哼的声音涌出如水。
verses.textEnNiv: For sighing has become my daily food; my groans pour out like water.
verses.textEnEsv: For my sighing comes instead of my bread, and my groanings are poured out like water.
verses.textEnNkjv: For my sighing comes before I eat, And my groanings pour out like water.
verses.textEnNlt: I cannot eat for sighing; my groans pour out like water.
verses.textEnNasb: "For my groaning comes at the sight of my food, And my cries pour out like water.
verses.textEn: For sighing has become my daily food; my groans pour out like water.

verses.textZh: 我所惧怕的临到我， 我所惊恐的向我而来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我所惧怕的临到我， 我所惊恐的向我而来。
verses.textZhCuv: 因我所恐惧的临到我身， 我所惧怕的迎我而来。
verses.textEnNiv: What I feared has come upon me; what I dreaded has happened to me.
verses.textEnEsv: For the thing that I fear comes upon me, and what I dread befalls me.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the thing I greatly feared has come upon me, And what I dreaded has happened to me.
verses.textEnNlt: What I always feared has happened to me. What I dreaded has come true.
verses.textEnNasb: "For what I fear comes upon me, And what I dread encounters me.
verses.textEn: What I feared has come upon me; what I dreaded has happened to me.

verses.textZh: 我不得安逸，不得安静， 也不得安息，却有搅扰来到。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我不得安逸，不得安静， 也不得安息，却有搅扰来到。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我不得安逸，不得平静， 也不得安息，却有患难来到。
verses.textEnNiv: I have no peace, no quietness; I have no rest, but only turmoil."
verses.textEnEsv: I am not at ease, nor am I quiet; I have no rest, but trouble comes."
verses.textEnNkjv: I am not at ease, nor am I quiet; I have no rest, for trouble comes."
verses.textEnNlt: I have no peace, no quietness. I have no rest; only trouble comes."
verses.textEnNasb: "I am not at ease, nor am I quiet, And I am not at rest, but turmoil comes."
verses.textEn: I have no peace, no quietness; I have no rest, but only turmoil."

verses.textZh: 提幔人以利法回答说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 提幔人以利法回答说：
verses.textZhCuv: 提幔人以利法回答说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then Eliphaz the Temanite replied:
verses.textEnEsv: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said:
verses.textEnNlt: Then Eliphaz the Temanite replied to Job:
verses.textEnNasb: Then Eliphaz the Temanite responded,
verses.textEn: Then Eliphaz the Temanite replied:

verses.textZh: "人若对你说一句话，你就厌烦吗？ 但谁又忍得住不说话呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: "人若对你说一句话，你就厌烦吗？ 但谁又忍得住不说话呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 人若想与你说话，你就厌烦吗？ 但谁能忍住不说呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "If someone ventures a word with you, will you be impatient? But who can keep from speaking?
verses.textEnEsv: "If one ventures a word with you, will you be impatient? Yet who can keep from speaking?
verses.textEnNkjv: "If one attempts a word with you, will you become weary? But who can withhold himself from speaking?
verses.textEnNlt: "Will you be patient and let me say a word? For who could keep from speaking out?
verses.textEnNasb: "If one ventures a word with you, will you become impatient? But who can refrain from speaking?
verses.textEn: "If someone ventures a word with you, will you be impatient? But who can keep from speaking?

verses.textZh: 你曾经教过许多人， 又坚固了无力的手；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你曾经教过许多人， 又坚固了无力的手；
verses.textZhCuv: 你素来教导许多的人， 又坚固软弱的手。
verses.textEnNiv: Think how you have instructed many, how you have strengthened feeble hands.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, you have instructed many, and you have strengthened the weak hands.
verses.textEnNkjv: Surely you have instructed many, And you have strengthened weak hands.
verses.textEnNlt: "In the past you have encouraged many people; you have strengthened those who were weak.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, you have taught many, And you have strengthened weak hands.
verses.textEn: Think how you have instructed many, how you have strengthened feeble hands.

verses.textZh: 你的话扶起了绊倒的人， 你使弯曲乏力的膝坚挺。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的话扶起了绊倒的人， 你使弯曲乏力的膝坚挺。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的言语曾扶助那将要跌倒的人； 你又使软弱的膝稳固。
verses.textEnNiv: Your words have supported those who stumbled; you have strengthened faltering knees.
verses.textEnEsv: Your words have upheld him who was stumbling, and you have made firm the feeble knees.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your words have upheld him who was stumbling, And you have strengthened the feeble knees;
verses.textEnNlt: Your words have supported those who were falling; you encouraged those with shaky knees.
verses.textEnNasb: "Your words have helped the stumbling to stand, And you have strengthened feeble knees.
verses.textEn: Your words have supported those who stumbled; you have strengthened faltering knees.

verses.textZh: 但现在祸患临到你，你就灰心， 灾祸遇上你，你就惊惶沮丧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但现在祸患临到你，你就灰心， 灾祸遇上你，你就惊惶沮丧。
verses.textZhCuv: 但现在祸患临到你，你就昏迷， 挨近你，你便惊惶。
verses.textEnNiv: But now trouble comes to you, and you are discouraged; it strikes you, and you are dismayed.
verses.textEnEsv: But now it has come to you, and you are impatient; it touches you, and you are dismayed.
verses.textEnNkjv: But now it comes upon you, and you are weary; It touches you, and you are troubled.
verses.textEnNlt: But now when trouble strikes, you lose heart. You are terrified when it touches you.
verses.textEnNasb: "But now it comes to you, and you are impatient; It touches you, and you are horrified.
verses.textEn: But now trouble comes to you, and you are discouraged; it strikes you, and you are dismayed.

verses.textZh: 你所自恃的，不是敬畏神吗？ 你所盼望的，不是行为完全吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你所自恃的，不是敬畏神吗？ 你所盼望的，不是行为完全吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你的倚靠不是在你敬畏神吗？ 你的盼望不是在你行事纯正吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Should not your piety be your confidence and your blameless ways your hope?
verses.textEnEsv: Is not your fear of God your confidence, and the integrity of your ways your hope?
verses.textEnNkjv: Is not your reverence your confidence? And the integrity of your ways your hope?
verses.textEnNlt: Doesn’t your reverence for God give you confidence? Doesn’t your life of integrity give you hope?
verses.textEnNasb: "Is your fear of God not your confidence, And the integrity of your ways your hope?
verses.textEn: Should not your piety be your confidence and your blameless ways your hope?

verses.textZh: 请想一想，无辜的人有谁灭亡？ 哪有正直的人被剪除呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 请想一想，无辜的人有谁灭亡？ 哪有正直的人被剪除呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 请你追想：无辜的人有谁灭亡？ 正直的人在何处剪除？
verses.textEnNiv: "Consider now: Who, being innocent, has ever perished? Where were the upright ever destroyed?
verses.textEnEsv: "Remember: who that was innocent ever perished? Or where were the upright cut off?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Remember now, who ever perished being innocent? Or where were the upright ever cut off?
verses.textEnNlt: "Stop and think! Do the innocent die? When have the upright been destroyed?
verses.textEnNasb: "Remember now, who ever perished being innocent? Or where were the upright destroyed?
verses.textEn: "Consider now: Who, being innocent, has ever perished? Where were the upright ever destroyed?

verses.textZh: 据我所见，耕耘罪孽的，必收割罪孽； 种植毒害的，必收割毒害。
verses.textZhCnvs: 据我所见，耕耘罪孽的，必收割罪孽； 种植毒害的，必收割毒害。
verses.textZhCuv: 按我所见，耕罪孽、种毒害的人 都照样收割。
verses.textEnNiv: As I have observed, those who plow evil and those who sow trouble reap it.
verses.textEnEsv: As I have seen, those who plow iniquity and sow trouble reap the same.
verses.textEnNkjv: Even as I have seen, Those who plow iniquity And sow trouble reap the same.
verses.textEnNlt: My experience shows that those who plant trouble and cultivate evil will harvest the same.
verses.textEnNasb: "According to what I have seen, those who plow wrongdoing And those who sow trouble harvest it.
verses.textEn: As I have observed, those who plow evil and those who sow trouble reap it.

verses.textZh: 他们因神的气息而灭亡， 因他的怒气而消灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们因神的气息而灭亡， 因他的怒气而消灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 神一出气，他们就灭亡；神一发怒，他们就消没。
verses.textEnNiv: At the breath of God they perish; at the blast of his anger they are no more.
verses.textEnEsv: By the breath of God they perish, and by the blast of his anger they are consumed.
verses.textEnNkjv: By the blast of God they perish, And by the breath of His anger they are consumed.
verses.textEnNlt: A breath from God destroys them. They vanish in a blast of his anger.
verses.textEnNasb: "By the breath of God they perish, And by the blast of His anger they come to an end.
verses.textEn: At the breath of God they perish; at the blast of his anger they are no more.

verses.textZh: 狮子的咆哮，猛狮的吼声，尽都止息， 壮狮的牙齿也都断掉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 狮子的咆哮，猛狮的吼声，尽都止息， 壮狮的牙齿也都断掉。
verses.textZhCuv: 狮子的吼叫和猛狮的声音尽都止息； 少壮狮子的牙齿也都敲掉。
verses.textEnNiv: The lions may roar and growl, yet the teeth of the great lions are broken.
verses.textEnEsv: The roar of the lion, the voice of the fierce lion, the teeth of the young lions are broken.
verses.textEnNkjv: The roaring of the lion, The voice of the fierce lion, And the teeth of the young lions are broken.
verses.textEnNlt: The lion roars and the wildcat snarls, but the teeth of strong lions will be broken.
verses.textEnNasb: "The roaring of the lion and the voice of the fierce lion, And the teeth of the young lions are broken out.
verses.textEn: The lions may roar and growl, yet the teeth of the great lions are broken.

verses.textZh: 公狮因缺乏猎物而死亡， 母狮之子也被分散。
verses.textZhCnvs: 公狮因缺乏猎物而死亡， 母狮之子也被分散。
verses.textZhCuv: 老狮子因绝食而死； 母狮之子也都离散。
verses.textEnNiv: The lion perishes for lack of prey, and the cubs of the lioness are scattered.
verses.textEnEsv: The strong lion perishes for lack of prey, and the cubs of the lioness are scattered.
verses.textEnNkjv: The old lion perishes for lack of prey, And the cubs of the lioness are scattered.
verses.textEnNlt: The fierce lion will starve for lack of prey, and the cubs of the lioness will be scattered.
verses.textEnNasb: "The lion perishes for lack of prey, And the cubs of the lioness are scattered.
verses.textEn: The lion perishes for lack of prey, and the cubs of the lioness are scattered.

verses.textZh: 有话偷偷传给我， 我的耳朵听到细语；
verses.textZhCnvs: 有话偷偷传给我， 我的耳朵听到细语；
verses.textZhCuv: 我暗暗地得了默示； 我耳朵也听其细微的声音。
verses.textEnNiv: "A word was secretly brought to me, my ears caught a whisper of it.
verses.textEnEsv: "Now a word was brought to me stealthily; my ear received the whisper of it.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now a word was secretly brought to me, And my ear received a whisper of it.
verses.textEnNlt: "This truth was given to me in secret, as though whispered in my ear.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now a word was brought to me secretly, And my ear received a whisper of it.
verses.textEn: "A word was secretly brought to me, my ears caught a whisper of it.

verses.textZh: 在夜间因异象而烦扰的心思中， 世人都在沉睡的时候，
verses.textZhCnvs: 在夜间因异象而烦扰的心思中， 世人都在沉睡的时候，
verses.textZhCuv: 在思念夜中、异象之间， 世人沉睡的时候，
verses.textEnNiv: Amid disquieting dreams in the night, when deep sleep falls on people,
verses.textEnEsv: Amid thoughts from visions of the night, when deep sleep falls on men,
verses.textEnNkjv: In disquieting thoughts from the visions of the night, When deep sleep falls on men,
verses.textEnNlt: It came to me in a disturbing vision at night, when people are in a deep sleep.
verses.textEnNasb: "Amid disquieting thoughts from visions of the night, When deep sleep falls on people,
verses.textEn: Amid disquieting dreams in the night, when deep sleep falls on people,

verses.textZh: 恐惧战栗临到我， 以致我全身发抖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恐惧战栗临到我， 以致我全身发抖。
verses.textZhCuv: 恐惧、战兢临到我身， 使我百骨打战。
verses.textEnNiv: fear and trembling seized me and made all my bones shake.
verses.textEnEsv: dread came upon me, and trembling, which made all my bones shake.
verses.textEnNkjv: Fear came upon me, and trembling, Which made all my bones shake.
verses.textEnNlt: Fear gripped me, and my bones trembled.
verses.textEnNasb: Dread came upon me, and trembling, And made all my bones shake.
verses.textEn: fear and trembling seized me and made all my bones shake.

verses.textZh: 有灵拂过我面前， 使我毛骨悚然。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有灵拂过我面前， 使我毛骨悚然。
verses.textZhCuv: 有灵从我面前经过， 我身上的毫毛直立。
verses.textEnNiv: A spirit glided past my face, and the hair on my body stood on end.
verses.textEnEsv: A spirit glided past my face; the hair of my flesh stood up.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then a spirit passed before my face; The hair on my body stood up.
verses.textEnNlt: A spirit swept past my face, and my hair stood on end.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then a spirit passed by my face; The hair of my flesh stood up.
verses.textEn: A spirit glided past my face, and the hair on my body stood on end.

verses.textZh: 那灵站住， 我辨不出他的形状， 只见有一形象在我眼前， 然后我听见低微的声音，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 那灵站住， 我辨不出他的形状， 只见有一形象在我眼前， 然后我听见低微的声音，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 那灵停住， 我却不能辨其形状； 有影像在我眼前。 我在静默中听见有声音说：
verses.textEnNiv: It stopped, but I could not tell what it was. A form stood before my eyes, and I heard a hushed voice:
verses.textEnEsv: It stood still, but I could not discern its appearance. A form was before my eyes; there was silence, then I heard a voice:
verses.textEnNkjv: It stood still, But I could not discern its appearance. A form was before my eyes; Therewas silence; Then I heard a voice saying:
verses.textEnNlt: The spirit stopped, but I couldn’t see its shape. There was a form before my eyes. In the silence I heard a voice say,
verses.textEnNasb: "Something was standing still, but I could not recognize its appearance; A form was before my eyes; There was silence, then I heard a voice:
verses.textEn: It stopped, but I could not tell what it was. A form stood before my eyes, and I heard a hushed voice:

verses.textZh: ‘人能在神面前算为公义吗？ 人能在他的创造主面前算为洁净吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘人能在神面前算为公义吗？ 人能在他的创造主面前算为洁净吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 必死的人岂能比神公义吗？ 人岂能比造他的主洁净吗？
verses.textEnNiv: ‘Can a mortal be more righteous than God? Can even a strong man be more pure than his Maker?
verses.textEnEsv: ‘Can mortal man be in the right before God? Can a man be pure before his Maker?
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Can a mortal be more righteous than God? Can a man be more pure than his Maker?
verses.textEnNlt: ‘Can a mortal be innocent before God? Can anyone be pure before the Creator?’
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Can mankind be righteous before God? Can a man be pure before his Maker?
verses.textEn: ‘Can a mortal be more righteous than God? Can even a strong man be more pure than his Maker?

verses.textZh: 他的仆役他还不信任， 他的天使他也指责过错，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的仆役他还不信任， 他的天使他也指责过错，
verses.textZhCuv: 主不信靠他的臣仆， 并且指他的使者为愚昧；
verses.textEnNiv: If God places no trust in his servants, if he charges his angels with error,
verses.textEnEsv: Even in his servants he puts no trust, and his angels he charges with error;
verses.textEnNkjv: If He puts no trust in His servants, If He charges His angels with error,
verses.textEnNlt: "If God does not trust his own angels and has charged his messengers with foolishness,
verses.textEnNasb: ‘He puts no trust even in His servants; And He accuses His angels of error.
verses.textEn: If God places no trust in his servants, if he charges his angels with error,

verses.textZh: 何况那些住在土屋里， 根基在尘土中， 比蠹虫还容易被压碎的人呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 何况那些住在土屋里， 根基在尘土中， 比蠹虫还容易被压碎的人呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 何况那住在土房、根基在尘土里、 被蠹虫所毁坏的人呢？
verses.textEnNiv: how much more those who live in houses of clay, whose foundations are in the dust, who are crushed more readily than a moth!
verses.textEnEsv: how much more those who dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, who are crushed like the moth.
verses.textEnNkjv: How much more those who dwell in houses of clay, Whose foundation is in the dust, Who are crushed before a moth?
verses.textEnNlt: how much less will he trust people made of clay! They are made of dust, crushed as easily as a moth.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘How much more those who live in houses of clay, Whose foundation is in the dust, Who are crushed before the moth!
verses.textEn: how much more those who live in houses of clay, whose foundations are in the dust, who are crushed more readily than a moth!

verses.textZh: 在早晚之间他们就被毁灭， 永归沉沦，无人怀念。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在早晚之间他们就被毁灭， 永归沉沦，无人怀念。
verses.textZhCuv: 早晚之间，就被毁灭， 永归无有，无人理会。
verses.textEnNiv: Between dawn and dusk they are broken to pieces; unnoticed, they perish forever.
verses.textEnEsv: Between morning and evening they are beaten to pieces; they perish forever without anyone regarding it.
verses.textEnNkjv: They are broken in pieces from morning till evening; They perish forever, with no one regarding.
verses.textEnNlt: They are alive in the morning but dead by evening, gone forever without a trace.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Between morning and evening they are broken in pieces; Unregarded, they perish forever.
verses.textEn: Between dawn and dusk they are broken to pieces; unnoticed, they perish forever.

verses.textZh: 他们帐棚的绳索不是从他们中间抽出来吗？ 他们死去，不是无智慧而死吗？’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们帐棚的绳索不是从他们中间抽出来吗？ 他们死去，不是无智慧而死吗？’"
verses.textZhCuv: 他帐棚的绳索岂不从中抽出来呢？ 他死，且是无智慧而死。
verses.textEnNiv: Are not the cords of their tent pulled up, so that they die without wisdom?’
verses.textEnEsv: Is not their tent-cord plucked up within them, do they not die, and that without wisdom?’
verses.textEnNkjv: Does not their own excellence go away? They die, even without wisdom.’
verses.textEnNlt: Their tent-cords are pulled and the tent collapses, and they die in ignorance.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Is their tent-cord not pulled out within them? They die, yet without wisdom.’
verses.textEn: Are not the cords of their tent pulled up, so that they die without wisdom?’

verses.textZh: "你只管呼吁吧，有谁回答你？ 在众圣者之中你转向哪一位？
verses.textZhCnvs: "你只管呼吁吧，有谁回答你？ 在众圣者之中你转向哪一位？
verses.textZhCuv: 你且呼求，有谁答应你？ 诸圣者之中，你转向哪一位呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "Call if you will, but who will answer you? To which of the holy ones will you turn?
verses.textEnEsv: "Call now; is there anyone who will answer you? To which of the holy ones will you turn?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Call out now; Is there anyone who will answer you? And to which of the holy ones will you turn?
verses.textEnNlt: "Cry for help, but will anyone answer you? Which of the angels will help you?
verses.textEnNasb: "Call now, is there anyone who will answer you? And to which of the holy ones will you turn?
verses.textEn: "Call if you will, but who will answer you? To which of the holy ones will you turn?

verses.textZh: 烦恼杀死愚昧人， 激情害死愚蒙人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 烦恼杀死愚昧人， 激情害死愚蒙人。
verses.textZhCuv: 忿怒害死愚妄人； 嫉妒杀死痴迷人。
verses.textEnNiv: Resentment kills a fool, and envy slays the simple.
verses.textEnEsv: Surely vexation kills the fool, and jealousy slays the simple.
verses.textEnNkjv: For wrath kills a foolish man, And envy slays a simple one.
verses.textEnNlt: Surely resentment destroys the fool, and jealousy kills the simple.
verses.textEnNasb: "For irritation kills the fool, And jealousy brings death to the simple.
verses.textEn: Resentment kills a fool, and envy slays the simple.

verses.textZh: 我看见愚昧人扎下了根， 但咒诅忽然临到他的居所。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我看见愚昧人扎下了根， 但咒诅忽然临到他的居所。
verses.textZhCuv: 我曾见愚妄人扎下根， 但我忽然咒诅他的住处。
verses.textEnNiv: I myself have seen a fool taking root, but suddenly his house was cursed.
verses.textEnEsv: I have seen the fool taking root, but suddenly I cursed his dwelling.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have seen the foolish taking root, But suddenly I cursed his dwelling place.
verses.textEnNlt: I have seen that fools may be successful for the moment, but then comes sudden disaster.
verses.textEnNasb: "I have seen the fool taking root, And I cursed his home immediately.
verses.textEn: I myself have seen a fool taking root, but suddenly his house was cursed.

verses.textZh: 他的儿女远离安稳之处， 在城门口被欺压却没有人援救。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的儿女远离安稳之处， 在城门口被欺压却没有人援救。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的儿女远离稳妥的地步， 在城门口被压，并无人搭救。
verses.textEnNiv: His children are far from safety, crushed in court without a defender.
verses.textEnEsv: His children are far from safety; they are crushed in the gate, and there is no one to deliver them.
verses.textEnNkjv: His sons are far from safety, They are crushed in the gate, And thereis no deliverer.
verses.textEnNlt: Their children are abandoned far from help; they are crushed in court with no one to defend them.
verses.textEnNasb: "His sons are far from safety, They are also oppressed at the gate, And there is no one to save them.
verses.textEn: His children are far from safety, crushed in court without a defender.

verses.textZh: 饥饿的人吃尽他的庄稼， 连在荆棘里的也抢去； 口渴的人 吞尽他的财富。
verses.textZhCnvs: 饥饿的人吃尽他的庄稼， 连在荆棘里的也抢去； 口渴的人 吞尽他的财富。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的庄稼有饥饿的人吃尽了， 就是在荆棘里的也抢去了； 他的财宝有网罗张口吞灭了。
verses.textEnNiv: The hungry consume his harvest, taking it even from among thorns, and the thirsty pant after his wealth.
verses.textEnEsv: The hungry eat his harvest, and he takes it even out of thorns, and the thirsty pant after his wealth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because the hungry eat up his harvest, Taking it even from the thorns, And a snare snatches their substance.
verses.textEnNlt: The hungry devour their harvest, even when it is guarded by brambles. The thirsty pant after their wealth.
verses.textEnNasb: " The hungry devour his harvest And take it to a place of thorns, And the schemer is eager for their wealth.
verses.textEn: The hungry consume his harvest, taking it even from among thorns, and the thirsty pant after his wealth.

verses.textZh: 患难不从土中生出来， 劳碌不由地里长出来；
verses.textZhCnvs: 患难不从土中生出来， 劳碌不由地里长出来；
verses.textZhCuv: 祸患原不是从土中出来； 患难也不是从地里发生。
verses.textEnNiv: For hardship does not spring from the soil, nor does trouble sprout from the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: For affliction does not come from the dust, nor does trouble sprout from the ground,
verses.textEnNkjv: For affliction does not come from the dust, Nor does trouble spring from the ground;
verses.textEnNlt: But evil does not spring from the soil, and trouble does not sprout from the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: "For disaster does not come from the dust, Nor does trouble sprout from the ground,
verses.textEn: For hardship does not spring from the soil, nor does trouble sprout from the ground.

verses.textZh: 原来人为劳碌而生， 如同火花向上飞扬。
verses.textZhCnvs: 原来人为劳碌而生， 如同火花向上飞扬。
verses.textZhCuv: 人生在世必遇患难， 如同火星飞腾。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet man is born to trouble as surely as sparks fly upward.
verses.textEnEsv: but man is born to trouble as the sparks fly upward.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet man is born to trouble, As the sparks fly upward.
verses.textEnNlt: People are born for trouble as readily as sparks fly up from a fire.
verses.textEnNasb: For man is born for trouble, As sparks fly upward.
verses.textEn: Yet man is born to trouble as surely as sparks fly upward.

verses.textZh: 至于我，我必寻求神， 向他陈明我的案件。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于我，我必寻求神， 向他陈明我的案件。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于我，我必仰望神， 把我的事情托付他。
verses.textEnNiv: "But if I were you, I would appeal to God; I would lay my cause before him.
verses.textEnEsv: "As for me, I would seek God, and to God would I commit my cause,
verses.textEnNkjv: "But as for me, I would seek God, And to God I would commit my cause—
verses.textEnNlt: "If I were you, I would go to God and present my case to him.
verses.textEnNasb: "But as for me, I would seek God, And I would make my plea before God,
verses.textEn: "But if I were you, I would appeal to God; I would lay my cause before him.

verses.textZh: 他所作的大事无法测度， 所行的奇事不可胜数。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他所作的大事无法测度， 所行的奇事不可胜数。
verses.textZhCuv: 他行大事不可测度， 行奇事不可胜数：
verses.textEnNiv: He performs wonders that cannot be fathomed, miracles that cannot be counted.
verses.textEnEsv: who does great things and unsearchable, marvelous things without number:
verses.textEnNkjv: Who does great things, and unsearchable, Marvelous things without number.
verses.textEnNlt: He does great things too marvelous to understand. He performs countless miracles.
