verses.textEnNasb: Who does great and unsearchable things, Wonders without number.
verses.textEn: He performs wonders that cannot be fathomed, miracles that cannot be counted.

verses.textZh: 降雨在地上， 遣水到田里，
verses.textZhCnvs: 降雨在地上， 遣水到田里，
verses.textZhCuv: 降雨在地上， 赐水于田里；
verses.textEnNiv: He provides rain for the earth; he sends water on the countryside.
verses.textEnEsv: he gives rain on the earth and sends waters on the fields;
verses.textEnNkjv: He gives rain on the earth, And sends waters on the fields.
verses.textEnNlt: He gives rain for the earth and water for the fields.
verses.textEnNasb: "He gives rain on the earth, And sends water on the fields,
verses.textEn: He provides rain for the earth; he sends water on the countryside.

verses.textZh: 把低微的安置在高位， 把哀恸的高举于安稳之处；
verses.textZhCnvs: 把低微的安置在高位， 把哀恸的高举于安稳之处；
verses.textZhCuv: 将卑微的安置在高处， 将哀痛的举到稳妥之地；
verses.textEnNiv: The lowly he sets on high, and those who mourn are lifted to safety.
verses.textEnEsv: he sets on high those who are lowly, and those who mourn are lifted to safety.
verses.textEnNkjv: He sets on high those who are lowly, And those who mourn are lifted to safety.
verses.textEnNlt: He gives prosperity to the poor and protects those who suffer.
verses.textEnNasb: So that He sets on high those who are lowly, And those who mourn are lifted to safety.
verses.textEn: The lowly he sets on high, and those who mourn are lifted to safety.

verses.textZh: 又挫败狡猾人的计谋， 使他们的手所作的无法成全；
verses.textZhCnvs: 又挫败狡猾人的计谋， 使他们的手所作的无法成全；
verses.textZhCuv: 破坏狡猾人的计谋， 使他们所谋的不得成就。
verses.textEnNiv: He thwarts the plans of the crafty, so that their hands achieve no success.
verses.textEnEsv: He frustrates the devices of the crafty, so that their hands achieve no success.
verses.textEnNkjv: He frustrates the devices of the crafty, So that their hands cannot carry out their plans.
verses.textEnNlt: He frustrates the plans of schemers so the work of their hands will not succeed.
verses.textEnNasb: "He frustrates the schemes of the shrewd, So that their hands cannot attain success.
verses.textEn: He thwarts the plans of the crafty, so that their hands achieve no success.

verses.textZh: 他使有智慧的人中了自己的诡计， 使奸诈人的谋算快快失败。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他使有智慧的人中了自己的诡计， 使奸诈人的谋算快快失败。
verses.textZhCuv: 他叫有智慧的中了自己的诡计， 使狡诈人的计谋速速灭亡。
verses.textEnNiv: He catches the wise in their craftiness, and the schemes of the wily are swept away.
verses.textEnEsv: He catches the wise in their own craftiness, and the schemes of the wily are brought to a quick end.
verses.textEnNkjv: He catches the wise in their own craftiness, And the counsel of the cunning comes quickly upon them.
verses.textEnNlt: He traps the wise in their own cleverness so their cunning schemes are thwarted.
verses.textEnNasb: "He captures the wise by their own cleverness, And the advice of the cunning is quickly thwarted.
verses.textEn: He catches the wise in their craftiness, and the schemes of the wily are swept away.

verses.textZh: 他们白天遇见黑暗， 中午摸索如在夜间。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们白天遇见黑暗， 中午摸索如在夜间。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们白昼遇见黑暗， 午间摸索如在夜间。
verses.textEnNiv: Darkness comes upon them in the daytime; at noon they grope as in the night.
verses.textEnEsv: They meet with darkness in the daytime and grope at noonday as in the night.
verses.textEnNkjv: They meet with darkness in the daytime, And grope at noontime as in the night.
verses.textEnNlt: They find it is dark in the daytime, and they grope at noon as if it were night.
verses.textEnNasb: "By day they meet with darkness, And grope at noon as in the night.
verses.textEn: Darkness comes upon them in the daytime; at noon they grope as in the night.

verses.textZh: 他拯救穷乏人脱离他们口中的刀剑， 脱离强暴人的手；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他拯救穷乏人脱离他们口中的刀剑， 脱离强暴人的手；
verses.textZhCuv: 神拯救穷乏人 脱离他们口中的刀和强暴人的手。
verses.textEnNiv: He saves the needy from the sword in their mouth; he saves them from the clutches of the powerful.
verses.textEnEsv: But he saves the needy from the sword of their mouth and from the hand of the mighty.
verses.textEnNkjv: But He saves the needy from the sword, From the mouth of the mighty, And from their hand.
verses.textEnNlt: He rescues the poor from the cutting words of the strong, and rescues them from the clutches of the powerful.
verses.textEnNasb: "But He saves from the sword of their mouth, And the poor from the hand of the strong.
verses.textEn: He saves the needy from the sword in their mouth; he saves them from the clutches of the powerful.

verses.textZh: 这样，贫穷人有指望， 不义的人却闭口无言。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，贫穷人有指望， 不义的人却闭口无言。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，贫寒的人有指望， 罪孽之辈必塞口无言。
verses.textEnNiv: So the poor have hope, and injustice shuts its mouth.
verses.textEnEsv: So the poor have hope, and injustice shuts her mouth.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the poor have hope, And injustice shuts her mouth.
verses.textEnNlt: And so at last the poor have hope, and the snapping jaws of the wicked are shut.
verses.textEnNasb: "So the helpless has hope, And injustice has shut its mouth.
verses.textEn: So the poor have hope, and injustice shuts its mouth.

verses.textZh: 神所责备的人是有福的， 所以你不要轻看全能者的管教。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神所责备的人是有福的， 所以你不要轻看全能者的管教。
verses.textZhCuv: 神所惩治的人是有福的！ 所以你不可轻看全能者的管教。
verses.textEnNiv: "Blessed is the one whom God corrects; so do not despise the discipline of the Almighty.
verses.textEnEsv: "Behold, blessed is the one whom God reproves; therefore despise not the discipline of the Almighty.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, happy is the man whom God corrects; Therefore do not despise the chastening of the Almighty.
verses.textEnNlt: "But consider the joy of those corrected by God! Do not despise the discipline of the Almighty when you sin.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, happy is the person whom God disciplines, So do not reject the discipline of the Almighty.
verses.textEn: "Blessed is the one whom God corrects; so do not despise the discipline of the Almighty.

verses.textZh: 因为他打伤，又缠裹； 他击伤，又亲手医治。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他打伤，又缠裹； 他击伤，又亲手医治。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他打破，又缠裹； 他击伤，用手医治。
verses.textEnNiv: For he wounds, but he also binds up; he injures, but his hands also heal.
verses.textEnEsv: For he wounds, but he binds up; he shatters, but his hands heal.
verses.textEnNkjv: For He bruises, but He binds up; He wounds, but His hands make whole.
verses.textEnNlt: For though he wounds, he also bandages. He strikes, but his hands also heal.
verses.textEnNasb: "For He inflicts pain, and gives relief; He wounds, but His hands also heal.
verses.textEn: For he wounds, but he also binds up; he injures, but his hands also heal.

verses.textZh: 你六次遭遇患难，他都救拔你， 就算第七次，灾祸也伤不了你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你六次遭遇患难，他都救拔你， 就算第七次，灾祸也伤不了你。
verses.textZhCuv: 你六次遭难，他必救你； 就是七次，灾祸也无法害你。
verses.textEnNiv: From six calamities he will rescue you; in seven no harm will touch you.
verses.textEnEsv: He will deliver you from six troubles; in seven no evil shall touch you.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall deliver you in six troubles, Yes, in seven no evil shall touch you.
verses.textEnNlt: From six disasters he will rescue you; even in the seventh, he will keep you from evil.
verses.textEnNasb: "In six troubles He will save you; Even in seven, evil will not touch you.
verses.textEn: From six calamities he will rescue you; in seven no harm will touch you.

verses.textZh: 在饥荒中，他必救你脱离死亡； 在战争中，他必救你脱离刀剑的权势。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在饥荒中，他必救你脱离死亡； 在战争中，他必救你脱离刀剑的权势。
verses.textZhCuv: 在饥荒中，他必救你脱离死亡； 在争战中，他必救你脱离刀剑的权力。
verses.textEnNiv: In famine he will deliver you from death, and in battle from the stroke of the sword.
verses.textEnEsv: In famine he will redeem you from death, and in war from the power of the sword.
verses.textEnNkjv: In famine He shall redeem you from death, And in war from the power of the sword.
verses.textEnNlt: He will save you from death in time of famine, from the power of the sword in time of war.
verses.textEnNasb: "In famine He will redeem you from death, And in war, from the power of the sword.
verses.textEn: In famine he will deliver you from death, and in battle from the stroke of the sword.

verses.textZh: 你必不受人口舌之害， 灾殃临到，也不害怕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必不受人口舌之害， 灾殃临到，也不害怕。
verses.textZhCuv: 你必被隐藏，不受口舌之害； 灾殃临到，你也不惧怕。
verses.textEnNiv: You will be protected from the lash of the tongue, and need not fear when destruction comes.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall be hidden from the lash of the tongue, and shall not fear destruction when it comes.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall be hidden from the scourge of the tongue, And you shall not be afraid of destruction when it comes.
verses.textEnNlt: You will be safe from slander and have no fear when destruction comes.
verses.textEnNasb: "You will be hidden from the scourge of the tongue, And you will not be afraid of violence when it comes.
verses.textEn: You will be protected from the lash of the tongue, and need not fear when destruction comes.

verses.textZh: 对灾殃和饥馑，一笑置之， 地上的野兽你也不害怕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 对灾殃和饥馑，一笑置之， 地上的野兽你也不害怕。
verses.textZhCuv: 你遇见灾害饥馑，就必嬉笑； 地上的野兽，你也不惧怕。
verses.textEnNiv: You will laugh at destruction and famine, and need not fear the wild animals.
verses.textEnEsv: At destruction and famine you shall laugh, and shall not fear the beasts of the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall laugh at destruction and famine, And you shall not be afraid of the beasts of the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: You will laugh at destruction and famine; wild animals will not terrify you.
verses.textEnNasb: "You will laugh at violence and hunger, And you will not be afraid of wild animals.
verses.textEn: You will laugh at destruction and famine, and need not fear the wild animals.

verses.textZh: 你必与田间的石头立约， 田间的野兽必与你和平相处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必与田间的石头立约， 田间的野兽必与你和平相处。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为你必与田间的石头立约； 田里的野兽也必与你和好。
verses.textEnNiv: For you will have a covenant with the stones of the field, and the wild animals will be at peace with you.
verses.textEnEsv: For you shall be in league with the stones of the field, and the beasts of the field shall be at peace with you.
verses.textEnNkjv: For you shall have a covenant with the stones of the field, And the beasts of the field shall be at peace with you.
verses.textEnNlt: You will be at peace with the stones of the field, and its wild animals will be at peace with you.
verses.textEnNasb: "For you will be in league with the stones of the field, And the animals of the field will be at peace with you.
verses.textEn: For you will have a covenant with the stones of the field, and the wild animals will be at peace with you.

verses.textZh: 你必晓得你的帐棚平安无事； 你查看庄舍，也一无缺失。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必晓得你的帐棚平安无事； 你查看庄舍，也一无缺失。
verses.textZhCuv: 你必知道你帐棚平安， 要查看你的羊圈，一无所失；
verses.textEnNiv: You will know that your tent is secure; you will take stock of your property and find nothing missing.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall know that your tent is at peace, and you shall inspect your fold and miss nothing.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall know that your tent is in peace; You shall visit your dwelling and find nothing amiss.
verses.textEnNlt: You will know that your home is safe. When you survey your possessions, nothing will be missing.
verses.textEnNasb: "You will know that your tent is secure, For you will visit your home and have nothing missing.
verses.textEn: You will know that your tent is secure; you will take stock of your property and find nothing missing.

verses.textZh: 你必晓得你的后裔众多， 子孙像地上的青草那样茂盛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必晓得你的后裔众多， 子孙像地上的青草那样茂盛。
verses.textZhCuv: 也必知道你的后裔将来发达， 你的子孙像地上的青草。
verses.textEnNiv: You will know that your children will be many, and your descendants like the grass of the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall know also that your offspring shall be many, and your descendants as the grass of the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall also know that your descendants shallbe many, And your offspring like the grass of the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: You will have many children; your descendants will be as plentiful as grass!
verses.textEnNasb: "You will also know that your descendants will be many, And your offspring as the grass of the earth.
verses.textEn: You will know that your children will be many, and your descendants like the grass of the earth.

verses.textZh: 你必全寿才归到坟墓去， 如同禾捆到时就收起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必全寿才归到坟墓去， 如同禾捆到时就收起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 你必寿高年迈才归坟墓， 好像禾捆到时收藏。
verses.textEnNiv: You will come to the grave in full vigor, like sheaves gathered in season.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall come to your grave in ripe old age, like a sheaf gathered up in its season.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall come to the grave at a full age, As a sheaf of grain ripens in its season.
verses.textEnNlt: You will go to the grave at a ripe old age, like a sheaf of grain harvested at the proper time!
verses.textEnNasb: "You will come to the grave at a ripe age, Like the stacking of grain in its season.
verses.textEn: You will come to the grave in full vigor, like sheaves gathered in season.

verses.textZh: 这道理我们已经查明实在是这样， 你当聆听，也当明白。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这道理我们已经查明实在是这样， 你当聆听，也当明白。"
verses.textZhCuv: 这理，我们已经考察，本是如此。 你须要听，要知道是与自己有益。
verses.textEnNiv: "We have examined this, and it is true. So hear it and apply it to yourself."
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, this we have searched out; it is true. Hear, and know it for your good."
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, this we have searched out; It is true. Hear it, and know for yourself."
verses.textEnNlt: "We have studied life and found all this to be true. Listen to my counsel, and apply it to yourself."
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold this; we have investigated it, and so it is. Hear it, and know for yourself."
verses.textEn: "We have examined this, and it is true. So hear it and apply it to yourself."

verses.textZh: 于是约伯回答说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是约伯回答说：
verses.textZhCuv: 约伯回答说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then Job replied:
verses.textEnEsv: Then Job answered and said:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Job answered and said:
verses.textEnNlt: Then Job spoke again:
verses.textEnNasb: Then Job responded,
verses.textEn: Then Job replied:

verses.textZh: "但愿称称我的烦恼， 把我的灾害一起放在天平上。
verses.textZhCnvs: "但愿称称我的烦恼， 把我的灾害一起放在天平上。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟愿我的烦恼称一称， 我一切的灾害放在天平里；
verses.textEnNiv: "If only my anguish could be weighed and all my misery be placed on the scales!
verses.textEnEsv: "Oh that my vexation were weighed, and all my calamity laid in the balances!
verses.textEnNkjv: "Oh, that my grief were fully weighed, And my calamity laid with it on the scales!
verses.textEnNlt: "If my misery could be weighed and my troubles be put on the scales,
verses.textEnNasb: "Oh if only my grief were actually weighed And laid in the balances together with my disaster!
verses.textEn: "If only my anguish could be weighed and all my misery be placed on the scales!

verses.textZh: 现在这些都比海沙更重， 所以我冒失发言。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在这些都比海沙更重， 所以我冒失发言。
verses.textZhCuv: 现今都比海沙更重， 所以我的言语急躁。
verses.textEnNiv: It would surely outweigh the sand of the seas— no wonder my words have been impetuous.
verses.textEnEsv: For then it would be heavier than the sand of the sea; therefore my words have been rash.
verses.textEnNkjv: For then it would be heavier than the sand of the sea— Therefore my words have been rash.
verses.textEnNlt: they would outweigh all the sands of the sea. That is why I spoke impulsively.
verses.textEnNasb: "For then it would be heavier than the sand of the seas; For that reason my words have been rash.
verses.textEn: It would surely outweigh the sand of the seas— no wonder my words have been impetuous.

verses.textZh: 因为全能者的箭射中我， 我的灵喝尽了箭的毒液，神的惊吓排阵攻击我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为全能者的箭射中我， 我的灵喝尽了箭的毒液，神的惊吓排阵攻击我。
verses.textZhCuv: 因全能者的箭射入我身； 其毒，我的灵喝尽了；神的惊吓摆阵攻击我。
verses.textEnNiv: The arrows of the Almighty are in me, my spirit drinks in their poison; God’s terrors are marshaled against me.
verses.textEnEsv: For the arrows of the Almighty are in me; my spirit drinks their poison; the terrors of God are arrayed against me.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me; My spirit drinks in their poison; The terrors of God are arrayed against me.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Almighty has struck me down with his arrows. Their poison infects my spirit. God’s terrors are lined up against me.
verses.textEnNasb: "For the arrows of the Almighty are within me, My spirit drinks their poison; The terrors of God line up against me.
verses.textEn: The arrows of the Almighty are in me, my spirit drinks in their poison; God’s terrors are marshaled against me.

verses.textZh: 野驴有草料还会哀鸣吗？ 牛有饲料还会穷叫吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 野驴有草料还会哀鸣吗？ 牛有饲料还会穷叫吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 野驴有草岂能叫唤？ 牛有料岂能吼叫？
verses.textEnNiv: Does a wild donkey bray when it has grass, or an ox bellow when it has fodder?
verses.textEnEsv: Does the wild donkey bray when he has grass, or the ox low over his fodder?
verses.textEnNkjv: Does the wild donkey bray when it has grass, Or does the ox low over its fodder?
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t I have a right to complain? Don’t wild donkeys bray when they find no grass, and oxen bellow when they have no food?
verses.textEnNasb: "Does the wild donkey bray over his grass, Or does the ox low over his feed?
verses.textEn: Does a wild donkey bray when it has grass, or an ox bellow when it has fodder?

verses.textZh: 淡而无盐的食物有甚么好吃呢？ 蛋白有甚么味道呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 淡而无盐的食物有甚么好吃呢？ 蛋白有甚么味道呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 物淡而无盐岂可吃吗？ 蛋青有什么滋味呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Is tasteless food eaten without salt, or is there flavor in the sap of the mallow ?
verses.textEnEsv: Can that which is tasteless be eaten without salt, or is there any taste in the juice of the mallow?
verses.textEnNkjv: Can flavorless food be eaten without salt? Or is there any taste in the white of an egg?
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t people complain about unsalted food? Does anyone want the tasteless white of an egg?
verses.textEnNasb: "Can something tasteless be eaten without salt, Or is there any taste in the juice of an alkanet plant?
verses.textEn: Is tasteless food eaten without salt, or is there flavor in the sap of the mallow ?

verses.textZh: 这些使我恶心的食物， 我必不肯尝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些使我恶心的食物， 我必不肯尝。
verses.textZhCuv: 看为可厌的食物， 我心不肯挨近。
verses.textEnNiv: I refuse to touch it; such food makes me ill.
verses.textEnEsv: My appetite refuses to touch them; they are as food that is loathsome to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: My soul refuses to touch them; They are as loathsome food to me.
verses.textEnNlt: My appetite disappears when I look at it; I gag at the thought of eating it!
verses.textEnNasb: "My soul refuses to touch them; They are like loathsome food to me.
verses.textEn: I refuse to touch it; such food makes me ill.

verses.textZh: 但愿我得着我所祈求的， 愿神赐我所盼望的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但愿我得着我所祈求的， 愿神赐我所盼望的。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟愿我得着所求的， 愿神赐我所切望的；
verses.textEnNiv: "Oh, that I might have my request, that God would grant what I hope for,
verses.textEnEsv: "Oh that I might have my request, and that God would fulfill my hope,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Oh, that I might have my request, That God would grant me the thing that I long for!
verses.textEnNlt: "Oh, that I might have my request, that God would grant my desire.
verses.textEnNasb: "Oh, that my request might come to pass, And that God would grant my hope!
verses.textEn: "Oh, that I might have my request, that God would grant what I hope for,

verses.textZh: 愿他乐意把我压碎， 愿他放手把我剪除。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿他乐意把我压碎， 愿他放手把我剪除。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是愿神把我压碎， 伸手将我剪除。
verses.textEnNiv: that God would be willing to crush me, to let loose his hand and cut off my life!
verses.textEnEsv: that it would please God to crush me, that he would let loose his hand and cut me off!
verses.textEnNkjv: That it would please God to crush me, That He would loose His hand and cut me off!
verses.textEnNlt: I wish he would crush me. I wish he would reach out his hand and kill me.
verses.textEnNasb: "Oh, that God would decide to crush me, That He would let loose His hand and cut me off!
verses.textEn: that God would be willing to crush me, to let loose his hand and cut off my life!

verses.textZh: 这样，我们得安慰， 在无情的痛苦之中我还可以欢跃， 因为我没有否认那圣者的言语。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，我们得安慰， 在无情的痛苦之中我还可以欢跃， 因为我没有否认那圣者的言语。
verses.textZhCuv: 我因没有违弃那圣者的言语， 就仍以此为安慰， 在不止息的痛苦中还可踊跃。
verses.textEnNiv: Then I would still have this consolation— my joy in unrelenting pain— that I had not denied the words of the Holy One.
verses.textEnEsv: This would be my comfort; I would even exult in pain unsparing, for I have not denied the words of the Holy One.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I would still have comfort; Though in anguish I would exult, He will not spare; For I have not concealed the words of the Holy One.
verses.textEnNlt: At least I can take comfort in this: Despite the pain, I have not denied the words of the Holy One.
verses.textEnNasb: "But it is still my comfort, And I rejoice in unsparing pain, That I have not denied the words of the Holy One.
verses.textEn: Then I would still have this consolation— my joy in unrelenting pain— that I had not denied the words of the Holy One.

verses.textZh: 我有甚么力量使我能等候呢？ 我的结局是甚么好叫我忍耐呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我有甚么力量使我能等候呢？ 我的结局是甚么好叫我忍耐呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 我有什么气力使我等候？ 我有什么结局使我忍耐？
verses.textEnNiv: "What strength do I have, that I should still hope? What prospects, that I should be patient?
verses.textEnEsv: What is my strength, that I should wait? And what is my end, that I should be patient?
verses.textEnNkjv: "What strength do I have, that I should hope? And what is my end, that I should prolong my life?
verses.textEnNlt: But I don’t have the strength to endure. I have nothing to live for.
verses.textEnNasb: "What is my strength, that I should wait? And what is my end, that I should endure?
verses.textEn: "What strength do I have, that I should still hope? What prospects, that I should be patient?

verses.textZh: 我的气力是石头一样吗？ 我的肉身是铜的吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的气力是石头一样吗？ 我的肉身是铜的吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 我的气力岂是石头的气力？ 我的肉身岂是铜的呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Do I have the strength of stone? Is my flesh bronze?
verses.textEnEsv: Is my strength the strength of stones, or is my flesh bronze?
verses.textEnNkjv: Is my strength the strength of stones? Or is my flesh bronze?
verses.textEnNlt: Do I have the strength of a stone? Is my body made of bronze?
verses.textEnNasb: "Is my strength the strength of stones, Or is my flesh bronze?
verses.textEn: Do I have the strength of stone? Is my flesh bronze?

verses.textZh: 我里面不是无能自助吗？ 见识不是离我而去吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我里面不是无能自助吗？ 见识不是离我而去吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 在我岂不是毫无帮助吗？ 智慧岂不是从我心中赶出净尽吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Do I have any power to help myself, now that success has been driven from me?
verses.textEnEsv: Have I any help in me, when resource is driven from me?
verses.textEnNkjv: Is my help not within me? And is success driven from me?
verses.textEnNlt: No, I am utterly helpless, without any chance of success.
verses.textEnNasb: "Is it that my help is not within me, And that a good outcome is driven away from me?
verses.textEn: Do I have any power to help myself, now that success has been driven from me?

verses.textZh: 朋友应该怜悯灰心的人， 因为他舍弃了对全能者的敬畏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 朋友应该怜悯灰心的人， 因为他舍弃了对全能者的敬畏。
verses.textZhCuv: 那将要灰心、离弃全能者、 不敬畏神的人， 他的朋友当以慈爱待他。
verses.textEnNiv: "Anyone who withholds kindness from a friend forsakes the fear of the Almighty.
verses.textEnEsv: "He who withholds kindness from a friend forsakes the fear of the Almighty.
verses.textEnNkjv: "To him who is afflicted, kindness shouldbeshown by his friend, Even though he forsakes the fear of the Almighty.
verses.textEnNlt: "One should be kind to a fainting friend, but you accuse me without any fear of the Almighty.
verses.textEnNasb: "For the despairing man there should be kindness from his friend; So that he does not abandon the fear of the Almighty.
verses.textEn: "Anyone who withholds kindness from a friend forsakes the fear of the Almighty.

verses.textZh: 我的兄弟诡诈像干涸的溪流， 又像流干的溪水；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的兄弟诡诈像干涸的溪流， 又像流干的溪水；
verses.textZhCuv: 我的弟兄诡诈，好像溪水， 又像溪水流干的河道。
verses.textEnNiv: But my brothers are as undependable as intermittent streams, as the streams that overflow
verses.textEnEsv: My brothers are treacherous as a torrent-bed, as torrential streams that pass away,
verses.textEnNkjv: My brothers have dealt deceitfully like a brook, Like the streams of the brooks that pass away,
verses.textEnNlt: My brothers, you have proved as unreliable as a seasonal brook that overflows its banks in the spring
verses.textEnNasb: "My brothers have acted deceitfully like a wadi, Like the torrents of wadis which drain away,
verses.textEn: But my brothers are as undependable as intermittent streams, as the streams that overflow

verses.textZh: 水流因冰块融化而混浊， 有雪隐藏在其中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 水流因冰块融化而混浊， 有雪隐藏在其中。
verses.textZhCuv: 这河因结冰发黑， 有雪藏在其中；
verses.textEnNiv: when darkened by thawing ice and swollen with melting snow,
verses.textEnEsv: which are dark with ice, and where the snow hides itself.
verses.textEnNkjv: Which are dark because of the ice, And into which the snow vanishes.
verses.textEnNlt: when it is swollen with ice and melting snow.
verses.textEnNasb: Which are darkened because of ice, And into which the snow melts.
verses.textEn: when darkened by thawing ice and swollen with melting snow,

verses.textZh: 天气一暖溪水就消失， 气候一热就干涸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 天气一暖溪水就消失， 气候一热就干涸。
verses.textZhCuv: 天气渐暖就随时消化， 日头炎热便从原处干涸。
verses.textEnNiv: but that stop flowing in the dry season, and in the heat vanish from their channels.
verses.textEnEsv: When they melt, they disappear; when it is hot, they vanish from their place.
verses.textEnNkjv: When it is warm, they cease to flow; When it is hot, they vanish from their place.
verses.textEnNlt: But when the hot weather arrives, the water disappears. The brook vanishes in the heat.
verses.textEnNasb: "When they dry up, they vanish; When it is hot, they disappear from their place.
verses.textEn: but that stop flowing in the dry season, and in the heat vanish from their channels.

verses.textZh: 商队顺溪而行，结果偏离原道， 走到荒野之地而死亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 商队顺溪而行，结果偏离原道， 走到荒野之地而死亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 结伴的客旅离弃大道， 顺河偏行，到荒野之地死亡。
verses.textEnNiv: Caravans turn aside from their routes; they go off into the wasteland and perish.
verses.textEnEsv: The caravans turn aside from their course; they go up into the waste and perish.
verses.textEnNkjv: The paths of their way turn aside, They go nowhere and perish.
verses.textEnNlt: The caravans turn aside to be refreshed, but there is nothing to drink, so they die.
verses.textEnNasb: "The paths of their course wind along, They go up into wasteland and perish.
verses.textEn: Caravans turn aside from their routes; they go off into the wasteland and perish.

verses.textZh: 提玛的商队瞻望溪水， 示巴的客旅等候水流。
verses.textZhCnvs: 提玛的商队瞻望溪水， 示巴的客旅等候水流。
verses.textZhCuv: 提玛结伴的客旅瞻望； 示巴同伙的人等候。
verses.textEnNiv: The caravans of Tema look for water, the traveling merchants of Sheba look in hope.
verses.textEnEsv: The caravans of Tema look, the travelers of Sheba hope.
verses.textEnNkjv: The caravans of Tema look, The travelers of Sheba hope for them.
verses.textEnNlt: The caravans from Tema search for this water; the travelers from Sheba hope to find it.
verses.textEnNasb: "The caravans of Tema looked, The travelers of Sheba hoped for them.
verses.textEn: The caravans of Tema look for water, the traveling merchants of Sheba look in hope.

verses.textZh: 他们失望，因为所盼望的落了空； 他们到达那里就灰心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们失望，因为所盼望的落了空； 他们到达那里就灰心。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们因失了盼望就抱愧， 来到那里便蒙羞。
verses.textEnNiv: They are distressed, because they had been confident; they arrive there, only to be disappointed.
verses.textEnEsv: They are ashamed because they were confident; they come there and are disappointed.
verses.textEnNkjv: They are disappointed because they were confident; They come there and are confused.
verses.textEnNlt: They count on it but are disappointed. When they arrive, their hopes are dashed.
verses.textEnNasb: "They were put to shame, for they had trusted, They came there and were humiliated.
verses.textEn: They are distressed, because they had been confident; they arrive there, only to be disappointed.

verses.textZh: 现在你们就是这样， 看见我的灾难就害怕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你们就是这样， 看见我的灾难就害怕。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你们正是这样， 看见惊吓的事便惧怕。
verses.textEnNiv: Now you too have proved to be of no help; you see something dreadful and are afraid.
verses.textEnEsv: For you have now become nothing; you see my calamity and are afraid.
verses.textEnNkjv: For now you are nothing, You see terror and are afraid.
verses.textEnNlt: You, too, have given no help. You have seen my calamity, and you are afraid.
verses.textEnNasb: "Indeed, you have now become such, You see terrors and are afraid.
verses.textEn: Now you too have proved to be of no help; you see something dreadful and are afraid.

verses.textZh: 难道我说过‘请供给我’， 或说‘取你们的财物馈赠我’吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 难道我说过‘请供给我’， 或说‘取你们的财物馈赠我’吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 我岂说：请你们供给我， 从你们的财物中送礼物给我？
verses.textEnNiv: Have I ever said, ‘Give something on my behalf, pay a ransom for me from your wealth,
verses.textEnEsv: Have I said, ‘Make me a gift’? Or, ‘From your wealth offer a bribe for me’?
verses.textEnNkjv: Did I ever say, ‘Bring something to me’? Or, ‘Offer a bribe for me from your wealth’?
verses.textEnNlt: But why? Have I ever asked you for a gift? Have I begged for anything of yours for myself?
verses.textEnNasb: "Have I said, ‘Give me something,’ Or, ‘Offer a bribe for me from your wealth,’
verses.textEn: Have I ever said, ‘Give something on my behalf, pay a ransom for me from your wealth,

verses.textZh: 或我说过‘救我脱离敌人的手’， 或说‘赎我脱离强暴人的手’吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 或我说过‘救我脱离敌人的手’， 或说‘赎我脱离强暴人的手’吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 岂说：拯救我脱离敌人的手吗？ 救赎我脱离强暴人的手吗？
verses.textEnNiv: deliver me from the hand of the enemy, rescue me from the clutches of the ruthless’?
verses.textEnEsv: Or, ‘Deliver me from the adversary’s hand’? Or, ‘Redeem me from the hand of the ruthless’?
verses.textEnNkjv: Or, ‘Deliver me from the enemy’s hand’? Or, ‘Redeem me from the hand of oppressors’?
verses.textEnNlt: Have I asked you to rescue me from my enemies, or to save me from ruthless people?
verses.textEnNasb: Or, ‘Save me from the hand of the enemy,’ Or, ‘Redeem me from the hand of the tyrants’?
verses.textEn: deliver me from the hand of the enemy, rescue me from the clutches of the ruthless’?

verses.textZh: 请指教，我就默不作声； 请指示，我有甚么过错。
verses.textZhCnvs: 请指教，我就默不作声； 请指示，我有甚么过错。
verses.textZhCuv: 请你们教导我，我便不作声； 使我明白在何事上有错。
verses.textEnNiv: "Teach me, and I will be quiet; show me where I have been wrong.
verses.textEnEsv: "Teach me, and I will be silent; make me understand how I have gone astray.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Teach me, and I will hold my tongue; Cause me to understand wherein I have erred.
verses.textEnNlt: Teach me, and I will keep quiet. Show me what I have done wrong.
verses.textEnNasb: "Teach me, and I will be silent; And show me how I have done wrong.
verses.textEn: "Teach me, and I will be quiet; show me where I have been wrong.

verses.textZh: 正直的言语多么有力！ 但你们的责备究竟责备甚么呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 正直的言语多么有力！ 但你们的责备究竟责备甚么呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 正直的言语力量何其大！ 但你们责备是责备什么呢？
verses.textEnNiv: How painful are honest words! But what do your arguments prove?
verses.textEnEsv: How forceful are upright words! But what does reproof from you reprove?
verses.textEnNkjv: How forceful are right words! But what does your arguing prove?
verses.textEnNlt: Honest words can be painful, but what do your criticisms amount to?
verses.textEnNasb: "How painful are honest words! But what does your argument prove?
verses.textEn: How painful are honest words! But what do your arguments prove?

verses.textZh: 绝望人的话不过是风， 你们还想批判吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 绝望人的话不过是风， 你们还想批判吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 绝望人的讲论既然如风， 你们还想要驳正言语吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Do you mean to correct what I say, and treat my desperate words as wind?
verses.textEnEsv: Do you think that you can reprove words, when the speech of a despairing man is wind?
verses.textEnNkjv: Do you intend to rebuke my words, And the speeches of a desperate one, whichare as wind?
verses.textEnNlt: Do you think your words are convincing when you disregard my cry of desperation?
verses.textEnNasb: "Do you intend to rebuke my words, When the words of one in despair belong to the wind?
verses.textEn: Do you mean to correct what I say, and treat my desperate words as wind?

verses.textZh: 你们竟抽签得孤儿， 拿朋友当货物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们竟抽签得孤儿， 拿朋友当货物。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们想为孤儿拈阄， 以朋友当货物。
verses.textEnNiv: You would even cast lots for the fatherless and barter away your friend.
verses.textEnEsv: You would even cast lots over the fatherless, and bargain over your friend.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yes, you overwhelm the fatherless, And you undermine your friend.
verses.textEnNlt: You would even send an orphan into slavery or sell a friend.
verses.textEnNasb: "You would even cast lots for the orphans, And barter over your friend.
verses.textEn: You would even cast lots for the fatherless and barter away your friend.

verses.textZh: 现在请你们看看我， 我绝不当你们的面撒谎。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在请你们看看我， 我绝不当你们的面撒谎。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在请你们看看我， 我决不当面说谎。
verses.textEnNiv: "But now be so kind as to look at me. Would I lie to your face?
verses.textEnEsv: "But now, be pleased to look at me, for I will not lie to your face.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, be pleased to look at me; For I would never lie to your face.
verses.textEnNlt: Look at me! Would I lie to your face?
verses.textEnNasb: "Now please look at me, And see if I am lying to your face.
verses.textEn: "But now be so kind as to look at me. Would I lie to your face?

verses.textZh: 请转意，不要不公道； 请再转意，我还有道理在。
verses.textZhCnvs: 请转意，不要不公道； 请再转意，我还有道理在。
verses.textZhCuv: 请你们转意，不要不公； 请再转意，我的事有理。
verses.textEnNiv: Relent, do not be unjust; reconsider, for my integrity is at stake.
verses.textEnEsv: Please turn; let no injustice be done. Turn now; my vindication is at stake.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yield now, let there be no injustice! Yes, concede, my righteousness still stands!
verses.textEnNlt: Stop assuming my guilt, for I have done no wrong.
verses.textEnNasb: "Please turn away, let there be no injustice; Turn away, my righteousness is still in it.
verses.textEn: Relent, do not be unjust; reconsider, for my integrity is at stake.

verses.textZh: 我的舌上有不义吗？ 我的口不能辨别灾害吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的舌上有不义吗？ 我的口不能辨别灾害吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 我的舌上岂有不义吗？ 我的口里岂不辨奸恶吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Is there any wickedness on my lips? Can my mouth not discern malice?
verses.textEnEsv: Is there any injustice on my tongue? Cannot my palate discern the cause of calamity?
verses.textEnNkjv: Is there injustice on my tongue? Cannot my taste discern the unsavory?
verses.textEnNlt: Do you think I am lying? Don’t I know the difference between right and wrong?
verses.textEnNasb: "Is there injustice on my tongue? Does my palate not discern disasters?
verses.textEn: Is there any wickedness on my lips? Can my mouth not discern malice?

verses.textZh: "人在世上怎能没有劳役呢？ 他的日子不像雇工的日子吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: "人在世上怎能没有劳役呢？ 他的日子不像雇工的日子吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 人在世上岂无争战吗？ 他的日子不像雇工人的日子吗？
verses.textEnNiv: "Do not mortals have hard service on earth? Are not their days like those of hired laborers?
verses.textEnEsv: "Has not man a hard service on earth, and are not his days like the days of a hired hand?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Isthere not a time of hard service for man on earth? Arenot his days also like the days of a hired man?
verses.textEnNlt: "Is not all human life a struggle? Our lives are like that of a hired hand,
verses.textEnNasb: " Is a person not forced to labor on earth, And are his days not like the days of a hired worker?
verses.textEn: "Do not mortals have hard service on earth? Are not their days like those of hired laborers?

verses.textZh: 正如仆人切慕暮影， 又像雇工盼望工价。
verses.textZhCnvs: 正如仆人切慕暮影， 又像雇工盼望工价。
verses.textZhCuv: 像奴仆切慕黑影， 像雇工人盼望工价；
verses.textEnNiv: Like a slave longing for the evening shadows, or a hired laborer waiting to be paid,
verses.textEnEsv: Like a slave who longs for the shadow, and like a hired hand who looks for his wages,
verses.textEnNkjv: Like a servant who earnestly desires the shade, And like a hired man who eagerly looks for his wages,
verses.textEnNlt: like a worker who longs for the shade, like a servant waiting to be paid.
verses.textEnNasb: "As a slave pants for the shade, And as a hired worker who eagerly waits for his wages,
verses.textEn: Like a slave longing for the evening shadows, or a hired laborer waiting to be paid,

verses.textZh: 照样，我有空虚的岁月， 也有劳苦的黑夜为我派定。
verses.textZhCnvs: 照样，我有空虚的岁月， 也有劳苦的黑夜为我派定。
verses.textZhCuv: 我也照样经过困苦的日月， 夜间的疲乏为我而定。
verses.textEnNiv: so I have been allotted months of futility, and nights of misery have been assigned to me.
verses.textEnEsv: so I am allotted months of emptiness, and nights of misery are apportioned to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: So I have been allotted months of futility, And wearisome nights have been appointed to me.
verses.textEnNlt: I, too, have been assigned months of futility, long and weary nights of misery.
verses.textEnNasb: So I am allotted worthless months, And nights of trouble are apportioned to me.
verses.textEn: so I have been allotted months of futility, and nights of misery have been assigned to me.

verses.textZh: 我躺下的时候，就说： ‘我甚么时候起来？’ 然而，长夜漫漫，我辗转反侧，直到黎明。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我躺下的时候，就说： ‘我甚么时候起来？’ 然而，长夜漫漫，我辗转反侧，直到黎明。
verses.textZhCuv: 我躺卧的时候便说： 我何时起来，黑夜就过去呢？ 我尽是反来复去，直到天亮。
verses.textEnNiv: When I lie down I think, ‘How long before I get up?’ The night drags on, and I toss and turn until dawn.
verses.textEnEsv: When I lie down I say, ‘When shall I arise?’ But the night is long, and I toss and turn till the dawn.
verses.textEnNkjv: When I lie down, I say, ‘When shall I arise, And the night be ended?’ For I have had my fill of tossing till dawn.
verses.textEnNlt: Lying in bed, I think, ‘When will it be morning?’ But the night drags on, and I toss till dawn.
verses.textEnNasb: "When I lie down, I say, ‘When shall I arise?’ But the night continues, And I am continually tossing until dawn.
verses.textEn: When I lie down I think, ‘How long before I get up?’ The night drags on, and I toss and turn until dawn.

verses.textZh: 我的肉体以虫子和土块为衣裳， 我的皮肤裂开又流脓。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的肉体以虫子和土块为衣裳， 我的皮肤裂开又流脓。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的肉体以虫子和尘土为衣； 我的皮肤才收了口又重新破裂。
verses.textEnNiv: My body is clothed with worms and scabs, my skin is broken and festering.
verses.textEnEsv: My flesh is clothed with worms and dirt; my skin hardens, then breaks out afresh.
verses.textEnNkjv: My flesh is caked with worms and dust, My skin is cracked and breaks out afresh.
verses.textEnNlt: My body is covered with maggots and scabs. My skin breaks open, oozing with pus.
verses.textEnNasb: "My flesh is clothed with maggots and a crust of dirt, My skin hardens and oozes.
verses.textEn: My body is clothed with worms and scabs, my skin is broken and festering.

verses.textZh: 我过的日子比梭还要快， 在毫无盼望之中而结束。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我过的日子比梭还要快， 在毫无盼望之中而结束。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的日子比梭更快， 都消耗在无指望之中。
verses.textEnNiv: "My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, and they come to an end without hope.
verses.textEnEsv: My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle and come to their end without hope.
verses.textEnNkjv: "My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, And are spent without hope.
verses.textEnNlt: "My days fly faster than a weaver’s shuttle. They end without hope.
verses.textEnNasb: "My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, And they come to an end without hope.
verses.textEn: "My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, and they come to an end without hope.

verses.textZh: 求你记念我的性命不过是一口气， 我的眼必不再看见福乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你记念我的性命不过是一口气， 我的眼必不再看见福乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你想念，我的生命不过是一口气； 我的眼睛必不再见福乐。
verses.textEnNiv: Remember, O God, that my life is but a breath; my eyes will never see happiness again.
verses.textEnEsv: "Remember that my life is a breath; my eye will never again see good.
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, remember that my life is a breath! My eye will never again see good.
verses.textEnNlt: O God, remember that my life is but a breath, and I will never again feel happiness.
verses.textEnNasb: "Remember that my life is a mere breath; My eye will not see goodness again.
verses.textEn: Remember, O God, that my life is but a breath; my eyes will never see happiness again.

verses.textZh: 看我的，他的眼再也看不到我， 你的眼要看我，我已经不在了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看我的，他的眼再也看不到我， 你的眼要看我，我已经不在了。
verses.textZhCuv: 观看我的人，他的眼必不再见我； 你的眼目要看我，我却不在了。
verses.textEnNiv: The eye that now sees me will see me no longer; you will look for me, but I will be no more.
verses.textEnEsv: The eye of him who sees me will behold me no more; while your eyes are on me, I shall be gone.
verses.textEnNkjv: The eye of him who sees me will see me no more; While your eyes are upon me, I shall no longer be.
verses.textEnNlt: You see me now, but not for long. You will look for me, but I will be gone.
verses.textEnNasb: "The eye of him who sees me will no longer look at me; Your eyes will be on me, but I will not exist.
verses.textEn: The eye that now sees me will see me no longer; you will look for me, but I will be no more.

verses.textZh: 云彩怎样消散逝去， 照样，人下阴间也不再上来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 云彩怎样消散逝去， 照样，人下阴间也不再上来。
verses.textZhCuv: 云彩消散而过； 照样，人下阴间也不再上来。
verses.textEnNiv: As a cloud vanishes and is gone, so one who goes down to the grave does not return.
verses.textEnEsv: As the cloud fades and vanishes, so he who goes down to Sheol does not come up;
verses.textEnNkjv: As the cloud disappears and vanishes away, So he who goes down to the grave does not come up.
verses.textEnNlt: Just as a cloud dissipates and vanishes, those who die will not come back.
verses.textEnNasb: "When a cloud vanishes, it is gone; In the same way one who goes down to Sheol does not come up.
verses.textEn: As a cloud vanishes and is gone, so one who goes down to the grave does not return.

verses.textZh: 他不再回自己的家， 故乡再也不认识他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他不再回自己的家， 故乡再也不认识他。
verses.textZhCuv: 他不再回自己的家； 故土也不再认识他。
verses.textEnNiv: He will never come to his house again; his place will know him no more.
verses.textEnEsv: he returns no more to his house, nor does his place know him anymore.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall never return to his house, Nor shall his place know him anymore.
verses.textEnNlt: They are gone forever from their home— never to be seen again.
verses.textEnNasb: "He will not return to his house again, Nor will his place know about him anymore.
verses.textEn: He will never come to his house again; his place will know him no more.

verses.textZh: 因此，我不再禁止我的口， 我要说出灵里的忧愁， 倾诉心中的痛苦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，我不再禁止我的口， 我要说出灵里的忧愁， 倾诉心中的痛苦。
verses.textZhCuv: 我不禁止我口； 我灵愁苦，要发出言语； 我心苦恼，要吐露哀情。
verses.textEnNiv: "Therefore I will not keep silent; I will speak out in the anguish of my spirit, I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.
verses.textEnEsv: "Therefore I will not restrain my mouth; I will speak in the anguish of my spirit; I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore I will not restrain my mouth; I will speak in the anguish of my spirit; I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.
verses.textEnNlt: "I cannot keep from speaking. I must express my anguish. My bitter soul must complain.
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore I will not restrain my mouth; I will speak in the anguish of my spirit, I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.
verses.textEn: "Therefore I will not keep silent; I will speak out in the anguish of my spirit, I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.

verses.textZh: 我岂是海洋或是海怪， 你竟然设守卫防备我？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我岂是海洋或是海怪， 你竟然设守卫防备我？
verses.textZhCuv: 我对神说：我岂是洋海， 岂是大鱼，你竟防守我呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Am I the sea, or the monster of the deep, that you put me under guard?
verses.textEnEsv: Am I the sea, or a sea monster, that you set a guard over me?
verses.textEnNkjv: Am I a sea, or a sea serpent, That You set a guard over me?
verses.textEnNlt: Am I a sea monster or a dragon that you must place me under guard?
verses.textEnNasb: "Am I the sea, or the sea monster, That You set a guard over me?
verses.textEn: Am I the sea, or the monster of the deep, that you put me under guard?

verses.textZh: 我若说：‘我的床必安慰我， 我的榻必减轻我的苦情’，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我若说：‘我的床必安慰我， 我的榻必减轻我的苦情’，
verses.textZhCuv: 若说：我的床必安慰我， 我的榻必解释我的苦情，
verses.textEnNiv: When I think my bed will comfort me and my couch will ease my complaint,
verses.textEnEsv: When I say, ‘My bed will comfort me, my couch will ease my complaint,’
verses.textEnNkjv: When I say, ‘My bed will comfort me, My couch will ease my complaint,’
verses.textEnNlt: I think, ‘My bed will comfort me, and sleep will ease my misery,’
verses.textEnNasb: "If I say, ‘My couch will comfort me, My bed will ease my complaint,’
verses.textEn: When I think my bed will comfort me and my couch will ease my complaint,

verses.textZh: 你就用梦惊扰我， 又用异象惊吓我，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你就用梦惊扰我， 又用异象惊吓我，
verses.textZhCuv: 你就用梦惊骇我， 用异象恐吓我，
verses.textEnNiv: even then you frighten me with dreams and terrify me with visions,
verses.textEnEsv: then you scare me with dreams and terrify me with visions,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then You scare me with dreams And terrify me with visions,
verses.textEnNlt: but then you shatter me with dreams and terrify me with visions.
verses.textEnNasb: Then You frighten me with dreams, And terrify me by visions,
verses.textEn: even then you frighten me with dreams and terrify me with visions,

verses.textZh: 以致我宁可窒息而死， 也不肯保留我这一身的骨头。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以致我宁可窒息而死， 也不肯保留我这一身的骨头。
verses.textZhCuv: 甚至我宁肯噎死，宁肯死亡， 胜似留我这一身的骨头。
verses.textEnNiv: so that I prefer strangling and death, rather than this body of mine.
verses.textEnEsv: so that I would choose strangling and death rather than my bones.
verses.textEnNkjv: So that my soul chooses strangling And death rather than my body.
verses.textEnNlt: I would rather be strangled— rather die than suffer like this.
verses.textEnNasb: So that my soul would choose suffocation, Death rather than my pains.
verses.textEn: so that I prefer strangling and death, rather than this body of mine.

verses.textZh: 我厌恶自己，不愿永远活下去。 任凭我吧，因为我的日子都是空虚的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我厌恶自己，不愿永远活下去。 任凭我吧，因为我的日子都是空虚的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我厌弃性命，不愿永活。 你任凭我吧，因我的日子都是虚空。
verses.textEnNiv: I despise my life; I would not live forever. Let me alone; my days have no meaning.
verses.textEnEsv: I loathe my life; I would not live forever. Leave me alone, for my days are a breath.
verses.textEnNkjv: I loathe mylife; I would not live forever. Let me alone, For my days arebut a breath.
verses.textEnNlt: I hate my life and don’t want to go on living. Oh, leave me alone for my few remaining days.
verses.textEnNasb: "I waste away; I will not live forever. Leave me alone, for my days are only a breath.
verses.textEn: I despise my life; I would not live forever. Let me alone; my days have no meaning.

verses.textZh: 人算甚么，你竟看他为大， 又把他放在心上；
verses.textZhCnvs: 人算甚么，你竟看他为大， 又把他放在心上；
verses.textZhCuv: 人算什么，你竟看他为大， 将他放在心上？
verses.textEnNiv: "What is mankind that you make so much of them, that you give them so much attention,
verses.textEnEsv: What is man, that you make so much of him, and that you set your heart on him,
verses.textEnNkjv: "What is man, that You should exalt him, That You should set Your heart on him,
verses.textEnNlt: "What are people, that you should make so much of us, that you should think of us so often?
verses.textEnNasb: "What is man that You exalt him, And that You are concerned about him,
verses.textEn: "What is mankind that you make so much of them, that you give them so much attention,

verses.textZh: 每天早晨你都鉴察他， 每时每刻你也试验他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 每天早晨你都鉴察他， 每时每刻你也试验他。
verses.textZhCuv: 每早鉴察他， 时刻试验他？
verses.textEnNiv: that you examine them every morning and test them every moment?
verses.textEnEsv: visit him every morning and test him every moment?
verses.textEnNkjv: That You should visit him every morning, And test him every moment?
verses.textEnNlt: For you examine us every morning and test us every moment.
verses.textEnNasb: That You examine him every morning And put him to the test every moment?
verses.textEn: that you examine them every morning and test them every moment?

verses.textZh: 你到甚么时候才转眼不看我， 任凭我咽下唾沫呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你到甚么时候才转眼不看我， 任凭我咽下唾沫呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你到何时才转眼不看我， 才任凭我咽下唾沫呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Will you never look away from me, or let me alone even for an instant?
verses.textEnEsv: How long will you not look away from me, nor leave me alone till I swallow my spit?
verses.textEnNkjv: How long? Will You not look away from me, And let me alone till I swallow my saliva?
verses.textEnNlt: Why won’t you leave me alone, at least long enough for me to swallow!
verses.textEnNasb: " Will You never turn Your gaze away from me, Nor leave me alone until I swallow my spittle?
verses.textEn: Will you never look away from me, or let me alone even for an instant?

verses.textZh: 鉴察世人的主啊！ 我若犯了罪，跟你有甚么关系呢？ 你为甚么把我当作箭靶， 使我以自己为重担呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 鉴察世人的主啊！ 我若犯了罪，跟你有甚么关系呢？ 你为甚么把我当作箭靶， 使我以自己为重担呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 鉴察人的主啊，我若有罪，于你何妨？ 为何以我当你的箭靶子， 使我厌弃自己的性命？
verses.textEnNiv: If I have sinned, what have I done to you, you who see everything we do? Why have you made me your target? Have I become a burden to you?
verses.textEnEsv: If I sin, what do I do to you, you watcher of mankind? Why have you made me your mark? Why have I become a burden to you?
verses.textEnNkjv: Have I sinned? What have I done to You, O watcher of men? Why have You set me as Your target, So that I am a burden to myself?
verses.textEnNlt: If I have sinned, what have I done to you, O watcher of all humanity? Why make me your target? Am I a burden to you?
verses.textEnNasb: "Have I sinned? What have I done to You, Watcher of mankind? Why have You made me Your target, So that I am a burden to myself?
verses.textEn: If I have sinned, what have I done to you, you who see everything we do? Why have you made me your target? Have I become a burden to you?

verses.textZh: 你为甚么不赦免我的过犯， 除去我的罪孽呢？ 现在我快要躺卧在尘土中， 那时你寻找我，我却不在了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你为甚么不赦免我的过犯， 除去我的罪孽呢？ 现在我快要躺卧在尘土中， 那时你寻找我，我却不在了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 为何不赦免我的过犯， 除掉我的罪孽？ 我现今要躺卧在尘土中； 你要殷勤地寻找我，我却不在了。
verses.textEnNiv: Why do you not pardon my offenses and forgive my sins? For I will soon lie down in the dust; you will search for me, but I will be no more."
verses.textEnEsv: Why do you not pardon my transgression and take away my iniquity? For now I shall lie in the earth; you will seek me, but I shall not be."
verses.textEnNkjv: Why then do You not pardon my transgression, And take away my iniquity? For now I will lie down in the dust, And You will seek me diligently, But I will no longer be."
verses.textEnNlt: Why not just forgive my sin and take away my guilt? For soon I will lie down in the dust and die. When you look for me, I will be gone."
verses.textEnNasb: "Why then do You not forgive my wrongdoing And take away my guilt? For now I will lie down in the dust; And You will search for me, but I will no longer exist."
verses.textEn: Why do you not pardon my offenses and forgive my sins? For I will soon lie down in the dust; you will search for me, but I will be no more."

verses.textZh: 书亚人比勒达回答说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 书亚人比勒达回答说：
verses.textZhCuv: 书亚人比勒达回答说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then Bildad the Shuhite replied:
verses.textEnEsv: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered and said:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered and said:
verses.textEnNlt: Then Bildad the Shuhite replied to Job:
verses.textEnNasb: Then Bildad the Shuhite responded,
verses.textEn: Then Bildad the Shuhite replied:

verses.textZh: "这些话你要说到几时， 你口中的言语像狂风到几时呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: "这些话你要说到几时， 你口中的言语像狂风到几时呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 这些话你要说到几时？ 口中的言语如狂风要到几时呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "How long will you say such things? Your words are a blustering wind.
verses.textEnEsv: "How long will you say these things, and the words of your mouth be a great wind?
verses.textEnNkjv: "How long will you speak these things, And the words of your mouth belike a strong wind?
verses.textEnNlt: "How long will you go on like this? You sound like a blustering wind.
verses.textEnNasb: "How long will you say these things, And the words of your mouth be a mighty wind?
verses.textEn: "How long will you say such things? Your words are a blustering wind.

verses.textZh: 神怎会歪曲公平？ 全能者怎会屈枉公义？
verses.textZhCnvs: 神怎会歪曲公平？ 全能者怎会屈枉公义？
verses.textZhCuv: 神岂能偏离公平？ 全能者岂能偏离公义？
verses.textEnNiv: Does God pervert justice? Does the Almighty pervert what is right?
verses.textEnEsv: Does God pervert justice? Or does the Almighty pervert the right?
verses.textEnNkjv: Does God subvert judgment? Or does the Almighty pervert justice?
verses.textEnNlt: Does God twist justice? Does the Almighty twist what is right?
verses.textEnNasb: "Does God pervert justice? Or does the Almighty pervert what is right?
verses.textEn: Does God pervert justice? Does the Almighty pervert what is right?

verses.textZh: 你的儿女若得罪了他， 他就因他们的过犯撇弃他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的儿女若得罪了他， 他就因他们的过犯撇弃他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 或者你的儿女得罪了他； 他使他们受报应。
verses.textEnNiv: When your children sinned against him, he gave them over to the penalty of their sin.
verses.textEnEsv: If your children have sinned against him, he has delivered them into the hand of their transgression.
verses.textEnNkjv: If your sons have sinned against Him, He has cast them away for their transgression.
verses.textEnNlt: Your children must have sinned against him, so their punishment was well deserved.
verses.textEnNasb: "If your sons sinned against Him, Then He turned them over to the power of their wrongdoing.
verses.textEn: When your children sinned against him, he gave them over to the penalty of their sin.

verses.textZh: 你若殷勤寻求神， 向全能者恳求；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你若殷勤寻求神， 向全能者恳求；
verses.textZhCuv: 你若殷勤地寻求神， 向全能者恳求；
verses.textEnNiv: But if you will seek God earnestly and plead with the Almighty,
verses.textEnEsv: If you will seek God and plead with the Almighty for mercy,
verses.textEnNkjv: If you would earnestly seek God And make your supplication to the Almighty,
verses.textEnNlt: But if you pray to God and seek the favor of the Almighty,
verses.textEnNasb: "If you will search for God And implore the compassion of the Almighty,
verses.textEn: But if you will seek God earnestly and plead with the Almighty,

verses.textZh: 你若又洁净又正直， 他就必为你奋起， 复兴你公义的居所。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你若又洁净又正直， 他就必为你奋起， 复兴你公义的居所。
verses.textZhCuv: 你若清洁正直， 他必定为你起来， 使你公义的居所兴旺。
verses.textEnNiv: if you are pure and upright, even now he will rouse himself on your behalf and restore you to your prosperous state.
verses.textEnEsv: if you are pure and upright, surely then he will rouse himself for you and restore your rightful habitation.
verses.textEnNkjv: If you were pure and upright, Surely now He would awake for you, And prosper your rightful dwelling place.
verses.textEnNlt: and if you are pure and live with integrity, he will surely rise up and restore your happy home.
verses.textEnNasb: If you are pure and upright, Surely now He will stir Himself for you And restore your righteous estate.
verses.textEn: if you are pure and upright, even now he will rouse himself on your behalf and restore you to your prosperous state.

verses.textZh: 你起初虽然微小， 到后来必定非常兴旺。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你起初虽然微小， 到后来必定非常兴旺。
verses.textZhCuv: 你起初虽然微小， 终久必甚发达。
verses.textEnNiv: Your beginnings will seem humble, so prosperous will your future be.
verses.textEnEsv: And though your beginning was small, your latter days will be very great.
verses.textEnNkjv: Though your beginning was small, Yet your latter end would increase abundantly.
verses.textEnNlt: And though you started with little, you will end with much.
verses.textEnNasb: "Though your beginning was insignificant, Yet your end will increase greatly.
verses.textEn: Your beginnings will seem humble, so prosperous will your future be.

verses.textZh: 请你查问前几代， 留意他们列祖所查究的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 请你查问前几代， 留意他们列祖所查究的。
verses.textZhCuv: 请你考问前代， 追念他们的列祖所查究的。
verses.textEnNiv: "Ask the former generation and find out what their ancestors learned,
verses.textEnEsv: "For inquire, please, of bygone ages, and consider what the fathers have searched out.
verses.textEnNkjv: "For inquire, please, of the former age, And consider the things discovered by their fathers;
verses.textEnNlt: "Just ask the previous generation. Pay attention to the experience of our ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: "Please inquire of past generations, And consider the things searched out by their fathers.
verses.textEn: "Ask the former generation and find out what their ancestors learned,

verses.textZh: 我们只是昨天才有的，所以一无所知； 我们在世的日子不过是影儿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们只是昨天才有的，所以一无所知； 我们在世的日子不过是影儿。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们不过从昨日才有，一无所知； 我们在世的日子好像影儿。
verses.textEnNiv: for we were born only yesterday and know nothing, and our days on earth are but a shadow.
verses.textEnEsv: For we are but of yesterday and know nothing, for our days on earth are a shadow.
verses.textEnNkjv: For we wereborn yesterday, and know nothing, Because our days on earth are a shadow.
verses.textEnNlt: For we were born but yesterday and know nothing. Our days on earth are as fleeting as a shadow.
verses.textEnNasb: "For we are only of yesterday and know nothing, Because our days on earth are as a shadow.
verses.textEn: for we were born only yesterday and know nothing, and our days on earth are but a shadow.

verses.textZh: 难道他们不指教你，告诉你， 从心里发出言语来吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 难道他们不指教你，告诉你， 从心里发出言语来吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 他们岂不指教你，告诉你， 从心里发出言语来呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Will they not instruct you and tell you? Will they not bring forth words from their understanding?
verses.textEnEsv: Will they not teach you and tell you and utter words out of their understanding?
verses.textEnNkjv: Will they not teach you and tell you, And utter words from their heart?
verses.textEnNlt: But those who came before us will teach you. They will teach you the wisdom of old.
verses.textEnNasb: "Will they not teach you and tell you, And bring forth words from their minds?
verses.textEn: Will they not instruct you and tell you? Will they not bring forth words from their understanding?

verses.textZh: 蒲草没有泥，怎能生长？ 芦苇没有水，怎能长大呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 蒲草没有泥，怎能生长？ 芦苇没有水，怎能长大呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 蒲草没有泥岂能发长？ 芦荻没有水岂能生发？
verses.textEnNiv: Can papyrus grow tall where there is no marsh? Can reeds thrive without water?
verses.textEnEsv: "Can papyrus grow where there is no marsh? Can reeds flourish where there is no water?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Can the papyrus grow up without a marsh? Can the reeds flourish without water?
verses.textEnNlt: "Can papyrus reeds grow tall without a marsh? Can marsh grass flourish without water?
verses.textEnNasb: "Can papyrus grow tall without a marsh? Can the rushes grow without water?
verses.textEn: Can papyrus grow tall where there is no marsh? Can reeds thrive without water?

verses.textZh: 尚青还没有割下来的时候， 就比百草先枯槁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 尚青还没有割下来的时候， 就比百草先枯槁。
verses.textZhCuv: 尚青的时候，还没有割下， 比百样的草先枯槁。
verses.textEnNiv: While still growing and uncut, they wither more quickly than grass.
verses.textEnEsv: While yet in flower and not cut down, they wither before any other plant.
verses.textEnNkjv: While it is yet green and not cut down, It withers before any other plant.
verses.textEnNlt: While they are still flowering, not ready to be cut, they begin to wither more quickly than grass.
verses.textEnNasb: "While it is still green and not cut down, Yet it withers before any other plant.
verses.textEn: While still growing and uncut, they wither more quickly than grass.

verses.textZh: 忘记神的，他们的末路也是这样； 不敬虔的人，他的指望必成泡影。
verses.textZhCnvs: 忘记神的，他们的末路也是这样； 不敬虔的人，他的指望必成泡影。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡忘记神的人，景况也是这样； 不虔敬人的指望要灭没。
verses.textEnNiv: Such is the destiny of all who forget God; so perishes the hope of the godless.
verses.textEnEsv: Such are the paths of all who forget God; the hope of the godless shall perish.
verses.textEnNkjv: So are the paths of all who forget God; And the hope of the hypocrite shall perish,
verses.textEnNlt: The same happens to all who forget God. The hopes of the godless evaporate.
verses.textEnNasb: "So are the paths of all who forget God; And the hope of the godless will perish,
verses.textEn: Such is the destiny of all who forget God; so perishes the hope of the godless.

verses.textZh: 他所自恃的，必被折断； 他所靠赖的，不过是蜘蛛网。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他所自恃的，必被折断； 他所靠赖的，不过是蜘蛛网。
verses.textZhCuv: 他所仰赖的必折断； 他所倚靠的是蜘蛛网。
verses.textEnNiv: What they trust in is fragile ; what they rely on is a spider’s web.
verses.textEnEsv: His confidence is severed, and his trust is a spider’s web.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whose confidence shall be cut off, And whose trust is a spider’s web.
verses.textEnNlt: Their confidence hangs by a thread. They are leaning on a spider’s web.
verses.textEnNasb: His confidence is fragile, And his trust is a spider’s web.
verses.textEn: What they trust in is fragile ; what they rely on is a spider’s web.

verses.textZh: 他倚靠自己的家，家却立不住， 他抓紧自己的家，家却存不久。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他倚靠自己的家，家却立不住， 他抓紧自己的家，家却存不久。
verses.textZhCuv: 他要倚靠房屋，房屋却站立不住； 他要抓住房屋，房屋却不能存留。
verses.textEnNiv: They lean on the web, but it gives way; they cling to it, but it does not hold.
verses.textEnEsv: He leans against his house, but it does not stand; he lays hold of it, but it does not endure.
verses.textEnNkjv: He leans on his house, but it does not stand. He holds it fast, but it does not endure.
verses.textEnNlt: They cling to their home for security, but it won’t last. They try to hold it tight, but it will not endure.
verses.textEnNasb: "He depends on his house, but it does not stand; He holds on to it, but it does not endure.
verses.textEn: They lean on the web, but it gives way; they cling to it, but it does not hold.

verses.textZh: 他在阳光之下，枝润叶青， 它的嫩枝长满园子，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在阳光之下，枝润叶青， 它的嫩枝长满园子，
verses.textZhCuv: 他在日光之下发青， 蔓子爬满了园子；
verses.textEnNiv: They are like a well-watered plant in the sunshine, spreading its shoots over the garden;
verses.textEnEsv: He is a lush plant before the sun, and his shoots spread over his garden.
verses.textEnNkjv: He grows green in the sun, And his branches spread out in his garden.
verses.textEnNlt: The godless seem like a lush plant growing in the sunshine, its branches spreading across the garden.
verses.textEnNasb: "He flourishes before the sun, And his shoots spread out over his garden.
verses.textEn: They are like a well-watered plant in the sunshine, spreading its shoots over the garden;

verses.textZh: 它的根缠绕石堆， 扎入石地之中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 它的根缠绕石堆， 扎入石地之中。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的根盘绕石堆， 扎入石地。
verses.textEnNiv: it entwines its roots around a pile of rocks and looks for a place among the stones.
verses.textEnEsv: His roots entwine the stone heap; he looks upon a house of stones.
verses.textEnNkjv: His roots wrap around the rock heap, And look for a place in the stones.
verses.textEnNlt: Its roots grow down through a pile of stones; it takes hold on a bed of rocks.
verses.textEnNasb: "His roots wrap around a rock pile, He grasps a house of stones.
verses.textEn: it entwines its roots around a pile of rocks and looks for a place among the stones.

verses.textZh: 他若从本处被拔除， 那处就否认他，说：‘我没有见过你。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 他若从本处被拔除， 那处就否认他，说：‘我没有见过你。’
verses.textZhCuv: 他若从本地被拔出， 那地就不认识他，说： 我没有见过你。
verses.textEnNiv: But when it is torn from its spot, that place disowns it and says, ‘I never saw you.’
verses.textEnEsv: If he is destroyed from his place, then it will deny him, saying, ‘I have never seen you.’
verses.textEnNkjv: If he is destroyed from his place, Then it will deny him, saying, ‘I have not seen you.’
verses.textEnNlt: But when it is uprooted, it’s as though it never existed!
verses.textEnNasb: "If he is removed from his place, Then it will deny him, saying, ‘I never saw you.’
verses.textEn: But when it is torn from its spot, that place disowns it and says, ‘I never saw you.’

verses.textZh: 看哪，这就是他人生的乐趣， 往后必有别的人从尘土中生出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪，这就是他人生的乐趣， 往后必有别的人从尘土中生出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，这就是他道中之乐； 以后必另有人从地而生。
verses.textEnNiv: Surely its life withers away, and from the soil other plants grow.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, this is the joy of his way, and out of the soil others will spring.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, this is the joy of His way, And out of the earth others will grow.
verses.textEnNlt: That’s the end of its life, and others spring up from the earth to replace it.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, this is the joy of His way; And out of the dust others will spring.
verses.textEn: Surely its life withers away, and from the soil other plants grow.

verses.textZh: 看哪，神必不离弃完全人， 也不扶助行恶的人之手；
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪，神必不离弃完全人， 也不扶助行恶的人之手；
verses.textZhCuv: 神必不丢弃完全人， 也不扶助邪恶人。
verses.textEnNiv: "Surely God does not reject one who is blameless or strengthen the hands of evildoers.
verses.textEnEsv: "Behold, God will not reject a blameless man, nor take the hand of evildoers.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, God will not cast away the blameless, Nor will He uphold the evildoers.
verses.textEnNlt: "But look, God will not reject a person of integrity, nor will he lend a hand to the wicked.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, God will not reject a person of integrity, Nor will He help evildoers.
verses.textEn: "Surely God does not reject one who is blameless or strengthen the hands of evildoers.

verses.textZh: 他还要以欢笑充满你的口， 以欢呼充满你的嘴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他还要以欢笑充满你的口， 以欢呼充满你的嘴。
verses.textZhCuv: 他还要以喜笑充满你的口， 以欢呼充满你的嘴。
verses.textEnNiv: He will yet fill your mouth with laughter and your lips with shouts of joy.
verses.textEnEsv: He will yet fill your mouth with laughter, and your lips with shouting.
verses.textEnNkjv: He will yet fill your mouth with laughing, And your lips with rejoicing.
verses.textEnNlt: He will once again fill your mouth with laughter and your lips with shouts of joy.
verses.textEnNasb: "He will yet fill your mouth with laughter, And your lips with joyful shouting.
verses.textEn: He will yet fill your mouth with laughter and your lips with shouts of joy.

verses.textZh: 恨你的都必以羞耻为衣， 恶人的帐棚必归于无有。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 恨你的都必以羞耻为衣， 恶人的帐棚必归于无有。"
verses.textZhCuv: 恨恶你的要披戴惭愧； 恶人的帐棚必归于无有。
verses.textEnNiv: Your enemies will be clothed in shame, and the tents of the wicked will be no more."
verses.textEnEsv: Those who hate you will be clothed with shame, and the tent of the wicked will be no more."
verses.textEnNkjv: Those who hate you will be clothed with shame, And the dwelling place of the wicked will come to nothing."
verses.textEnNlt: Those who hate you will be clothed with shame, and the home of the wicked will be destroyed."
verses.textEnNasb: "Those who hate you will be clothed with shame, And the tent of the wicked will no longer exist."
verses.textEn: Your enemies will be clothed in shame, and the tents of the wicked will be no more."

verses.textZh: 约伯回答说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 约伯回答说：
verses.textZhCuv: 约伯回答说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then Job replied:
verses.textEnEsv: Then Job answered and said:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Job answered and said:
verses.textEnNlt: Then Job spoke again:
verses.textEnNasb: Then Job responded,
verses.textEn: Then Job replied:

verses.textZh: "我实在知道是这样， 但是，人在神面前怎能算为公义呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: "我实在知道是这样， 但是，人在神面前怎能算为公义呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 我真知道是这样； 但人在神面前怎能成为义呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "Indeed, I know that this is true. But how can mere mortals prove their innocence before God?
verses.textEnEsv: "Truly I know that it is so: But how can a man be in the right before God?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Truly I know itis so, But how can a man be righteous before God?
verses.textEnNlt: "Yes, I know all this is true in principle. But how can a person be declared innocent in God’s sight?
verses.textEnNasb: "In truth I know that this is so; But how can a person be in the right with God?
verses.textEn: "Indeed, I know that this is true. But how can mere mortals prove their innocence before God?

verses.textZh: 人若愿意与他辩论， 连千分之一也答不出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人若愿意与他辩论， 连千分之一也答不出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 若愿意与他争辩， 千中之一也不能回答。
verses.textEnNiv: Though they wished to dispute with him, they could not answer him one time out of a thousand.
verses.textEnEsv: If one wished to contend with him, one could not answer him once in a thousand times.
verses.textEnNkjv: If one wished to contend with Him, He could not answer Him one time out of a thousand.
verses.textEnNlt: If someone wanted to take God to court, would it be possible to answer him even once in a thousand times?
verses.textEnNasb: "If one wished to dispute with Him, He could not answer Him once in a thousand times.
verses.textEn: Though they wished to dispute with him, they could not answer him one time out of a thousand.

verses.textZh: 他心里有智慧，而且有极大的能力， 有谁对他刚硬而平安无事呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 他心里有智慧，而且有极大的能力， 有谁对他刚硬而平安无事呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 他心里有智慧，且大有能力。 谁向神刚硬而得亨通呢？
verses.textEnNiv: His wisdom is profound, his power is vast. Who has resisted him and come out unscathed?
verses.textEnEsv: He is wise in heart and mighty in strength— who has hardened himself against him, and succeeded?—
verses.textEnNkjv: Godis wise in heart and mighty in strength. Who has hardened himself against Him and prospered?
verses.textEnNlt: For God is so wise and so mighty. Who has ever challenged him successfully?
verses.textEnNasb: "Wise in heart and mighty in strength, Who has defied Him without harm?
verses.textEn: His wisdom is profound, his power is vast. Who has resisted him and come out unscathed?

verses.textZh: 他在怒中移山翻冈； 山冈却不知道；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在怒中移山翻冈； 山冈却不知道；
verses.textZhCuv: 他发怒，把山翻倒挪移， 山并不知觉。
verses.textEnNiv: He moves mountains without their knowing it and overturns them in his anger.
verses.textEnEsv: he who removes mountains, and they know it not, when he overturns them in his anger,
verses.textEnNkjv: He removes the mountains, and they do not know When He overturns them in His anger;
verses.textEnNlt: "Without warning, he moves the mountains, overturning them in his anger.
verses.textEnNasb: "It is God who removes the mountains, and they do not know how, When He overturns them in His anger.
verses.textEn: He moves mountains without their knowing it and overturns them in his anger.

verses.textZh: 他使大地震动离开本处， 大地的柱子就摇撼；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他使大地震动离开本处， 大地的柱子就摇撼；
verses.textZhCuv: 他使地震动，离其本位， 地的柱子就摇撼。
verses.textEnNiv: He shakes the earth from its place and makes its pillars tremble.
verses.textEnEsv: who shakes the earth out of its place, and its pillars tremble;
verses.textEnNkjv: He shakes the earth out of its place, And its pillars tremble;
verses.textEnNlt: He shakes the earth from its place, and its foundations tremble.
verses.textEnNasb: "It is He who shakes the earth from its place, And its pillars tremble;
verses.textEn: He shakes the earth from its place and makes its pillars tremble.

verses.textZh: 他吩咐太阳，太阳就不上升， 又封闭众星；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他吩咐太阳，太阳就不上升， 又封闭众星；
verses.textZhCuv: 他吩咐日头不出来，就不出来， 又封闭众星。
verses.textEnNiv: He speaks to the sun and it does not shine; he seals off the light of the stars.
verses.textEnEsv: who commands the sun, and it does not rise; who seals up the stars;
verses.textEnNkjv: He commands the sun, and it does not rise; He seals off the stars;
verses.textEnNlt: If he commands it, the sun won’t rise and the stars won’t shine.
verses.textEnNasb: Who commands the sun not to shine, And puts a seal on the stars;
verses.textEn: He speaks to the sun and it does not shine; he seals off the light of the stars.

verses.textZh: 他独自铺开苍天， 步行在海浪之上；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他独自铺开苍天， 步行在海浪之上；
verses.textZhCuv: 他独自铺张苍天， 步行在海浪之上。
verses.textEnNiv: He alone stretches out the heavens and treads on the waves of the sea.
verses.textEnEsv: who alone stretched out the heavens and trampled the waves of the sea;
verses.textEnNkjv: He alone spreads out the heavens, And treads on the waves of the sea;
verses.textEnNlt: He alone has spread out the heavens and marches on the waves of the sea.
verses.textEnNasb: Who alone stretches out the heavens, And tramples down the waves of the sea;
verses.textEn: He alone stretches out the heavens and treads on the waves of the sea.

verses.textZh: 他造北斗与参星， 昴星和南方的星座；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他造北斗与参星， 昴星和南方的星座；
verses.textZhCuv: 他造北斗、参星、昴星， 并南方的密宫；
verses.textEnNiv: He is the Maker of the Bear and Orion, the Pleiades and the constellations of the south.
verses.textEnEsv: who made the Bear and Orion, the Pleiades and the chambers of the south;
verses.textEnNkjv: He made the Bear, Orion, and the Pleiades, And the chambers of the south;
verses.textEnNlt: He made all the stars—the Bear and Orion, the Pleiades and the constellations of the southern sky.
verses.textEnNasb: Who makes the Bear, Orion, and the Pleiades, And the constellations of the south.
verses.textEn: He is the Maker of the Bear and Orion, the Pleiades and the constellations of the south.

verses.textZh: 他所行的大事无法测度， 所行的奇事不可胜数。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他所行的大事无法测度， 所行的奇事不可胜数。
verses.textZhCuv: 他行大事，不可测度， 行奇事，不可胜数。
verses.textEnNiv: He performs wonders that cannot be fathomed, miracles that cannot be counted.
verses.textEnEsv: who does great things beyond searching out, and marvelous things beyond number.
verses.textEnNkjv: He does great things past finding out, Yes, wonders without number.
verses.textEnNlt: He does great things too marvelous to understand. He performs countless miracles.
verses.textEnNasb: "It is He who does great things, the unfathomable, And wondrous works without number.
verses.textEn: He performs wonders that cannot be fathomed, miracles that cannot be counted.

verses.textZh: 他行过我身边，我却看不见； 他掠过去，我竟不觉察。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他行过我身边，我却看不见； 他掠过去，我竟不觉察。
verses.textZhCuv: 他从我旁边经过，我却不看见； 他在我面前行走，我倒不知觉。
verses.textEnNiv: When he passes me, I cannot see him; when he goes by, I cannot perceive him.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, he passes by me, and I see him not; he moves on, but I do not perceive him.
verses.textEnNkjv: If He goes by me, I do not see Him; If He moves past, I do not perceive Him;
verses.textEnNlt: "Yet when he comes near, I cannot see him. When he moves by, I do not see him go.
verses.textEnNasb: "If He were to pass by me, I would not see Him; Were He to move past me, I would not perceive Him.
verses.textEn: When he passes me, I cannot see him; when he goes by, I cannot perceive him.

verses.textZh: 他夺取，谁能拦阻他？ 谁敢问他：‘你干甚么？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 他夺取，谁能拦阻他？ 谁敢问他：‘你干甚么？’
verses.textZhCuv: 他夺取，谁能阻挡？ 谁敢问他：你做什么？
verses.textEnNiv: If he snatches away, who can stop him? Who can say to him, ‘What are you doing?’
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, he snatches away; who can turn him back? Who will say to him, ‘What are you doing?’
verses.textEnNkjv: If He takes away, who can hinder Him? Who can say to Him, ‘What are You doing?’
verses.textEnNlt: If he snatches someone in death, who can stop him? Who dares to ask, ‘What are you doing?’
verses.textEnNasb: "If He were to snatch away, who could restrain Him? Who could say to Him, ‘What are You doing?’
verses.textEn: If he snatches away, who can stop him? Who can say to him, ‘What are you doing?’

verses.textZh: 神必不抑制他的怒气， 海怪拉哈伯的助手都俯伏在他以下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神必不抑制他的怒气， 海怪拉哈伯的助手都俯伏在他以下。
verses.textZhCuv: 神必不收回他的怒气； 扶助拉哈伯的，屈身在他以下。
verses.textEnNiv: God does not restrain his anger; even the cohorts of Rahab cowered at his feet.
verses.textEnEsv: "God will not turn back his anger; beneath him bowed the helpers of Rahab.
verses.textEnNkjv: God will not withdraw His anger, The allies of the proud lie prostrate beneath Him.
verses.textEnNlt: And God does not restrain his anger. Even the monsters of the sea are crushed beneath his feet.
verses.textEnNasb: "God will not turn back His anger; Beneath Him the helpers of Rahab cower.
verses.textEn: God does not restrain his anger; even the cohorts of Rahab cowered at his feet.

verses.textZh: 何况我呢？我怎敢回答他， 措辞与他辩论呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 何况我呢？我怎敢回答他， 措辞与他辩论呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 既是这样，我怎敢回答他， 怎敢选择言语与他辩论呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "How then can I dispute with him? How can I find words to argue with him?
verses.textEnEsv: How then can I answer him, choosing my words with him?
verses.textEnNkjv: "How then can I answer Him, And choose my words toreason with Him?
verses.textEnNlt: "So who am I, that I should try to answer God or even reason with him?
verses.textEnNasb: "How then can I answer Him, And choose my words before Him?
verses.textEn: "How then can I dispute with him? How can I find words to argue with him?

verses.textZh: 即使我有理，也不敢回答， 只向那审判我的求怜悯；
verses.textZhCnvs: 即使我有理，也不敢回答， 只向那审判我的求怜悯；
verses.textZhCuv: 我虽有义，也不回答他， 只要向那审判我的恳求。
verses.textEnNiv: Though I were innocent, I could not answer him; I could only plead with my Judge for mercy.
verses.textEnEsv: Though I am in the right, I cannot answer him; I must appeal for mercy to my accuser.
verses.textEnNkjv: For though I were righteous, I could not answer Him; I would beg mercy of my Judge.
verses.textEnNlt: Even if I were right, I would have no defense. I could only plead for mercy.
verses.textEnNasb: "For though I were right, I could not answer; I would have to implore the mercy of my Judge.
verses.textEn: Though I were innocent, I could not answer him; I could only plead with my Judge for mercy.

verses.textZh: 即使我呼求，他也回答我， 我还是不信他会垂听我的声音。
verses.textZhCnvs: 即使我呼求，他也回答我， 我还是不信他会垂听我的声音。
verses.textZhCuv: 我若呼吁，他应允我； 我仍不信他真听我的声音。
verses.textEnNiv: Even if I summoned him and he responded, I do not believe he would give me a hearing.
verses.textEnEsv: If I summoned him and he answered me, I would not believe that he was listening to my voice.
verses.textEnNkjv: If I called and He answered me, I would not believe that He was listening to my voice.
verses.textEnNlt: And even if I summoned him and he responded, I’m not sure he would listen to me.
verses.textEnNasb: "If I called and He answered me, I could not believe that He was listening to my voice.
verses.textEn: Even if I summoned him and he responded, I do not believe he would give me a hearing.

verses.textZh: 他用暴风伤害我， 无缘无故加添我的创伤。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他用暴风伤害我， 无缘无故加添我的创伤。
verses.textZhCuv: 他用暴风折断我， 无故地加增我的损伤。
verses.textEnNiv: He would crush me with a storm and multiply my wounds for no reason.
verses.textEnEsv: For he crushes me with a tempest and multiplies my wounds without cause;
verses.textEnNkjv: For He crushes me with a tempest, And multiplies my wounds without cause.
verses.textEnNlt: For he attacks me with a storm and repeatedly wounds me without cause.
verses.textEnNasb: "For He bruises me with a storm And multiplies my wounds without cause.
verses.textEn: He would crush me with a storm and multiply my wounds for no reason.

verses.textZh: 他不让我喘一口气， 却使我饱尝苦楚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他不让我喘一口气， 却使我饱尝苦楚。
verses.textZhCuv: 我就是喘一口气，他都不容， 倒使我满心苦恼。
verses.textEnNiv: He would not let me catch my breath but would overwhelm me with misery.
verses.textEnEsv: he will not let me get my breath, but fills me with bitterness.
verses.textEnNkjv: He will not allow me to catch my breath, But fills me with bitterness.
verses.textEnNlt: He will not let me catch my breath, but fills me instead with bitter sorrows.
verses.textEnNasb: "He will not allow me to get my breath, But He saturates me with bitterness.
verses.textEn: He would not let me catch my breath but would overwhelm me with misery.

verses.textZh: 若论力量，他多么强大， 若论诉讼，他说：‘谁能把我传来？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 若论力量，他多么强大， 若论诉讼，他说：‘谁能把我传来？’
verses.textZhCuv: 若论力量，他真有能力！ 若论审判，他说谁能将我传来呢？
verses.textEnNiv: If it is a matter of strength, he is mighty! And if it is a matter of justice, who can challenge him ?
verses.textEnEsv: If it is a contest of strength, behold, he is mighty! If it is a matter of justice, who can summon him?
verses.textEnNkjv: If itisamatter of strength, indeed Heis strong; And if of justice, who will appoint my day incourt?
verses.textEnNlt: If it’s a question of strength, he’s the strong one. If it’s a matter of justice, who dares to summon him to court?
verses.textEnNasb: "If it is a matter of power, behold, He is the strong one! And if it is a matter of justice, who can summon Him?
verses.textEn: If it is a matter of strength, he is mighty! And if it is a matter of justice, who can challenge him ?

verses.textZh: 即使我有理，我的口还是定我有罪； 即使我完全，我的口还是判我乖谬。
verses.textZhCnvs: 即使我有理，我的口还是定我有罪； 即使我完全，我的口还是判我乖谬。
verses.textZhCuv: 我虽有义，自己的口要定我为有罪； 我虽完全，我口必显我为弯曲。
verses.textEnNiv: Even if I were innocent, my mouth would condemn me; if I were blameless, it would pronounce me guilty.
verses.textEnEsv: Though I am in the right, my own mouth would condemn me; though I am blameless, he would prove me perverse.
verses.textEnNkjv: Though I were righteous, my own mouth would condemn me; Though I were blameless, it would prove me perverse.
