verses.textEnNlt: Though I am innocent, my own mouth would pronounce me guilty. Though I am blameless, it would prove me wicked.
verses.textEnNasb: "Though I am righteous, my mouth will condemn me; Though I am guiltless, He will declare me guilty.
verses.textEn: Even if I were innocent, my mouth would condemn me; if I were blameless, it would pronounce me guilty.

verses.textZh: 我虽然完全，却不顾我自己， 倒厌恶我的生命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我虽然完全，却不顾我自己， 倒厌恶我的生命。
verses.textZhCuv: 我本完全，不顾自己； 我厌恶我的性命。
verses.textEnNiv: "Although I am blameless, I have no concern for myself; I despise my own life.
verses.textEnEsv: I am blameless; I regard not myself; I loathe my life.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I am blameless, yet I do not know myself; I despise my life.
verses.textEnNlt: "I am innocent, but it makes no difference to me— I despise my life.
verses.textEnNasb: "I am guiltless; I do not take notice of myself; I reject my life.
verses.textEn: "Although I am blameless, I have no concern for myself; I despise my own life.

verses.textZh: 所以我说，善恶都是一样， 完全人和恶人，他都灭尽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以我说，善恶都是一样， 完全人和恶人，他都灭尽。
verses.textZhCuv: 善恶无分，都是一样； 所以我说，完全人和恶人，他都灭绝。
verses.textEnNiv: It is all the same; that is why I say, ‘He destroys both the blameless and the wicked.’
verses.textEnEsv: It is all one; therefore I say, ‘He destroys both the blameless and the wicked.’
verses.textEnNkjv: It is all one thing; Therefore I say, ‘He destroys the blameless and the wicked.’
verses.textEnNlt: Innocent or wicked, it is all the same to God. That’s why I say, ‘He destroys both the blameless and the wicked.’
verses.textEnNasb: "It is all one; therefore I say, ‘He destroys the guiltless and the wicked.’
verses.textEn: It is all the same; that is why I say, ‘He destroys both the blameless and the wicked.’

verses.textZh: 灾祸忽然把人杀害的时候， 他就必嘲笑无辜人的遭遇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 灾祸忽然把人杀害的时候， 他就必嘲笑无辜人的遭遇。
verses.textZhCuv: 若忽然遭杀害之祸， 他必戏笑无辜的人遇难。
verses.textEnNiv: When a scourge brings sudden death, he mocks the despair of the innocent.
verses.textEnEsv: When disaster brings sudden death, he mocks at the calamity of the innocent.
verses.textEnNkjv: If the scourge slays suddenly, He laughs at the plight of the innocent.
verses.textEnNlt: When a plague sweeps through, he laughs at the death of the innocent.
verses.textEnNasb: "If the whip kills suddenly, He mocks the despair of the innocent.
verses.textEn: When a scourge brings sudden death, he mocks the despair of the innocent.

verses.textZh: 全世界交在恶人的手中， 他蒙蔽世上审判官的脸， 如果不是他，那么是谁呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 全世界交在恶人的手中， 他蒙蔽世上审判官的脸， 如果不是他，那么是谁呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 世界交在恶人手中； 蒙蔽世界审判官的脸， 若不是他，是谁呢？
verses.textEnNiv: When a land falls into the hands of the wicked, he blindfolds its judges. If it is not he, then who is it?
verses.textEnEsv: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked; he covers the faces of its judges— if it is not he, who then is it?
verses.textEnNkjv: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked. He covers the faces of its judges. If it is not He, who else could it be?
verses.textEnNlt: The whole earth is in the hands of the wicked, and God blinds the eyes of the judges. If he’s not the one who does it, who is?
verses.textEnNasb: "The earth is handed over to the wicked; He covers the faces of its judges. If it is not He, then who is it?
verses.textEn: When a land falls into the hands of the wicked, he blindfolds its judges. If it is not he, then who is it?

verses.textZh: 我的日子过得比信差还快， 飞快逝去，不见福乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的日子过得比信差还快， 飞快逝去，不见福乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的日子比跑信的更快， 急速过去，不见福乐。
verses.textEnNiv: "My days are swifter than a runner; they fly away without a glimpse of joy.
verses.textEnEsv: "My days are swifter than a runner; they flee away; they see no good.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now my days are swifter than a runner; They flee away, they see no good.
verses.textEnNlt: "My life passes more swiftly than a runner. It flees away without a glimpse of happiness.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now my days are swifter than a runner; They flee away, they see no good.
verses.textEn: "My days are swifter than a runner; they fly away without a glimpse of joy.

verses.textZh: 我的日子消逝有如快船， 好象俯冲猛扑食物的鹰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的日子消逝有如快船， 好象俯冲猛扑食物的鹰。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的日子过去如快船， 如急落抓食的鹰。
verses.textEnNiv: They skim past like boats of papyrus, like eagles swooping down on their prey.
verses.textEnEsv: They go by like skiffs of reed, like an eagle swooping on the prey.
verses.textEnNkjv: They pass by like swift ships, Like an eagle swooping on its prey.
verses.textEnNlt: It disappears like a swift papyrus boat, like an eagle swooping down on its prey.
verses.textEnNasb: "They slip by like reed boats, Like an eagle that swoops on its prey.
verses.textEn: They skim past like boats of papyrus, like eagles swooping down on their prey.

verses.textZh: 我若说：‘我要忘记我的苦情， 要除去愁容，面露喜乐。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我若说：‘我要忘记我的苦情， 要除去愁容，面露喜乐。’
verses.textZhCuv: 我若说：我要忘记我的哀情， 除去我的愁容，心中畅快；
verses.textEnNiv: If I say, ‘I will forget my complaint, I will change my expression, and smile,’
verses.textEnEsv: If I say, ‘I will forget my complaint, I will put off my sad face, and be of good cheer,’
verses.textEnNkjv: If I say, ‘I will forget my complaint, I will put off my sad face and wear a smile,’
verses.textEnNlt: If I decided to forget my complaints, to put away my sad face and be cheerful,
verses.textEnNasb: "Though I say, ‘I will forget my complaint, I will put my face in order and be cheerful,’
verses.textEn: If I say, ‘I will forget my complaint, I will change my expression, and smile,’

verses.textZh: 我就惧怕我的一切痛苦， 因为我知道你必不以我为无辜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我就惧怕我的一切痛苦， 因为我知道你必不以我为无辜。
verses.textZhCuv: 我因愁苦而惧怕， 知道你必不以我为无辜。
verses.textEnNiv: I still dread all my sufferings, for I know you will not hold me innocent.
verses.textEnEsv: I become afraid of all my suffering, for I know you will not hold me innocent.
verses.textEnNkjv: I am afraid of all my sufferings; I know that You will not hold me innocent.
verses.textEnNlt: I would still dread all the pain, for I know you will not find me innocent, O God.
verses.textEnNasb: I am afraid of all my pains, I know that You will not acquit me.
verses.textEn: I still dread all my sufferings, for I know you will not hold me innocent.

verses.textZh: 我既然被定为有罪， 又何必徒然劳苦呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我既然被定为有罪， 又何必徒然劳苦呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 我必被你定为有罪， 我何必徒然劳苦呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Since I am already found guilty, why should I struggle in vain?
verses.textEnEsv: I shall be condemned; why then do I labor in vain?
verses.textEnNkjv: If I am condemned, Why then do I labor in vain?
verses.textEnNlt: Whatever happens, I will be found guilty. So what’s the use of trying?
verses.textEnNasb: "I am guilty, Why then should I struggle in vain?
verses.textEn: Since I am already found guilty, why should I struggle in vain?

verses.textZh: 我若用雪水洗净我的身， 又用碱水洁净我的手，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我若用雪水洗净我的身， 又用碱水洁净我的手，
verses.textZhCuv: 我若用雪水洗身， 用硷洁净我的手，
verses.textEnNiv: Even if I washed myself with soap and my hands with cleansing powder,
verses.textEnEsv: If I wash myself with snow and cleanse my hands with lye,
verses.textEnNkjv: If I wash myself with snow water, And cleanse my hands with soap,
verses.textEnNlt: Even if I were to wash myself with soap and clean my hands with lye,
verses.textEnNasb: "If I washed myself with snow, And cleansed my hands with lye,
verses.textEn: Even if I washed myself with soap and my hands with cleansing powder,

verses.textZh: 你还是把我扔入坑中， 连我的衣服也憎恶我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你还是把我扔入坑中， 连我的衣服也憎恶我。
verses.textZhCuv: 你还要扔我在坑里， 我的衣服都憎恶我。
verses.textEnNiv: you would plunge me into a slime pit so that even my clothes would detest me.
verses.textEnEsv: yet you will plunge me into a pit, and my own clothes will abhor me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet You will plunge me into the pit, And my own clothes will abhor me.
verses.textEnNlt: you would plunge me into a muddy ditch, and my own filthy clothing would hate me.
verses.textEnNasb: Then You would plunge me into the pit, And my own clothes would loathe me.
verses.textEn: you would plunge me into a slime pit so that even my clothes would detest me.

verses.textZh: 他不像我是个人， 使我可以答他，让我们一起对簿公堂。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他不像我是个人， 使我可以答他，让我们一起对簿公堂。
verses.textZhCuv: 他本不像我是人，使我可以回答他， 又使我们可以同听审判。
verses.textEnNiv: "He is not a mere mortal like me that I might answer him, that we might confront each other in court.
verses.textEnEsv: For he is not a man, as I am, that I might answer him, that we should come to trial together.
verses.textEnNkjv: "For Heis not a man, as I am, That I may answer Him, Andthat we should go to court together.
verses.textEnNlt: "God is not a mortal like me, so I cannot argue with him or take him to trial.
verses.textEnNasb: "For He is not a man, as I am, that I may answer Him— That we may go to court together!
verses.textEn: "He is not a mere mortal like me that I might answer him, that we might confront each other in court.

verses.textZh: 我俩之间并没有仲裁者， 能够按手在我们双方身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我俩之间并没有仲裁者， 能够按手在我们双方身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们中间没有听讼的人 可以向我们两造按手。
verses.textEnNiv: If only there were someone to mediate between us, someone to bring us together,
verses.textEnEsv: There is no arbiter between us, who might lay his hand on us both.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nor is there any mediator between us, Who may lay his hand on us both.
verses.textEnNlt: If only there were a mediator between us, someone who could bring us together.
verses.textEnNasb: "There is no arbitrator between us, Who can place his hand upon us both.
verses.textEn: If only there were someone to mediate between us, someone to bring us together,

verses.textZh: 愿他使他的刑杖离开我， 愿他可畏的威严不惊吓我，
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿他使他的刑杖离开我， 愿他可畏的威严不惊吓我，
verses.textZhCuv: 愿他把杖离开我， 不使惊惶威吓我。
verses.textEnNiv: someone to remove God’s rod from me, so that his terror would frighten me no more.
verses.textEnEsv: Let him take his rod away from me, and let not dread of him terrify me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let Him take His rod away from me, And do not let dread of Him terrify me.
verses.textEnNlt: The mediator could make God stop beating me, and I would no longer live in terror of his punishment.
verses.textEnNasb: "Let Him remove His rod from me, And let not the dread of Him terrify me.
verses.textEn: someone to remove God’s rod from me, so that his terror would frighten me no more.

verses.textZh: 我就说话，也不怕他， 因为我本身并不是这种人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我就说话，也不怕他， 因为我本身并不是这种人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我就说话，也不惧怕他， 现在我却不是那样。
verses.textEnNiv: Then I would speak up without fear of him, but as it now stands with me, I cannot.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I would speak without fear of him, for I am not so in myself.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I would speak and not fear Him, But it is not so with me.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I could speak to him without fear, but I cannot do that in my own strength.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then I would speak and not fear Him; But I am not like that in myself.
verses.textEn: Then I would speak up without fear of him, but as it now stands with me, I cannot.

verses.textZh: "我厌恶我的性命， 我要尽情吐苦水， 倾诉心中的痛苦。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我厌恶我的性命， 我要尽情吐苦水， 倾诉心中的痛苦。
verses.textZhCuv: 我厌烦我的性命， 必由着自己述说我的哀情； 因心里苦恼，我要说话，
verses.textEnNiv: "I loathe my very life; therefore I will give free rein to my complaint and speak out in the bitterness of my soul.
verses.textEnEsv: "I loathe my life; I will give free utterance to my complaint; I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.
verses.textEnNkjv: "My soul loathes my life; I will give free course to my complaint, I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.
verses.textEnNlt: "I am disgusted with my life. Let me complain freely. My bitter soul must complain.
verses.textEnNasb: " I am disgusted with my own life; I will express my complaint freely; I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.
verses.textEn: "I loathe my very life; therefore I will give free rein to my complaint and speak out in the bitterness of my soul.

verses.textZh: 我要对神说：不要定我有罪， 请告诉我你为甚么与我相争。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要对神说：不要定我有罪， 请告诉我你为甚么与我相争。
verses.textZhCuv: 对神说：不要定我有罪， 要指示我，你为何与我争辩？
verses.textEnNiv: I say to God: Do not declare me guilty, but tell me what charges you have against me.
verses.textEnEsv: I will say to God, Do not condemn me; let me know why you contend against me.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will say to God, ‘Do not condemn me; Show me why You contend with me.
verses.textEnNlt: I will say to God, ‘Don’t simply condemn me— tell me the charge you are bringing against me.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will say to God, ‘Do not condemn me; Let me know why You contend with me.
verses.textEn: I say to God: Do not declare me guilty, but tell me what charges you have against me.

verses.textZh: 压迫无辜， 又弃绝你手所作的， 却喜悦恶人的计谋，你都以为美吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 压迫无辜， 又弃绝你手所作的， 却喜悦恶人的计谋，你都以为美吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你手所造的， 你又欺压，又藐视， 却光照恶人的计谋。 这事你以为美吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Does it please you to oppress me, to spurn the work of your hands, while you smile on the plans of the wicked?
verses.textEnEsv: Does it seem good to you to oppress, to despise the work of your hands and favor the designs of the wicked?
verses.textEnNkjv: Doesit seem good to You that You should oppress, That You should despise the work of Your hands, And smile on the counsel of the wicked?
verses.textEnNlt: What do you gain by oppressing me? Why do you reject me, the work of your own hands, while smiling on the schemes of the wicked?
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Is it right for You indeed to oppress, To reject the work of Your hands, And to look favorably on the plan of the wicked?
verses.textEn: Does it please you to oppress me, to spurn the work of your hands, while you smile on the plans of the wicked?

verses.textZh: 你的眼不是肉眼， 你观看不像人观看，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的眼不是肉眼， 你观看不像人观看，
verses.textZhCuv: 你的眼岂是肉眼？ 你查看岂像人查看吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Do you have eyes of flesh? Do you see as a mortal sees?
verses.textEnEsv: Have you eyes of flesh? Do you see as man sees?
verses.textEnNkjv: Do You have eyes of flesh? Or do You see as man sees?
verses.textEnNlt: Are your eyes like those of a human? Do you see things only as people see them?
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Do You have eyes of flesh? Or do You see as mankind sees?
verses.textEn: Do you have eyes of flesh? Do you see as a mortal sees?

verses.textZh: 你的日子不如人的日子， 你的年岁不像人的年岁，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的日子不如人的日子， 你的年岁不像人的年岁，
verses.textZhCuv: 你的日子岂像人的日子， 你的年岁岂像人的年岁，
verses.textEnNiv: Are your days like those of a mortal or your years like those of a strong man,
verses.textEnEsv: Are your days as the days of man, or your years as a man’s years,
verses.textEnNkjv: Are Your days like the days of a mortal man? Are Your years like the days of a mighty man,
verses.textEnNlt: Is your lifetime only as long as ours? Is your life so short
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Are Your days like the days of a mortal, Or Your years like a man’s year,
verses.textEn: Are your days like those of a mortal or your years like those of a strong man,

verses.textZh: 以致你追究我的罪孽， 细察我的罪过吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 以致你追究我的罪孽， 细察我的罪过吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 就追问我的罪孽， 寻察我的罪过吗？
verses.textEnNiv: that you must search out my faults and probe after my sin—
verses.textEnEsv: that you seek out my iniquity and search for my sin,
verses.textEnNkjv: That You should seek for my iniquity And search out my sin,
verses.textEnNlt: that you must quickly probe for my guilt and search for my sin?
verses.textEnNasb: That You should search for my guilt And carefully seek my sin?
verses.textEn: that you must search out my faults and probe after my sin—

verses.textZh: 你知道我并没有罪， 但没有人能救我脱离你的手。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你知道我并没有罪， 但没有人能救我脱离你的手。
verses.textZhCuv: 其实，你知道我没有罪恶， 并没有能救我脱离你手的。
verses.textEnNiv: though you know that I am not guilty and that no one can rescue me from your hand?
verses.textEnEsv: although you know that I am not guilty, and there is none to deliver out of your hand?
verses.textEnNkjv: Although You know that I am not wicked, And thereis no one who can deliver from Your hand?
verses.textEnNlt: Although you know I am not guilty, no one can rescue me from your hands.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘According to Your knowledge I am indeed not guilty, Yet there is no one to save me from Your hand.
verses.textEn: though you know that I am not guilty and that no one can rescue me from your hand?

verses.textZh: 你的手塑我造我， 但一转过来你就要毁灭我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的手塑我造我， 但一转过来你就要毁灭我。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的手创造我，造就我的四肢百体， 你还要毁灭我。
verses.textEnNiv: "Your hands shaped me and made me. Will you now turn and destroy me?
verses.textEnEsv: Your hands fashioned and made me, and now you have destroyed me altogether.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Your hands have made me and fashioned me, An intricate unity; Yet You would destroy me.
verses.textEnNlt: "‘You formed me with your hands; you made me, yet now you completely destroy me.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Your hands fashioned and made me altogether, Yet would You destroy me?
verses.textEn: "Your hands shaped me and made me. Will you now turn and destroy me?

verses.textZh: 求你记念你造我如抟泥， 你还要使我归于尘土吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你记念你造我如抟泥， 你还要使我归于尘土吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 求你记念－制造我如抟泥一般， 你还要使我归于尘土吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Remember that you molded me like clay. Will you now turn me to dust again?
verses.textEnEsv: Remember that you have made me like clay; and will you return me to the dust?
verses.textEnNkjv: Remember, I pray, that You have made me like clay. And will You turn me into dust again?
verses.textEnNlt: Remember that you made me from dust— will you turn me back to dust so soon?
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Remember that You have made me as clay; Yet would You turn me into dust again?
verses.textEn: Remember that you molded me like clay. Will you now turn me to dust again?

verses.textZh: 你不是把我倒出来像倒奶， 又使我凝结像乳酪凝固吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不是把我倒出来像倒奶， 又使我凝结像乳酪凝固吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你不是倒出我来好像奶， 使我凝结如同奶饼吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Did you not pour me out like milk and curdle me like cheese,
verses.textEnEsv: Did you not pour me out like milk and curdle me like cheese?
verses.textEnNkjv: Did You not pour me out like milk, And curdle me like cheese,
verses.textEnNlt: You guided my conception and formed me in the womb.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Did You not pour me out like milk, And curdle me like cheese,
verses.textEn: Did you not pour me out like milk and curdle me like cheese,

verses.textZh: 你以皮肉为衣给我穿上， 以筋骨接络我；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你以皮肉为衣给我穿上， 以筋骨接络我；
verses.textZhCuv: 你以皮和肉为衣给我穿上， 用骨与筋把我全体联络。
verses.textEnNiv: clothe me with skin and flesh and knit me together with bones and sinews?
verses.textEnEsv: You clothed me with skin and flesh, and knit me together with bones and sinews.
verses.textEnNkjv: Clothe me with skin and flesh, And knit me together with bones and sinews?
verses.textEnNlt: You clothed me with skin and flesh, and you knit my bones and sinews together.
verses.textEnNasb: Clothe me with skin and flesh, And intertwine me with bones and tendons?
verses.textEn: clothe me with skin and flesh and knit me together with bones and sinews?

verses.textZh: 你赐我生命，又向我施慈爱， 你的眷顾保守我的心灵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你赐我生命，又向我施慈爱， 你的眷顾保守我的心灵。
verses.textZhCuv: 你将生命和慈爱赐给我； 你也眷顾保全我的心灵。
verses.textEnNiv: You gave me life and showed me kindness, and in your providence watched over my spirit.
verses.textEnEsv: You have granted me life and steadfast love, and your care has preserved my spirit.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have granted me life and favor, And Your care has preserved my spirit.
verses.textEnNlt: You gave me life and showed me your unfailing love. My life was preserved by your care.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘You have granted me life and goodness; And Your care has guarded my spirit.
verses.textEn: You gave me life and showed me kindness, and in your providence watched over my spirit.

verses.textZh: 这些事你都藏在你的心里， 我知道这是你的旨意。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些事你都藏在你的心里， 我知道这是你的旨意。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，你待我的这些事早已藏在你心里； 我知道你久有此意。
verses.textEnNiv: "But this is what you concealed in your heart, and I know that this was in your mind:
verses.textEnEsv: Yet these things you hid in your heart; I know that this was your purpose.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘And these things You have hidden in Your heart; I know that this was with You:
verses.textEnNlt: "‘Yet your real motive— your true intent—
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Yet You have concealed these things in Your heart; I know that this is within You:
verses.textEn: "But this is what you concealed in your heart, and I know that this was in your mind:

verses.textZh: 我若犯罪，你就鉴察， 绝不赦免我的罪孽；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我若犯罪，你就鉴察， 绝不赦免我的罪孽；
verses.textZhCuv: 我若犯罪，你就察看我， 并不赦免我的罪孽。
verses.textEnNiv: If I sinned, you would be watching me and would not let my offense go unpunished.
verses.textEnEsv: If I sin, you watch me and do not acquit me of my iniquity.
verses.textEnNkjv: If I sin, then You mark me, And will not acquit me of my iniquity.
verses.textEnNlt: was to watch me, and if I sinned, you would not forgive my guilt.
verses.textEnNasb: If I have sinned, You will take note of me, And will not acquit me of my guilt.
verses.textEn: If I sinned, you would be watching me and would not let my offense go unpunished.

verses.textZh: 我若有罪，就有祸了； 我若有理，也不敢抬头， 饱尝羞辱，看看自己的苦难。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我若有罪，就有祸了； 我若有理，也不敢抬头， 饱尝羞辱，看看自己的苦难。
verses.textZhCuv: 我若行恶，便有了祸； 我若为义，也不敢抬头， 正是满心羞愧， 眼见我的苦情。
verses.textEnNiv: If I am guilty—woe to me! Even if I am innocent, I cannot lift my head, for I am full of shame and drowned in my affliction.
verses.textEnEsv: If I am guilty, woe to me! If I am in the right, I cannot lift up my head, for I am filled with disgrace and look on my affliction.
verses.textEnNkjv: If I am wicked, woe to me; Even if I am righteous, I cannot lift up my head. Iam full of disgrace; See my misery!
verses.textEnNlt: If I am guilty, too bad for me; and even if I’m innocent, I can’t hold my head high, because I am filled with shame and misery.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘If I am wicked, woe to me! But if I am righteous, I dare not lift up my head. I am full of shame, and conscious of my misery.
verses.textEn: If I am guilty—woe to me! Even if I am innocent, I cannot lift my head, for I am full of shame and drowned in my affliction.

verses.textZh: 我若昂首自得，你就如狮子猎我 ， 又在我身上彰显你惊人的大能。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我若昂首自得，你就如狮子猎我 ， 又在我身上彰显你惊人的大能。
verses.textZhCuv: 我若昂首自得，你就追捕我如狮子， 又在我身上显出奇能。
verses.textEnNiv: If I hold my head high, you stalk me like a lion and again display your awesome power against me.
verses.textEnEsv: And were my head lifted up, you would hunt me like a lion and again work wonders against me.
verses.textEnNkjv: If myhead is exalted, You hunt me like a fierce lion, And again You show Yourself awesome against me.
verses.textEnNlt: And if I hold my head high, you hunt me like a lion and display your awesome power against me.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘And should my head be high, You would hunt me like a lion; And You would show Your power against me again.
verses.textEn: If I hold my head high, you stalk me like a lion and again display your awesome power against me.

verses.textZh: 你重新设立见证攻击我， 对我加增你的忿怒， 派兵轮流攻击我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你重新设立见证攻击我， 对我加增你的忿怒， 派兵轮流攻击我。
verses.textZhCuv: 你重立见证攻击我， 向我加增恼怒， 如军兵更换着攻击我。
verses.textEnNiv: You bring new witnesses against me and increase your anger toward me; your forces come against me wave upon wave.
verses.textEnEsv: You renew your witnesses against me and increase your vexation toward me; you bring fresh troops against me.
verses.textEnNkjv: You renew Your witnesses against me, And increase Your indignation toward me; Changes and war are ever with me.
verses.textEnNlt: Again and again you witness against me. You pour out your growing anger on me and bring fresh armies against me.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘You renew Your witnesses against me And increase Your anger toward me; Hardship after hardship is with me.
verses.textEn: You bring new witnesses against me and increase your anger toward me; your forces come against me wave upon wave.

verses.textZh: 你为甚么使我出母胎呢？ 我不如死去，无人得见我，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你为甚么使我出母胎呢？ 我不如死去，无人得见我，
verses.textZhCuv: 你为何使我出母胎呢？ 不如我当时气绝，无人得见我；
verses.textEnNiv: "Why then did you bring me out of the womb? I wish I had died before any eye saw me.
verses.textEnEsv: "Why did you bring me out from the womb? Would that I had died before any eye had seen me
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Why then have You brought me out of the womb? Oh, that I had perished and no eye had seen me!
verses.textEnNlt: "‘Why, then, did you deliver me from my mother’s womb? Why didn’t you let me die at birth?
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Why then did You bring me out of the womb? If only I had died and no eye had seen me!
verses.textEn: "Why then did you bring me out of the womb? I wish I had died before any eye saw me.

verses.textZh: 这样，就像从来没有我一样， 一出母腹就被送入坟墓。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，就像从来没有我一样， 一出母腹就被送入坟墓。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，就如没有我一般， 一出母胎就被送入坟墓。
verses.textEnNiv: If only I had never come into being, or had been carried straight from the womb to the grave!
verses.textEnEsv: and were as though I had not been, carried from the womb to the grave.
verses.textEnNkjv: I would have been as though I had not been. I would have been carried from the womb to the grave.
verses.textEnNlt: It would be as though I had never existed, going directly from the womb to the grave.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘I should have been as though I had not been, Brought from womb to tomb.’
verses.textEn: If only I had never come into being, or had been carried straight from the womb to the grave!

verses.textZh: 我的日子不是很少吗？请住手，转离我， 使我在往黑暗死荫之地以先，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的日子不是很少吗？请住手，转离我， 使我在往黑暗死荫之地以先，
verses.textZhCuv: 求你停手宽容我， 叫我在往而不返之先－ 就是往黑暗和死荫之地以先－ 可以稍得畅快。
verses.textEnNiv: Are not my few days almost over? Turn away from me so I can have a moment’s joy
verses.textEnEsv: Are not my days few? Then cease, and leave me alone, that I may find a little cheer
verses.textEnNkjv: Are not my days few? Cease! Leave me alone, that I may take a little comfort,
verses.textEnNlt: I have only a few days left, so leave me alone, that I may have a moment of comfort
verses.textEnNasb: "Would He not leave my few days alone? Withdraw from me so that I may have a little cheerfulness
verses.textEn: Are not my few days almost over? Turn away from me so I can have a moment’s joy

verses.textZh: 在去而不返之前， 可以喜乐片刻；
verses.textZhCnvs: 在去而不返之前， 可以喜乐片刻；
verses.textZhCuv: 那地甚是幽暗，是死荫混沌之地； 那里的光好像幽暗。
verses.textEnNiv: before I go to the place of no return, to the land of gloom and utter darkness,
verses.textEnEsv: before I go—and I shall not return— to the land of darkness and deep shadow,
verses.textEnNkjv: Before I go totheplacefromwhich I shall not return, To the land of darkness and the shadow of death,
verses.textEnNlt: before I leave—never to return— for the land of darkness and utter gloom.
verses.textEnNasb: Before I go—and I shall not return— To the land of darkness and deep shadow,
verses.textEn: before I go to the place of no return, to the land of gloom and utter darkness,

verses.textZh: 那地黑暗，如死荫的幽暗， 毫无秩序，即使有光也像幽暗。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那地黑暗，如死荫的幽暗， 毫无秩序，即使有光也像幽暗。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那地黑暗，如死荫的幽暗， 毫无秩序，即使有光也像幽暗。"
verses.textEnNiv: to the land of deepest night, of utter darkness and disorder, where even the light is like darkness."
verses.textEnEsv: the land of gloom like thick darkness, like deep shadow without any order, where light is as thick darkness."
verses.textEnNkjv: A land as dark as darkness itself, As the shadow of death, without any order, Where even the light is like darkness.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: It is a land as dark as midnight, a land of gloom and confusion, where even the light is dark as midnight.’"
verses.textEnNasb: The land of utter gloom like darkness itself, Of deep shadow without order, And it shines like darkness."
verses.textEn: to the land of deepest night, of utter darkness and disorder, where even the light is like darkness."

verses.textZh: 拿玛人琐法回答说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿玛人琐法回答说：
verses.textZhCuv: 拿玛人琐法回答说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then Zophar the Naamathite replied:
verses.textEnEsv: Then Zophar the Naamathite answered and said:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Zophar the Naamathite answered and said:
verses.textEnNlt: Then Zophar the Naamathite replied to Job:
verses.textEnNasb: Then Zophar the Naamathite responded,
verses.textEn: Then Zophar the Naamathite replied:

verses.textZh: "这许多的话怎可不回答， 多嘴多舌的人怎能算为义呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: "这许多的话怎可不回答， 多嘴多舌的人怎能算为义呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 这许多的言语岂不该回答吗？ 多嘴多舌的人岂可称为义吗？
verses.textEnNiv: "Are all these words to go unanswered? Is this talker to be vindicated?
verses.textEnEsv: "Should a multitude of words go unanswered, and a man full of talk be judged right?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Should not the multitude of words be answered? And should a man full of talk be vindicated?
verses.textEnNlt: "Shouldn’t someone answer this torrent of words? Is a person proved innocent just by a lot of talking?
verses.textEnNasb: "Shall a multitude of words go unanswered, And a talkative man be acquitted?
verses.textEn: "Are all these words to go unanswered? Is this talker to be vindicated?

verses.textZh: 你胡言乱语可使人不作声吗？ 你嘲笑的时候，无人责备吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你胡言乱语可使人不作声吗？ 你嘲笑的时候，无人责备吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你夸大的话岂能使人不作声吗？ 你戏笑的时候岂没有人叫你害羞吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Will your idle talk reduce others to silence? Will no one rebuke you when you mock?
verses.textEnEsv: Should your babble silence men, and when you mock, shall no one shame you?
verses.textEnNkjv: Should your empty talk make men hold their peace? And when you mock, should no one rebuke you?
verses.textEnNlt: Should I remain silent while you babble on? When you mock God, shouldn’t someone make you ashamed?
verses.textEnNasb: "Shall your boasts silence people? And will you scoff, and no one rebuke?
verses.textEn: Will your idle talk reduce others to silence? Will no one rebuke you when you mock?

verses.textZh: 你说：‘我的道理纯全， 我在你眼前洁净。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 你说：‘我的道理纯全， 我在你眼前洁净。’
verses.textZhCuv: 你说：我的道理纯全； 我在你眼前洁净。
verses.textEnNiv: You say to God, ‘My beliefs are flawless and I am pure in your sight.’
verses.textEnEsv: For you say, ‘My doctrine is pure, and I am clean in God’s eyes.’
verses.textEnNkjv: For you have said, ‘My doctrine is pure, And I am clean in your eyes.’
verses.textEnNlt: You claim, ‘My beliefs are pure,’ and ‘I am clean in the sight of God.’
verses.textEnNasb: "For you have said, ‘My teaching is pure, And I am innocent in your eyes.’
verses.textEn: You say to God, ‘My beliefs are flawless and I am pure in your sight.’

verses.textZh: 但愿神说话， 愿他开口跟你说话，
verses.textZhCnvs: 但愿神说话， 愿他开口跟你说话，
verses.textZhCuv: 惟愿神说话； 愿他开口攻击你，
verses.textEnNiv: Oh, how I wish that God would speak, that he would open his lips against you
verses.textEnEsv: But oh, that God would speak and open his lips to you,
verses.textEnNkjv: But oh, that God would speak, And open His lips against you,
verses.textEnNlt: If only God would speak; if only he would tell you what he thinks!
verses.textEnNasb: "But if only God would speak, And open His lips against you,
verses.textEn: Oh, how I wish that God would speak, that he would open his lips against you

verses.textZh: 把智慧的奥秘向你显明， 因为真的智慧有两面。 你当知道神已忘记了你一部分的罪孽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 把智慧的奥秘向你显明， 因为真的智慧有两面。 你当知道神已忘记了你一部分的罪孽。
verses.textZhCuv: 并将智慧的奥秘指示你； 他有诸般的智识。 所以当知道神追讨你 比你罪孽该得的还少。
verses.textEnNiv: and disclose to you the secrets of wisdom, for true wisdom has two sides. Know this: God has even forgotten some of your sin.
verses.textEnEsv: and that he would tell you the secrets of wisdom! For he is manifold in understanding. Know then that God exacts of you less than your guilt deserves.
verses.textEnNkjv: That He would show you the secrets of wisdom! For they would double your prudence. Know therefore that God exacts from you Less than your iniquity deserves.
verses.textEnNlt: If only he would tell you the secrets of wisdom, for true wisdom is not a simple matter. Listen! God is doubtless punishing you far less than you deserve!
verses.textEnNasb: And show you the secrets of wisdom! For sound wisdom has two sides. Know then that God forgets part of your guilt.
verses.textEn: and disclose to you the secrets of wisdom, for true wisdom has two sides. Know this: God has even forgotten some of your sin.

verses.textZh: 神高深莫测之事你怎能查出呢？ 全能者的终极你怎能洞悉呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 神高深莫测之事你怎能查出呢？ 全能者的终极你怎能洞悉呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你考察就能测透神吗？ 你岂能尽情测透全能者吗？
verses.textEnNiv: "Can you fathom the mysteries of God? Can you probe the limits of the Almighty?
verses.textEnEsv: "Can you find out the deep things of God? Can you find out the limit of the Almighty?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Can you search out the deep things of God? Can you find out the limits of the Almighty?
verses.textEnNlt: "Can you solve the mysteries of God? Can you discover everything about the Almighty?
verses.textEnNasb: "Can you discover the depths of God? Can you discover the limits of the Almighty?
verses.textEn: "Can you fathom the mysteries of God? Can you probe the limits of the Almighty?

verses.textZh: 他的智慧高于诸天，你能作甚么呢？ 比阴间还深，你怎能识透？
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的智慧高于诸天，你能作甚么呢？ 比阴间还深，你怎能识透？
verses.textZhCuv: 他的智慧高于天，你还能做什么？ 深于阴间，你还能知道什么？
verses.textEnNiv: They are higher than the heavens above—what can you do? They are deeper than the depths below—what can you know?
verses.textEnEsv: It is higher than heaven —what can you do? Deeper than Sheol—what can you know?
verses.textEnNkjv: Theyare higher than heaven— what can you do? Deeper than Sheol— what can you know?
verses.textEnNlt: Such knowledge is higher than the heavens— and who are you? It is deeper than the underworld — what do you know?
verses.textEnNasb: "They are as high as the heavens; what can you do? Deeper than Sheol; what can you know?
verses.textEn: They are higher than the heavens above—what can you do? They are deeper than the depths below—what can you know?

verses.textZh: 他的智慧比地长，比海宽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的智慧比地长，比海宽。
verses.textZhCuv: 其量比地长， 比海宽。
verses.textEnNiv: Their measure is longer than the earth and wider than the sea.
verses.textEnEsv: Its measure is longer than the earth and broader than the sea.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their measure is longer than the earth And broader than the sea.
verses.textEnNlt: It is broader than the earth and wider than the sea.
verses.textEnNasb: "Its measurement is longer than the earth And broader than the sea.
verses.textEn: Their measure is longer than the earth and wider than the sea.

verses.textZh: 他若过来把人囚禁， 召人受审，谁能阻止他呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 他若过来把人囚禁， 召人受审，谁能阻止他呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 他若经过，将人拘禁， 招人受审，谁能阻挡他呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "If he comes along and confines you in prison and convenes a court, who can oppose him?
verses.textEnEsv: If he passes through and imprisons and summons the court, who can turn him back?
verses.textEnNkjv: "If He passes by, imprisons, and gathers tojudgment, Then who can hinder Him?
verses.textEnNlt: If God comes and puts a person in prison or calls the court to order, who can stop him?
verses.textEnNasb: "If He passes by or apprehends people, Or calls an assembly, who can restrain Him?
verses.textEn: "If he comes along and confines you in prison and convenes a court, who can oppose him?

verses.textZh: 因为他认识虚谎的人， 他看见欺诈，怎能不鉴察？
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他认识虚谎的人， 他看见欺诈，怎能不鉴察？
verses.textZhCuv: 他本知道虚妄的人； 人的罪孽，他虽不留意，还是无所不见。
verses.textEnNiv: Surely he recognizes deceivers; and when he sees evil, does he not take note?
verses.textEnEsv: For he knows worthless men; when he sees iniquity, will he not consider it?
verses.textEnNkjv: For He knows deceitful men; He sees wickedness also. Will He not then consider it?
verses.textEnNlt: For he knows those who are false, and he takes note of all their sins.
verses.textEnNasb: "For He knows false people, And He sees injustice without investigating.
verses.textEn: Surely he recognizes deceivers; and when he sees evil, does he not take note?

verses.textZh: 虚妄的人悟出慧心， 就像野驴生子为人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 虚妄的人悟出慧心， 就像野驴生子为人。
verses.textZhCuv: 空虚的人却毫无知识； 人生在世好像野驴的驹子。
verses.textEnNiv: But the witless can no more become wise than a wild donkey’s colt can be born human.
verses.textEnEsv: But a stupid man will get understanding when a wild donkey’s colt is born a man!
verses.textEnNkjv: For an empty-headed man will be wise, When a wild donkey’s colt is born a man.
verses.textEnNlt: An empty-headed person won’t become wise any more than a wild donkey can bear a human child.
verses.textEnNasb: " An idiot will become intelligent When a wild donkey is born a human.
verses.textEn: But the witless can no more become wise than a wild donkey’s colt can be born human.

verses.textZh: 你若心里归向他， 又向他伸手祷告；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你若心里归向他， 又向他伸手祷告；
verses.textZhCuv: 你若将心安正， 又向主举手；
verses.textEnNiv: "Yet if you devote your heart to him and stretch out your hands to him,
verses.textEnEsv: "If you prepare your heart, you will stretch out your hands toward him.
verses.textEnNkjv: "If you would prepare your heart, And stretch out your hands toward Him;
verses.textEnNlt: "If only you would prepare your heart and lift up your hands to him in prayer!
verses.textEnNasb: "If you would direct your heart rightly And spread out your hands to Him,
verses.textEn: "Yet if you devote your heart to him and stretch out your hands to him,

verses.textZh: 你若远远地除掉你手里的欺诈， 不让不义居在你的帐棚里；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你若远远地除掉你手里的欺诈， 不让不义居在你的帐棚里；
verses.textZhCuv: 你手里若有罪孽， 就当远远地除掉， 也不容非义住在你帐棚之中。
verses.textEnNiv: if you put away the sin that is in your hand and allow no evil to dwell in your tent,
verses.textEnEsv: If iniquity is in your hand, put it far away, and let not injustice dwell in your tents.
verses.textEnNkjv: If iniquity were in your hand, andyou put it far away, And would not let wickedness dwell in your tents;
verses.textEnNlt: Get rid of your sins, and leave all iniquity behind you.
verses.textEnNasb: If wrongdoing is in your hand, put it far away, And do not let malice dwell in your tents;
verses.textEn: if you put away the sin that is in your hand and allow no evil to dwell in your tent,

verses.textZh: 那么你必仰面，毫无愧色； 你也必坚定稳妥，无所惧怕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那么你必仰面，毫无愧色； 你也必坚定稳妥，无所惧怕。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，你必仰起脸来毫无斑点； 你也必坚固，无所惧怕。
verses.textEnNiv: then, free of fault, you will lift up your face; you will stand firm and without fear.
verses.textEnEsv: Surely then you will lift up your face without blemish; you will be secure and will not fear.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then surely you could lift up your face without spot; Yes, you could be steadfast, and not fear;
verses.textEnNlt: Then your face will brighten with innocence. You will be strong and free of fear.
verses.textEnNasb: Then, indeed, you could lift up your face without moral blemish, And you would be firmly established and not fear.
verses.textEn: then, free of fault, you will lift up your face; you will stand firm and without fear.

verses.textZh: 你必忘记你的苦楚， 回忆好象逝去的流水，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必忘记你的苦楚， 回忆好象逝去的流水，
verses.textZhCuv: 你必忘记你的苦楚， 就是想起也如流过去的水一样。
verses.textEnNiv: You will surely forget your trouble, recalling it only as waters gone by.
verses.textEnEsv: You will forget your misery; you will remember it as waters that have passed away.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because you would forget your misery, And remember it as waters thathave passed away,
verses.textEnNlt: You will forget your misery; it will be like water flowing away.
verses.textEnNasb: "For you would forget your trouble; Like waters that have passed by, you would remember it.
verses.textEn: You will surely forget your trouble, recalling it only as waters gone by.

verses.textZh: 你们的人生必明亮如正午， 虽然黑暗仍像早晨。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们的人生必明亮如正午， 虽然黑暗仍像早晨。
verses.textZhCuv: 你在世的日子要比正午更明， 虽有黑暗仍像早晨。
verses.textEnNiv: Life will be brighter than noonday, and darkness will become like morning.
verses.textEnEsv: And your life will be brighter than the noonday; its darkness will be like the morning.
verses.textEnNkjv: And your life would be brighter than noonday. Though you were dark, you would be like the morning.
verses.textEnNlt: Your life will be brighter than the noonday. Even darkness will be as bright as morning.
verses.textEnNasb: "Your life would be brighter than noonday; Darkness would be like the morning.
verses.textEn: Life will be brighter than noonday, and darkness will become like morning.

verses.textZh: 因为有指望，你必安稳， 你必四处巡查，安然睡觉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为有指望，你必安稳， 你必四处巡查，安然睡觉。
verses.textZhCuv: 你因有指望就必稳固， 也必四围巡查，坦然安息。
verses.textEnNiv: You will be secure, because there is hope; you will look about you and take your rest in safety.
verses.textEnEsv: And you will feel secure, because there is hope; you will look around and take your rest in security.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you would be secure, because there is hope; Yes, you would dig aroundyou, and take your rest in safety.
verses.textEnNlt: Having hope will give you courage. You will be protected and will rest in safety.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then you would trust, because there is hope; And you would look around and rest securely.
verses.textEn: You will be secure, because there is hope; you will look about you and take your rest in safety.

verses.textZh: 你躺卧，不受惊吓， 必有很多人求你的情面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你躺卧，不受惊吓， 必有很多人求你的情面。
verses.textZhCuv: 你躺卧，无人惊吓， 且有许多人向你求恩。
verses.textEnNiv: You will lie down, with no one to make you afraid, and many will court your favor.
verses.textEnEsv: You will lie down, and none will make you afraid; many will court your favor.
verses.textEnNkjv: You would also lie down, and no one would make you afraid; Yes, many would court your favor.
verses.textEnNlt: You will lie down unafraid, and many will look to you for help.
verses.textEnNasb: "You would lie down and none would disturb you, And many would flatter you.
verses.textEn: You will lie down, with no one to make you afraid, and many will court your favor.

verses.textZh: 但恶人的眼目必昏花， 逃亡之路也必断绝， 他们的指望就是最后的一口气。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但恶人的眼目必昏花， 逃亡之路也必断绝， 他们的指望就是最后的一口气。"
verses.textZhCuv: 但恶人的眼目必要失明。 他们无路可逃； 他们的指望就是气绝。
verses.textEnNiv: But the eyes of the wicked will fail, and escape will elude them; their hope will become a dying gasp."
verses.textEnEsv: But the eyes of the wicked will fail; all way of escape will be lost to them, and their hope is to breathe their last."
verses.textEnNkjv: But the eyes of the wicked will fail, And they shall not escape, And their hope—loss of life!"
verses.textEnNlt: But the wicked will be blinded. They will have no escape. Their only hope is death."
verses.textEnNasb: "But the eyes of the wicked will fail, And there will be no escape for them; And their hope is to breathe their last."
verses.textEn: But the eyes of the wicked will fail, and escape will elude them; their hope will become a dying gasp."

verses.textZh: 约伯回答说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 约伯回答说：
verses.textZhCuv: 约伯回答说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then Job replied:
verses.textEnEsv: Then Job answered and said:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Job answered and said:
verses.textEnNlt: Then Job spoke again:
verses.textEnNasb: Then Job responded,
verses.textEn: Then Job replied:

verses.textZh: "你们真的是有知识的民， 你们死了，智慧也跟你们一同灭亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们真的是有知识的民， 你们死了，智慧也跟你们一同灭亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们真是子民哪， 你们死亡，智慧也就灭没了。
verses.textEnNiv: "Doubtless you are the only people who matter, and wisdom will die with you!
verses.textEnEsv: "No doubt you are the people, and wisdom will die with you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "No doubt you are the people, And wisdom will die with you!
verses.textEnNlt: "You people really know everything, don’t you? And when you die, wisdom will die with you!
verses.textEnNasb: "Truly then you are the people, And with you wisdom will die!
verses.textEn: "Doubtless you are the only people who matter, and wisdom will die with you!

verses.textZh: 但我也有聪明像你们一样， 我并非不及你们， 像你们所说的这些事，有谁不晓得呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 但我也有聪明像你们一样， 我并非不及你们， 像你们所说的这些事，有谁不晓得呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 但我也有聪明，与你们一样， 并非不及你们。 你们所说的，谁不知道呢？
verses.textEnNiv: But I have a mind as well as you; I am not inferior to you. Who does not know all these things?
verses.textEnEsv: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you. Who does not know such things as these?
verses.textEnNkjv: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you. Indeed, who does not know such things as these?
verses.textEnNlt: Well, I know a few things myself— and you’re no better than I am. Who doesn’t know these things you’ve been saying?
verses.textEnNasb: "But I have intelligence as well as you; I am not inferior to you. And who does not know such things as these?
verses.textEn: But I have a mind as well as you; I am not inferior to you. Who does not know all these things?

verses.textZh: 我这求告神，又蒙他应允的， 竟成为朋友的笑柄， 公义完全的人竟成为笑柄，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我这求告神，又蒙他应允的， 竟成为朋友的笑柄， 公义完全的人竟成为笑柄，
verses.textZhCuv: 我这求告神、蒙他应允的人 竟成了朋友所讥笑的； 公义完全人竟受了人的讥笑。
verses.textEnNiv: "I have become a laughingstock to my friends, though I called on God and he answered— a mere laughingstock, though righteous and blameless!
verses.textEnEsv: I am a laughingstock to my friends; I, who called to God and he answered me, a just and blameless man, am a laughingstock.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I am one mocked by his friends, Who called on God, and He answered him, The just and blameless whois ridiculed.
verses.textEnNlt: Yet my friends laugh at me, for I call on God and expect an answer. I am a just and blameless man, yet they laugh at me.
verses.textEnNasb: "I am a joke to my friends, The one who called on God and He answered him; The just and blameless man is a joke.
verses.textEn: "I have become a laughingstock to my friends, though I called on God and he answered— a mere laughingstock, though righteous and blameless!

verses.textZh: 平静的人心中藐视灾祸， 作将滑跌者的分。
verses.textZhCnvs: 平静的人心中藐视灾祸， 作将滑跌者的分。
verses.textZhCuv: 安逸的人心里藐视灾祸； 这灾祸常常等待滑脚的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who are at ease have contempt for misfortune as the fate of those whose feet are slipping.
verses.textEnEsv: In the thought of one who is at ease there is contempt for misfortune; it is ready for those whose feet slip.
verses.textEnNkjv: A lamp is despised in the thought of one who is at ease; Itis made ready for those whose feet slip.
verses.textEnNlt: People who are at ease mock those in trouble. They give a push to people who are stumbling.
verses.textEnNasb: " He who is at ease holds disaster in contempt, As prepared for those whose feet slip.
verses.textEn: Those who are at ease have contempt for misfortune as the fate of those whose feet are slipping.

verses.textZh: 强盗的帐幕兴旺， 惹神发怒的安稳，神的手赏赐他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 强盗的帐幕兴旺， 惹神发怒的安稳，神的手赏赐他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 强盗的帐棚兴旺， 惹神的人稳固，神多将财物送到他们手中。
verses.textEnNiv: The tents of marauders are undisturbed, and those who provoke God are secure— those God has in his hand.
verses.textEnEsv: The tents of robbers are at peace, and those who provoke God are secure, who bring their god in their hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: The tents of robbers prosper, And those who provoke God are secure— In what God provides by His hand.
verses.textEnNlt: But robbers are left in peace, and those who provoke God live in safety— though God keeps them in his power.
verses.textEnNasb: "The tents of the destroyers prosper, And those who provoke God are secure, Whom God brings into their power.
verses.textEn: The tents of marauders are undisturbed, and those who provoke God are secure— those God has in his hand.

verses.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你， 又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你， 又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你；
verses.textZhCuv: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你； 又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你；
verses.textEnNiv: "But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you;
verses.textEnEsv: "But ask the beasts, and they will teach you; the birds of the heavens, and they will tell you;
verses.textEnNkjv: "But now ask the beasts, and they will teach you; And the birds of the air, and they will tell you;
verses.textEnNlt: "Just ask the animals, and they will teach you. Ask the birds of the sky, and they will tell you.
verses.textEnNasb: "But just ask the animals, and have them teach you; And the birds of the sky, and have them tell you.
verses.textEn: "But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you;

verses.textZh: 或向地说话，地必指教你， 海中的鱼也必向你说明。
verses.textZhCnvs: 或向地说话，地必指教你， 海中的鱼也必向你说明。
verses.textZhCuv: 或与地说话，地必指教你； 海中的鱼也必向你说明。
verses.textEnNiv: or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verses.textEnEsv: or the bushes of the earth, and they will teach you; and the fish of the sea will declare to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Or speak to the earth, and it will teach you; And the fish of the sea will explain to you.
verses.textEnNlt: Speak to the earth, and it will instruct you. Let the fish in the sea speak to you.
verses.textEnNasb: "Or speak to the earth, and have it teach you; And have the fish of the sea tell you.
verses.textEn: or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.

verses.textZh: 从这一切看来，谁不知道， 是耶和华的手作成这事的呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 从这一切看来，谁不知道， 是耶和华的手作成这事的呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 看这一切， 谁不知道是耶和华的手做成的呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Which of all these does not know that the hand of the Lord has done this?
verses.textEnEsv: Who among all these does not know that the hand of the Lord has done this?
verses.textEnNkjv: Who among all these does not know That the hand of the Lord has done this,
verses.textEnNlt: For they all know that my disaster has come from the hand of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "Who among all these does not know That the hand of the Lord has done this,
verses.textEn: Which of all these does not know that the hand of the Lord has done this?

verses.textZh: 活物的生命与全人类的气息， 都在耶和华的手中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 活物的生命与全人类的气息， 都在耶和华的手中。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡活物的生命和人类的气息都在他手中。
verses.textEnNiv: In his hand is the life of every creature and the breath of all mankind.
verses.textEnEsv: In his hand is the life of every living thing and the breath of all mankind.
verses.textEnNkjv: In whose hand is the life of every living thing, And the breath of all mankind?
verses.textEnNlt: For the life of every living thing is in his hand, and the breath of every human being.
verses.textEnNasb: In whose hand is the life of every living thing, And the breath of all mankind?
verses.textEn: In his hand is the life of every creature and the breath of all mankind.

verses.textZh: 耳朵不是试验说话， 好象上膛尝试食物吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 耳朵不是试验说话， 好象上膛尝试食物吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 耳朵岂不试验言语， 正如上膛尝食物吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Does not the ear test words as the tongue tastes food?
verses.textEnEsv: Does not the ear test words as the palate tastes food?
verses.textEnNkjv: Does not the ear test words And the mouth taste its food?
verses.textEnNlt: The ear tests the words it hears just as the mouth distinguishes between foods.
verses.textEnNasb: "Does the ear not put words to the test, As the palate tastes its food?
verses.textEn: Does not the ear test words as the tongue tastes food?

verses.textZh: 你们说：老年的有智慧， 长寿的有聪明。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们说：老年的有智慧， 长寿的有聪明。
verses.textZhCuv: 年老的有智慧； 寿高的有知识。
verses.textEnNiv: Is not wisdom found among the aged? Does not long life bring understanding?
verses.textEnEsv: Wisdom is with the aged, and understanding in length of days.
verses.textEnNkjv: Wisdom is with aged men, And with length of days, understanding.
verses.textEnNlt: Wisdom belongs to the aged, and understanding to the old.
verses.textEnNasb: "Wisdom is with the aged, And with long life comes understanding.
verses.textEn: Is not wisdom found among the aged? Does not long life bring understanding?

verses.textZh: 他有智慧与能力， 又有谋略与聪明。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他有智慧与能力， 又有谋略与聪明。
verses.textZhCuv: 在神有智慧和能力； 他有谋略和知识。
verses.textEnNiv: "To God belong wisdom and power; counsel and understanding are his.
verses.textEnEsv: "With God are wisdom and might; he has counsel and understanding.
verses.textEnNkjv: "With Him are wisdom and strength, He has counsel and understanding.
verses.textEnNlt: "But true wisdom and power are found in God; counsel and understanding are his.
verses.textEnNasb: "Wisdom and might are with Him; Advice and understanding belong to Him.
verses.textEn: "To God belong wisdom and power; counsel and understanding are his.

verses.textZh: 他所拆毁的，就不能重建， 他所囚禁的，就不能释放。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他所拆毁的，就不能重建， 他所囚禁的，就不能释放。
verses.textZhCuv: 他拆毁的，就不能再建造； 他捆住人，便不得开释。
verses.textEnNiv: What he tears down cannot be rebuilt; those he imprisons cannot be released.
verses.textEnEsv: If he tears down, none can rebuild; if he shuts a man in, none can open.
verses.textEnNkjv: If He breaks athing down, it cannot be rebuilt; If He imprisons a man, there can be no release.
verses.textEnNlt: What he destroys cannot be rebuilt. When he puts someone in prison, there is no escape.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, He tears down, and it cannot be rebuilt; He imprisons a person, and there is no release.
verses.textEn: What he tears down cannot be rebuilt; those he imprisons cannot be released.

verses.textZh: 他若把水阻截，水就干涸， 他再把水放出，水就使地翻倒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他若把水阻截，水就干涸， 他再把水放出，水就使地翻倒。
verses.textZhCuv: 他把水留住，水便枯干； 他再发出水来，水就翻地。
verses.textEnNiv: If he holds back the waters, there is drought; if he lets them loose, they devastate the land.
verses.textEnEsv: If he withholds the waters, they dry up; if he sends them out, they overwhelm the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: If He withholds the waters, they dry up; If He sends them out, they overwhelm the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: If he holds back the rain, the earth becomes a desert. If he releases the waters, they flood the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, He restrains the waters, and they dry up; And He sends them out, and they inundate the earth.
verses.textEn: If he holds back the waters, there is drought; if he lets them loose, they devastate the land.

verses.textZh: 他有大能与智谋， 受骗的与骗人的，都是属他的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他有大能与智谋， 受骗的与骗人的，都是属他的。
verses.textZhCuv: 在他有能力和智慧， 被诱惑的与诱惑人的都是属他。
verses.textEnNiv: To him belong strength and insight; both deceived and deceiver are his.
verses.textEnEsv: With him are strength and sound wisdom; the deceived and the deceiver are his.
verses.textEnNkjv: With Him are strength and prudence. The deceived and the deceiver are His.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, strength and wisdom are his; deceivers and deceived are both in his power.
verses.textEnNasb: "Strength and sound wisdom are with Him. One who goes astray and one who leads astray belong to Him.
verses.textEn: To him belong strength and insight; both deceived and deceiver are his.

verses.textZh: 他把谋士剥衣掳去， 并且愚弄审判官。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把谋士剥衣掳去， 并且愚弄审判官。
verses.textZhCuv: 他把谋士剥衣掳去， 又使审判官变成愚人。
verses.textEnNiv: He leads rulers away stripped and makes fools of judges.
verses.textEnEsv: He leads counselors away stripped, and judges he makes fools.
verses.textEnNkjv: He leads counselors away plundered, And makes fools of the judges.
verses.textEnNlt: He leads counselors away, stripped of good judgment; wise judges become fools.
verses.textEnNasb: "He makes advisers walk barefoot And makes fools of judges.
verses.textEn: He leads rulers away stripped and makes fools of judges.

verses.textZh: 他解开了君王绑人的绳索， 又用腰布捆绑君王的腰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他解开了君王绑人的绳索， 又用腰布捆绑君王的腰。
verses.textZhCuv: 他放松君王的绑， 又用带子捆他们的腰。
verses.textEnNiv: He takes off the shackles put on by kings and ties a loincloth around their waist.
verses.textEnEsv: He looses the bonds of kings and binds a waistcloth on their hips.
verses.textEnNkjv: He loosens the bonds of kings, And binds their waist with a belt.
verses.textEnNlt: He removes the royal robe of kings. They are led away with ropes around their waist.
verses.textEnNasb: "He undoes the binding of kings, And ties a loincloth around their waist.
verses.textEn: He takes off the shackles put on by kings and ties a loincloth around their waist.

verses.textZh: 他把祭司剥衣掳去， 倾覆有权有势的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把祭司剥衣掳去， 倾覆有权有势的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他把祭司剥衣掳去， 又使有能的人倾败。
verses.textEnNiv: He leads priests away stripped and overthrows officials long established.
verses.textEnEsv: He leads priests away stripped and overthrows the mighty.
verses.textEnNkjv: He leads princes away plundered, And overthrows the mighty.
verses.textEnNlt: He leads priests away, stripped of status; he overthrows those with long years in power.
verses.textEnNasb: "He makes priests walk barefoot, And overthrows the secure ones.
verses.textEn: He leads priests away stripped and overthrows officials long established.

verses.textZh: 他除掉忠信人的言论， 又除去老年人的辨别力。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他除掉忠信人的言论， 又除去老年人的辨别力。
verses.textZhCuv: 他废去忠信人的讲论， 又夺去老人的聪明。
verses.textEnNiv: He silences the lips of trusted advisers and takes away the discernment of elders.
verses.textEnEsv: He deprives of speech those who are trusted and takes away the discernment of the elders.
verses.textEnNkjv: He deprives the trusted ones of speech, And takes away the discernment of the elders.
verses.textEnNlt: He silences the trusted adviser and removes the insight of the elders.
verses.textEnNasb: "He deprives the trusted ones of speech, And takes away the discernment of the elders.
verses.textEn: He silences the lips of trusted advisers and takes away the discernment of elders.

verses.textZh: 他把羞辱倾倒在王子上， 又松开壮士的腰带。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把羞辱倾倒在王子上， 又松开壮士的腰带。
verses.textZhCuv: 他使君王蒙羞被辱， 放松有力之人的腰带。
verses.textEnNiv: He pours contempt on nobles and disarms the mighty.
verses.textEnEsv: He pours contempt on princes and loosens the belt of the strong.
verses.textEnNkjv: He pours contempt on princes, And disarms the mighty.
verses.textEnNlt: He pours disgrace upon princes and disarms the strong.
verses.textEnNasb: "He pours contempt on nobles, And loosens the belt of the strong.
verses.textEn: He pours contempt on nobles and disarms the mighty.

verses.textZh: 他从黑暗中彰显奥秘， 把死荫领进光中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他从黑暗中彰显奥秘， 把死荫领进光中。
verses.textZhCuv: 他将深奥的事从黑暗中彰显， 使死荫显为光明。
verses.textEnNiv: He reveals the deep things of darkness and brings utter darkness into the light.
verses.textEnEsv: He uncovers the deeps out of darkness and brings deep darkness to light.
verses.textEnNkjv: He uncovers deep things out of darkness, And brings the shadow of death to light.
verses.textEnNlt: "He uncovers mysteries hidden in darkness; he brings light to the deepest gloom.
verses.textEnNasb: "He reveals mysteries from the darkness, And brings the deep darkness into light.
verses.textEn: He reveals the deep things of darkness and brings utter darkness into the light.

verses.textZh: 他使邦国兴盛，又毁灭他们， 扩张邦国，又把他们掳去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他使邦国兴盛，又毁灭他们， 扩张邦国，又把他们掳去。
verses.textZhCuv: 他使邦国兴旺而又毁灭； 他使邦国开广而又掳去。
verses.textEnNiv: He makes nations great, and destroys them; he enlarges nations, and disperses them.
verses.textEnEsv: He makes nations great, and he destroys them; he enlarges nations, and leads them away.
verses.textEnNkjv: He makes nations great, and destroys them; He enlarges nations, and guides them.
verses.textEnNlt: He builds up nations, and he destroys them. He expands nations, and he abandons them.
verses.textEnNasb: "He makes the nations great, then destroys them; He enlarges the nations, then leads them away.
verses.textEn: He makes nations great, and destroys them; he enlarges nations, and disperses them.

verses.textZh: 他除掉地上人民中首领的悟性， 使他们在无路的荒野之地飘流。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他除掉地上人民中首领的悟性， 使他们在无路的荒野之地飘流。
verses.textZhCuv: 他将地上民中首领的聪明夺去， 使他们在荒废无路之地漂流；
verses.textEnNiv: He deprives the leaders of the earth of their reason; he makes them wander in a trackless waste.
verses.textEnEsv: He takes away understanding from the chiefs of the people of the earth and makes them wander in a trackless waste.
verses.textEnNkjv: He takes away the understanding of the chiefs of the people of the earth, And makes them wander in a pathless wilderness.
verses.textEnNlt: He strips kings of understanding and leaves them wandering in a pathless wasteland.
verses.textEnNasb: "He deprives the leaders of the earth’s people of intelligence And makes them wander in a pathless wasteland.
verses.textEn: He deprives the leaders of the earth of their reason; he makes them wander in a trackless waste.

verses.textZh: 他们在黑暗无光中摸索， 他使他们飘泊无定像醉汉一样。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在黑暗无光中摸索， 他使他们飘泊无定像醉汉一样。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们无光，在黑暗中摸索， 又使他们东倒西歪，像醉酒的人一样。
verses.textEnNiv: They grope in darkness with no light; he makes them stagger like drunkards.
verses.textEnEsv: They grope in the dark without light, and he makes them stagger like a drunken man.
verses.textEnNkjv: They grope in the dark without light, And He makes them stagger like a drunken man.
verses.textEnNlt: They grope in the darkness without a light. He makes them stagger like drunkards.
verses.textEnNasb: "They grope in darkness with no light, And He makes them stagger like a drunken person.
verses.textEn: They grope in darkness with no light; he makes them stagger like drunkards.

verses.textZh: "这一切我的眼睛都见过， 我的耳朵都听过，而且明白。
verses.textZhCnvs: "这一切我的眼睛都见过， 我的耳朵都听过，而且明白。
verses.textZhCuv: 这一切，我眼都见过； 我耳都听过，而且明白。
verses.textEnNiv: "My eyes have seen all this, my ears have heard and understood it.
verses.textEnEsv: "Behold, my eye has seen all this, my ear has heard and understood it.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, my eye has seen all this, My ear has heard and understood it.
verses.textEnNlt: "Look, I have seen all this with my own eyes and heard it with my own ears, and now I understand.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, my eye has seen all this, My ear has heard and understood it.
verses.textEn: "My eyes have seen all this, my ears have heard and understood it.

verses.textZh: 你们所知道的我也知道， 我并非不及你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们所知道的我也知道， 我并非不及你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们所知道的，我也知道， 并非不及你们。
verses.textEnNiv: What you know, I also know; I am not inferior to you.
verses.textEnEsv: What you know, I also know; I am not inferior to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: What you know, I also know; I am not inferior to you.
verses.textEnNlt: I know as much as you do. You are no better than I am.
verses.textEnNasb: "What you know I also know; I am not inferior to you.
verses.textEn: What you know, I also know; I am not inferior to you.

verses.textZh: 但我要对全能者说话， 我愿与神辩论。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但我要对全能者说话， 我愿与神辩论。
verses.textZhCuv: 我真要对全能者说话； 我愿与神理论。
verses.textEnNiv: But I desire to speak to the Almighty and to argue my case with God.
verses.textEnEsv: But I would speak to the Almighty, and I desire to argue my case with God.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I would speak to the Almighty, And I desire to reason with God.
verses.textEnNlt: As for me, I would speak directly to the Almighty. I want to argue my case with God himself.
verses.textEnNasb: "But I would speak to the Almighty, And I desire to argue with God.
verses.textEn: But I desire to speak to the Almighty and to argue my case with God.

verses.textZh: 你们都是捏造谎言的， 都是无用的医生。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们都是捏造谎言的， 都是无用的医生。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们是编造谎言的， 都是无用的医生。
verses.textEnNiv: You, however, smear me with lies; you are worthless physicians, all of you!
verses.textEnEsv: As for you, you whitewash with lies; worthless physicians are you all.
verses.textEnNkjv: But you forgers of lies, You are all worthless physicians.
verses.textEnNlt: As for you, you smear me with lies. As physicians, you are worthless quacks.
verses.textEnNasb: "But you smear me with lies; You are all worthless physicians.
verses.textEn: You, however, smear me with lies; you are worthless physicians, all of you!

verses.textZh: 但愿你们完全不作声， 这样才算为你们的智慧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但愿你们完全不作声， 这样才算为你们的智慧。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟愿你们全然不作声； 这就算为你们的智慧！
verses.textEnNiv: If only you would be altogether silent! For you, that would be wisdom.
verses.textEnEsv: Oh that you would keep silent, and it would be your wisdom!
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, that you would be silent, And it would be your wisdom!
verses.textEnNlt: If only you could be silent! That’s the wisest thing you could do.
verses.textEnNasb: "Oh that you would be completely silent, And that it would become your wisdom!
verses.textEn: If only you would be altogether silent! For you, that would be wisdom.

verses.textZh: 请你们听我的辩论， 留心听我嘴唇的申诉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 请你们听我的辩论， 留心听我嘴唇的申诉。
verses.textZhCuv: 请你们听我的辩论， 留心听我口中的分诉。
verses.textEnNiv: Hear now my argument; listen to the pleas of my lips.
verses.textEnEsv: Hear now my argument and listen to the pleadings of my lips.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now hear my reasoning, And heed the pleadings of my lips.
verses.textEnNlt: Listen to my charge; pay attention to my arguments.
verses.textEnNasb: "Please hear my argument, And give your attention to the contentions of my lips.
verses.textEn: Hear now my argument; listen to the pleas of my lips.

verses.textZh: 你们要为神说不义的言语吗？ 你们要为他说诡诈的话吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要为神说不义的言语吗？ 你们要为他说诡诈的话吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要为神说不义的话吗？ 为他说诡诈的言语吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Will you speak wickedly on God’s behalf? Will you speak deceitfully for him?
verses.textEnEsv: Will you speak falsely for God and speak deceitfully for him?
verses.textEnNkjv: Will you speak wickedly for God, And talk deceitfully for Him?
verses.textEnNlt: "Are you defending God with lies? Do you make your dishonest arguments for his sake?
verses.textEnNasb: "Will you speak what is unjust for God, And speak what is deceitful for Him?
verses.textEn: Will you speak wickedly on God’s behalf? Will you speak deceitfully for him?

verses.textZh: 你们要徇神的情面吗？ 要为神争辩吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要徇神的情面吗？ 要为神争辩吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要为神徇情吗？ 要为他争论吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Will you show him partiality? Will you argue the case for God?
verses.textEnEsv: Will you show partiality toward him? Will you plead the case for God?
verses.textEnNkjv: Will you show partiality for Him? Will you contend for God?
verses.textEnNlt: Will you slant your testimony in his favor? Will you argue God’s case for him?
verses.textEnNasb: "Will you show partiality for Him? Will you contend for God?
verses.textEn: Will you show him partiality? Will you argue the case for God?

verses.textZh: 他把你们查出来，这是好吗？ 人怎样哄骗人，你们也怎样哄骗神吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把你们查出来，这是好吗？ 人怎样哄骗人，你们也怎样哄骗神吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 他查出你们来，这岂是好吗？ 人欺哄人，你们也要照样欺哄他吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Would it turn out well if he examined you? Could you deceive him as you might deceive a mortal?
verses.textEnEsv: Will it be well with you when he searches you out? Or can you deceive him, as one deceives a man?
verses.textEnNkjv: Will it be well when He searches you out? Or can you mock Him as one mocks a man?
verses.textEnNlt: What will happen when he finds out what you are doing? Can you fool him as easily as you fool people?
verses.textEnNasb: "Will it go well when He examines you? Or will you deceive Him as one deceives a man?
verses.textEn: Would it turn out well if he examined you? Could you deceive him as you might deceive a mortal?

verses.textZh: 你们若暗中徇情面， 他必然责备你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们若暗中徇情面， 他必然责备你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们若暗中徇情， 他必要责备你们。
verses.textEnNiv: He would surely call you to account if you secretly showed partiality.
verses.textEnEsv: He will surely rebuke you if in secret you show partiality.
verses.textEnNkjv: He will surely rebuke you If you secretly show partiality.
verses.textEnNlt: No, you will be in trouble with him if you secretly slant your testimony in his favor.
verses.textEnNasb: "He will certainly punish you If you secretly show partiality.
verses.textEn: He would surely call you to account if you secretly showed partiality.

verses.textZh: 他的尊严不是叫你们惧怕吗？ 他的惊吓不是临到你们吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的尊严不是叫你们惧怕吗？ 他的惊吓不是临到你们吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 他的尊荣岂不叫你们惧怕吗？ 他的惊吓岂不临到你们吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Would not his splendor terrify you? Would not the dread of him fall on you?
verses.textEnEsv: Will not his majesty terrify you, and the dread of him fall upon you?
verses.textEnNkjv: Will not His excellence make you afraid, And the dread of Him fall upon you?
verses.textEnNlt: Doesn’t his majesty terrify you? Doesn’t your fear of him overwhelm you?
verses.textEnNasb: "Will His majesty not terrify you, And the dread of Him fall upon you?
verses.textEn: Would not his splendor terrify you? Would not the dread of him fall on you?

verses.textZh: 你们背诵的格言都是炉灰的格言， 你们的辩护都是泥土的辩护。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们背诵的格言都是炉灰的格言， 你们的辩护都是泥土的辩护。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们以为可记念的箴言是炉灰的箴言； 你们以为可靠的坚垒是淤泥的坚垒。
verses.textEnNiv: Your maxims are proverbs of ashes; your defenses are defenses of clay.
verses.textEnEsv: Your maxims are proverbs of ashes; your defenses are defenses of clay.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your platitudes are proverbs of ashes, Your defenses are defenses of clay.
verses.textEnNlt: Your platitudes are as valuable as ashes. Your defense is as fragile as a clay pot.
verses.textEnNasb: "Your memorable sayings are proverbs of ashes, Your defenses are defenses of clay.
verses.textEn: Your maxims are proverbs of ashes; your defenses are defenses of clay.

verses.textZh: 你们要静默，离开我，好让我说话， 然后不论甚么事也好，让它临到我吧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要静默，离开我，好让我说话， 然后不论甚么事也好，让它临到我吧。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们不要作声，任凭我吧！ 让我说话，无论如何我都承当。
verses.textEnNiv: "Keep silent and let me speak; then let come to me what may.
verses.textEnEsv: "Let me have silence, and I will speak, and let come on me what may.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Hold your peace with me, and let me speak, Then let come on me what may!
verses.textEnNlt: "Be silent now and leave me alone. Let me speak, and I will face the consequences.
verses.textEnNasb: "Be silent before me so that I may speak; Then let come upon me what may.
verses.textEn: "Keep silent and let me speak; then let come to me what may.

verses.textZh: 我已把我的肉挂在自己的牙上， 把我的命放在自己的手中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我已把我的肉挂在自己的牙上， 把我的命放在自己的手中。
verses.textZhCuv: 我何必把我的肉挂在牙上， 将我的命放在手中。
verses.textEnNiv: Why do I put myself in jeopardy and take my life in my hands?
verses.textEnEsv: Why should I take my flesh in my teeth and put my life in my hand?
verses.textEnNkjv: Why do I take my flesh in my teeth, And put my life in my hands?
verses.textEnNlt: Why should I put myself in mortal danger and take my life in my own hands?
verses.textEnNasb: "Why should I take my flesh in my teeth, And put my life in my hands?
verses.textEn: Why do I put myself in jeopardy and take my life in my hands?

verses.textZh: 他必杀我，我没有指望了， 我必在他面前辩明我所行的；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必杀我，我没有指望了， 我必在他面前辩明我所行的；
verses.textZhCuv: 他必杀我；我虽无指望， 然而我在他面前还要辩明我所行的。
verses.textEnNiv: Though he slay me, yet will I hope in him; I will surely defend my ways to his face.
verses.textEnEsv: Though he slay me, I will hope in him; yet I will argue my ways to his face.
verses.textEnNkjv: Though He slay me, yet will I trust Him. Even so, I will defend my own ways before Him.
verses.textEnNlt: God might kill me, but I have no other hope. I am going to argue my case with him.
verses.textEnNasb: "Though He slay me, I will hope in Him. Nevertheless I will argue my ways before Him.
verses.textEn: Though he slay me, yet will I hope in him; I will surely defend my ways to his face.

verses.textZh: 这要成为我的拯救， 因为不敬虔的人不能到他面前来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这要成为我的拯救， 因为不敬虔的人不能到他面前来。
verses.textZhCuv: 这要成为我的拯救， 因为不虔诚的人不得到他面前。
verses.textEnNiv: Indeed, this will turn out for my deliverance, for no godless person would dare come before him!
verses.textEnEsv: This will be my salvation, that the godless shall not come before him.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also shall be my salvation, For a hypocrite could not come before Him.
verses.textEnNlt: But this is what will save me—I am not godless. If I were, I could not stand before him.
verses.textEnNasb: "This also will be my salvation, For a godless person cannot come before His presence.
verses.textEn: Indeed, this will turn out for my deliverance, for no godless person would dare come before him!

verses.textZh: 你们当细听我的言语， 让我的宣言进入你们的耳中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们当细听我的言语， 让我的宣言进入你们的耳中。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要细听我的言语， 使我所辩论的入你们的耳中。
verses.textEnNiv: Listen carefully to what I say; let my words ring in your ears.
verses.textEnEsv: Keep listening to my words, and let my declaration be in your ears.
verses.textEnNkjv: Listen carefully to my speech, And to my declaration with your ears.
verses.textEnNlt: "Listen closely to what I am about to say. Hear me out.
verses.textEnNasb: "Listen carefully to my speech, And let my declaration fill your ears.
verses.textEn: Listen carefully to what I say; let my words ring in your ears.

verses.textZh: 现在我已呈上我的案件， 我知道我自己得算为义，
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在我已呈上我的案件， 我知道我自己得算为义，
verses.textZhCuv: 我已陈明我的案， 知道自己有义。
verses.textEnNiv: Now that I have prepared my case, I know I will be vindicated.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, I have prepared my case; I know that I shall be in the right.
verses.textEnNkjv: See now, I have prepared my case, I know that I shall be vindicated.
verses.textEnNlt: I have prepared my case; I will be proved innocent.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold now, I have prepared my case; I know that I will be vindicated.
verses.textEn: Now that I have prepared my case, I know I will be vindicated.

verses.textZh: 有谁与我相争呢？ 若有，我就默然不言，气绝而亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有谁与我相争呢？ 若有，我就默然不言，气绝而亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 有谁与我争论， 我就情愿缄默不言，气绝而亡。
verses.textEnNiv: Can anyone bring charges against me? If so, I will be silent and die.
verses.textEnEsv: Who is there who will contend with me? For then I would be silent and die.
verses.textEnNkjv: Who is he who will contend with me? If now I hold my tongue, I perish.
verses.textEnNlt: Who can argue with me over this? And if you prove me wrong, I will remain silent and die.
verses.textEnNasb: "Who could contend with me? For then I would be silent and die.
verses.textEn: Can anyone bring charges against me? If so, I will be silent and die.

verses.textZh: 只要不对我行两件事， 我就不躲开你的面，
verses.textZhCnvs: 只要不对我行两件事， 我就不躲开你的面，
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有两件不要向我施行， 我就不躲开你的面：
verses.textEnNiv: "Only grant me these two things, God, and then I will not hide from you:
verses.textEnEsv: Only grant me two things, then I will not hide myself from your face:
verses.textEnNkjv: "Only two things do not do to me, Then I will not hide myself from You:
verses.textEnNlt: "O God, grant me these two things, and then I will be able to face you.
verses.textEnNasb: "Only two things I ask that You do not do to me, Then I will not hide from Your face:
verses.textEn: "Only grant me these two things, God, and then I will not hide from you:

verses.textZh: 就是把你的手缩回，远离我身， 又不使你的惊惧威吓我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是把你的手缩回，远离我身， 又不使你的惊惧威吓我。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是把你的手缩回，远离我身； 又不使你的惊惶威吓我。
verses.textEnNiv: Withdraw your hand far from me, and stop frightening me with your terrors.
verses.textEnEsv: withdraw your hand far from me, and let not dread of you terrify me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Withdraw Your hand far from me, And let not the dread of You make me afraid.
verses.textEnNlt: Remove your heavy hand from me, and don’t terrify me with your awesome presence.
verses.textEnNasb: Remove Your hand from me, And may the dread of You not terrify me.
verses.textEn: Withdraw your hand far from me, and stop frightening me with your terrors.

verses.textZh: 这样，你一呼叫，我就回答， 或是让我说话，你回答我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，你一呼叫，我就回答， 或是让我说话，你回答我。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，你呼叫，我就回答； 或是让我说话，你回答我。
verses.textEnNiv: Then summon me and I will answer, or let me speak, and you reply to me.
verses.textEnEsv: Then call, and I will answer; or let me speak, and you reply to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then call, and I will answer; Or let me speak, then You respond to me.
verses.textEnNlt: Now summon me, and I will answer! Or let me speak to you, and you reply.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then call and I will answer; Or let me speak, then reply to me.
verses.textEn: Then summon me and I will answer, or let me speak, and you reply to me.

verses.textZh: 我的罪孽与罪过有多少呢？ 求你让我知道我的过犯与罪过。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的罪孽与罪过有多少呢？ 求你让我知道我的过犯与罪过。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的罪孽和罪过有多少呢？ 求你叫我知道我的过犯与罪愆。
verses.textEnNiv: How many wrongs and sins have I committed? Show me my offense and my sin.
verses.textEnEsv: How many are my iniquities and my sins? Make me know my transgression and my sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: How many are my iniquities and sins? Make me know my transgression and my sin.
verses.textEnNlt: Tell me, what have I done wrong? Show me my rebellion and my sin.
verses.textEnNasb: "How many are my guilty deeds and sins? Make known to me my wrongdoing and my sin.
verses.textEn: How many wrongs and sins have I committed? Show me my offense and my sin.

verses.textZh: 你为甚么掩面， 把我当作你的仇敌呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你为甚么掩面， 把我当作你的仇敌呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你为何掩面、 拿我当仇敌呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Why do you hide your face and consider me your enemy?
verses.textEnEsv: Why do you hide your face and count me as your enemy?
verses.textEnNkjv: Why do You hide Your face, And regard me as Your enemy?
verses.textEnNlt: Why do you turn away from me? Why do you treat me as your enemy?
verses.textEnNasb: "Why do You hide Your face And consider me Your enemy?
verses.textEn: Why do you hide your face and consider me your enemy?

verses.textZh: 你要使被风吹动的树叶战抖吗？ 你要追赶枯干了的碎秸吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要使被风吹动的树叶战抖吗？ 你要追赶枯干了的碎秸吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你要惊动被风吹的叶子吗？ 要追赶枯干的碎秸吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Will you torment a windblown leaf? Will you chase after dry chaff?
verses.textEnEsv: Will you frighten a driven leaf and pursue dry chaff?
verses.textEnNkjv: Will You frighten a leaf driven to and fro? And will You pursue dry stubble?
verses.textEnNlt: Would you terrify a leaf blown by the wind? Would you chase dry straw?
verses.textEnNasb: "Will You scare away a scattered leaf? Or will You pursue the dry chaff?
verses.textEn: Will you torment a windblown leaf? Will you chase after dry chaff?

verses.textZh: 你记录判词攻击我， 又使我承当我幼年的罪孽；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你记录判词攻击我， 又使我承当我幼年的罪孽；
verses.textZhCuv: 你按罪状刑罚我， 又使我担当幼年的罪孽；
verses.textEnNiv: For you write down bitter things against me and make me reap the sins of my youth.
verses.textEnEsv: For you write bitter things against me and make me inherit the iniquities of my youth.
verses.textEnNkjv: For You write bitter things against me, And make me inherit the iniquities of my youth.
verses.textEnNlt: "You write bitter accusations against me and bring up all the sins of my youth.
verses.textEnNasb: "For You write bitter things against me And make me inherit the guilty deeds of my youth.
verses.textEn: For you write down bitter things against me and make me reap the sins of my youth.

verses.textZh: 你把我的两脚上了木狗， 又鉴察我一切所行的， 为我的脚掌定界限。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你把我的两脚上了木狗， 又鉴察我一切所行的， 为我的脚掌定界限。
verses.textZhCuv: 也把我的脚上了木狗， 并窥察我一切的道路， 为我的脚掌划定界限。
verses.textEnNiv: You fasten my feet in shackles; you keep close watch on all my paths by putting marks on the soles of my feet.
verses.textEnEsv: You put my feet in the stocks and watch all my paths; you set a limit for the soles of my feet.
verses.textEnNkjv: You put my feet in the stocks, And watch closely all my paths. You set a limit for the soles of my feet.
verses.textEnNlt: You put my feet in stocks. You examine all my paths. You trace all my footprints.
verses.textEnNasb: "You put my feet in the stocks And watch all my paths; You set a limit for the soles of my feet,
verses.textEn: You fasten my feet in shackles; you keep close watch on all my paths by putting marks on the soles of my feet.

verses.textZh: 我的生命像破灭腐朽之物， 又像虫蛀的衣服。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的生命像破灭腐朽之物， 又像虫蛀的衣服。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我已经像灭绝的烂物， 像虫蛀的衣裳。
verses.textEnNiv: "So man wastes away like something rotten, like a garment eaten by moths.
verses.textEnEsv: Man wastes away like a rotten thing, like a garment that is moth-eaten.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Man decays like a rotten thing, Like a garment that is moth-eaten.
verses.textEnNlt: I waste away like rotting wood, like a moth-eaten coat.
verses.textEnNasb: While I am decaying like a rotten thing, Like a garment that is moth-eaten.
verses.textEn: "So man wastes away like something rotten, like a garment eaten by moths.

verses.textZh: "妇人所生的日子短少，满有搅扰；
verses.textZhCnvs: "妇人所生的日子短少，满有搅扰；
verses.textZhCuv: 人为妇人所生， 日子短少，多有患难；
verses.textEnNiv: "Mortals, born of woman, are of few days and full of trouble.
verses.textEnEsv: "Man who is born of a woman is few of days and full of trouble.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Man whois born of woman Is of few days and full of trouble.
verses.textEnNlt: "How frail is humanity! How short is life, how full of trouble!
verses.textEnNasb: "Man, who is born of woman, Is short-lived and full of turmoil.
verses.textEn: "Mortals, born of woman, are of few days and full of trouble.

verses.textZh: 他生长如花，又遭割下； 他飞去如影，并不停留。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他生长如花，又遭割下； 他飞去如影，并不停留。
verses.textZhCuv: 出来如花，又被割下， 飞去如影，不能存留。
verses.textEnNiv: They spring up like flowers and wither away; like fleeting shadows, they do not endure.
verses.textEnEsv: He comes out like a flower and withers; he flees like a shadow and continues not.
