verses.textEnNkjv: He comes forth like a flower and fades away; He flees like a shadow and does not continue.
verses.textEnNlt: We blossom like a flower and then wither. Like a passing shadow, we quickly disappear.
verses.textEnNasb: "Like a flower he comes out and withers. He also flees like a shadow and does not remain.
verses.textEn: They spring up like flowers and wither away; like fleeting shadows, they do not endure.

verses.textZh: 这样的人你还睁眼看他， 又把他带到你跟前受审吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样的人你还睁眼看他， 又把他带到你跟前受审吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 这样的人你岂睁眼看他吗？ 又叫我来受审吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Do you fix your eye on them? Will you bring them before you for judgment?
verses.textEnEsv: And do you open your eyes on such a one and bring me into judgment with you?
verses.textEnNkjv: And do You open Your eyes on such a one, And bring me to judgment with Yourself?
verses.textEnNlt: Must you keep an eye on such a frail creature and demand an accounting from me?
verses.textEnNasb: "You also open Your eyes on him And bring him into judgment with Yourself.
verses.textEn: Do you fix your eye on them? Will you bring them before you for judgment?

verses.textZh: 谁能使洁净出于污秽呢？ 无人有此本事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁能使洁净出于污秽呢？ 无人有此本事。
verses.textZhCuv: 谁能使洁净之物出于污秽之中呢？ 无论谁也不能！
verses.textEnNiv: Who can bring what is pure from the impure? No one!
verses.textEnEsv: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? There is not one.
verses.textEnNkjv: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? No one!
verses.textEnNlt: Who can bring purity out of an impure person? No one!
verses.textEnNasb: "Who can make the clean out of the unclean? No one!
verses.textEn: Who can bring what is pure from the impure? No one!

verses.textZh: 人的日子既然被限定， 他的月数亦在乎你， 你也定下他的界限，使他不能越过。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人的日子既然被限定， 他的月数亦在乎你， 你也定下他的界限，使他不能越过。
verses.textZhCuv: 人的日子既然限定， 他的月数在你那里， 你也派定他的界限，使他不能越过，
verses.textEnNiv: A person’s days are determined; you have decreed the number of his months and have set limits he cannot exceed.
verses.textEnEsv: Since his days are determined, and the number of his months is with you, and you have appointed his limits that he cannot pass,
verses.textEnNkjv: Since his days are determined, The number of his months is with You; You have appointed his limits, so that he cannot pass.
verses.textEnNlt: You have decided the length of our lives. You know how many months we will live, and we are not given a minute longer.
verses.textEnNasb: "Since his days are determined, The number of his months is with You; And You have set his limits so that he cannot pass.
verses.textEn: A person’s days are determined; you have decreed the number of his months and have set limits he cannot exceed.

verses.textZh: 就求你转眼不看他，使他得歇息 ， 直等到他像雇工一样享受他的日子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就求你转眼不看他，使他得歇息 ， 直等到他像雇工一样享受他的日子。
verses.textZhCuv: 便求你转眼不看他，使他得歇息， 直等他像雇工人完毕他的日子。
verses.textEnNiv: So look away from him and let him alone, till he has put in his time like a hired laborer.
verses.textEnEsv: look away from him and leave him alone, that he may enjoy, like a hired hand, his day.
verses.textEnNkjv: Look away from him that he may rest, Till like a hired man he finishes his day.
verses.textEnNlt: So leave us alone and let us rest! We are like hired hands, so let us finish our work in peace.
verses.textEnNasb: "Look away from him so that he may rest, Until he fulfills his day like a hired worker.
verses.textEn: So look away from him and let him alone, till he has put in his time like a hired laborer.

verses.textZh: 树木常有希望， 树木若被砍下，也会再发芽， 嫩枝仍生长不息。
verses.textZhCnvs: 树木常有希望， 树木若被砍下，也会再发芽， 嫩枝仍生长不息。
verses.textZhCuv: 树若被砍下， 还可指望发芽， 嫩枝生长不息；
verses.textEnNiv: "At least there is hope for a tree: If it is cut down, it will sprout again, and its new shoots will not fail.
verses.textEnEsv: "For there is hope for a tree, if it be cut down, that it will sprout again, and that its shoots will not cease.
verses.textEnNkjv: "For there is hope for a tree, If it is cut down, that it will sprout again, And that its tender shoots will not cease.
verses.textEnNlt: "Even a tree has more hope! If it is cut down, it will sprout again and grow new branches.
verses.textEnNasb: "For there is hope for a tree, When it is cut down, that it will sprout again, And its shoots will not fail.
verses.textEn: "At least there is hope for a tree: If it is cut down, it will sprout again, and its new shoots will not fail.

verses.textZh: 虽然树根衰老在地里， 树干也枯死在土中，
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽然树根衰老在地里， 树干也枯死在土中，
verses.textZhCuv: 其根虽然衰老在地里， 干也死在土中，
verses.textEnNiv: Its roots may grow old in the ground and its stump die in the soil,
verses.textEnEsv: Though its root grow old in the earth, and its stump die in the soil,
verses.textEnNkjv: Though its root may grow old in the earth, And its stump may die in the ground,
verses.textEnNlt: Though its roots have grown old in the earth and its stump decays,
verses.textEnNasb: "Though its roots grow old in the ground, And its stump dies in the dry soil,
verses.textEn: Its roots may grow old in the ground and its stump die in the soil,

verses.textZh: 一有水气，就会萌芽， 又生长枝条如新栽的树一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 一有水气，就会萌芽， 又生长枝条如新栽的树一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 及至得了水气，还要发芽， 又长枝条，像新栽的树一样。
verses.textEnNiv: yet at the scent of water it will bud and put forth shoots like a plant.
verses.textEnEsv: yet at the scent of water it will bud and put out branches like a young plant.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet at the scent of water it will bud And bring forth branches like a plant.
verses.textEnNlt: at the scent of water it will bud and sprout again like a new seedling.
verses.textEnNasb: At the scent of water it will flourish And produce sprigs like a plant.
verses.textEn: yet at the scent of water it will bud and put forth shoots like a plant.

verses.textZh: 人死了，就化为乌有； 人一气绝就不在了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人死了，就化为乌有； 人一气绝就不在了。
verses.textZhCuv: 但人死亡而消灭； 他气绝，竟在何处呢？
verses.textEnNiv: But a man dies and is laid low; he breathes his last and is no more.
verses.textEnEsv: But a man dies and is laid low; man breathes his last, and where is he?
verses.textEnNkjv: But man dies and is laid away; Indeed he breathes his last And where is he?
verses.textEnNlt: "But when people die, their strength is gone. They breathe their last, and then where are they?
verses.textEnNasb: "But a man dies and lies prostrate. A person passes away, and where is he?
verses.textEn: But a man dies and is laid low; he breathes his last and is no more.

verses.textZh: 海洋中的水消失， 江河枯竭干涸，
verses.textZhCnvs: 海洋中的水消失， 江河枯竭干涸，
verses.textZhCuv: 海中的水绝尽， 江河消散干涸。
verses.textEnNiv: As the water of a lake dries up or a riverbed becomes parched and dry,
verses.textEnEsv: As waters fail from a lake and a river wastes away and dries up,
verses.textEnNkjv: As water disappears from the sea, And a river becomes parched and dries up,
verses.textEnNlt: As water evaporates from a lake and a river disappears in drought,
verses.textEnNasb: "As water evaporates from the sea, And a river becomes parched and dried up,
verses.textEn: As the water of a lake dries up or a riverbed becomes parched and dry,

verses.textZh: 人也是这样一躺下去，就不再起来， 直到天都没有了还不醒过来， 也不能从睡眠中被唤醒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人也是这样一躺下去，就不再起来， 直到天都没有了还不醒过来， 也不能从睡眠中被唤醒。
verses.textZhCuv: 人也是如此，躺下不再起来， 等到天没有了，仍不得复醒， 也不得从睡中唤醒。
verses.textEnNiv: so he lies down and does not rise; till the heavens are no more, people will not awake or be roused from their sleep.
verses.textEnEsv: so a man lies down and rises not again; till the heavens are no more he will not awake or be roused out of his sleep.
verses.textEnNkjv: So man lies down and does not rise. Till the heavens are no more, They will not awake Nor be roused from their sleep.
verses.textEnNlt: people are laid to rest and do not rise again. Until the heavens are no more, they will not wake up nor be roused from their sleep.
verses.textEnNasb: So a man lies down and does not rise. Until the heavens no longer exist, He will not awake nor be woken from his sleep.
verses.textEn: so he lies down and does not rise; till the heavens are no more, people will not awake or be roused from their sleep.

verses.textZh: 但愿你把我藏在阴间， 把我隐藏，直到你的怒气过去； 愿你为我定一个期限，好记念我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但愿你把我藏在阴间， 把我隐藏，直到你的怒气过去； 愿你为我定一个期限，好记念我。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟愿你把我藏在阴间， 存于隐密处，等你的忿怒过去； 愿你为我定了日期，记念我。
verses.textEnNiv: "If only you would hide me in the grave and conceal me till your anger has passed! If only you would set me a time and then remember me!
verses.textEnEsv: Oh that you would hide me in Sheol, that you would conceal me until your wrath be past, that you would appoint me a set time, and remember me!
verses.textEnNkjv: "Oh, that You would hide me in the grave, That You would conceal me until Your wrath is past, That You would appoint me a set time, and remember me!
verses.textEnNlt: "I wish you would hide me in the grave and forget me there until your anger has passed. But mark your calendar to think of me again!
verses.textEnNasb: "Oh that You would hide me in Sheol, That You would conceal me until Your wrath returns to You, That You would set a limit for me and remember me!
verses.textEn: "If only you would hide me in the grave and conceal me till your anger has passed! If only you would set me a time and then remember me!

verses.textZh: 人若死了，怎能再活呢？ 我要在我一切劳苦的日子等待， 等到我得释放的时候来到。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人若死了，怎能再活呢？ 我要在我一切劳苦的日子等待， 等到我得释放的时候来到。
verses.textZhCuv: 人若死了岂能再活呢？ 我只要在我一切争战的日子， 等我被释放 的时候来到。
verses.textEnNiv: If someone dies, will they live again? All the days of my hard service I will wait for my renewal to come.
verses.textEnEsv: If a man dies, shall he live again? All the days of my service I would wait, till my renewal should come.
verses.textEnNkjv: If a man dies, shall he live again? All the days of my hard service I will wait, Till my change comes.
verses.textEnNlt: Can the dead live again? If so, this would give me hope through all my years of struggle, and I would eagerly await the release of death.
verses.textEnNasb: "If a man dies, will he live again? All the days of my struggle I will wait Until my relief comes.
verses.textEn: If someone dies, will they live again? All the days of my hard service I will wait for my renewal to come.

verses.textZh: 你一呼叫，我就回答你， 你必渴慕你手所作的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你一呼叫，我就回答你， 你必渴慕你手所作的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你呼叫，我便回答； 你手所做的，你必羡慕。
verses.textEnNiv: You will call and I will answer you; you will long for the creature your hands have made.
verses.textEnEsv: You would call, and I would answer you; you would long for the work of your hands.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall call, and I will answer You; You shall desire the work of Your hands.
verses.textEnNlt: You would call and I would answer, and you would yearn for me, your handiwork.
verses.textEnNasb: "You will call, and I will answer You; You will long for the work of Your hands.
verses.textEn: You will call and I will answer you; you will long for the creature your hands have made.

verses.textZh: 但现在你数点我的脚步， 必不再鉴察我的罪过，
verses.textZhCnvs: 但现在你数点我的脚步， 必不再鉴察我的罪过，
verses.textZhCuv: 但如今你数点我的脚步， 岂不窥察我的罪过吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Surely then you will count my steps but not keep track of my sin.
verses.textEnEsv: For then you would number my steps; you would not keep watch over my sin;
verses.textEnNkjv: For now You number my steps, But do not watch over my sin.
verses.textEnNlt: For then you would guard my steps, instead of watching for my sins.
verses.textEnNasb: "For now You number my steps, You do not observe my sin.
verses.textEn: Surely then you will count my steps but not keep track of my sin.

verses.textZh: 我的过犯被你封在囊中， 我的罪孽你以灰泥遮盖了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的过犯被你封在囊中， 我的罪孽你以灰泥遮盖了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的过犯被你封在囊中， 也缝严了我的罪孽。
verses.textEnNiv: My offenses will be sealed up in a bag; you will cover over my sin.
verses.textEnEsv: my transgression would be sealed up in a bag, and you would cover over my iniquity.
verses.textEnNkjv: My transgression is sealed up in a bag, And You cover my iniquity.
verses.textEnNlt: My sins would be sealed in a pouch, and you would cover my guilt.
verses.textEnNasb: "My wrongdoing is sealed up in a bag, And You cover over my guilt.
verses.textEn: My offenses will be sealed up in a bag; you will cover over my sin.

verses.textZh: 山崩下坠， 岩石挪开原处；
verses.textZhCnvs: 山崩下坠， 岩石挪开原处；
verses.textZhCuv: 山崩变为无有； 磐石挪开原处。
verses.textEnNiv: "But as a mountain erodes and crumbles and as a rock is moved from its place,
verses.textEnEsv: "But the mountain falls and crumbles away, and the rock is removed from its place;
verses.textEnNkjv: "But as a mountain falls and crumbles away, And as a rock is moved from its place;
verses.textEnNlt: "But instead, as mountains fall and crumble and as rocks fall from a cliff,
verses.textEnNasb: "But the falling mountain crumbles away, And the rock moves from its place;
verses.textEn: "But as a mountain erodes and crumbles and as a rock is moved from its place,

verses.textZh: 流水磨蚀石头， 水的泛溢冲去地上的尘土， 你也这样灭绝人的指望。
verses.textZhCnvs: 流水磨蚀石头， 水的泛溢冲去地上的尘土， 你也这样灭绝人的指望。
verses.textZhCuv: 水流消磨石头， 所流溢的洗去地上的尘土； 你也照样灭绝人的指望。
verses.textEnNiv: as water wears away stones and torrents wash away the soil, so you destroy a person’s hope.
verses.textEnEsv: the waters wear away the stones; the torrents wash away the soil of the earth; so you destroy the hope of man.
verses.textEnNkjv: As water wears away stones, Andas torrents wash away the soil of the earth; So You destroy the hope of man.
verses.textEnNlt: as water wears away the stones and floods wash away the soil, so you destroy people’s hope.
verses.textEnNasb: Water wears away stones, Its torrents wash away the dust of the earth; So You destroy a man’s hope.
verses.textEn: as water wears away stones and torrents wash away the soil, so you destroy a person’s hope.

verses.textZh: 你永远胜过人，人就去世， 你改变他的容貌，把他遣走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你永远胜过人，人就去世， 你改变他的容貌，把他遣走。
verses.textZhCuv: 你攻击人常常得胜，使他去世； 你改变他的容貌，叫他往而不回。
verses.textEnNiv: You overpower them once for all, and they are gone; you change their countenance and send them away.
verses.textEnEsv: You prevail forever against him, and he passes; you change his countenance, and send him away.
verses.textEnNkjv: You prevail forever against him, and he passes on; You change his countenance and send him away.
verses.textEnNlt: You always overpower them, and they pass from the scene. You disfigure them in death and send them away.
verses.textEnNasb: "You forever overpower him and he departs; You change his appearance and send him away.
verses.textEn: You overpower them once for all, and they are gone; you change their countenance and send them away.

verses.textZh: 他的儿女得尊荣，他并不晓得， 他们降为卑，他也不觉得，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的儿女得尊荣，他并不晓得， 他们降为卑，他也不觉得，
verses.textZhCuv: 他儿子得尊荣，他也不知道， 降为卑，他也不觉得。
verses.textEnNiv: If their children are honored, they do not know it; if their offspring are brought low, they do not see it.
verses.textEnEsv: His sons come to honor, and he does not know it; they are brought low, and he perceives it not.
verses.textEnNkjv: His sons come to honor, and he does not know it; They are brought low, and he does not perceive it.
verses.textEnNlt: They never know if their children grow up in honor or sink to insignificance.
verses.textEnNasb: "His sons achieve honor, but he does not know it; Or they become insignificant, and he does not perceive it.
verses.textEn: If their children are honored, they do not know it; if their offspring are brought low, they do not see it.

verses.textZh: 只觉自己身上的痛苦， 为自己悲哀。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 只觉自己身上的痛苦， 为自己悲哀。"
verses.textZhCuv: 但知身上疼痛， 心中悲哀。
verses.textEnNiv: They feel but the pain of their own bodies and mourn only for themselves."
verses.textEnEsv: He feels only the pain of his own body, and he mourns only for himself."
verses.textEnNkjv: But his flesh will be in pain over it, And his soul will mourn over it."
verses.textEnNlt: They suffer painfully; their life is full of trouble."
verses.textEnNasb: "However, his body pains him, And his soul mourns for himself."
verses.textEn: They feel but the pain of their own bodies and mourn only for themselves."

verses.textZh: 提幔人以利法回答说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 提幔人以利法回答说：
verses.textZhCuv: 提幔人以利法回答说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then Eliphaz the Temanite replied:
verses.textEnEsv: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said:
verses.textEnNlt: Then Eliphaz the Temanite replied:
verses.textEnNasb: Then Eliphaz the Temanite responded,
verses.textEn: Then Eliphaz the Temanite replied:

verses.textZh: "智慧人怎可用虚空的知识来回答呢？ 怎可用东风充满自己的肚腹呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: "智慧人怎可用虚空的知识来回答呢？ 怎可用东风充满自己的肚腹呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 智慧人岂可用虚空的知识回答， 用东风充满肚腹呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "Would a wise person answer with empty notions or fill their belly with the hot east wind?
verses.textEnEsv: "Should a wise man answer with windy knowledge, and fill his belly with the east wind?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Should a wise man answer with empty knowledge, And fill himself with the east wind?
verses.textEnNlt: "A wise man wouldn’t answer with such empty talk! You are nothing but a windbag.
verses.textEnNasb: "Should a wise man answer with windy knowledge, And fill himself with the east wind?
verses.textEn: "Would a wise person answer with empty notions or fill their belly with the hot east wind?

verses.textZh: 他怎可用无益的话，或无用的言词辩论呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 他怎可用无益的话，或无用的言词辩论呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 他岂可用无益的话 和无济于事的言语理论呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Would they argue with useless words, with speeches that have no value?
verses.textEnEsv: Should he argue in unprofitable talk, or in words with which he can do no good?
verses.textEnNkjv: Should he reason with unprofitable talk, Or by speeches with which he can do no good?
verses.textEnNlt: The wise don’t engage in empty chatter. What good are such words?
verses.textEnNasb: "Should he argue with useless talk, Or with words which do not benefit?
verses.textEn: Would they argue with useless words, with speeches that have no value?

verses.textZh: 你还废弃了敬畏神的心， 拦阻了在神面前的默祷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你还废弃了敬畏神的心， 拦阻了在神面前的默祷。
verses.textZhCuv: 你是废弃敬畏的意， 在神面前阻止敬虔的心。
verses.textEnNiv: But you even undermine piety and hinder devotion to God.
verses.textEnEsv: But you are doing away with the fear of God and hindering meditation before God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yes, you cast off fear, And restrain prayer before God.
verses.textEnNlt: Have you no fear of God, no reverence for him?
verses.textEnNasb: "Indeed, you do away with reverence, And hinder meditation before God.
verses.textEn: But you even undermine piety and hinder devotion to God.

verses.textZh: 你的罪孽教导你的口， 你采用诡诈人的舌头，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的罪孽教导你的口， 你采用诡诈人的舌头，
verses.textZhCuv: 你的罪孽指教你的口； 你选用诡诈人的舌头。
verses.textEnNiv: Your sin prompts your mouth; you adopt the tongue of the crafty.
verses.textEnEsv: For your iniquity teaches your mouth, and you choose the tongue of the crafty.
verses.textEnNkjv: For your iniquity teaches your mouth, And you choose the tongue of the crafty.
verses.textEnNlt: Your sins are telling your mouth what to say. Your words are based on clever deception.
verses.textEnNasb: "For your wrongdoing teaches your mouth, And you choose the language of the cunning.
verses.textEn: Your sin prompts your mouth; you adopt the tongue of the crafty.

verses.textZh: 是你的口定你的罪，不是我， 你嘴唇作见证控告你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 是你的口定你的罪，不是我， 你嘴唇作见证控告你。
verses.textZhCuv: 你自己的口定你有罪，并非是我； 你自己的嘴见证你的不是。
verses.textEnNiv: Your own mouth condemns you, not mine; your own lips testify against you.
verses.textEnEsv: Your own mouth condemns you, and not I; your own lips testify against you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your own mouth condemns you, and not I; Yes, your own lips testify against you.
verses.textEnNlt: Your own mouth condemns you, not I. Your own lips testify against you.
verses.textEnNasb: "Your own mouth condemns you, and not I; And your own lips testify against you.
verses.textEn: Your own mouth condemns you, not mine; your own lips testify against you.

verses.textZh: 你是头一个生下来的人吗？ 你在诸山未有之前诞生的吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你是头一个生下来的人吗？ 你在诸山未有之前诞生的吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你岂是头一个被生的人吗？ 你受造在诸山之先吗？
verses.textEnNiv: "Are you the first man ever born? Were you brought forth before the hills?
verses.textEnEsv: "Are you the first man who was born? Or were you brought forth before the hills?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Are you the first man who was born? Or were you made before the hills?
verses.textEnNlt: "Were you the first person ever born? Were you born before the hills were made?
verses.textEnNasb: "Were you the first person to be born, Or were you brought forth before the hills?
verses.textEn: "Are you the first man ever born? Were you brought forth before the hills?

verses.textZh: 你曾聆听过神的密旨吗？ 你可以独占智慧吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你曾聆听过神的密旨吗？ 你可以独占智慧吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你曾听见神的密旨吗？ 你还将智慧独自得尽吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Do you listen in on God’s council? Do you have a monopoly on wisdom?
verses.textEnEsv: Have you listened in the council of God? And do you limit wisdom to yourself?
verses.textEnNkjv: Have you heard the counsel of God? Do you limit wisdom to yourself?
verses.textEnNlt: Were you listening at God’s secret council? Do you have a monopoly on wisdom?
verses.textEnNasb: "Do you hear the secret discussion of God, And limit wisdom to yourself?
verses.textEn: Do you listen in on God’s council? Do you have a monopoly on wisdom?

verses.textZh: 有甚么是你知道，我们不知道的呢？ 你明白，我们不明白的呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 有甚么是你知道，我们不知道的呢？ 你明白，我们不明白的呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你知道什么是我们不知道的呢？ 你明白什么是我们不明白的呢？
verses.textEnNiv: What do you know that we do not know? What insights do you have that we do not have?
verses.textEnEsv: What do you know that we do not know? What do you understand that is not clear to us?
verses.textEnNkjv: What do you know that we do not know? What do you understand that is not in us?
verses.textEnNlt: What do you know that we don’t? What do you understand that we do not?
verses.textEnNasb: "What do you know that we do not know? What do you understand that we do not?
verses.textEn: What do you know that we do not know? What insights do you have that we do not have?

verses.textZh: 我们中间有白头发的，又有年纪老的， 年岁比你的父亲还大。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们中间有白头发的，又有年纪老的， 年岁比你的父亲还大。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们这里有白发的和年纪老迈的， 比你父亲还老。
verses.textEnNiv: The gray-haired and the aged are on our side, men even older than your father.
verses.textEnEsv: Both the gray-haired and the aged are among us, older than your father.
verses.textEnNkjv: Both the gray-haired and the aged are among us, Much older than your father.
verses.textEnNlt: On our side are aged, gray-haired men much older than your father!
verses.textEnNasb: "Both the gray-haired and the aged are among us, Older than your father.
verses.textEn: The gray-haired and the aged are on our side, men even older than your father.

verses.textZh: 神的安慰对你是否太少？ 温柔的言语对你是否不足？
verses.textZhCnvs: 神的安慰对你是否太少？ 温柔的言语对你是否不足？
verses.textZhCuv: 神用温和的话安慰你， 你以为太小吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Are God’s consolations not enough for you, words spoken gently to you?
verses.textEnEsv: Are the comforts of God too small for you, or the word that deals gently with you?
verses.textEnNkjv: Are the consolations of God too small for you, And the word spoken gently with you?
verses.textEnNlt: "Is God’s comfort too little for you? Is his gentle word not enough?
verses.textEnNasb: "Are the consolations of God too little for you, Or the word spoken gently to you?
verses.textEn: Are God’s consolations not enough for you, words spoken gently to you?

verses.textZh: 你的心为甚么迷惑你， 你的眼为甚么闪出怒光，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的心为甚么迷惑你， 你的眼为甚么闪出怒光，
verses.textZhCuv: 你的心为何将你逼去？ 你的眼为何冒出火星，
verses.textEnNiv: Why has your heart carried you away, and why do your eyes flash,
verses.textEnEsv: Why does your heart carry you away, and why do your eyes flash,
verses.textEnNkjv: Why does your heart carry you away, And what do your eyes wink at,
verses.textEnNlt: What has taken away your reason? What has weakened your vision,
verses.textEnNasb: "Why does your heart take you away? And why do your eyes wink,
verses.textEn: Why has your heart carried you away, and why do your eyes flash,

verses.textZh: 以致你的心灵转过来抗拒神， 从你的口中竟发出这样的话？
verses.textZhCnvs: 以致你的心灵转过来抗拒神， 从你的口中竟发出这样的话？
verses.textZhCuv: 使你的灵反对神， 也任你的口发这言语？
verses.textEnNiv: so that you vent your rage against God and pour out such words from your mouth?
verses.textEnEsv: that you turn your spirit against God and bring such words out of your mouth?
verses.textEnNkjv: That you turn your spirit against God, And let such words go out of your mouth?
verses.textEnNlt: that you turn against God and say all these evil things?
verses.textEnNasb: That you can turn your spirit against God And produce such words from your mouth?
verses.textEn: so that you vent your rage against God and pour out such words from your mouth?

verses.textZh: 人是甚么，能算为洁净吗？ 妇人所生的，能算为公义吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 人是甚么，能算为洁净吗？ 妇人所生的，能算为公义吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 人是什么，竟算为洁净呢？ 妇人所生的是什么，竟算为义呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "What are mortals, that they could be pure, or those born of woman, that they could be righteous?
verses.textEnEsv: What is man, that he can be pure? Or he who is born of a woman, that he can be righteous?
verses.textEnNkjv: "What is man, that he could be pure? And hewhois born of a woman, that he could be righteous?
verses.textEnNlt: Can any mortal be pure? Can anyone born of a woman be just?
verses.textEnNasb: "What is man, that he would be pure, Or he who is born of a woman, that he would be righteous?
verses.textEn: "What are mortals, that they could be pure, or those born of woman, that they could be righteous?

verses.textZh: 神不信任他的众天使， 在他看来，诸天也不洁净，
verses.textZhCnvs: 神不信任他的众天使， 在他看来，诸天也不洁净，
verses.textZhCuv: 神不信靠他的众圣者； 在他眼前，天也不洁净，
verses.textEnNiv: If God places no trust in his holy ones, if even the heavens are not pure in his eyes,
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, God puts no trust in his holy ones, and the heavens are not pure in his sight;
verses.textEnNkjv: If God puts no trust in His saints, And the heavens are not pure in His sight,
verses.textEnNlt: Look, God does not even trust the angels. Even the heavens are not absolutely pure in his sight.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, He has no trust in His holy ones, And the heavens are not pure in His sight;
verses.textEn: If God places no trust in his holy ones, if even the heavens are not pure in his eyes,

verses.textZh: 何况那可憎又腐败， 喝罪孽如同喝水的世人呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 何况那可憎又腐败， 喝罪孽如同喝水的世人呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 何况那污秽可憎、 喝罪孽如水的世人呢！
verses.textEnNiv: how much less mortals, who are vile and corrupt, who drink up evil like water!
verses.textEnEsv: how much less one who is abominable and corrupt, a man who drinks injustice like water!
verses.textEnNkjv: How much less man, whois abominable and filthy, Who drinks iniquity like water!
verses.textEnNlt: How much less pure is a corrupt and sinful person with a thirst for wickedness!
verses.textEnNasb: How much less one who is detestable and corrupt: A person who drinks malice like water!
verses.textEn: how much less mortals, who are vile and corrupt, who drink up evil like water!

verses.textZh: 我要告诉你，你要听我说。 我所看见的，我要述说，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要告诉你，你要听我说。 我所看见的，我要述说，
verses.textZhCuv: 我指示你，你要听； 我要述说所看见的，
verses.textEnNiv: "Listen to me and I will explain to you; let me tell you what I have seen,
verses.textEnEsv: "I will show you; hear me, and what I have seen I will declare
verses.textEnNkjv: "I will tell you, hear me; What I have seen I will declare,
verses.textEnNlt: "If you will listen, I will show you. I will answer you from my own experience.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will tell you, listen to me; And what I have seen I will also declare;
verses.textEn: "Listen to me and I will explain to you; let me tell you what I have seen,

verses.textZh: 就是智慧人所传讲的， 并没有隐瞒从他们列祖所领受的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是智慧人所传讲的， 并没有隐瞒从他们列祖所领受的。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是智慧人从列祖所受， 传说而不隐瞒的。
verses.textEnNiv: what the wise have declared, hiding nothing received from their ancestors
verses.textEnEsv: (what wise men have told, without hiding it from their fathers,
verses.textEnNkjv: What wise men have told, Not hiding anythingreceived from their fathers,
verses.textEnNlt: And it is confirmed by the reports of wise men who have heard the same thing from their fathers—
verses.textEnNasb: What wise people have told, And have not concealed from their fathers,
verses.textEn: what the wise have declared, hiding nothing received from their ancestors

verses.textZh: 这地唯独赐给列祖， 并没有外族人从他们中间经过。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这地唯独赐给列祖， 并没有外族人从他们中间经过。
verses.textZhCuv: 这地惟独赐给他们， 并没有外人从他们中间经过。
verses.textEnNiv: (to whom alone the land was given when no foreigners moved among them):
verses.textEnEsv: to whom alone the land was given, and no stranger passed among them).
verses.textEnNkjv: To whom alone the land was given, And no alien passed among them:
verses.textEnNlt: from those to whom the land was given long before any foreigners arrived.
verses.textEnNasb: To whom alone the land was given, And no stranger passed among them.
verses.textEn: (to whom alone the land was given when no foreigners moved among them):

verses.textZh: 恶人一生饱受痛苦， 一生的年数都为强暴留存。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人一生饱受痛苦， 一生的年数都为强暴留存。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人一生之日劬劳痛苦； 强暴人一生的年数也是如此。
verses.textEnNiv: All his days the wicked man suffers torment, the ruthless man through all the years stored up for him.
verses.textEnEsv: The wicked man writhes in pain all his days, through all the years that are laid up for the ruthless.
verses.textEnNkjv: The wicked man writhes with pain all his days, And the number of years is hidden from the oppressor.
verses.textEnNlt: "The wicked writhe in pain throughout their lives. Years of trouble are stored up for the ruthless.
verses.textEnNasb: "The wicked person writhes in pain all his days, And the years reserved for the ruthless are numbered.
verses.textEn: All his days the wicked man suffers torment, the ruthless man through all the years stored up for him.

verses.textZh: 恐怖之声常在他的耳中， 太平的时候，强盗就来袭击他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恐怖之声常在他的耳中， 太平的时候，强盗就来袭击他。
verses.textZhCuv: 惊吓的声音常在他耳中； 在平安时，抢夺的必临到他那里。
verses.textEnNiv: Terrifying sounds fill his ears; when all seems well, marauders attack him.
verses.textEnEsv: Dreadful sounds are in his ears; in prosperity the destroyer will come upon him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Dreadful sounds are in his ears; In prosperity the destroyer comes upon him.
verses.textEnNlt: The sound of terror rings in their ears, and even on good days they fear the attack of the destroyer.
verses.textEnNasb: " Sounds of terror are in his ears; While he is at peace the destroyer comes upon him.
verses.textEn: Terrifying sounds fill his ears; when all seems well, marauders attack him.

verses.textZh: 他不信他能从黑暗中转回， 自己留给刀剑杀害。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他不信他能从黑暗中转回， 自己留给刀剑杀害。
verses.textZhCuv: 他不信自己能从黑暗中转回； 他被刀剑等候。
verses.textEnNiv: He despairs of escaping the realm of darkness; he is marked for the sword.
verses.textEnEsv: He does not believe that he will return out of darkness, and he is marked for the sword.
verses.textEnNkjv: He does not believe that he will return from darkness, For a sword is waiting for him.
verses.textEnNlt: They dare not go out into the darkness for fear they will be murdered.
verses.textEnNasb: "He does not believe that he will return from darkness, And he is destined for the sword.
verses.textEn: He despairs of escaping the realm of darkness; he is marked for the sword.

verses.textZh: 他飘流觅食说：‘哪里有呢？’ 他知道黑暗的日子已经临近了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他飘流觅食说：‘哪里有呢？’ 他知道黑暗的日子已经临近了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他漂流在外求食，说：哪里有食物呢？ 他知道黑暗的日子在他手边预备好了。
verses.textEnNiv: He wanders about for food like a vulture; he knows the day of darkness is at hand.
verses.textEnEsv: He wanders abroad for bread, saying, ‘Where is it?’ He knows that a day of darkness is ready at his hand;
verses.textEnNkjv: He wanders about for bread, saying, ‘Where isit?’ He knows that a day of darkness is ready at his hand.
verses.textEnNlt: They wander around, saying, ‘Where can I find bread?’ They know their day of destruction is near.
verses.textEnNasb: "He wanders about for food, saying, ‘Where is it?’ He knows that a day of darkness is at hand.
verses.textEn: He wanders about for food like a vulture; he knows the day of darkness is at hand.

verses.textZh: 患难与困苦使他惊惶， 又胜过他，像君王预备上阵攻击一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 患难与困苦使他惊惶， 又胜过他，像君王预备上阵攻击一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 急难困苦叫他害怕， 而且胜了他，好像君王预备上阵一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Distress and anguish fill him with terror; troubles overwhelm him, like a king poised to attack,
verses.textEnEsv: distress and anguish terrify him; they prevail against him, like a king ready for battle.
verses.textEnNkjv: Trouble and anguish make him afraid; They overpower him, like a king ready for battle.
verses.textEnNlt: That dark day terrifies them. They live in distress and anguish, like a king preparing for battle.
verses.textEnNasb: "Distress and anguish terrify him, They overpower him like a king ready for the attack,
verses.textEn: Distress and anguish fill him with terror; troubles overwhelm him, like a king poised to attack,

verses.textZh: 因为他向神挥拳，向全能者逞强，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他向神挥拳，向全能者逞强，
verses.textZhCuv: 他伸手攻击神， 以骄傲攻击全能者，
verses.textEnNiv: because he shakes his fist at God and vaunts himself against the Almighty,
verses.textEnEsv: Because he has stretched out his hand against God and defies the Almighty,
verses.textEnNkjv: For he stretches out his hand against God, And acts defiantly against the Almighty,
verses.textEnNlt: For they shake their fists at God, defying the Almighty.
verses.textEnNasb: Because he has reached out with his hand against God, And is arrogant toward the Almighty.
verses.textEn: because he shakes his fist at God and vaunts himself against the Almighty,

verses.textZh: 用盾牌的厚凸面， 硬着颈项向他直闯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 用盾牌的厚凸面， 硬着颈项向他直闯。
verses.textZhCuv: 挺着颈项， 用盾牌的厚凸面向全能者直闯；
verses.textEnNiv: defiantly charging against him with a thick, strong shield.
verses.textEnEsv: running stubbornly against him with a thickly bossed shield;
verses.textEnNkjv: Running stubbornly against Him With his strong, embossed shield.
verses.textEnNlt: Holding their strong shields, they defiantly charge against him.
verses.textEnNasb: "He rushes headlong at Him With his massive shield.
verses.textEn: defiantly charging against him with a thick, strong shield.

verses.textZh: 因为他以自己的脂肪蒙脸， 腰上积满肥油。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他以自己的脂肪蒙脸， 腰上积满肥油。
verses.textZhCuv: 是因他的脸蒙上脂油， 腰积成肥肉。
verses.textEnNiv: "Though his face is covered with fat and his waist bulges with flesh,
verses.textEnEsv: because he has covered his face with his fat and gathered fat upon his waist
verses.textEnNkjv: "Though he has covered his face with his fatness, And made his waist heavy with fat,
verses.textEnNlt: "These wicked people are heavy and prosperous; their waists bulge with fat.
verses.textEnNasb: "For he has covered his face with his fat, And put fat on his waist.
verses.textEn: "Though his face is covered with fat and his waist bulges with flesh,

verses.textZh: 他住在被毁的城邑里， 住在没有人居住， 注定快要成为乱堆的房屋里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他住在被毁的城邑里， 住在没有人居住， 注定快要成为乱堆的房屋里。
verses.textZhCuv: 他曾住在荒凉城邑， 无人居住、将成乱堆的房屋。
verses.textEnNiv: he will inhabit ruined towns and houses where no one lives, houses crumbling to rubble.
verses.textEnEsv: and has lived in desolate cities, in houses that none should inhabit, which were ready to become heaps of ruins;
verses.textEnNkjv: He dwells in desolate cities, In houses which no one inhabits, Which are destined to become ruins.
verses.textEnNlt: But their cities will be ruined. They will live in abandoned houses that are ready to tumble down.
verses.textEnNasb: "He has lived in desolate cities, In houses no one would inhabit, Which are destined to become ruins.
verses.textEn: he will inhabit ruined towns and houses where no one lives, houses crumbling to rubble.

verses.textZh: 他不再富足，他的财富不能持久， 他的产业也不得在地上扩张，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他不再富足，他的财富不能持久， 他的产业也不得在地上扩张，
verses.textZhCuv: 他不得富足，财物不得常存， 产业在地上也不加增。
verses.textEnNiv: He will no longer be rich and his wealth will not endure, nor will his possessions spread over the land.
verses.textEnEsv: he will not be rich, and his wealth will not endure, nor will his possessions spread over the earth;
verses.textEnNkjv: He will not be rich, Nor will his wealth continue, Nor will his possessions overspread the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: Their riches will not last, and their wealth will not endure. Their possessions will no longer spread across the horizon.
verses.textEnNasb: "He will not become rich, nor will his wealth endure; And his property will not stretch out on the earth.
verses.textEn: He will no longer be rich and his wealth will not endure, nor will his possessions spread over the land.

verses.textZh: 他不能离开黑暗， 火焰必烧干他的嫩枝， 他必因神口中的气而离去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他不能离开黑暗， 火焰必烧干他的嫩枝， 他必因神口中的气而离去。
verses.textZhCuv: 他不得出离黑暗。 火焰要将他的枝子烧干； 因神口中的气，他要灭亡 。
verses.textEnNiv: He will not escape the darkness; a flame will wither his shoots, and the breath of God’s mouth will carry him away.
verses.textEnEsv: he will not depart from darkness; the flame will dry up his shoots, and by the breath of his mouth he will depart.
verses.textEnNkjv: He will not depart from darkness; The flame will dry out his branches, And by the breath of His mouth he will go away.
verses.textEnNlt: "They will not escape the darkness. The burning sun will wither their shoots, and the breath of God will destroy them.
verses.textEnNasb: "He will not escape from darkness; The flame will dry up his shoot, And he will go away by the breath of His mouth.
verses.textEn: He will not escape the darkness; a flame will wither his shoots, and the breath of God’s mouth will carry him away.

verses.textZh: 他不信靠虚假，自己欺骗自己， 因为虚假必成为他的报应。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他不信靠虚假，自己欺骗自己， 因为虚假必成为他的报应。
verses.textZhCuv: 他不用倚靠虚假欺哄自己， 因虚假必成为他的报应。
verses.textEnNiv: Let him not deceive himself by trusting what is worthless, for he will get nothing in return.
verses.textEnEsv: Let him not trust in emptiness, deceiving himself, for emptiness will be his payment.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let him not trust in futile things, deceiving himself, For futility will be his reward.
verses.textEnNlt: Let them no longer fool themselves by trusting in empty riches, for emptiness will be their only reward.
verses.textEnNasb: "Let him not trust in emptiness, deceiving himself; For his reward will be emptiness.
verses.textEn: Let him not deceive himself by trusting what is worthless, for he will get nothing in return.

verses.textZh: 他的日期未到以先，这事必成全， 他的枝子，也不青绿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的日期未到以先，这事必成全， 他的枝子，也不青绿。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的日期未到之先，这事必成就； 他的枝子不得青绿。
verses.textEnNiv: Before his time he will wither, and his branches will not flourish.
verses.textEnEsv: It will be paid in full before his time, and his branch will not be green.
verses.textEnNkjv: It will be accomplished before his time, And his branch will not be green.
verses.textEnNlt: They will be cut down in the prime of life; their branches will never again be green.
verses.textEnNasb: "It will be accomplished before his time, And his palm branch will not be green.
verses.textEn: Before his time he will wither, and his branches will not flourish.

verses.textZh: 他必像葡萄树未熟的葡萄掉落一样， 又如橄榄树的花朵一开就谢一般。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必像葡萄树未熟的葡萄掉落一样， 又如橄榄树的花朵一开就谢一般。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必像葡萄树的葡萄，未熟而落； 又像橄榄树的花，一开而谢。
verses.textEnNiv: He will be like a vine stripped of its unripe grapes, like an olive tree shedding its blossoms.
verses.textEnEsv: He will shake off his unripe grape like the vine, and cast off his blossom like the olive tree.
verses.textEnNkjv: He will shake off his unripe grape like a vine, And cast off his blossom like an olive tree.
verses.textEnNlt: They will be like a vine whose grapes are harvested too early, like an olive tree that loses its blossoms before the fruit can form.
verses.textEnNasb: "He will drop off his unripe grape like the vine, And will cast off his flower like the olive tree.
verses.textEn: He will be like a vine stripped of its unripe grapes, like an olive tree shedding its blossoms.

verses.textZh: 因为不敬虔的人必不能生育， 火必吞灭收受贿赂者的帐幕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为不敬虔的人必不能生育， 火必吞灭收受贿赂者的帐幕。
verses.textZhCuv: 原来不敬虔之辈必无生育； 受贿赂之人的帐棚必被火烧。
verses.textEnNiv: For the company of the godless will be barren, and fire will consume the tents of those who love bribes.
verses.textEnEsv: For the company of the godless is barren, and fire consumes the tents of bribery.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the company of hypocrites willbe barren, And fire will consume the tents of bribery.
verses.textEnNlt: For the godless are barren. Their homes, enriched through bribery, will burn.
verses.textEnNasb: "For the company of the godless is barren, And fire consumes the tents of the corrupt.
verses.textEn: For the company of the godless will be barren, and fire will consume the tents of those who love bribes.

verses.textZh: 他们所怀的是罪恶，所生的是罪孽， 他们腹中所预备的是诡诈。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们所怀的是罪恶，所生的是罪孽， 他们腹中所预备的是诡诈。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们所怀的是毒害，所生的是罪孽； 心里所预备的是诡诈。
verses.textEnNiv: They conceive trouble and give birth to evil; their womb fashions deceit."
verses.textEnEsv: They conceive trouble and give birth to evil, and their womb prepares deceit."
verses.textEnNkjv: They conceive trouble and bring forth futility; Their womb prepares deceit."
verses.textEnNlt: They conceive trouble and give birth to evil. Their womb produces deceit."
verses.textEnNasb: "They conceive harm and give birth to wrongdoing, And their mind prepares deception."
verses.textEn: They conceive trouble and give birth to evil; their womb fashions deceit."

verses.textZh: 约伯回答说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 约伯回答说：
verses.textZhCuv: 约伯回答说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then Job replied:
verses.textEnEsv: Then Job answered and said:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Job answered and said:
verses.textEnNlt: Then Job spoke again:
verses.textEnNasb: Then Job responded,
verses.textEn: Then Job replied:

verses.textZh: "像这样的话，我听了很多； 你们都是叫人愁烦的安慰者。
verses.textZhCnvs: "像这样的话，我听了很多； 你们都是叫人愁烦的安慰者。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样的话我听了许多； 你们安慰人，反叫人愁烦。
verses.textEnNiv: "I have heard many things like these; you are miserable comforters, all of you!
verses.textEnEsv: "I have heard many such things; miserable comforters are you all.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I have heard many such things; Miserable comforters are you all!
verses.textEnNlt: "I have heard all this before. What miserable comforters you are!
verses.textEnNasb: "I have heard many things like these; Miserable comforters are you all!
verses.textEn: "I have heard many things like these; you are miserable comforters, all of you!

verses.textZh: 虚空的言语，有穷尽吗？ 或有甚么惹你答个不休的呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 虚空的言语，有穷尽吗？ 或有甚么惹你答个不休的呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 虚空的言语有穷尽吗？ 有什么话惹动你回答呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Will your long-winded speeches never end? What ails you that you keep on arguing?
verses.textEnEsv: Shall windy words have an end? Or what provokes you that you answer?
verses.textEnNkjv: Shall words of wind have an end? Or what provokes you that you answer?
verses.textEnNlt: Won’t you ever stop blowing hot air? What makes you keep on talking?
verses.textEnNasb: "Is there no end to windy words? Or what provokes you that you answer?
verses.textEn: Will your long-winded speeches never end? What ails you that you keep on arguing?

verses.textZh: 你们若处在我的景况， 我也能像你们那样说话， 我也能砌辞攻击你们， 并且能向你们摇头。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们若处在我的景况， 我也能像你们那样说话， 我也能砌辞攻击你们， 并且能向你们摇头。
verses.textZhCuv: 我也能说你们那样的话； 你们若处在我的境遇， 我也会联络言语攻击你们， 又能向你们摇头。
verses.textEnNiv: I also could speak like you, if you were in my place; I could make fine speeches against you and shake my head at you.
verses.textEnEsv: I also could speak as you do, if you were in my place; I could join words together against you and shake my head at you.
verses.textEnNkjv: I also could speak as you do, If your soul were in my soul’s place. I could heap up words against you, And shake my head at you;
verses.textEnNlt: I could say the same things if you were in my place. I could spout off criticism and shake my head at you.
verses.textEnNasb: "I too could speak like you, If only I were in your place. I could compose words against you And shake my head at you.
verses.textEn: I also could speak like you, if you were in my place; I could make fine speeches against you and shake my head at you.

verses.textZh: 我能用口鼓励你们， 我嘴唇的安慰，能缓和你们的痛苦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我能用口鼓励你们， 我嘴唇的安慰，能缓和你们的痛苦。
verses.textZhCuv: 但我必用口坚固你们， 用嘴消解你们的忧愁。
verses.textEnNiv: But my mouth would encourage you; comfort from my lips would bring you relief.
verses.textEnEsv: I could strengthen you with my mouth, and the solace of my lips would assuage your pain.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I would strengthen you with my mouth, And the comfort of my lips would relieve yourgrief.
verses.textEnNlt: But if it were me, I would encourage you. I would try to take away your grief.
verses.textEnNasb: "Or I could strengthen you with my mouth, And the condolence of my lips could lessen your pain.
verses.textEn: But my mouth would encourage you; comfort from my lips would bring you relief.

verses.textZh: 我若说话，痛苦仍不消解， 我若闭口不说，痛苦也不离开我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我若说话，痛苦仍不消解， 我若闭口不说，痛苦也不离开我。
verses.textZhCuv: 我虽说话，忧愁仍不得消解； 我虽停住不说，忧愁就离开我吗？
verses.textEnNiv: "Yet if I speak, my pain is not relieved; and if I refrain, it does not go away.
verses.textEnEsv: "If I speak, my pain is not assuaged, and if I forbear, how much of it leaves me?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Though I speak, my grief is not relieved; And if I remain silent, how am I eased?
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, I suffer if I defend myself, and I suffer no less if I refuse to speak.
verses.textEnNasb: "If I speak, my pain is not lessened, And if I refrain, what pain leaves me?
verses.textEn: "Yet if I speak, my pain is not relieved; and if I refrain, it does not go away.

verses.textZh: 现在神使我困倦， ‘你蹂躏了我的全家，
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在神使我困倦， ‘你蹂躏了我的全家，
verses.textZhCuv: 但现在神使我困倦， 使亲友远离我，
verses.textEnNiv: Surely, God, you have worn me out; you have devastated my entire household.
verses.textEnEsv: Surely now God has worn me out; he has made desolate all my company.
verses.textEnNkjv: But now He has worn me out; You have made desolate all my company.
verses.textEnNlt: "O God, you have ground me down and devastated my family.
verses.textEnNasb: "But now He has exhausted me; You have laid waste all my group of loved ones.
verses.textEn: Surely, God, you have worn me out; you have devastated my entire household.

verses.textZh: 又把我捆绑起来。’这就作为证据； 我身体的枯瘦也当面作证反对我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又把我捆绑起来。’这就作为证据； 我身体的枯瘦也当面作证反对我。
verses.textZhCuv: 又抓住我，作见证攻击我； 我身体的枯瘦也当面见证我的不是。
verses.textEnNiv: You have shriveled me up—and it has become a witness; my gauntness rises up and testifies against me.
verses.textEnEsv: And he has shriveled me up, which is a witness against me, and my leanness has risen up against me; it testifies to my face.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have shriveled me up, And it is a witness againstme; My leanness rises up against me And bears witness to my face.
verses.textEnNlt: As if to prove I have sinned, you’ve reduced me to skin and bones. My gaunt flesh testifies against me.
verses.textEnNasb: "And You have shriveled me up, It has become a witness; And my infirmity rises up against me, It testifies to my face.
verses.textEn: You have shriveled me up—and it has become a witness; my gauntness rises up and testifies against me.

verses.textZh: 他的怒气撕裂我，攻击我； 他向我咬牙切齿， 我的敌人以锐利的眼光看着我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的怒气撕裂我，攻击我； 他向我咬牙切齿， 我的敌人以锐利的眼光看着我。
verses.textZhCuv: 主发怒撕裂我，逼迫我， 向我切齿； 我的敌人怒目看我。
verses.textEnNiv: God assails me and tears me in his anger and gnashes his teeth at me; my opponent fastens on me his piercing eyes.
verses.textEnEsv: He has torn me in his wrath and hated me; he has gnashed his teeth at me; my adversary sharpens his eyes against me.
verses.textEnNkjv: He tears me in His wrath, and hates me; He gnashes at me with His teeth; My adversary sharpens His gaze on me.
verses.textEnNlt: God hates me and angrily tears me apart. He snaps his teeth at me and pierces me with his eyes.
verses.textEnNasb: "His anger has torn me and hunted me down, He has gnashed at me with His teeth; My enemy glares at me.
verses.textEn: God assails me and tears me in his anger and gnashes his teeth at me; my opponent fastens on me his piercing eyes.

verses.textZh: 他们向我大大张嘴， 以蔑视的态度打我的脸颊， 联合一起攻击我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们向我大大张嘴， 以蔑视的态度打我的脸颊， 联合一起攻击我。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们向我开口， 打我的脸羞辱我， 聚会攻击我。
verses.textEnNiv: People open their mouths to jeer at me; they strike my cheek in scorn and unite together against me.
verses.textEnEsv: Men have gaped at me with their mouth; they have struck me insolently on the cheek; they mass themselves together against me.
verses.textEnNkjv: They gape at me with their mouth, They strike me reproachfully on the cheek, They gather together against me.
verses.textEnNlt: People jeer and laugh at me. They slap my cheek in contempt. A mob gathers against me.
verses.textEnNasb: "They have gaped at me with their mouths, They have slapped me on the cheek with contempt; They have massed themselves against me.
verses.textEn: People open their mouths to jeer at me; they strike my cheek in scorn and unite together against me.

verses.textZh: 神把我交给不义的人， 把我丢在恶人的手中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神把我交给不义的人， 把我丢在恶人的手中。
verses.textZhCuv: 神把我交给不敬虔的人， 把我扔到恶人的手中。
verses.textEnNiv: God has turned me over to the ungodly and thrown me into the clutches of the wicked.
verses.textEnEsv: God gives me up to the ungodly and casts me into the hands of the wicked.
verses.textEnNkjv: God has delivered me to the ungodly, And turned me over to the hands of the wicked.
verses.textEnNlt: God has handed me over to sinners. He has tossed me into the hands of the wicked.
verses.textEnNasb: "God hands me over to criminals, And tosses me into the hands of the wicked.
verses.textEn: God has turned me over to the ungodly and thrown me into the clutches of the wicked.

verses.textZh: 我本来安逸，他却把我压碎； 掐着我的颈项，把我摔碎； 又把我当作他的箭靶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我本来安逸，他却把我压碎； 掐着我的颈项，把我摔碎； 又把我当作他的箭靶。
verses.textZhCuv: 我素来安逸，他折断我， 掐住我的颈项，把我摔碎， 又立我为他的箭靶子。
verses.textEnNiv: All was well with me, but he shattered me; he seized me by the neck and crushed me. He has made me his target;
verses.textEnEsv: I was at ease, and he broke me apart; he seized me by the neck and dashed me to pieces; he set me up as his target;
verses.textEnNkjv: I was at ease, but He has shattered me; He also has taken me by my neck, and shaken me to pieces; He has set me up for His target,
verses.textEnNlt: "I was living quietly until he shattered me. He took me by the neck and broke me in pieces. Then he set me up as his target,
verses.textEnNasb: "I was at ease, but He shattered me, And He has grasped me by my neck and shaken me to pieces; He has also set me up as His target.
verses.textEn: All was well with me, but he shattered me; he seized me by the neck and crushed me. He has made me his target;

verses.textZh: 他的弓箭手四面包围我， 他剖开我的腰子，全不顾惜， 把我的胆倾倒在地上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的弓箭手四面包围我， 他剖开我的腰子，全不顾惜， 把我的胆倾倒在地上。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的弓箭手四面围绕我； 他破裂我的肺腑，并不留情， 把我的胆倾倒在地上，
verses.textEnNiv: his archers surround me. Without pity, he pierces my kidneys and spills my gall on the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: his archers surround me. He slashes open my kidneys and does not spare; he pours out my gall on the ground.
verses.textEnNkjv: His archers surround me. He pierces my heart and does not pity; He pours out my gall on the ground.
verses.textEnNlt: and now his archers surround me. His arrows pierce me without mercy. The ground is wet with my blood.
verses.textEnNasb: "His arrows surround me. He splits my kidneys open without mercy; He pours out my bile on the ground.
verses.textEn: his archers surround me. Without pity, he pierces my kidneys and spills my gall on the ground.

verses.textZh: 他把我破伤，在破口上又加破伤， 如勇士一般向我直冲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把我破伤，在破口上又加破伤， 如勇士一般向我直冲。
verses.textZhCuv: 将我破裂又破裂， 如同勇士向我直闯。
verses.textEnNiv: Again and again he bursts upon me; he rushes at me like a warrior.
verses.textEnEsv: He breaks me with breach upon breach; he runs upon me like a warrior.
verses.textEnNkjv: He breaks me with wound upon wound; He runs at me like a warrior.
verses.textEnNlt: Again and again he smashes against me, charging at me like a warrior.
verses.textEnNasb: "He breaks through me with breach after breach; He runs at me like a warrior.
verses.textEn: Again and again he bursts upon me; he rushes at me like a warrior.

verses.textZh: 我把麻布缝在我的皮肤上， 把我的角插入尘土中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我把麻布缝在我的皮肤上， 把我的角插入尘土中。
verses.textZhCuv: 我缝麻布在我皮肤上， 把我的角放在尘土中。
verses.textEnNiv: "I have sewed sackcloth over my skin and buried my brow in the dust.
verses.textEnEsv: I have sewed sackcloth upon my skin and have laid my strength in the dust.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I have sewn sackcloth over my skin, And laid my head in the dust.
verses.textEnNlt: I wear burlap to show my grief. My pride lies in the dust.
verses.textEnNasb: "I have sewed sackcloth over my skin, And thrust my horn in the dust.
verses.textEn: "I have sewed sackcloth over my skin and buried my brow in the dust.

verses.textZh: 我的脸因哭泣而发红， 在我的眼皮上满是黑影。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的脸因哭泣而发红， 在我的眼皮上满是黑影。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的脸因哭泣发紫， 在我的眼皮上有死荫。
verses.textEnNiv: My face is red with weeping, dark shadows ring my eyes;
verses.textEnEsv: My face is red with weeping, and on my eyelids is deep darkness,
verses.textEnNkjv: My face is flushed from weeping, And on my eyelids is the shadow of death;
verses.textEnNlt: My eyes are red with weeping; dark shadows circle my eyes.
verses.textEnNasb: "My face is flushed from weeping, And deep darkness is on my eyelids,
verses.textEn: My face is red with weeping, dark shadows ring my eyes;

verses.textZh: 然而在我的手中没有强暴， 我的祷告也是清洁的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而在我的手中没有强暴， 我的祷告也是清洁的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的手中却无强暴； 我的祈祷也是清洁。
verses.textEnNiv: yet my hands have been free of violence and my prayer is pure.
verses.textEnEsv: although there is no violence in my hands, and my prayer is pure.
verses.textEnNkjv: Although no violence is in my hands, And my prayer is pure.
verses.textEnNlt: Yet I have done no wrong, and my prayer is pure.
verses.textEnNasb: Although there is no violence in my hands, And my prayer is pure.
verses.textEn: yet my hands have been free of violence and my prayer is pure.

verses.textZh: 地啊，不要遮盖我的血； 不要让我的哀求有停留的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 地啊，不要遮盖我的血； 不要让我的哀求有停留的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 地啊，不要遮盖我的血！ 不要阻挡我的哀求！
verses.textEnNiv: "Earth, do not cover my blood; may my cry never be laid to rest!
verses.textEnEsv: "O earth, cover not my blood, and let my cry find no resting place.
verses.textEnNkjv: "O earth, do not cover my blood, And let my cry have no resting place!
verses.textEnNlt: "O earth, do not conceal my blood. Let it cry out on my behalf.
verses.textEnNasb: "Earth, do not cover my blood, And may there be no resting place for my cry.
verses.textEn: "Earth, do not cover my blood; may my cry never be laid to rest!

verses.textZh: 现今，在天上有我的见证， 在高天之上，有我的证人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现今，在天上有我的见证， 在高天之上，有我的证人。
verses.textZhCuv: 现今，在天有我的见证， 在上有我的中保。
verses.textEnNiv: Even now my witness is in heaven; my advocate is on high.
verses.textEnEsv: Even now, behold, my witness is in heaven, and he who testifies for me is on high.
verses.textEnNkjv: Surely even now my witness is in heaven, And my evidence is on high.
verses.textEnNlt: Even now my witness is in heaven. My advocate is there on high.
verses.textEnNasb: "Even now, behold, my witness is in heaven, And my advocate is on high.
verses.textEn: Even now my witness is in heaven; my advocate is on high.

verses.textZh: 讥笑我的，就是我的朋友， 我的眼向神流泪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 讥笑我的，就是我的朋友， 我的眼向神流泪。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的朋友讥诮我， 我却向神眼泪汪汪。
verses.textEnNiv: My intercessor is my friend as my eyes pour out tears to God;
verses.textEnEsv: My friends scorn me; my eye pours out tears to God,
verses.textEnNkjv: My friends scorn me; My eyes pour out tears to God.
verses.textEnNlt: My friends scorn me, but I pour out my tears to God.
verses.textEnNasb: "My friends are my scoffers; My eye weeps to God,
verses.textEn: My intercessor is my friend as my eyes pour out tears to God;

verses.textZh: 但愿人可以为人与神分辩， 正如世人为朋友辩白一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但愿人可以为人与神分辩， 正如世人为朋友辩白一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿人得与神辩白， 如同人与朋友辩白一样；
verses.textEnNiv: on behalf of a man he pleads with God as one pleads for a friend.
verses.textEnEsv: that he would argue the case of a man with God, as a son of man does with his neighbor.
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, that one might plead for a man with God, As a man pleads for his neighbor!
verses.textEnNlt: I need someone to mediate between God and me, as a person mediates between friends.
verses.textEnNasb: That one might plead for a man with God As a son of man with his neighbor!
verses.textEn: on behalf of a man he pleads with God as one pleads for a friend.

verses.textZh: 因为我的年数将尽， 我快要走上那条一去不返的路。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我的年数将尽， 我快要走上那条一去不返的路。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为再过几年， 我必走那往而不返之路。
verses.textEnNiv: "Only a few years will pass before I take the path of no return.
verses.textEnEsv: For when a few years have come I shall go the way from which I shall not return.
verses.textEnNkjv: For when a few years are finished, I shall go the way of no return.
verses.textEnNlt: For soon I must go down that road from which I will never return.
verses.textEnNasb: "For when a few years are past, I shall go the way of no return.
verses.textEn: "Only a few years will pass before I take the path of no return.

verses.textZh: "我的气息将断， 我的日子快尽， 坟墓已为我预备好了。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我的气息将断， 我的日子快尽， 坟墓已为我预备好了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的心灵消耗，我的日子灭尽； 坟墓为我预备好了。
verses.textEnNiv: My spirit is broken, my days are cut short, the grave awaits me.
verses.textEnEsv: "My spirit is broken; my days are extinct; the graveyard is ready for me.
verses.textEnNkjv: "My spirit is broken, My days are extinguished, The grave isready for me.
verses.textEnNlt: "My spirit is crushed, and my life is nearly snuffed out. The grave is ready to receive me.
verses.textEnNasb: "My spirit is broken, my days are extinguished, The grave is ready for me.
verses.textEn: My spirit is broken, my days are cut short, the grave awaits me.

verses.textZh: 真有嘲笑人的在我这里， 我的眼看着他们的悖逆。
verses.textZhCnvs: 真有嘲笑人的在我这里， 我的眼看着他们的悖逆。
verses.textZhCuv: 真有戏笑我的在我这里， 我眼常见他们惹动我。
verses.textEnNiv: Surely mockers surround me; my eyes must dwell on their hostility.
verses.textEnEsv: Surely there are mockers about me, and my eye dwells on their provocation.
verses.textEnNkjv: Are not mockers with me? And does not my eye dwell on their provocation?
verses.textEnNlt: I am surrounded by mockers. I watch how bitterly they taunt me.
verses.textEnNasb: "Mockers are certainly with me, And my eye gazes on their provocation.
verses.textEn: Surely mockers surround me; my eyes must dwell on their hostility.

verses.textZh: 愿你给我保证，亲自为我作保； 除你以外有谁肯与我击掌作保呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿你给我保证，亲自为我作保； 除你以外有谁肯与我击掌作保呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 愿主拿凭据给我，自己为我作保。 在你以外谁肯与我击掌呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "Give me, O God, the pledge you demand. Who else will put up security for me?
verses.textEnEsv: "Lay down a pledge for me with you; who is there who will put up security for me?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now put down a pledge for me with Yourself. Who is he who will shake hands with me?
verses.textEnNlt: "You must defend my innocence, O God, since no one else will stand up for me.
verses.textEnNasb: "Make a pledge for me with Yourself; Who is there that will be my guarantor?
verses.textEn: "Give me, O God, the pledge you demand. Who else will put up security for me?

verses.textZh: 你蒙蔽了他们的心，不让他们明白； 因此你必不高举他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你蒙蔽了他们的心，不让他们明白； 因此你必不高举他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 因你使他们心不明理， 所以你必不高举他们。
verses.textEnNiv: You have closed their minds to understanding; therefore you will not let them triumph.
verses.textEnEsv: Since you have closed their hearts to understanding, therefore you will not let them triumph.
verses.textEnNkjv: For You have hidden their heart from understanding; Therefore You will not exalt them.
verses.textEnNlt: You have closed their minds to understanding, but do not let them triumph.
verses.textEnNasb: "For You have kept their hearts away from understanding; Therefore You will not exalt them.
verses.textEn: You have closed their minds to understanding; therefore you will not let them triumph.

verses.textZh: 为分产业而控告朋友的， 他子孙的眼睛也要昏花。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为分产业而控告朋友的， 他子孙的眼睛也要昏花。
verses.textZhCuv: 控告他的朋友、以朋友为可抢夺的， 连他儿女的眼睛也要失明。
verses.textEnNiv: If anyone denounces their friends for reward, the eyes of their children will fail.
verses.textEnEsv: He who informs against his friends to get a share of their property— the eyes of his children will fail.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who speaks flattery to his friends, Even the eyes of his children will fail.
verses.textEnNlt: They betray their friends for their own advantage, so let their children faint with hunger.
verses.textEnNasb: "He who informs against friends for a share of the spoils, The eyes of his children also will perish.
verses.textEn: If anyone denounces their friends for reward, the eyes of their children will fail.

verses.textZh: 他使我成为民众的笑柄， 人人都吐唾沫在我的脸上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他使我成为民众的笑柄， 人人都吐唾沫在我的脸上。
verses.textZhCuv: 神使我作了民中的笑谈； 他们也吐唾沫在我脸上。
verses.textEnNiv: "God has made me a byword to everyone, a man in whose face people spit.
verses.textEnEsv: "He has made me a byword of the peoples, and I am one before whom men spit.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But He has made me a byword of the people, And I have become one in whose face men spit.
verses.textEnNlt: "God has made a mockery of me among the people; they spit in my face.
verses.textEnNasb: "But He has made me a proverb among the people, And I am one at whom people spit.
verses.textEn: "God has made me a byword to everyone, a man in whose face people spit.

verses.textZh: 我的眼睛因忧愁而昏花， 我的身体瘦骨如柴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的眼睛因忧愁而昏花， 我的身体瘦骨如柴。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的眼睛因忧愁昏花； 我的百体好像影儿。
verses.textEnNiv: My eyes have grown dim with grief; my whole frame is but a shadow.
verses.textEnEsv: My eye has grown dim from vexation, and all my members are like a shadow.
verses.textEnNkjv: My eye has also grown dim because of sorrow, And all my members are like shadows.
verses.textEnNlt: My eyes are swollen with weeping, and I am but a shadow of my former self.
verses.textEnNasb: "My eye has also become inexpressive because of grief, And all my body parts are like a shadow.
verses.textEn: My eyes have grown dim with grief; my whole frame is but a shadow.

verses.textZh: 正直人必因此惊讶， 要被激发起来， 攻击不敬虔的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 正直人必因此惊讶， 要被激发起来， 攻击不敬虔的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 正直人因此必惊奇； 无辜的人要兴起攻击不敬虔之辈。
verses.textEnNiv: The upright are appalled at this; the innocent are aroused against the ungodly.
verses.textEnEsv: The upright are appalled at this, and the innocent stirs himself up against the godless.
verses.textEnNkjv: Upright men are astonished at this, And the innocent stirs himself up against the hypocrite.
verses.textEnNlt: The virtuous are horrified when they see me. The innocent rise up against the ungodly.
verses.textEnNasb: "The upright will be appalled at this, And the innocent will stir himself up against the godless.
verses.textEn: The upright are appalled at this; the innocent are aroused against the ungodly.

verses.textZh: 义人必坚守自己的道路， 手洁的人要力上加力。
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人必坚守自己的道路， 手洁的人要力上加力。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，义人要持守所行的道； 手洁的人要力上加力。
verses.textEnNiv: Nevertheless, the righteous will hold to their ways, and those with clean hands will grow stronger.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet the righteous holds to his way, and he who has clean hands grows stronger and stronger.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet the righteous will hold to his way, And he who has clean hands will be stronger and stronger.
verses.textEnNlt: The righteous keep moving forward, and those with clean hands become stronger and stronger.
verses.textEnNasb: "Nevertheless the righteous will hold to his way, And the one who has clean hands will grow stronger and stronger.
verses.textEn: Nevertheless, the righteous will hold to their ways, and those with clean hands will grow stronger.

verses.textZh: 然而你们众人，可以再来， 在你们中间我找不到一个有智慧的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而你们众人，可以再来， 在你们中间我找不到一个有智慧的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于你们众人，可以再来辩论吧！ 你们中间，我找不着一个智慧人。
verses.textEnNiv: "But come on, all of you, try again! I will not find a wise man among you.
verses.textEnEsv: But you, come on again, all of you, and I shall not find a wise man among you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But please, come back again, all of you, For I shall not find one wise man among you.
verses.textEnNlt: "As for all of you, come back with a better argument, though I still won’t find a wise man among you.
verses.textEnNasb: "But come again all of you now, For I do not find a wise man among you.
verses.textEn: "But come on, all of you, try again! I will not find a wise man among you.

verses.textZh: 我的日子已过， 我的谋算和我心中所想的都已粉碎。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的日子已过， 我的谋算和我心中所想的都已粉碎。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的日子已经过了； 我的谋算、我心所想望的已经断绝。
verses.textEnNiv: My days have passed, my plans are shattered. Yet the desires of my heart
verses.textEnEsv: My days are past; my plans are broken off, the desires of my heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: My days are past, My purposes are broken off, Even the thoughts of my heart.
verses.textEnNlt: My days are over. My hopes have disappeared. My heart’s desires are broken.
verses.textEnNasb: "My days are past, my plans are torn apart, The wishes of my heart.
verses.textEn: My days have passed, my plans are shattered. Yet the desires of my heart

verses.textZh: 他们把黑夜变为白昼， 因为黑暗的缘故，他们就说：‘光明临近了。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把黑夜变为白昼， 因为黑暗的缘故，他们就说：‘光明临近了。’
verses.textZhCuv: 他们以黑夜为白昼， 说：亮光近乎黑暗。
verses.textEnNiv: turn night into day; in the face of the darkness light is near.
verses.textEnEsv: They make night into day: ‘The light,’ they say, ‘is near to the darkness.’
verses.textEnNkjv: They change the night into day; ‘The light is near,’ theysay, in the face of darkness.
verses.textEnNlt: These men say that night is day; they claim that the darkness is light.
verses.textEnNasb: "They make night into day, saying, ‘The light is near,’ in the presence of darkness.
verses.textEn: turn night into day; in the face of the darkness light is near.

verses.textZh: 我若等待阴间作我的家， 在黑暗中铺张我的床榻；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我若等待阴间作我的家， 在黑暗中铺张我的床榻；
verses.textZhCuv: 我若盼望阴间为我的房屋， 若下榻在黑暗中，
verses.textEnNiv: If the only home I hope for is the grave, if I spread out my bed in the realm of darkness,
verses.textEnEsv: If I hope for Sheol as my house, if I make my bed in darkness,
verses.textEnNkjv: If I wait for the grave as my house, If I make my bed in the darkness,
verses.textEnNlt: What if I go to the grave and make my bed in darkness?
verses.textEnNasb: "If I hope for Sheol as my home, I make my bed in the darkness;
verses.textEn: If the only home I hope for is the grave, if I spread out my bed in the realm of darkness,

verses.textZh: 我若对深坑说：‘你是我的父亲’， 对虫说：‘你是我的母亲，我的姊妹’，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我若对深坑说：‘你是我的父亲’， 对虫说：‘你是我的母亲，我的姊妹’，
verses.textZhCuv: 若对朽坏说：你是我的父； 对虫说：你是我的母亲姊妹；
verses.textEnNiv: if I say to corruption, ‘You are my father,’ and to the worm, ‘My mother’ or ‘My sister,’
verses.textEnEsv: if I say to the pit, ‘You are my father,’ and to the worm, ‘My mother,’ or ‘My sister,’
verses.textEnNkjv: If I say to corruption, ‘You are my father,’ And to the worm, ‘You are my mother and my sister,’
verses.textEnNlt: What if I call the grave my father, and the maggot my mother or my sister?
verses.textEnNasb: If I call to the grave, ‘You are my father’; To the maggot, ‘my mother and my sister’;
verses.textEn: if I say to corruption, ‘You are my father,’ and to the worm, ‘My mother’ or ‘My sister,’

verses.textZh: 那么，我的指望在哪里呢？ 我的指望谁能看得见呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 那么，我的指望在哪里呢？ 我的指望谁能看得见呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，我的指望在哪里呢？ 我所指望的谁能看见呢？
verses.textEnNiv: where then is my hope— who can see any hope for me?
verses.textEnEsv: where then is my hope? Who will see my hope?
verses.textEnNkjv: Where then is my hope? As for my hope, who can see it?
verses.textEnNlt: Where then is my hope? Can anyone find it?
verses.textEnNasb: Where then is my hope? And who looks at my hope?
verses.textEn: where then is my hope— who can see any hope for me?

verses.textZh: 等到安息在尘土中的时候， 那些指望必下到阴间的门闩那里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 等到安息在尘土中的时候， 那些指望必下到阴间的门闩那里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 等到安息在尘土中， 这指望必下到阴间的门闩那里了。
verses.textEnNiv: Will it go down to the gates of death? Will we descend together into the dust?"
verses.textEnEsv: Will it go down to the bars of Sheol? Shall we descend together into the dust?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Will they go down to the gates of Sheol? Shall wehave rest together in the dust?"
verses.textEnNlt: No, my hope will go down with me to the grave. We will rest together in the dust!"
verses.textEnNasb: " Will it go down with me to Sheol? Shall we together go down into the dust?"
verses.textEn: Will it go down to the gates of death? Will we descend together into the dust?"

verses.textZh: 书亚人比勒达回答说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 书亚人比勒达回答说：
verses.textZhCuv: 书亚人比勒达回答说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then Bildad the Shuhite replied:
verses.textEnEsv: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered and said:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered and said:
verses.textEnNlt: Then Bildad the Shuhite replied:
verses.textEnNasb: Then Bildad the Shuhite responded,
verses.textEn: Then Bildad the Shuhite replied:

verses.textZh: "你寻索言语要到几时呢？ 先想清楚，然后我们再说吧。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你寻索言语要到几时呢？ 先想清楚，然后我们再说吧。
verses.textZhCuv: 你寻索言语要到几时呢？ 你可以揣摩思想，然后我们就说话。
verses.textEnNiv: "When will you end these speeches? Be sensible, and then we can talk.
verses.textEnEsv: "How long will you hunt for words? Consider, and then we will speak.
verses.textEnNkjv: "How long till you put an end to words? Gain understanding, and afterward we will speak.
verses.textEnNlt: "How long before you stop talking? Speak sense if you want us to answer!
verses.textEnNasb: "How long will you hunt for words? Show understanding, and then we can talk.
verses.textEn: "When will you end these speeches? Be sensible, and then we can talk.

verses.textZh: 我们为甚么算为牲畜？ 为甚么在你的眼中看为污秽呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们为甚么算为牲畜？ 为甚么在你的眼中看为污秽呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 我们为何算为畜生， 在你眼中看作污秽呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Why are we regarded as cattle and considered stupid in your sight?
verses.textEnEsv: Why are we counted as cattle? Why are we stupid in your sight?
verses.textEnNkjv: Why are we counted as beasts, And regarded as stupid in your sight?
verses.textEnNlt: Do you think we are mere animals? Do you think we are stupid?
verses.textEnNasb: "Why are we regarded as animals, As stupid in your eyes?
verses.textEn: Why are we regarded as cattle and considered stupid in your sight?

verses.textZh: 你这因怒气而撕裂自己的， 难道大地要为你的缘故被丢弃， 盘石要挪移离开原处吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你这因怒气而撕裂自己的， 难道大地要为你的缘故被丢弃， 盘石要挪移离开原处吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你这恼怒将自己撕裂的， 难道大地为你见弃、 磐石挪开原处吗？
verses.textEnNiv: You who tear yourself to pieces in your anger, is the earth to be abandoned for your sake? Or must the rocks be moved from their place?
verses.textEnEsv: You who tear yourself in your anger, shall the earth be forsaken for you, or the rock be removed out of its place?
verses.textEnNkjv: You who tear yourself in anger, Shall the earth be forsaken for you? Or shall the rock be removed from its place?
verses.textEnNlt: You may tear out your hair in anger, but will that destroy the earth? Will it make the rocks tremble?
verses.textEnNasb: " You who tear yourself in your anger— Should the earth be abandoned for your sake, Or the rock moved from its place?
verses.textEn: You who tear yourself to pieces in your anger, is the earth to be abandoned for your sake? Or must the rocks be moved from their place?

verses.textZh: 恶人的灯必要熄灭， 他的火焰必不照耀；
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人的灯必要熄灭， 他的火焰必不照耀；
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人的亮光必要熄灭； 他的火焰必不照耀。
verses.textEnNiv: "The lamp of a wicked man is snuffed out; the flame of his fire stops burning.
verses.textEnEsv: "Indeed, the light of the wicked is put out, and the flame of his fire does not shine.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The light of the wicked indeed goes out, And the flame of his fire does not shine.
verses.textEnNlt: "Surely the light of the wicked will be snuffed out. The sparks of their fire will not glow.
verses.textEnNasb: "Indeed, the light of the wicked goes out, And the spark from his fire does not shine.
verses.textEn: "The lamp of a wicked man is snuffed out; the flame of his fire stops burning.

verses.textZh: 他帐棚中的光要变为黑暗， 上面的灯也必熄灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他帐棚中的光要变为黑暗， 上面的灯也必熄灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 他帐棚中的亮光要变为黑暗； 他以上的灯也必熄灭。
verses.textEnNiv: The light in his tent becomes dark; the lamp beside him goes out.
verses.textEnEsv: The light is dark in his tent, and his lamp above him is put out.
verses.textEnNkjv: The light is dark in his tent, And his lamp beside him is put out.
verses.textEnNlt: The light in their tent will grow dark. The lamp hanging above them will be quenched.
verses.textEnNasb: "The light in his tent is darkened, And his lamp goes out above him.
verses.textEn: The light in his tent becomes dark; the lamp beside him goes out.

verses.textZh: 他的脚步必然狭窄， 自己的计谋必把他绊倒；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的脚步必然狭窄， 自己的计谋必把他绊倒；
verses.textZhCuv: 他坚强的脚步必见狭窄； 自己的计谋必将他绊倒。
verses.textEnNiv: The vigor of his step is weakened; his own schemes throw him down.
verses.textEnEsv: His strong steps are shortened, and his own schemes throw him down.
verses.textEnNkjv: The steps of his strength are shortened, And his own counsel casts him down.
verses.textEnNlt: The confident stride of the wicked will be shortened. Their own schemes will be their downfall.
verses.textEnNasb: "His vigorous stride is shortened, And his own plan brings him down.
verses.textEn: The vigor of his step is weakened; his own schemes throw him down.

verses.textZh: 他的脚送自己进入网罗， 他走在陷阱之上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的脚送自己进入网罗， 他走在陷阱之上。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他被自己的脚陷入网中， 走在缠人的网罗上。
verses.textEnNiv: His feet thrust him into a net; he wanders into its mesh.
verses.textEnEsv: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he walks on its mesh.
verses.textEnNkjv: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, And he walks into a snare.
verses.textEnNlt: The wicked walk into a net. They fall into a pit.
verses.textEnNasb: "For he is thrown into the net by his own feet, And he steps on the webbing.
verses.textEn: His feet thrust him into a net; he wanders into its mesh.

verses.textZh: 圈套要缠住他的脚跟， 网罗要罩在他身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 圈套要缠住他的脚跟， 网罗要罩在他身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 圈套必抓住他的脚跟； 机关必擒获他。
verses.textEnNiv: A trap seizes him by the heel; a snare holds him fast.
verses.textEnEsv: A trap seizes him by the heel; a snare lays hold of him.
verses.textEnNkjv: The net takes him by the heel, And a snare lays hold of him.
verses.textEnNlt: A trap grabs them by the heel. A snare holds them tight.
verses.textEnNasb: "A snare seizes him by the heel, And a trap snaps shut on him.
verses.textEn: A trap seizes him by the heel; a snare holds him fast.

verses.textZh: 活扣为他藏在地里， 羁绊为他埋在路上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 活扣为他藏在地里， 羁绊为他埋在路上。
verses.textZhCuv: 活扣为他藏在土内； 羁绊为他藏在路上。
verses.textEnNiv: A noose is hidden for him on the ground; a trap lies in his path.
verses.textEnEsv: A rope is hidden for him in the ground, a trap for him in the path.
verses.textEnNkjv: A noose is hidden for him on the ground, And a trap for him in the road.
verses.textEnNlt: A noose lies hidden on the ground. A rope is stretched across their path.
verses.textEnNasb: "A noose for him is hidden in the ground, And a trap for him on the pathway.
verses.textEn: A noose is hidden for him on the ground; a trap lies in his path.

verses.textZh: 惊骇四面恐吓他， 并且追赶他的脚踪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 惊骇四面恐吓他， 并且追赶他的脚踪。
verses.textZhCuv: 四面的惊吓要使他害怕， 并且追赶他的脚跟。
verses.textEnNiv: Terrors startle him on every side and dog his every step.
verses.textEnEsv: Terrors frighten him on every side, and chase him at his heels.
verses.textEnNkjv: Terrors frighten him on every side, And drive him to his feet.
verses.textEnNlt: "Terrors surround the wicked and trouble them at every step.
verses.textEnNasb: "All around sudden terrors frighten him, And harass him at every step.
verses.textEn: Terrors startle him on every side and dog his every step.

verses.textZh: 他的气力因饥饿衰败， 祸患预备使他跌倒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的气力因饥饿衰败， 祸患预备使他跌倒。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的力量必因饥饿衰败； 祸患要在他旁边等候。
verses.textEnNiv: Calamity is hungry for him; disaster is ready for him when he falls.
verses.textEnEsv: His strength is famished, and calamity is ready for his stumbling.
verses.textEnNkjv: His strength is starved, And destruction is ready at his side.
verses.textEnNlt: Hunger depletes their strength, and calamity waits for them to stumble.
verses.textEnNasb: "His strength is famished, And disaster is ready at his side.
verses.textEn: Calamity is hungry for him; disaster is ready for him when he falls.

verses.textZh: 灾祸侵蚀了他大部分的皮肤， 死亡的长子吃掉了他的肢体。
verses.textZhCnvs: 灾祸侵蚀了他大部分的皮肤， 死亡的长子吃掉了他的肢体。
verses.textZhCuv: 他本身的肢体要被吞吃； 死亡的长子要吞吃他的肢体。
verses.textEnNiv: It eats away parts of his skin; death’s firstborn devours his limbs.
verses.textEnEsv: It consumes the parts of his skin; the firstborn of death consumes his limbs.
verses.textEnNkjv: It devours patches of his skin; The firstborn of death devours his limbs.
verses.textEnNlt: Disease eats their skin; death devours their limbs.
verses.textEnNasb: " It devours parts of his skin, The firstborn of death devours his limbs.
verses.textEn: It eats away parts of his skin; death’s firstborn devours his limbs.

verses.textZh: 他要从他倚靠的帐棚中被拔出来， 被带到惊骇的王那里，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要从他倚靠的帐棚中被拔出来， 被带到惊骇的王那里，
verses.textZhCuv: 他要从所倚靠的帐棚被拔出来， 带到惊吓的王那里。
verses.textEnNiv: He is torn from the security of his tent and marched off to the king of terrors.
verses.textEnEsv: He is torn from the tent in which he trusted and is brought to the king of terrors.
verses.textEnNkjv: He is uprooted from the shelter of his tent, And they parade him before the king of terrors.
verses.textEnNlt: They are torn from the security of their homes and are brought down to the king of terrors.
verses.textEnNasb: "He is torn from the security of his tent, And they march him before the king of terrors.
verses.textEn: He is torn from the security of his tent and marched off to the king of terrors.

verses.textZh: 不属他的住在他的帐棚里， 硫磺撒在他的居所之上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不属他的住在他的帐棚里， 硫磺撒在他的居所之上。
verses.textZhCuv: 不属他的必住在他的帐棚里； 硫磺必撒在他所住之处。
verses.textEnNiv: Fire resides in his tent; burning sulfur is scattered over his dwelling.
verses.textEnEsv: In his tent dwells that which is none of his; sulfur is scattered over his habitation.
verses.textEnNkjv: They dwell in his tent whoare none of his; Brimstone is scattered on his dwelling.
verses.textEnNlt: The homes of the wicked will burn down; burning sulfur rains on their houses.
verses.textEnNasb: " Nothing of his dwells in his tent; Brimstone is scattered on his home.
verses.textEn: Fire resides in his tent; burning sulfur is scattered over his dwelling.

verses.textZh: 他下面的根枯干， 上面的枝子凋谢。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他下面的根枯干， 上面的枝子凋谢。
verses.textZhCuv: 下边，他的根本要枯干； 上边，他的枝子要剪除。
verses.textEnNiv: His roots dry up below and his branches wither above.
verses.textEnEsv: His roots dry up beneath, and his branches wither above.
verses.textEnNkjv: His roots are dried out below, And his branch withers above.
verses.textEnNlt: Their roots will dry up, and their branches will wither.
verses.textEnNasb: "His roots are dried below, And his branch withers above.
verses.textEn: His roots dry up below and his branches wither above.

verses.textZh: 他令人怀念的都从地上灭没， 他的名字不再留存在田上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他令人怀念的都从地上灭没， 他的名字不再留存在田上。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的记念在地上必然灭亡； 他的名字在街上也不存留。
verses.textEnNiv: The memory of him perishes from the earth; he has no name in the land.
verses.textEnEsv: His memory perishes from the earth, and he has no name in the street.
verses.textEnNkjv: The memory of him perishes from the earth, And he has no name among the renowned.
verses.textEnNlt: All memory of their existence will fade from the earth; no one will remember their names.
verses.textEnNasb: "The memory of him perishes from the earth, And he has no name abroad.
verses.textEn: The memory of him perishes from the earth; he has no name in the land.

verses.textZh: 他们把他从光明中赶到黑暗里， 又把他从世界中赶出去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把他从光明中赶到黑暗里， 又把他从世界中赶出去。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必从光明中被撵到黑暗里， 必被赶出世界。
verses.textEnNiv: He is driven from light into the realm of darkness and is banished from the world.
verses.textEnEsv: He is thrust from light into darkness, and driven out of the world.
verses.textEnNkjv: He is driven from light into darkness, And chased out of the world.
