verses.textEnNlt: They will be thrust from light into darkness, driven from the world.
verses.textEnNasb: " He is driven from light into darkness, And chased from the inhabited world.
verses.textEn: He is driven from light into the realm of darkness and is banished from the world.

verses.textZh: 在本族中他无子无孙， 在他寄居之地，也没有生存的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在本族中他无子无孙， 在他寄居之地，也没有生存的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 在本民中必无子无孙； 在寄居之地也无一人存留。
verses.textEnNiv: He has no offspring or descendants among his people, no survivor where once he lived.
verses.textEnEsv: He has no posterity or progeny among his people, and no survivor where he used to live.
verses.textEnNkjv: He has neither son nor posterity among his people, Nor any remaining in his dwellings.
verses.textEnNlt: They will have neither children nor grandchildren, nor any survivor in the place where they lived.
verses.textEnNasb: "He has no offspring or descendants among his people, Nor any survivor where he resided.
verses.textEn: He has no offspring or descendants among his people, no survivor where once he lived.

verses.textZh: 西方的人因他的日子惊讶， 东方的人也战栗不已。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西方的人因他的日子惊讶， 东方的人也战栗不已。
verses.textZhCuv: 以后来的要惊奇他的日子， 好像以前去的受了惊骇。
verses.textEnNiv: People of the west are appalled at his fate; those of the east are seized with horror.
verses.textEnEsv: They of the west are appalled at his day, and horror seizes them of the east.
verses.textEnNkjv: Those in the west are astonished at his day, As those in the east are frightened.
verses.textEnNlt: People in the west are appalled at their fate; people in the east are horrified.
verses.textEnNasb: "Those in the west are appalled at his fate, And those in the east are seized with horror.
verses.textEn: People of the west are appalled at his fate; those of the east are seized with horror.

verses.textZh: 不义的人之住所实在是这样， 这就是不认识神的人的收场。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 不义的人之住所实在是这样， 这就是不认识神的人的收场。"
verses.textZhCuv: 不义之人的住处总是这样； 此乃不认识神之人的地步。
verses.textEnNiv: Surely such is the dwelling of an evil man; such is the place of one who does not know God."
verses.textEnEsv: Surely such are the dwellings of the unrighteous, such is the place of him who knows not God."
verses.textEnNkjv: Surely such are the dwellings of the wicked, And this is the place ofhimwho does not know God."
verses.textEnNlt: They will say, ‘This was the home of a wicked person, the place of one who rejected God.’"
verses.textEnNasb: "Certainly these are the dwellings of the wicked, And this is the place of him who does not know God."
verses.textEn: Surely such is the dwelling of an evil man; such is the place of one who does not know God."

verses.textZh: 约伯回答说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 约伯回答说：
verses.textZhCuv: 约伯回答说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then Job replied:
verses.textEnEsv: Then Job answered and said:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Job answered and said:
verses.textEnNlt: Then Job spoke again:
verses.textEnNasb: Then Job responded,
verses.textEn: Then Job replied:

verses.textZh: "你们叫我受苦要到几时呢？ 用话压碎我要到几时呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们叫我受苦要到几时呢？ 用话压碎我要到几时呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们搅扰我的心， 用言语压碎我要到几时呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "How long will you torment me and crush me with words?
verses.textEnEsv: "How long will you torment me and break me in pieces with words?
verses.textEnNkjv: "How long will you torment my soul, And break me in pieces with words?
verses.textEnNlt: "How long will you torture me? How long will you try to crush me with your words?
verses.textEnNasb: "How long will you torment me And crush me with words?
verses.textEn: "How long will you torment me and crush me with words?

verses.textZh: 你们已经十次侮辱我， 你们苛刻地对我，也不觉得羞耻。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们已经十次侮辱我， 你们苛刻地对我，也不觉得羞耻。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们这十次羞辱我； 你们苦待我也不以为耻。
verses.textEnNiv: Ten times now you have reproached me; shamelessly you attack me.
verses.textEnEsv: These ten times you have cast reproach upon me; are you not ashamed to wrong me?
verses.textEnNkjv: These ten times you have reproached me; You are not ashamed that you have wronged me.
verses.textEnNlt: You have already insulted me ten times. You should be ashamed of treating me so badly.
verses.textEnNasb: "These ten times you have insulted me; You are not ashamed to wrong me.
verses.textEn: Ten times now you have reproached me; shamelessly you attack me.

verses.textZh: 即使我真的有过错， 由我承担好了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 即使我真的有过错， 由我承担好了。
verses.textZhCuv: 果真我有错， 这错乃是在我。
verses.textEnNiv: If it is true that I have gone astray, my error remains my concern alone.
verses.textEnEsv: And even if it be true that I have erred, my error remains with myself.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if indeed I have erred, My error remains with me.
verses.textEnNlt: Even if I have sinned, that is my concern, not yours.
verses.textEnNasb: "Even if I have truly done wrong, My error stays with me.
verses.textEn: If it is true that I have gone astray, my error remains my concern alone.

verses.textZh: 你们若真的妄自尊大攻击我， 用我的羞辱来证明我的不是，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们若真的妄自尊大攻击我， 用我的羞辱来证明我的不是，
verses.textZhCuv: 你们果然要向我夸大， 以我的羞辱为证指责我，
verses.textEnNiv: If indeed you would exalt yourselves above me and use my humiliation against me,
verses.textEnEsv: If indeed you magnify yourselves against me and make my disgrace an argument against me,
verses.textEnNkjv: If indeed you exalt yourselves against me, And plead my disgrace against me,
verses.textEnNlt: You think you’re better than I am, using my humiliation as evidence of my sin.
verses.textEnNasb: "If indeed you exalt yourselves against me And prove my disgrace to me,
verses.textEn: If indeed you would exalt yourselves above me and use my humiliation against me,

verses.textZh: 那么，就知道是神颠倒我的案件， 用他的网圈住我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那么，就知道是神颠倒我的案件， 用他的网圈住我。
verses.textZhCuv: 就该知道是神倾覆我， 用网罗围绕我。
verses.textEnNiv: then know that God has wronged me and drawn his net around me.
verses.textEnEsv: know then that God has put me in the wrong and closed his net about me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Know then that God has wronged me, And has surrounded me with His net.
verses.textEnNlt: But it is God who has wronged me, capturing me in his net.
verses.textEnNasb: Know then that God has wronged me And has surrounded me with His net.
verses.textEn: then know that God has wronged me and drawn his net around me.

verses.textZh: 我呼叫‘强暴！’却没有回答； 我呼求，却得不到公断。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我呼叫‘强暴！’却没有回答； 我呼求，却得不到公断。
verses.textZhCuv: 我因委曲呼叫，却不蒙应允； 我呼求，却不得公断。
verses.textEnNiv: "Though I cry, ‘Violence!’ I get no response; though I call for help, there is no justice.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, I cry out, ‘Violence!’ but I am not answered; I call for help, but there is no justice.
verses.textEnNkjv: "If I cry out concerning wrong, I am not heard. If I cry aloud, thereis no justice.
verses.textEnNlt: "I cry out, ‘Help!’ but no one answers me. I protest, but there is no justice.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, I cry, ‘Violence!’ but I get no answer; I shout for help, but there is no justice.
verses.textEn: "Though I cry, ‘Violence!’ I get no response; though I call for help, there is no justice.

verses.textZh: 神用篱笆拦阻我的道路，使我不能经过； 他又使黑暗笼罩我的路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神用篱笆拦阻我的道路，使我不能经过； 他又使黑暗笼罩我的路。
verses.textZhCuv: 神用篱笆拦住我的道路，使我不得经过； 又使我的路径黑暗。
verses.textEnNiv: He has blocked my way so I cannot pass; he has shrouded my paths in darkness.
verses.textEnEsv: He has walled up my way, so that I cannot pass, and he has set darkness upon my paths.
verses.textEnNkjv: He has fenced up my way, so that I cannot pass; And He has set darkness in my paths.
verses.textEnNlt: God has blocked my way so I cannot move. He has plunged my path into darkness.
verses.textEnNasb: "He has blocked my way so that I cannot pass, And He has put darkness on my paths.
verses.textEn: He has blocked my way so I cannot pass; he has shrouded my paths in darkness.

verses.textZh: 他从我身上剥去我的荣耀， 又挪去我头上的冠冕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他从我身上剥去我的荣耀， 又挪去我头上的冠冕。
verses.textZhCuv: 他剥去我的荣光， 摘去我头上的冠冕。
verses.textEnNiv: He has stripped me of my honor and removed the crown from my head.
verses.textEnEsv: He has stripped from me my glory and taken the crown from my head.
verses.textEnNkjv: He has stripped me of my glory, And taken the crown from my head.
verses.textEnNlt: He has stripped me of my honor and removed the crown from my head.
verses.textEnNasb: "He has stripped my honor from me And removed the crown from my head.
verses.textEn: He has stripped me of my honor and removed the crown from my head.

verses.textZh: 他四面拆毁我，我就离世， 他又把我这指望如树枝一样拔出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他四面拆毁我，我就离世， 他又把我这指望如树枝一样拔出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 他在四围攻击我，我便归于死亡， 将我的指望如树拔出来。
verses.textEnNiv: He tears me down on every side till I am gone; he uproots my hope like a tree.
verses.textEnEsv: He breaks me down on every side, and I am gone, and my hope has he pulled up like a tree.
verses.textEnNkjv: He breaks me down on every side, And I am gone; My hope He has uprooted like a tree.
verses.textEnNlt: He has demolished me on every side, and I am finished. He has uprooted my hope like a fallen tree.
verses.textEnNasb: "He breaks me down on every side, and I am gone; And He has uprooted my hope like a tree.
verses.textEn: He tears me down on every side till I am gone; he uproots my hope like a tree.

verses.textZh: 他的怒气向我发作， 把我看作他的敌人；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的怒气向我发作， 把我看作他的敌人；
verses.textZhCuv: 他的忿怒向我发作， 以我为敌人。
verses.textEnNiv: His anger burns against me; he counts me among his enemies.
verses.textEnEsv: He has kindled his wrath against me and counts me as his adversary.
verses.textEnNkjv: He has also kindled His wrath against me, And He counts me as oneof His enemies.
verses.textEnNlt: His fury burns against me; he counts me as an enemy.
verses.textEnNasb: "He has also kindled His anger against me And considered me as His enemy.
verses.textEn: His anger burns against me; he counts me among his enemies.

verses.textZh: 他的军队一起上来， 他们建筑高的斜道攻击我 ，在我的帐棚周围安营。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的军队一起上来， 他们建筑高的斜道攻击我 ，在我的帐棚周围安营。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的军旅一齐上来， 修筑战路攻击我， 在我帐棚的四围安营。
verses.textEnNiv: His troops advance in force; they build a siege ramp against me and encamp around my tent.
verses.textEnEsv: His troops come on together; they have cast up their siege ramp against me and encamp around my tent.
verses.textEnNkjv: His troops come together And build up their road against me; They encamp all around my tent.
verses.textEnNlt: His troops advance. They build up roads to attack me. They camp all around my tent.
verses.textEnNasb: "His troops come together And build up their way against me And camp around my tent.
verses.textEn: His troops advance in force; they build a siege ramp against me and encamp around my tent.

verses.textZh: 他使我的族人远离我， 使我熟悉的人完全与我疏远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他使我的族人远离我， 使我熟悉的人完全与我疏远。
verses.textZhCuv: 他把我的弟兄隔在远处， 使我所认识的全然与我生疏。
verses.textEnNiv: "He has alienated my family from me; my acquaintances are completely estranged from me.
verses.textEnEsv: "He has put my brothers far from me, and those who knew me are wholly estranged from me.
verses.textEnNkjv: "He has removed my brothers far from me, And my acquaintances are completely estranged from me.
verses.textEnNlt: "My relatives stay far away, and my friends have turned against me.
verses.textEnNasb: "He has removed my brothers far from me, And my acquaintances have completely turned away from me.
verses.textEn: "He has alienated my family from me; my acquaintances are completely estranged from me.

verses.textZh: 我的亲戚离弃我， 我的朋友忘记我；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的亲戚离弃我， 我的朋友忘记我；
verses.textZhCuv: 我的亲戚与我断绝； 我的密友都忘记我。
verses.textEnNiv: My relatives have gone away; my closest friends have forgotten me.
verses.textEnEsv: My relatives have failed me, my close friends have forgotten me.
verses.textEnNkjv: My relatives have failed, And my close friends have forgotten me.
verses.textEnNlt: My family is gone, and my close friends have forgotten me.
verses.textEnNasb: "My relatives have failed, And my close friends have forgotten me.
verses.textEn: My relatives have gone away; my closest friends have forgotten me.

verses.textZh: 在我家中寄居的和我的婢女，都把我当作外人， 我在他们的眼中是个外族人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在我家中寄居的和我的婢女，都把我当作外人， 我在他们的眼中是个外族人。
verses.textZhCuv: 在我家寄居的， 和我的使女都以我为外人； 我在他们眼中看为外邦人。
verses.textEnNiv: My guests and my female servants count me a foreigner; they look on me as on a stranger.
verses.textEnEsv: The guests in my house and my maidservants count me as a stranger; I have become a foreigner in their eyes.
verses.textEnNkjv: Those who dwell in my house, and my maidservants, Count me as a stranger; I am an alien in their sight.
verses.textEnNlt: My servants and maids consider me a stranger. I am like a foreigner to them.
verses.textEnNasb: "Those who live in my house and my servant women consider me a stranger. I am a foreigner in their sight.
verses.textEn: My guests and my female servants count me a foreigner; they look on me as on a stranger.

verses.textZh: 我呼唤仆人，他不回答， 我得用口哀求他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我呼唤仆人，他不回答， 我得用口哀求他。
verses.textZhCuv: 我呼唤仆人， 虽用口求他，他还是不回答。
verses.textEnNiv: I summon my servant, but he does not answer, though I beg him with my own mouth.
verses.textEnEsv: I call to my servant, but he gives me no answer; I must plead with him with my mouth for mercy.
verses.textEnNkjv: I call my servant, but he gives no answer; I beg him with my mouth.
verses.textEnNlt: When I call my servant, he doesn’t come; I have to plead with him!
verses.textEnNasb: "I call to my servant, but he does not answer; I have to implore his favor with my mouth.
verses.textEn: I summon my servant, but he does not answer, though I beg him with my own mouth.

verses.textZh: 妻子厌恶我的气息， 同胞兄弟也厌弃我，
verses.textZhCnvs: 妻子厌恶我的气息， 同胞兄弟也厌弃我，
verses.textZhCuv: 我口的气味，我妻子厌恶； 我的恳求，我同胞也憎嫌。
verses.textEnNiv: My breath is offensive to my wife; I am loathsome to my own family.
verses.textEnEsv: My breath is strange to my wife, and I am a stench to the children of my own mother.
verses.textEnNkjv: My breath is offensive to my wife, And I am repulsive to the children of my own body.
verses.textEnNlt: My breath is repulsive to my wife. I am rejected by my own family.
verses.textEnNasb: "My breath is offensive to my wife, And I am loathsome to my own brothers.
verses.textEn: My breath is offensive to my wife; I am loathsome to my own family.

verses.textZh: 连小孩子也藐视我， 我一起来，他们就讥笑我；
verses.textZhCnvs: 连小孩子也藐视我， 我一起来，他们就讥笑我；
verses.textZhCuv: 连小孩子也藐视我； 我若起来，他们都嘲笑我。
verses.textEnNiv: Even the little boys scorn me; when I appear, they ridicule me.
verses.textEnEsv: Even young children despise me; when I rise they talk against me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Even young children despise me; I arise, and they speak against me.
verses.textEnNlt: Even young children despise me. When I stand to speak, they turn their backs on me.
verses.textEnNasb: "Even young children despise me; I stand up and they speak against me.
verses.textEn: Even the little boys scorn me; when I appear, they ridicule me.

verses.textZh: 我所有的密友都憎恶我， 我所爱的人也向我反脸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我所有的密友都憎恶我， 我所爱的人也向我反脸。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的密友都憎恶我； 我平日所爱的人向我翻脸。
verses.textEnNiv: All my intimate friends detest me; those I love have turned against me.
verses.textEnEsv: All my intimate friends abhor me, and those whom I loved have turned against me.
verses.textEnNkjv: All my close friends abhor me, And those whom I love have turned against me.
verses.textEnNlt: My close friends detest me. Those I loved have turned against me.
verses.textEnNasb: "All my associates loathe me, And those I love have turned against me.
verses.textEn: All my intimate friends detest me; those I love have turned against me.

verses.textZh: 我的骨头紧贴着皮肉， 我只剩牙皮逃过大难。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的骨头紧贴着皮肉， 我只剩牙皮逃过大难。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的皮肉紧贴骨头； 我只剩牙皮逃脱了。
verses.textEnNiv: I am nothing but skin and bones; I have escaped only by the skin of my teeth.
verses.textEnEsv: My bones stick to my skin and to my flesh, and I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.
verses.textEnNkjv: My bone clings to my skin and to my flesh, And I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.
verses.textEnNlt: I have been reduced to skin and bones and have escaped death by the skin of my teeth.
verses.textEnNasb: "My bone clings to my skin and my flesh, And I have escaped only by the skin of my teeth.
verses.textEn: I am nothing but skin and bones; I have escaped only by the skin of my teeth.

verses.textZh: 我的朋友啊！求你们怜悯我，怜悯我吧！ 因为神的手击打了我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的朋友啊！求你们怜悯我，怜悯我吧！ 因为神的手击打了我。
verses.textZhCuv: 我朋友啊，可怜我！可怜我！ 因为神的手攻击我。
verses.textEnNiv: "Have pity on me, my friends, have pity, for the hand of God has struck me.
verses.textEnEsv: Have mercy on me, have mercy on me, O you my friends, for the hand of God has touched me!
verses.textEnNkjv: "Have pity on me, have pity on me, O you my friends, For the hand of God has struck me!
verses.textEnNlt: "Have mercy on me, my friends, have mercy, for the hand of God has struck me.
verses.textEnNasb: "Pity me, pity me, you friends of mine, For the hand of God has struck me.
verses.textEn: "Have pity on me, my friends, have pity, for the hand of God has struck me.

verses.textZh: 你们为甚么有如神那样逼迫我？ 还不因吃我的肉感到满足吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们为甚么有如神那样逼迫我？ 还不因吃我的肉感到满足吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们为什么仿佛神逼迫我， 吃我的肉还以为不足呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Why do you pursue me as God does? Will you never get enough of my flesh?
verses.textEnEsv: Why do you, like God, pursue me? Why are you not satisfied with my flesh?
verses.textEnNkjv: Why do you persecute me as God does, And are not satisfied with my flesh?
verses.textEnNlt: Must you also persecute me, like God does? Haven’t you chewed me up enough?
verses.textEnNasb: "Why do you persecute me as God does, And are not satisfied with my flesh?
verses.textEn: Why do you pursue me as God does? Will you never get enough of my flesh?

verses.textZh: 但愿我的话现在都写下， 都刻在书简上，
verses.textZhCnvs: 但愿我的话现在都写下， 都刻在书简上，
verses.textZhCuv: 惟愿我的言语现在写上， 都记录在书上；
verses.textEnNiv: "Oh, that my words were recorded, that they were written on a scroll,
verses.textEnEsv: "Oh that my words were written! Oh that they were inscribed in a book!
verses.textEnNkjv: "Oh, that my words were written! Oh, that they were inscribed in a book!
verses.textEnNlt: "Oh, that my words could be recorded. Oh, that they could be inscribed on a monument,
verses.textEnNasb: "Oh that my words were written! Oh that they were recorded in a book!
verses.textEn: "Oh, that my words were recorded, that they were written on a scroll,

verses.textZh: 用铁笔又用铅， 永远刻在盘石上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 用铁笔又用铅， 永远刻在盘石上。
verses.textZhCuv: 用铁笔镌刻， 用铅灌在磐石上，直存到永远。
verses.textEnNiv: that they were inscribed with an iron tool on lead, or engraved in rock forever!
verses.textEnEsv: Oh that with an iron pen and lead they were engraved in the rock forever!
verses.textEnNkjv: That they were engraved on a rock With an iron pen and lead, forever!
verses.textEnNlt: carved with an iron chisel and filled with lead, engraved forever in the rock.
verses.textEnNasb: "That with an iron stylus and lead They were engraved in the rock forever!
verses.textEn: that they were inscribed with an iron tool on lead, or engraved in rock forever!

verses.textZh: 我知道我的救赎主活着， 最后他必在地上兴起 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我知道我的救赎主活着， 最后他必在地上兴起 。
verses.textZhCuv: 我知道我的救赎主活着， 末了必站立在地上。
verses.textEnNiv: I know that my redeemer lives, and that in the end he will stand on the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: For I know that my Redeemer lives, and at the last he will stand upon the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I know that my Redeemer lives, And He shall stand at last on the earth;
verses.textEnNlt: "But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives, and he will stand upon the earth at last.
verses.textEnNasb: "Yet as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives, And at the last, He will take His stand on the earth.
verses.textEn: I know that my redeemer lives, and that in the end he will stand on the earth.

verses.textZh: 我的皮肉遭受毁坏以后，这事就要发生， 我必在肉体以外得见神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的皮肉遭受毁坏以后，这事就要发生， 我必在肉体以外得见神。
verses.textZhCuv: 我这皮肉灭绝之后， 我必在肉体之外得见神。
verses.textEnNiv: And after my skin has been destroyed, yet in my flesh I will see God;
verses.textEnEsv: And after my skin has been thus destroyed, yet in my flesh I shall see God,
verses.textEnNkjv: And after my skin is destroyed, this Iknow, That in my flesh I shall see God,
verses.textEnNlt: And after my body has decayed, yet in my body I will see God!
verses.textEnNasb: "Even after my skin is destroyed, Yet from my flesh I will see God,
verses.textEn: And after my skin has been destroyed, yet in my flesh I will see God;

verses.textZh: 我必见他在我身边， 我要亲眼见他，并非外人， 我的心肠在我里面渴想极了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必见他在我身边， 我要亲眼见他，并非外人， 我的心肠在我里面渴想极了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我自己要见他， 亲眼要看他，并不像外人。 我的心肠在我里面消灭了！
verses.textEnNiv: I myself will see him with my own eyes—I, and not another. How my heart yearns within me!
verses.textEnEsv: whom I shall see for myself, and my eyes shall behold, and not another. My heart faints within me!
verses.textEnNkjv: Whom I shall see for myself, And my eyes shall behold, and not another. How my heart yearns within me!
verses.textEnNlt: I will see him for myself. Yes, I will see him with my own eyes. I am overwhelmed at the thought!
verses.textEnNasb: Whom I, on my part, shall behold for myself, And whom my eyes will see, and not another. My heart faints within me!
verses.textEn: I myself will see him with my own eyes—I, and not another. How my heart yearns within me!

verses.textZh: 你们若说：‘惹事的根既然在他， 我们要怎样逼迫他呢？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们若说：‘惹事的根既然在他， 我们要怎样逼迫他呢？’
verses.textZhCuv: 你们若说：我们逼迫他要何等地重呢？ 惹事的根乃在乎他；
verses.textEnNiv: "If you say, ‘How we will hound him, since the root of the trouble lies in him, ’
verses.textEnEsv: If you say, ‘How we will pursue him!’ and, ‘The root of the matter is found in him,’
verses.textEnNkjv: If you should say, ‘How shall we persecute him?’— Since the root of the matter is found in me,
verses.textEnNlt: "How dare you go on persecuting me, saying, ‘It’s his own fault’?
verses.textEnNasb: "If you say, ‘How shall we persecute him?’ And ‘ What pretext for a case against him can we find?’
verses.textEn: "If you say, ‘How we will hound him, since the root of the trouble lies in him, ’

verses.textZh: 你们就当惧怕刀剑， 因为这些罪孽带来刀剑的惩罚， 好使你们知道有审判。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们就当惧怕刀剑， 因为这些罪孽带来刀剑的惩罚， 好使你们知道有审判。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们就当惧怕刀剑； 因为忿怒惹动刀剑的刑罚， 使你们知道有报应 。
verses.textEnNiv: you should fear the sword yourselves; for wrath will bring punishment by the sword, and then you will know that there is judgment. "
verses.textEnEsv: be afraid of the sword, for wrath brings the punishment of the sword, that you may know there is a judgment."
verses.textEnNkjv: Be afraid of the sword for yourselves; For wrath brings the punishment of the sword, That you may know thereis a judgment."
verses.textEnNlt: You should fear punishment yourselves, for your attitude deserves punishment. Then you will know that there is indeed a judgment."
verses.textEnNasb: "Then be afraid of the sword for yourselves, For wrath brings the punishment of the sword, So that you may know there is judgment."
verses.textEn: you should fear the sword yourselves; for wrath will bring punishment by the sword, and then you will know that there is judgment. "

verses.textZh: 拿玛人琐法回答说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿玛人琐法回答说：
verses.textZhCuv: 拿玛人琐法回答说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then Zophar the Naamathite replied:
verses.textEnEsv: Then Zophar the Naamathite answered and said:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Zophar the Naamathite answered and said:
verses.textEnNlt: Then Zophar the Naamathite replied:
verses.textEnNasb: Then Zophar the Naamathite responded,
verses.textEn: Then Zophar the Naamathite replied:

verses.textZh: "我的心思烦扰叫我回话， 因为我内心急躁。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我的心思烦扰叫我回话， 因为我内心急躁。
verses.textZhCuv: 我心中急躁， 所以我的思念叫我回答。
verses.textEnNiv: "My troubled thoughts prompt me to answer because I am greatly disturbed.
verses.textEnEsv: "Therefore my thoughts answer me, because of my haste within me.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore my anxious thoughts make me answer, Because of the turmoil within me.
verses.textEnNlt: "I must reply because I am greatly disturbed.
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore my disquieting thoughts make me respond, Even because of my inward agitation.
verses.textEn: "My troubled thoughts prompt me to answer because I am greatly disturbed.

verses.textZh: 我听见了那羞辱我的责备， 心灵因着我的悟性回答我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我听见了那羞辱我的责备， 心灵因着我的悟性回答我。
verses.textZhCuv: 我已听见那羞辱我，责备我的话； 我的悟性叫我回答。
verses.textEnNiv: I hear a rebuke that dishonors me, and my understanding inspires me to reply.
verses.textEnEsv: I hear censure that insults me, and out of my understanding a spirit answers me.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have heard the rebuke that reproaches me, And the spirit of my understanding causes me to answer.
verses.textEnNlt: I’ve had to endure your insults, but now my spirit prompts me to reply.
verses.textEnNasb: "I listened to the reprimand which insults me, And the spirit of my understanding makes me answer.
verses.textEn: I hear a rebuke that dishonors me, and my understanding inspires me to reply.

verses.textZh: 你不知亘古以来， 自从地上有人以来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不知亘古以来， 自从地上有人以来，
verses.textZhCuv: 你岂不知亘古以来， 自从人生在地，
verses.textEnNiv: "Surely you know how it has been from of old, ever since mankind was placed on the earth,
verses.textEnEsv: Do you not know this from of old, since man was placed on earth,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Do you not know this of old, Since man was placed on earth,
verses.textEnNlt: "Don’t you realize that from the beginning of time, ever since people were first placed on the earth,
verses.textEnNasb: "Do you know this from ancient times, From the establishment of mankind on earth,
verses.textEn: "Surely you know how it has been from of old, ever since mankind was placed on the earth,

verses.textZh: 恶人的欢呼并不长久， 不敬虔者的快乐，不过是暂时的吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人的欢呼并不长久， 不敬虔者的快乐，不过是暂时的吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人夸胜是暂时的， 不敬虔人的喜乐不过转眼之间吗？
verses.textEnNiv: that the mirth of the wicked is brief, the joy of the godless lasts but a moment.
verses.textEnEsv: that the exulting of the wicked is short, and the joy of the godless but for a moment?
verses.textEnNkjv: That the triumphing of the wicked is short, And the joy of the hypocrite is but for a moment?
verses.textEnNlt: the triumph of the wicked has been short lived and the joy of the godless has been only temporary?
verses.textEnNasb: That the rejoicing of the wicked is short, And the joy of the godless momentary?
verses.textEn: that the mirth of the wicked is brief, the joy of the godless lasts but a moment.

verses.textZh: 虽然他的高贵上达于天， 他的头直插云霄，
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽然他的高贵上达于天， 他的头直插云霄，
verses.textZhCuv: 他的尊荣虽达到天上， 头虽顶到云中，
verses.textEnNiv: Though the pride of the godless person reaches to the heavens and his head touches the clouds,
verses.textEnEsv: Though his height mount up to the heavens, and his head reach to the clouds,
verses.textEnNkjv: Though his haughtiness mounts up to the heavens, And his head reaches to the clouds,
verses.textEnNlt: Though the pride of the godless reaches to the heavens and their heads touch the clouds,
verses.textEnNasb: "Though his arrogance reaches the heavens, And his head touches the clouds,
verses.textEn: Though the pride of the godless person reaches to the heavens and his head touches the clouds,

verses.textZh: 他必永远灭亡像自己的粪一般， 素来看见他的，都要说：‘他在哪里呢？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必永远灭亡像自己的粪一般， 素来看见他的，都要说：‘他在哪里呢？’
verses.textZhCuv: 他终必灭亡，像自己的粪一样； 素来见他的人要说：他在哪里呢？
verses.textEnNiv: he will perish forever, like his own dung; those who have seen him will say, ‘Where is he?’
verses.textEnEsv: he will perish forever like his own dung; those who have seen him will say, ‘Where is he?’
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet he will perish forever like his own refuse; Those who have seen him will say, ‘Where is he?’
verses.textEnNlt: yet they will vanish forever, thrown away like their own dung. Those who knew them will ask, ‘Where are they?’
verses.textEnNasb: He perishes forever like his refuse; Those who have seen him will say, ‘Where is he?’
verses.textEn: he will perish forever, like his own dung; those who have seen him will say, ‘Where is he?’

verses.textZh: 他必如梦一般飞逝，人再也找不着他， 他必被赶去如夜间的异象，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必如梦一般飞逝，人再也找不着他， 他必被赶去如夜间的异象，
verses.textZhCuv: 他必飞去如梦，不再寻见， 速被赶去，如夜间的异象。
verses.textEnNiv: Like a dream he flies away, no more to be found, banished like a vision of the night.
verses.textEnEsv: He will fly away like a dream and not be found; he will be chased away like a vision of the night.
verses.textEnNkjv: He will fly away like a dream, and not be found; Yes, he will be chased away like a vision of the night.
verses.textEnNlt: They will fade like a dream and not be found. They will vanish like a vision in the night.
verses.textEnNasb: "He flies away like a dream, and they cannot find him; Like a vision of the night he is chased away.
verses.textEn: Like a dream he flies away, no more to be found, banished like a vision of the night.

verses.textZh: 亲眼见过他的，必不再见他， 他的本处也必看不见他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亲眼见过他的，必不再见他， 他的本处也必看不见他。
verses.textZhCuv: 亲眼见过他的，必不再见他； 他的本处也再见不着他。
verses.textEnNiv: The eye that saw him will not see him again; his place will look on him no more.
verses.textEnEsv: The eye that saw him will see him no more, nor will his place any more behold him.
verses.textEnNkjv: The eye that saw him will seehim no more, Nor will his place behold him anymore.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who once saw them will see them no more. Their families will never see them again.
verses.textEnNasb: "The eye which saw him sees him no longer, And his place no longer beholds him.
verses.textEn: The eye that saw him will not see him again; his place will look on him no more.

verses.textZh: 他的儿女必向穷人求恩， 他们的手要退还他不义之财，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的儿女必向穷人求恩， 他们的手要退还他不义之财，
verses.textZhCuv: 他的儿女要求穷人的恩； 他的手要赔还不义之财。
verses.textEnNiv: His children must make amends to the poor; his own hands must give back his wealth.
verses.textEnEsv: His children will seek the favor of the poor, and his hands will give back his wealth.
verses.textEnNkjv: His children will seek the favor of the poor, And his hands will restore his wealth.
verses.textEnNlt: Their children will beg from the poor, for they must give back their stolen riches.
verses.textEnNasb: "His sons favor the poor, And his hands give back his wealth.
verses.textEn: His children must make amends to the poor; his own hands must give back his wealth.

verses.textZh: 他的骨头虽然充满青春活力， 却必与他一同躺卧在尘土中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的骨头虽然充满青春活力， 却必与他一同躺卧在尘土中。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的骨头虽然有青年之力， 却要和他一同躺卧在尘土中。
verses.textEnNiv: The youthful vigor that fills his bones will lie with him in the dust.
verses.textEnEsv: His bones are full of his youthful vigor, but it will lie down with him in the dust.
verses.textEnNkjv: His bones are full of his youthful vigor, But it will lie down with him in the dust.
verses.textEnNlt: Though they are young, their bones will lie in the dust.
verses.textEnNasb: "His bones are full of his youthful strength, But it lies down with him in the dust.
verses.textEn: The youthful vigor that fills his bones will lie with him in the dust.

verses.textZh: 邪恶在他的口中虽然甘甜， 他把邪恶藏在自己的舌下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 邪恶在他的口中虽然甘甜， 他把邪恶藏在自己的舌下。
verses.textZhCuv: 他口内虽以恶为甘甜， 藏在舌头底下，
verses.textEnNiv: "Though evil is sweet in his mouth and he hides it under his tongue,
verses.textEnEsv: "Though evil is sweet in his mouth, though he hides it under his tongue,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Though evil is sweet in his mouth, And he hides it under his tongue,
verses.textEnNlt: "They enjoyed the sweet taste of wickedness, letting it melt under their tongue.
verses.textEnNasb: "Though evil tastes sweet in his mouth And he hides it under his tongue,
verses.textEn: "Though evil is sweet in his mouth and he hides it under his tongue,

verses.textZh: 他虽然爱惜不舍， 含在口中，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他虽然爱惜不舍， 含在口中，
verses.textZhCuv: 爱恋不舍，含在口中；
verses.textEnNiv: though he cannot bear to let it go and lets it linger in his mouth,
verses.textEnEsv: though he is loath to let it go and holds it in his mouth,
verses.textEnNkjv: Though he spares it and does not forsake it, But still keeps it in his mouth,
verses.textEnNlt: They savored it, holding it long in their mouths.
verses.textEnNasb: Though he desires it and will not let it go, But holds it in his mouth,
verses.textEn: though he cannot bear to let it go and lets it linger in his mouth,

verses.textZh: 然而他的食物在他腹中却要变坏， 在他里面成为眼镜蛇的毒汁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而他的食物在他腹中却要变坏， 在他里面成为眼镜蛇的毒汁。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的食物在肚里却要化为酸， 在他里面成为虺蛇的恶毒。
verses.textEnNiv: yet his food will turn sour in his stomach; it will become the venom of serpents within him.
verses.textEnEsv: yet his food is turned in his stomach; it is the venom of cobras within him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet his food in his stomach turns sour; It becomes cobra venom within him.
verses.textEnNlt: But suddenly the food in their bellies turns sour, a poisonous venom in their stomach.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet his food in his stomach is changed To the venom of cobras within him.
verses.textEn: yet his food will turn sour in his stomach; it will become the venom of serpents within him.

verses.textZh: 他吞下了财宝，还要把它吐出来，神要从他的腹中把它掏出来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他吞下了财宝，还要把它吐出来，神要从他的腹中把它掏出来，
verses.textZhCuv: 他吞了财宝，还要吐出；神要从他腹中掏出来。
verses.textEnNiv: He will spit out the riches he swallowed; God will make his stomach vomit them up.
verses.textEnEsv: He swallows down riches and vomits them up again; God casts them out of his belly.
verses.textEnNkjv: He swallows down riches And vomits them up again; God casts them out of his belly.
verses.textEnNlt: They will vomit the wealth they swallowed. God won’t let them keep it down.
verses.textEnNasb: "He swallows riches, But will vomit them up; God will expel them from his belly.
verses.textEn: He will spit out the riches he swallowed; God will make his stomach vomit them up.

verses.textZh: 他必吸吮眼镜蛇的毒液， 腹蛇的舌头必把他杀死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必吸吮眼镜蛇的毒液， 腹蛇的舌头必把他杀死。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必吸饮虺蛇的毒气； 蝮蛇的舌头也必杀他。
verses.textEnNiv: He will suck the poison of serpents; the fangs of an adder will kill him.
verses.textEnEsv: He will suck the poison of cobras; the tongue of a viper will kill him.
verses.textEnNkjv: He will suck the poison of cobras; The viper’s tongue will slay him.
verses.textEnNlt: They will suck the poison of cobras. The viper will kill them.
verses.textEnNasb: "He sucks the poison of cobras; The viper’s tongue kills him.
verses.textEn: He will suck the poison of serpents; the fangs of an adder will kill him.

verses.textZh: 他必不得看见江河， 就是流蜜与奶的江河。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必不得看见江河， 就是流蜜与奶的江河。
verses.textZhCuv: 流奶与蜜之河， 他不得再见。
verses.textEnNiv: He will not enjoy the streams, the rivers flowing with honey and cream.
verses.textEnEsv: He will not look upon the rivers, the streams flowing with honey and curds.
verses.textEnNkjv: He will not see the streams, The rivers flowing with honey and cream.
verses.textEnNlt: They will never again enjoy streams of olive oil or rivers of milk and honey.
verses.textEnNasb: "He does not look at the streams, The rivers flowing with honey and curds.
verses.textEn: He will not enjoy the streams, the rivers flowing with honey and cream.

verses.textZh: 他劳苦所得的必归别人，自己却不得吃用； 他交易得来的财利，自己却不得享用。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他劳苦所得的必归别人，自己却不得吃用； 他交易得来的财利，自己却不得享用。
verses.textZhCuv: 他劳碌得来的要赔还，不得享用 ； 不能照所得的财货欢乐。
verses.textEnNiv: What he toiled for he must give back uneaten; he will not enjoy the profit from his trading.
verses.textEnEsv: He will give back the fruit of his toil and will not swallow it down; from the profit of his trading he will get no enjoyment.
verses.textEnNkjv: He will restore that for which he labored, And will not swallow it down; From the proceeds of business He will get no enjoyment.
verses.textEnNlt: They will give back everything they worked for. Their wealth will bring them no joy.
verses.textEnNasb: "He returns the product of his labor And cannot swallow it; As to the riches of his trading, He cannot even enjoy them.
verses.textEn: What he toiled for he must give back uneaten; he will not enjoy the profit from his trading.

verses.textZh: 因为他欺压穷人，不顾他们， 强抢不是自己建造的房屋。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他欺压穷人，不顾他们， 强抢不是自己建造的房屋。
verses.textZhCuv: 他欺压穷人，且又离弃； 强取非自己所盖的房屋 。
verses.textEnNiv: For he has oppressed the poor and left them destitute; he has seized houses he did not build.
verses.textEnEsv: For he has crushed and abandoned the poor; he has seized a house that he did not build.
verses.textEnNkjv: For he has oppressed and forsaken the poor, He has violently seized a house which he did not build.
verses.textEnNlt: For they oppressed the poor and left them destitute. They foreclosed on their homes.
verses.textEnNasb: "For he has oppressed and neglected the poor; He has seized a house which he has not built.
verses.textEn: For he has oppressed the poor and left them destitute; he has seized houses he did not build.

verses.textZh: 因为他内心没有安宁， 他不能保存他喜爱的东西。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他内心没有安宁， 他不能保存他喜爱的东西。
verses.textZhCuv: 他因贪而无厌， 所喜悦的连一样也不能保守。
verses.textEnNiv: "Surely he will have no respite from his craving; he cannot save himself by his treasure.
verses.textEnEsv: "Because he knew no contentment in his belly, he will not let anything in which he delights escape him.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Because he knows no quietness in his heart, He will not save anything he desires.
verses.textEnNlt: They were always greedy and never satisfied. Nothing remains of all the things they dreamed about.
verses.textEnNasb: "Because he knew no quiet within him, He does not retain anything he desires.
verses.textEn: "Surely he will have no respite from his craving; he cannot save himself by his treasure.

verses.textZh: 他吃得一无所剩， 所以他的福乐不能持久；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他吃得一无所剩， 所以他的福乐不能持久；
verses.textZhCuv: 其余的没有一样他不吞灭， 所以他的福乐不能长久。
verses.textEnNiv: Nothing is left for him to devour; his prosperity will not endure.
verses.textEnEsv: There was nothing left after he had eaten; therefore his prosperity will not endure.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nothing is left for him to eat; Therefore his well-being will not last.
verses.textEnNlt: Nothing is left after they finish gorging themselves. Therefore, their prosperity will not endure.
verses.textEnNasb: "Nothing remains for him to devour, Therefore his prosperity does not endure.
verses.textEn: Nothing is left for him to devour; his prosperity will not endure.

verses.textZh: 他在满足有余的时候，陷入困境， 受过苦的人的手都临到他身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在满足有余的时候，陷入困境， 受过苦的人的手都临到他身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 他在满足有余的时候，必到狭窄的地步； 凡受苦楚的人都必加手在他身上。
verses.textEnNiv: In the midst of his plenty, distress will overtake him; the full force of misery will come upon him.
verses.textEnEsv: In the fullness of his sufficiency he will be in distress; the hand of everyone in misery will come against him.
verses.textEnNkjv: In his self-sufficiency he will be in distress; Every hand of misery will come against him.
verses.textEnNlt: "In the midst of plenty, they will run into trouble and be overcome by misery.
verses.textEnNasb: "In the fullness of his excess he will be cramped; The hand of everyone who suffers will come against him.
verses.textEn: In the midst of his plenty, distress will overtake him; the full force of misery will come upon him.

verses.textZh: 他正在填饱肚腹的时候，神就把猛烈的怒气降在他身上， 他正在吃饭的时候，神要把这怒气如雨降在他身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他正在填饱肚腹的时候，神就把猛烈的怒气降在他身上， 他正在吃饭的时候，神要把这怒气如雨降在他身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 他正要充满肚腹的时候，神必将猛烈的忿怒降在他身上； 正在他吃饭的时候， 要将这忿怒像雨降在他身上。
verses.textEnNiv: When he has filled his belly, God will vent his burning anger against him and rain down his blows on him.
verses.textEnEsv: To fill his belly to the full, God will send his burning anger against him and rain it upon him into his body.
verses.textEnNkjv: When he is about to fill his stomach, God will cast on him the fury of His wrath, And will rain it on him while he is eating.
verses.textEnNlt: May God give them a bellyful of trouble. May God rain down his anger upon them.
verses.textEnNasb: "When he fills his belly, God will send His fierce anger on him And rain it on him while he is eating.
verses.textEn: When he has filled his belly, God will vent his burning anger against him and rain down his blows on him.

verses.textZh: 他要逃避铁制的兵器， 但铜弓的箭必把他射穿；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要逃避铁制的兵器， 但铜弓的箭必把他射穿；
verses.textZhCuv: 他要躲避铁器； 铜弓的箭要将他射透。
verses.textEnNiv: Though he flees from an iron weapon, a bronze-tipped arrow pierces him.
verses.textEnEsv: He will flee from an iron weapon; a bronze arrow will strike him through.
verses.textEnNkjv: He will flee from the iron weapon; A bronze bow will pierce him through.
verses.textEnNlt: When they try to escape an iron weapon, a bronze-tipped arrow will pierce them.
verses.textEnNasb: "He may flee from the iron weapon, But the bronze bow will pierce him.
verses.textEn: Though he flees from an iron weapon, a bronze-tipped arrow pierces him.

verses.textZh: 他把箭一抽，箭就从背后出来， 发亮的箭头从他的胆中出来， 死亡的惊恐临到他身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把箭一抽，箭就从背后出来， 发亮的箭头从他的胆中出来， 死亡的惊恐临到他身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 他把箭一抽，就从他身上出来； 发光的箭头从他胆中出来， 有惊惶临在他身上。
verses.textEnNiv: He pulls it out of his back, the gleaming point out of his liver. Terrors will come over him;
verses.textEnEsv: It is drawn forth and comes out of his body; the glittering point comes out of his gallbladder; terrors come upon him.
verses.textEnNkjv: It is drawn, and comes out of the body; Yes, the glittering pointcomes out of his gall. Terrors come upon him;
verses.textEnNlt: The arrow is pulled from their back, and the arrowhead glistens with blood. The terrors of death are upon them.
verses.textEnNasb: "It is drawn and comes out of his back, Even the flashing point from his gallbladder; Terrors come upon him,
verses.textEn: He pulls it out of his back, the gleaming point out of his liver. Terrors will come over him;

verses.textZh: 万般黑暗为他的财宝留存， 不是由人吹着的火要吞灭他， 要毁掉他帐棚中所剩下的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 万般黑暗为他的财宝留存， 不是由人吹着的火要吞灭他， 要毁掉他帐棚中所剩下的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的财宝归于黑暗； 人所不吹的火要把他烧灭， 要把他帐棚中所剩下的烧毁。
verses.textEnNiv: total darkness lies in wait for his treasures. A fire unfanned will consume him and devour what is left in his tent.
verses.textEnEsv: Utter darkness is laid up for his treasures; a fire not fanned will devour him; what is left in his tent will be consumed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Total darkness is reserved for his treasures. An unfanned fire will consume him; It shall go ill with him who is left in his tent.
verses.textEnNlt: Their treasures will be thrown into deepest darkness. A wildfire will devour their goods, consuming all they have left.
verses.textEnNasb: Complete darkness is held in reserve for his treasures, And unfanned fire will devour him; It will consume the survivor in his tent.
verses.textEn: total darkness lies in wait for his treasures. A fire unfanned will consume him and devour what is left in his tent.

verses.textZh: 天必显露他的罪孽， 地要兴起来攻击他，
verses.textZhCnvs: 天必显露他的罪孽， 地要兴起来攻击他，
verses.textZhCuv: 天要显明他的罪孽； 地要兴起攻击他。
verses.textEnNiv: The heavens will expose his guilt; the earth will rise up against him.
verses.textEnEsv: The heavens will reveal his iniquity, and the earth will rise up against him.
verses.textEnNkjv: The heavens will reveal his iniquity, And the earth will rise up against him.
verses.textEnNlt: The heavens will reveal their guilt, and the earth will testify against them.
verses.textEnNasb: "The heavens will reveal his guilt, And the earth will rise up against him.
verses.textEn: The heavens will expose his guilt; the earth will rise up against him.

verses.textZh: 他的家产必被掠去， 在神忿怒的日子被冲走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的家产必被掠去， 在神忿怒的日子被冲走。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的家产必然过去；神发怒的日子，他的货物都要消灭。
verses.textEnNiv: A flood will carry off his house, rushing waters on the day of God’s wrath.
verses.textEnEsv: The possessions of his house will be carried away, dragged off in the day of God’s wrath.
verses.textEnNkjv: The increase of his house will depart, Andhisgoods will flow away in the day of His wrath.
verses.textEnNlt: A flood will sweep away their house. God’s anger will descend on them in torrents.
verses.textEnNasb: "The increase of his house will disappear; His possessions will flow away on the day of His anger.
verses.textEn: A flood will carry off his house, rushing waters on the day of God’s wrath.

verses.textZh: 这是恶人从神所得的分， 是神给他指定的产业。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是恶人从神所得的分， 是神给他指定的产业。"
verses.textZhCuv: 这是恶人从神所得的分， 是神为他所定的产业。
verses.textEnNiv: Such is the fate God allots the wicked, the heritage appointed for them by God."
verses.textEnEsv: This is the wicked man’s portion from God, the heritage decreed for him by God."
verses.textEnNkjv: This is the portion from God for a wicked man, The heritage appointed to him by God."
verses.textEnNlt: This is the reward that God gives the wicked. It is the inheritance decreed by God."
verses.textEnNasb: "This is a wicked person’s portion from God, The inheritance decreed to him by God."
verses.textEn: Such is the fate God allots the wicked, the heritage appointed for them by God."

verses.textZh: 约伯回答说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 约伯回答说：
verses.textZhCuv: 约伯回答说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then Job replied:
verses.textEnEsv: Then Job answered and said:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Job answered and said:
verses.textEnNlt: Then Job spoke again:
verses.textEnNasb: Then Job responded,
verses.textEn: Then Job replied:

verses.textZh: "你们要细听我的言语， 这就算是你们给我的安慰。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们要细听我的言语， 这就算是你们给我的安慰。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要细听我的言语， 就算是你们安慰我。
verses.textEnNiv: "Listen carefully to my words; let this be the consolation you give me.
verses.textEnEsv: "Keep listening to my words, and let this be your comfort.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Listen carefully to my speech, And let this be your consolation.
verses.textEnNlt: "Listen closely to what I am saying. That’s one consolation you can give me.
verses.textEnNasb: "Listen carefully to my speech, And let this be your way of consolation.
verses.textEn: "Listen carefully to my words; let this be the consolation you give me.

verses.textZh: 请原谅我，我又要说话了， 说完以后，就任凭你们嘲笑吧！
verses.textZhCnvs: 请原谅我，我又要说话了， 说完以后，就任凭你们嘲笑吧！
verses.textZhCuv: 请宽容我，我又要说话； 说了以后，任凭你们嗤笑吧！
verses.textEnNiv: Bear with me while I speak, and after I have spoken, mock on.
verses.textEnEsv: Bear with me, and I will speak, and after I have spoken, mock on.
verses.textEnNkjv: Bear with me that I may speak, And after I have spoken, keep mocking.
verses.textEnNlt: Bear with me, and let me speak. After I have spoken, you may resume mocking me.
verses.textEnNasb: "Bear with me that I may speak; Then after I have spoken, you may mock me.
verses.textEn: Bear with me while I speak, and after I have spoken, mock on.

verses.textZh: 我岂是抱怨的人呢？ 我的心为甚么不能忍耐呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我岂是抱怨的人呢？ 我的心为甚么不能忍耐呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 我岂是向人诉冤？ 为何不焦急呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "Is my complaint directed to a human being? Why should I not be impatient?
verses.textEnEsv: As for me, is my complaint against man? Why should I not be impatient?
verses.textEnNkjv: "As for me, is my complaint against man? And if itwere, why should I not be impatient?
verses.textEnNlt: "My complaint is with God, not with people. I have good reason to be so impatient.
verses.textEnNasb: "As for me, is my complaint to a mortal? Or why should I not be impatient?
verses.textEn: "Is my complaint directed to a human being? Why should I not be impatient?

verses.textZh: 你们注视我，惊讶吧， 用手掩口吧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们注视我，惊讶吧， 用手掩口吧。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要看着我而惊奇， 用手捂口。
verses.textEnNiv: Look at me and be appalled; clap your hand over your mouth.
verses.textEnEsv: Look at me and be appalled, and lay your hand over your mouth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Look at me and be astonished; Put your hand over your mouth.
verses.textEnNlt: Look at me and be stunned. Put your hand over your mouth in shock.
verses.textEnNasb: "Look at me, and be astonished, And put your hand over your mouth.
verses.textEn: Look at me and be appalled; clap your hand over your mouth.

verses.textZh: 我每逢想起，就惊惶， 浑身战抖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我每逢想起，就惊惶， 浑身战抖。
verses.textZhCuv: 我每逢思想，心就惊惶， 浑身战兢。
verses.textEnNiv: When I think about this, I am terrified; trembling seizes my body.
verses.textEnEsv: When I remember, I am dismayed, and shuddering seizes my flesh.
verses.textEnNkjv: Even when I remember I am terrified, And trembling takes hold of my flesh.
verses.textEnNlt: When I think about what I am saying, I shudder. My body trembles.
verses.textEnNasb: "Even when I remember, I am disturbed, And horror takes hold of my flesh.
verses.textEn: When I think about this, I am terrified; trembling seizes my body.

verses.textZh: 恶人为甚么总可以存活， 活到老，而且财势强大？
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人为甚么总可以存活， 活到老，而且财势强大？
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人为何存活， 享大寿数，势力强盛呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Why do the wicked live on, growing old and increasing in power?
verses.textEnEsv: Why do the wicked live, reach old age, and grow mighty in power?
verses.textEnNkjv: Why do the wicked live and become old, Yes, become mighty in power?
verses.textEnNlt: "Why do the wicked prosper, growing old and powerful?
verses.textEnNasb: "Why do the wicked still live, Grow old, and also become very powerful?
verses.textEn: Why do the wicked live on, growing old and increasing in power?

verses.textZh: 他们的后裔在他们面前坚定， 他们眼见自己的子孙在他们周围立定。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的后裔在他们面前坚定， 他们眼见自己的子孙在他们周围立定。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们眼见儿孙， 和他们一同坚立。
verses.textEnNiv: They see their children established around them, their offspring before their eyes.
verses.textEnEsv: Their offspring are established in their presence, and their descendants before their eyes.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their descendants are established with them in their sight, And their offspring before their eyes.
verses.textEnNlt: They live to see their children grow up and settle down, and they enjoy their grandchildren.
verses.textEnNasb: "Their descendants endure with them in their sight, And their offspring before their eyes,
verses.textEn: They see their children established around them, their offspring before their eyes.

verses.textZh: 他们的家宅平安无惧，神的刑杖也不加在他们身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的家宅平安无惧，神的刑杖也不加在他们身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的家宅平安无惧；神的杖也不加在他们身上。
verses.textEnNiv: Their homes are safe and free from fear; the rod of God is not on them.
verses.textEnEsv: Their houses are safe from fear, and no rod of God is upon them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their houses are safe from fear, Neither is the rod of God upon them.
verses.textEnNlt: Their homes are safe from every fear, and God does not punish them.
verses.textEnNasb: Their houses are safe from fear, And the rod of God is not on them.
verses.textEn: Their homes are safe and free from fear; the rod of God is not on them.

verses.textZh: 他们的公牛交配而不落种， 他们的母牛下犊而不掉胎，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的公牛交配而不落种， 他们的母牛下犊而不掉胎，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的公牛孳生而不断绝； 母牛下犊而不掉胎。
verses.textEnNiv: Their bulls never fail to breed; their cows calve and do not miscarry.
verses.textEnEsv: Their bull breeds without fail; their cow calves and does not miscarry.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their bull breeds without failure; Their cow calves without miscarriage.
verses.textEnNlt: Their bulls never fail to breed. Their cows bear calves and never miscarry.
verses.textEnNasb: "His ox mates without fail; His cow calves and does not miscarry.
verses.textEn: Their bulls never fail to breed; their cows calve and do not miscarry.

verses.textZh: 他们叫小孩子出去多如羊群， 他们的年轻人四处跳跃；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们叫小孩子出去多如羊群， 他们的年轻人四处跳跃；
verses.textZhCuv: 他们打发小孩子出去，多如羊群； 他们的儿女踊跃跳舞。
verses.textEnNiv: They send forth their children as a flock; their little ones dance about.
verses.textEnEsv: They send out their little boys like a flock, and their children dance.
verses.textEnNkjv: They send forth their little ones like a flock, And their children dance.
verses.textEnNlt: They let their children frisk about like lambs. Their little ones skip and dance.
verses.textEnNasb: "They send out their boys like the flock, And their children dance.
verses.textEn: They send forth their children as a flock; their little ones dance about.

verses.textZh: 他们跟着琴鼓高歌， 又因着箫的声音欢乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们跟着琴鼓高歌， 又因着箫的声音欢乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们随着琴鼓歌唱， 又因箫声欢喜。
verses.textEnNiv: They sing to the music of timbrel and lyre; they make merry to the sound of the pipe.
verses.textEnEsv: They sing to the tambourine and the lyre and rejoice to the sound of the pipe.
verses.textEnNkjv: They sing to the tambourine and harp, And rejoice to the sound of the flute.
verses.textEnNlt: They sing with tambourine and harp. They celebrate to the sound of the flute.
verses.textEnNasb: "They sing with the tambourine and harp, And rejoice at the sound of the flute.
verses.textEn: They sing to the music of timbrel and lyre; they make merry to the sound of the pipe.

verses.textZh: 他们幸福度过他们的日子， 一剎那间下阴间，毫无病痛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们幸福度过他们的日子， 一剎那间下阴间，毫无病痛。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们度日诸事亨通， 转眼下入阴间。
verses.textEnNiv: They spend their years in prosperity and go down to the grave in peace.
verses.textEnEsv: They spend their days in prosperity, and in peace they go down to Sheol.
verses.textEnNkjv: They spend their days in wealth, And in a moment go down to the grave.
verses.textEnNlt: They spend their days in prosperity, then go down to the grave in peace.
verses.textEnNasb: "They spend their days in prosperity, And suddenly they go down to Sheol.
verses.textEn: They spend their years in prosperity and go down to the grave in peace.

verses.textZh: 然而他们对神说：‘离开我们吧， 我们不愿意晓得你的道路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而他们对神说：‘离开我们吧， 我们不愿意晓得你的道路。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们对神说：离开我们吧！ 我们不愿晓得你的道。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet they say to God, ‘Leave us alone! We have no desire to know your ways.
verses.textEnEsv: They say to God, ‘Depart from us! We do not desire the knowledge of your ways.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet they say to God, ‘Depart from us, For we do not desire the knowledge of Your ways.
verses.textEnNlt: And yet they say to God, ‘Go away. We want no part of you and your ways.
verses.textEnNasb: "Yet they say to God, ‘Go away from us! We do not even desire the knowledge of Your ways.
verses.textEn: Yet they say to God, ‘Leave us alone! We have no desire to know your ways.

verses.textZh: 全能者是谁，竟要我们服事他呢？ 我们若向他恳求，有甚么益处呢？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 全能者是谁，竟要我们服事他呢？ 我们若向他恳求，有甚么益处呢？’
verses.textZhCuv: 全能者是谁，我们何必事奉他呢？ 求告他有什么益处呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Who is the Almighty, that we should serve him? What would we gain by praying to him?’
verses.textEnEsv: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? And what profit do we get if we pray to him?’
verses.textEnNkjv: Who is the Almighty, that we should serve Him? And what profit do we have if we pray to Him?’
verses.textEnNlt: Who is the Almighty, and why should we obey him? What good will it do us to pray?’
verses.textEnNasb: ‘ Who is the Almighty, that we should serve Him, And what would we gain if we plead with Him?’
verses.textEn: Who is the Almighty, that we should serve him? What would we gain by praying to him?’

verses.textZh: 他们的福乐岂不是掌握在他们的手中？ 恶人的谋算离我很远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的福乐岂不是掌握在他们的手中？ 恶人的谋算离我很远。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，他们亨通不在乎自己； 恶人所谋定的离我好远。
verses.textEnNiv: But their prosperity is not in their own hands, so I stand aloof from the plans of the wicked.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, is not their prosperity in their hand? The counsel of the wicked is far from me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed their prosperity is not in their hand; The counsel of the wicked is far from me.
verses.textEnNlt: (They think their prosperity is of their own doing, but I will have nothing to do with that kind of thinking.)
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, their prosperity is not in their hand; The advice of the wicked is far from me.
verses.textEn: But their prosperity is not in their own hands, so I stand aloof from the plans of the wicked.

verses.textZh: 恶人的灯何尝熄灭？ 灾难何尝临到他们身上？神何尝在忿怒中把痛苦分给他们！
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人的灯何尝熄灭？ 灾难何尝临到他们身上？神何尝在忿怒中把痛苦分给他们！
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人的灯何尝熄灭？ 患难何尝临到他们呢？神何尝发怒，向他们分散灾祸呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "Yet how often is the lamp of the wicked snuffed out? How often does calamity come upon them, the fate God allots in his anger?
verses.textEnEsv: "How often is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out? That their calamity comes upon them? That God distributes pains in his anger?
verses.textEnNkjv: "How often is the lamp of the wicked put out? Howoften does their destruction come upon them, The sorrows God distributes in His anger?
verses.textEnNlt: "Yet the light of the wicked never seems to be extinguished. Do they ever have trouble? Does God distribute sorrows to them in anger?
verses.textEnNasb: "How often is the lamp of the wicked put out, Or does their disaster fall on them? Does God apportion destruction in His anger?
verses.textEn: "Yet how often is the lamp of the wicked snuffed out? How often does calamity come upon them, the fate God allots in his anger?

verses.textZh: 他们何尝像风前的干草， 何尝像暴风刮去的糠秕？
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们何尝像风前的干草， 何尝像暴风刮去的糠秕？
verses.textZhCuv: 他们何尝像风前的碎秸， 如暴风刮去的糠秕呢？
verses.textEnNiv: How often are they like straw before the wind, like chaff swept away by a gale?
verses.textEnEsv: That they are like straw before the wind, and like chaff that the storm carries away?
verses.textEnNkjv: They are like straw before the wind, And like chaff that a storm carries away.
verses.textEnNlt: Are they driven before the wind like straw? Are they carried away by the storm like chaff? Not at all!
verses.textEnNasb: "Are they as straw before the wind, And like chaff which the storm carries away?
verses.textEn: How often are they like straw before the wind, like chaff swept away by a gale?

verses.textZh: 你们说：‘神为恶人的儿女积蓄罪孽’， 我却说：‘神报应他本人，好叫他自己明白。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们说：‘神为恶人的儿女积蓄罪孽’， 我却说：‘神报应他本人，好叫他自己明白。’
verses.textZhCuv: 你们说：神为恶人的儿女积蓄罪孽； 我说：不如本人受报，好使他亲自知道。
verses.textEnNiv: It is said, ‘God stores up the punishment of the wicked for their children.’ Let him repay the wicked, so that they themselves will experience it!
verses.textEnEsv: You say, ‘God stores up their iniquity for their children.’ Let him pay it out to them, that they may know it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Theysay, ‘God lays up one’s iniquity for his children’; Let Him recompense him, that he may know it.
verses.textEnNlt: "‘Well,’ you say, ‘at least God will punish their children!’ But I say he should punish the ones who sin, so that they understand his judgment.
verses.textEnNasb: "You say, ‘God saves up a person’s wrongdoing for his sons.’ Let God repay him so that he may know it.
verses.textEn: It is said, ‘God stores up the punishment of the wicked for their children.’ Let him repay the wicked, so that they themselves will experience it!

verses.textZh: 愿他亲眼看见自己败落， 愿他喝全能者的烈怒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿他亲眼看见自己败落， 愿他喝全能者的烈怒。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿他亲眼看见自己败亡， 亲自饮全能者的忿怒。
verses.textEnNiv: Let their own eyes see their destruction; let them drink the cup of the wrath of the Almighty.
verses.textEnEsv: Let their own eyes see their destruction, and let them drink of the wrath of the Almighty.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let his eyes see his destruction, And let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty.
verses.textEnNlt: Let them see their destruction with their own eyes. Let them drink deeply of the anger of the Almighty.
verses.textEnNasb: "Let his own eyes see his destruction, And let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty.
verses.textEn: Let their own eyes see their destruction; let them drink the cup of the wrath of the Almighty.

verses.textZh: 他的岁月既然断绝， 他还会看顾自己身后的家吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的岁月既然断绝， 他还会看顾自己身后的家吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 他的岁月既尽， 他还顾他本家吗？
verses.textEnNiv: For what do they care about the families they leave behind when their allotted months come to an end?
verses.textEnEsv: For what do they care for their houses after them, when the number of their months is cut off?
verses.textEnNkjv: For what does he care about his household after him, When the number of his months is cut in half?
verses.textEnNlt: For they will not care what happens to their family after they are dead.
verses.textEnNasb: "For what does he care about his household after him, When the number of his months is at an end?
verses.textEn: For what do they care about the families they leave behind when their allotted months come to an end?

verses.textZh: 神既然审判那些在高位的， 谁能把甚么知识教给他呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 神既然审判那些在高位的， 谁能把甚么知识教给他呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 神既审判那在高位的， 谁能将知识教训他呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "Can anyone teach knowledge to God, since he judges even the highest?
verses.textEnEsv: Will any teach God knowledge, seeing that he judges those who are on high?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Can anyone teach God knowledge, Since He judges those on high?
verses.textEnNlt: "But who can teach a lesson to God, since he judges even the most powerful?
verses.textEnNasb: "Can anyone teach God knowledge, In that He judges those on high?
verses.textEn: "Can anyone teach knowledge to God, since he judges even the highest?

verses.textZh: 有人到死的时候仍然气力充足， 享尽平静与安逸；
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人到死的时候仍然气力充足， 享尽平静与安逸；
verses.textZhCuv: 有人至死身体强壮， 尽得平靖安逸；
verses.textEnNiv: One person dies in full vigor, completely secure and at ease,
verses.textEnEsv: One dies in his full vigor, being wholly at ease and secure,
verses.textEnNkjv: One dies in his full strength, Being wholly at ease and secure;
verses.textEnNlt: One person dies in prosperity, completely comfortable and secure,
verses.textEnNasb: "One dies in his full strength, Being wholly undisturbed and at ease;
verses.textEn: One person dies in full vigor, completely secure and at ease,

verses.textZh: 他的奶桶充满鲜奶， 他的骨髓滋润。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的奶桶充满鲜奶， 他的骨髓滋润。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的奶桶充满， 他的骨髓滋润。
verses.textEnNiv: well nourished in body, bones rich with marrow.
verses.textEnEsv: his pails full of milk and the marrow of his bones moist.
verses.textEnNkjv: His pails are full of milk, And the marrow of his bones is moist.
verses.textEnNlt: the picture of good health, vigorous and fit.
verses.textEnNasb: His sides are filled with fat, And the marrow of his bones is wet,
verses.textEn: well nourished in body, bones rich with marrow.

verses.textZh: 有人到死的时候心里痛苦， 一生未尝美食；
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人到死的时候心里痛苦， 一生未尝美食；
verses.textZhCuv: 有人至死心中痛苦， 终身未尝福乐的滋味；
verses.textEnNiv: Another dies in bitterness of soul, never having enjoyed anything good.
verses.textEnEsv: Another dies in bitterness of soul, never having tasted of prosperity.
verses.textEnNkjv: Another man dies in the bitterness of his soul, Never having eaten with pleasure.
verses.textEnNlt: Another person dies in bitter poverty, never having tasted the good life.
verses.textEnNasb: While another dies with a bitter soul, Never even tasting anything good.
verses.textEn: Another dies in bitterness of soul, never having enjoyed anything good.

verses.textZh: 他们都一起躺在尘土中， 虫子爬满他们身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们都一起躺在尘土中， 虫子爬满他们身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们一样躺卧在尘土中， 都被虫子遮盖。
verses.textEnNiv: Side by side they lie in the dust, and worms cover them both.
verses.textEnEsv: They lie down alike in the dust, and the worms cover them.
verses.textEnNkjv: They lie down alike in the dust, And worms cover them.
verses.textEnNlt: But both are buried in the same dust, both eaten by the same maggots.
verses.textEnNasb: "Together they lie down in the dust, And maggots cover them.
verses.textEn: Side by side they lie in the dust, and worms cover them both.

verses.textZh: 我知道你们的心思， 与你们恶待我的计谋。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我知道你们的心思， 与你们恶待我的计谋。
verses.textZhCuv: 我知道你们的意思， 并诬害我的计谋。
verses.textEnNiv: "I know full well what you are thinking, the schemes by which you would wrong me.
verses.textEnEsv: "Behold, I know your thoughts and your schemes to wrong me.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Look, I know your thoughts, And the schemes withwhich you would wrong me.
verses.textEnNlt: "Look, I know what you’re thinking. I know the schemes you plot against me.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, I know your thoughts, And the plots you devise against me.
verses.textEn: "I know full well what you are thinking, the schemes by which you would wrong me.

verses.textZh: 你们问：‘霸王的房屋在哪里？ 恶人住过的帐棚在哪里？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们问：‘霸王的房屋在哪里？ 恶人住过的帐棚在哪里？’
verses.textZhCuv: 你们说：霸者的房屋在哪里？ 恶人住过的帐棚在哪里？
verses.textEnNiv: You say, ‘Where now is the house of the great, the tents where the wicked lived?’
verses.textEnEsv: For you say, ‘Where is the house of the prince? Where is the tent in which the wicked lived?’
verses.textEnNkjv: For you say, ‘Where is the house of the prince? And where is the tent, The dwelling place of the wicked?’
verses.textEnNlt: You will tell me of rich and wicked people whose houses have vanished because of their sins.
verses.textEnNasb: "For you say, ‘Where is the house of the nobleman, And where is the tent, the dwelling places of the wicked?’
verses.textEn: You say, ‘Where now is the house of the great, the tents where the wicked lived?’

verses.textZh: 你们没有问问过路的人吗？ 不承认他们所提的证据吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们没有问问过路的人吗？ 不承认他们所提的证据吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们岂没有询问过路的人吗？ 不知道他们所引的证据吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Have you never questioned those who travel? Have you paid no regard to their accounts—
verses.textEnEsv: Have you not asked those who travel the roads, and do you not accept their testimony
verses.textEnNkjv: Have you not asked those who travel the road? And do you not know their signs?
verses.textEnNlt: But ask those who have been around, and they will tell you the truth.
verses.textEnNasb: "Have you not asked travelers, And do you not examine their evidence?
verses.textEn: Have you never questioned those who travel? Have you paid no regard to their accounts—

verses.textZh: 就是恶人在灾难的日子得存留， 在神发怒的时候得逃脱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是恶人在灾难的日子得存留， 在神发怒的时候得逃脱。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是恶人在祸患的日子得存留， 在发怒的日子得逃脱。
verses.textEnNiv: that the wicked are spared from the day of calamity, that they are delivered from the day of wrath?
verses.textEnEsv: that the evil man is spared in the day of calamity, that he is rescued in the day of wrath?
verses.textEnNkjv: For the wicked are reserved for the day of doom; They shall be brought out on the day of wrath.
verses.textEnNlt: Evil people are spared in times of calamity and are allowed to escape disaster.
verses.textEnNasb: "For the wicked person is spared a day of disaster; They are led away from a day of fury.
verses.textEn: that the wicked are spared from the day of calamity, that they are delivered from the day of wrath?

verses.textZh: 他所行的，有谁敢当面指责他呢？ 他所作的，有谁能报应他呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 他所行的，有谁敢当面指责他呢？ 他所作的，有谁能报应他呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 他所行的，有谁当面给他说明？ 他所做的，有谁报应他呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Who denounces their conduct to their face? Who repays them for what they have done?
verses.textEnEsv: Who declares his way to his face, and who repays him for what he has done?
verses.textEnNkjv: Who condemns his way to his face? And who repays him forwhat he has done?
verses.textEnNlt: No one criticizes them openly or pays them back for what they have done.
verses.textEnNasb: "Who confronts him with his actions, And who repays him for what he has done?
verses.textEn: Who denounces their conduct to their face? Who repays them for what they have done?

verses.textZh: 然而他被人抬到坟墓里， 并且有人看守他的墓地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而他被人抬到坟墓里， 并且有人看守他的墓地。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而他要被抬到茔地； 并有人看守坟墓。
verses.textEnNiv: They are carried to the grave, and watch is kept over their tombs.
verses.textEnEsv: When he is carried to the grave, watch is kept over his tomb.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet he shall be brought to the grave, And a vigil kept over the tomb.
verses.textEnNlt: When they are carried to the grave, an honor guard keeps watch at their tomb.
verses.textEnNasb: "When he is carried to the grave, People will keep watch over his tomb.
verses.textEn: They are carried to the grave, and watch is kept over their tombs.

verses.textZh: 他以谷中的土块为甘甜， 所有的人跟在他后面， 走在他前面的不计其数。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他以谷中的土块为甘甜， 所有的人跟在他后面， 走在他前面的不计其数。
verses.textZhCuv: 他要以谷中的土块为甘甜； 在他以先去的无数， 在他以后去的更多。
verses.textEnNiv: The soil in the valley is sweet to them; everyone follows after them, and a countless throng goes before them.
verses.textEnEsv: The clods of the valley are sweet to him; all mankind follows after him, and those who go before him are innumerable.
verses.textEnNkjv: The clods of the valley shall be sweet to him; Everyone shall follow him, As countless havegone before him.
verses.textEnNlt: A great funeral procession goes to the cemetery. Many pay their respects as the body is laid to rest, and the earth gives sweet repose.
verses.textEnNasb: "The clods of the valley will gently cover him; Moreover, all mankind will follow after him, While countless others go before him.
verses.textEn: The soil in the valley is sweet to them; everyone follows after them, and a countless throng goes before them.

verses.textZh: 你们的回话既然只存虚假， 怎样徒然安慰我呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们的回话既然只存虚假， 怎样徒然安慰我呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们对答的话中既都错谬， 怎么徒然安慰我呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "So how can you console me with your nonsense? Nothing is left of your answers but falsehood!"
verses.textEnEsv: How then will you comfort me with empty nothings? There is nothing left of your answers but falsehood."
verses.textEnNkjv: How then can you comfort me with empty words, Since falsehood remains in your answers?"
verses.textEnNlt: "How can your empty clichés comfort me? All your explanations are lies!"
verses.textEnNasb: "So how dare you give me empty comfort? For your answers remain nothing but falsehood!"
verses.textEn: "So how can you console me with your nonsense? Nothing is left of your answers but falsehood!"

verses.textZh: 提幔人以利法回答说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 提幔人以利法回答说：
verses.textZhCuv: 提幔人以利法回答说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then Eliphaz the Temanite replied:
verses.textEnEsv: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said:
verses.textEnNlt: Then Eliphaz the Temanite replied:
verses.textEnNasb: Then Eliphaz the Temanite responded,
verses.textEn: Then Eliphaz the Temanite replied:

verses.textZh: "人对神能有甚么益处呢？ 明智的人只能益己。
verses.textZhCnvs: "人对神能有甚么益处呢？ 明智的人只能益己。
verses.textZhCuv: 人岂能使神有益呢？ 智慧人但能有益于己。
verses.textEnNiv: "Can a man be of benefit to God? Can even a wise person benefit him?
verses.textEnEsv: "Can a man be profitable to God? Surely he who is wise is profitable to himself.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Can a man be profitable to God, Though he who is wise may be profitable to himself?
verses.textEnNlt: "Can a person do anything to help God? Can even a wise person be helpful to him?
verses.textEnNasb: "Can a strong man be of use to God, Or a wise one be useful to himself?
verses.textEn: "Can a man be of benefit to God? Can even a wise person benefit him?

verses.textZh: 你为人公义可讨全能者喜悦吗？ 你行为完全可有利于他呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你为人公义可讨全能者喜悦吗？ 你行为完全可有利于他呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你为人公义，岂叫全能者喜悦呢？ 你行为完全，岂能使他得利呢？
verses.textEnNiv: What pleasure would it give the Almighty if you were righteous? What would he gain if your ways were blameless?
verses.textEnEsv: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty if you are in the right, or is it gain to him if you make your ways blameless?
verses.textEnNkjv: Isit any pleasure to the Almighty that you are righteous? Or isit gain toHim that you make your ways blameless?
verses.textEnNlt: Is it any advantage to the Almighty if you are righteous? Would it be any gain to him if you were perfect?
verses.textEnNasb: "Is it any pleasure to the Almighty if you are righteous, Or gain if you make your ways blameless?
verses.textEn: What pleasure would it give the Almighty if you were righteous? What would he gain if your ways were blameless?

verses.textZh: 他是因你敬畏他而责备你， 对你施行审判吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 他是因你敬畏他而责备你， 对你施行审判吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 岂是因你敬畏他 就责备你、审判你吗？
verses.textEnNiv: "Is it for your piety that he rebukes you and brings charges against you?
verses.textEnEsv: Is it for your fear of him that he reproves you and enters into judgment with you?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Is it because of your fear of Him that He corrects you, And enters into judgment with you?
verses.textEnNlt: Is it because you’re so pious that he accuses you and brings judgment against you?
verses.textEnNasb: "Is it because of your reverence that He punishes you, That He enters into judgment against you?
verses.textEn: "Is it for your piety that he rebukes you and brings charges against you?

verses.textZh: 你的罪恶不是很大吗？ 你的罪孽不是没有穷尽吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的罪恶不是很大吗？ 你的罪孽不是没有穷尽吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你的罪恶岂不是大吗？ 你的罪孽也没有穷尽；
verses.textEnNiv: Is not your wickedness great? Are not your sins endless?
verses.textEnEsv: Is not your evil abundant? There is no end to your iniquities.
verses.textEnNkjv: Is not your wickedness great, And your iniquity without end?
verses.textEnNlt: No, it’s because of your wickedness! There’s no limit to your sins.
verses.textEnNasb: "Is your wickedness not abundant, And is there no end to your guilty deeds?
verses.textEn: Is not your wickedness great? Are not your sins endless?

verses.textZh: 你无缘无故强取兄弟的东西作当头， 剥去衣不蔽体的人的衣服。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你无缘无故强取兄弟的东西作当头， 剥去衣不蔽体的人的衣服。
verses.textZhCuv: 因你无故强取弟兄的物为当头， 剥去贫寒人的衣服。
verses.textEnNiv: You demanded security from your relatives for no reason; you stripped people of their clothing, leaving them naked.
verses.textEnEsv: For you have exacted pledges of your brothers for nothing and stripped the naked of their clothing.
verses.textEnNkjv: For you have taken pledges from your brother for no reason, And stripped the naked of their clothing.
verses.textEnNlt: "For example, you must have lent money to your friend and demanded clothing as security. Yes, you stripped him to the bone.
verses.textEnNasb: "For you have seized pledges from your brothers without cause, And stripped people naked.
verses.textEn: You demanded security from your relatives for no reason; you stripped people of their clothing, leaving them naked.

verses.textZh: 疲乏的人你没有给他水喝， 饥饿的人你没有给他饭吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 疲乏的人你没有给他水喝， 饥饿的人你没有给他饭吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 困乏的人，你没有给他水喝； 饥饿的人，你没有给他食物。
verses.textEnNiv: You gave no water to the weary and you withheld food from the hungry,
verses.textEnEsv: You have given no water to the weary to drink, and you have withheld bread from the hungry.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have not given the weary water to drink, And you have withheld bread from the hungry.
verses.textEnNlt: You must have refused water for the thirsty and food for the hungry.
verses.textEnNasb: "You have given the weary no water to drink, And you have withheld bread from the hungry.
verses.textEn: You gave no water to the weary and you withheld food from the hungry,

verses.textZh: 有势力的人就有土地， 尊贵的人住在其中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有势力的人就有土地， 尊贵的人住在其中。
verses.textZhCuv: 有能力的人就得地土； 尊贵的人也住在其中。
verses.textEnNiv: though you were a powerful man, owning land— an honored man, living on it.
verses.textEnEsv: The man with power possessed the land, and the favored man lived in it.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the mighty man possessed the land, And the honorable man dwelt in it.
verses.textEnNlt: You probably think the land belongs to the powerful and only the privileged have a right to it!
verses.textEnNasb: "But the earth belongs to the powerful man, And the one who is honorable dwells on it.
verses.textEn: though you were a powerful man, owning land— an honored man, living on it.

verses.textZh: 你叫寡妇空手而去，你折断孤儿的膀臂。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你叫寡妇空手而去，你折断孤儿的膀臂。
verses.textZhCuv: 你打发寡妇空手回去， 折断孤儿的膀臂。
verses.textEnNiv: And you sent widows away empty-handed and broke the strength of the fatherless.
verses.textEnEsv: You have sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless were crushed.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have sent widows away empty, And the strength of the fatherless was crushed.
verses.textEnNlt: You must have sent widows away empty-handed and crushed the hopes of orphans.
verses.textEnNasb: "You have sent widows away empty, And the strength of orphans has been crushed.
verses.textEn: And you sent widows away empty-handed and broke the strength of the fatherless.

verses.textZh: 因此有网罗环绕着你， 恐惧也忽然使你惊慌。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此有网罗环绕着你， 恐惧也忽然使你惊慌。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，有网罗环绕你， 有恐惧忽然使你惊惶；
verses.textEnNiv: That is why snares are all around you, why sudden peril terrifies you,
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore snares are all around you, and sudden terror overwhelms you,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore snares are all around you, And sudden fear troubles you,
verses.textEnNlt: That is why you are surrounded by traps and tremble from sudden fears.
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore traps surround you, And sudden dread terrifies you,
verses.textEn: That is why snares are all around you, why sudden peril terrifies you,

verses.textZh: 光明变成黑暗，以致你看不见， 并且洪水淹没你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 光明变成黑暗，以致你看不见， 并且洪水淹没你。
verses.textZhCuv: 或有黑暗蒙蔽你， 并有洪水淹没你。
verses.textEnNiv: why it is so dark you cannot see, and why a flood of water covers you.
verses.textEnEsv: or darkness, so that you cannot see, and a flood of water covers you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Or darkness sothat you cannot see; And an abundance of water covers you.
verses.textEnNlt: That is why you cannot see in the darkness, and waves of water cover you.
verses.textEnNasb: Or darkness, so that you cannot see, And a flood of water covers you.
verses.textEn: why it is so dark you cannot see, and why a flood of water covers you.

verses.textZh: 神不是高于诸天吗？ 你看看最高的星星，多么的高啊！
verses.textZhCnvs: 神不是高于诸天吗？ 你看看最高的星星，多么的高啊！
verses.textZhCuv: 神岂不是在高天吗？ 你看星宿何其高呢！
verses.textEnNiv: "Is not God in the heights of heaven? And see how lofty are the highest stars!
verses.textEnEsv: "Is not God high in the heavens? See the highest stars, how lofty they are!
verses.textEnNkjv: "Is not God in the height of heaven? And see the highest stars, how lofty they are!
verses.textEnNlt: "God is so great—higher than the heavens, higher than the farthest stars.
verses.textEnNasb: "Is God not in the height of heaven? Look also at the highest stars, how high they are!
verses.textEn: "Is not God in the heights of heaven? And see how lofty are the highest stars!

verses.textZh: 你说：‘神知道甚么？ 他能透过幽暗施行审判吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你说：‘神知道甚么？ 他能透过幽暗施行审判吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你说：神知道什么？ 他岂能看透幽暗施行审判呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Yet you say, ‘What does God know? Does he judge through such darkness?
verses.textEnEsv: But you say, ‘What does God know? Can he judge through the deep darkness?
verses.textEnNkjv: And you say, ‘What does God know? Can He judge through the deep darkness?
verses.textEnNlt: But you reply, ‘That’s why God can’t see what I am doing! How can he judge through the thick darkness?
verses.textEnNasb: "But you say, ‘What does God know? Can He judge through the thick darkness?
verses.textEn: Yet you say, ‘What does God know? Does he judge through such darkness?

verses.textZh: 密云把他遮盖，使他不能看见我们； 他在天上的圆圈上面走来走去。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 密云把他遮盖，使他不能看见我们； 他在天上的圆圈上面走来走去。’
verses.textZhCuv: 密云将他遮盖，使他不能看见； 他周游穹苍。
verses.textEnNiv: Thick clouds veil him, so he does not see us as he goes about in the vaulted heavens.’
verses.textEnEsv: Thick clouds veil him, so that he does not see, and he walks on the vault of heaven.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Thick clouds cover Him, so that He cannot see, And He walks above the circle of heaven.’
verses.textEnNlt: For thick clouds swirl about him, and he cannot see us. He is way up there, walking on the vault of heaven.’
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Clouds are a hiding place for Him, so that He cannot see; And He walks on the vault of heaven.’
verses.textEn: Thick clouds veil him, so he does not see us as he goes about in the vaulted heavens.’

verses.textZh: 你要谨守古往的道， 就是恶人所行走的吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要谨守古往的道， 就是恶人所行走的吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你要依从上古的道吗？ 这道是恶人所行的。
verses.textEnNiv: Will you keep to the old path that the wicked have trod?
verses.textEnEsv: Will you keep to the old way that wicked men have trod?
verses.textEnNkjv: Will you keep to the old way Which wicked men have trod,
verses.textEnNlt: "Will you continue on the old paths where evil people have walked?
verses.textEnNasb: "Will you keep to the ancient path Which wicked people have walked,
verses.textEn: Will you keep to the old path that the wicked have trod?

verses.textZh: 他们未到时候，就被抓去， 他们的根基被洪水冲去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们未到时候，就被抓去， 他们的根基被洪水冲去。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们未到死期，忽然除灭； 根基毁坏，好像被江河冲去。
verses.textEnNiv: They were carried off before their time, their foundations washed away by a flood.
verses.textEnEsv: They were snatched away before their time; their foundation was washed away.
verses.textEnNkjv: Who were cut down before their time, Whose foundations were swept away by a flood?
verses.textEnNlt: They were snatched away in the prime of life, the foundations of their lives washed away.
verses.textEnNasb: Who were snatched away before their time, Whose foundations were washed away by a river?
verses.textEn: They were carried off before their time, their foundations washed away by a flood.

verses.textZh: 他们对神说：‘离开我们吧！ 全能者能把我们怎么样呢？’
