verses.textZhCnvs: 他们对神说：‘离开我们吧！ 全能者能把我们怎么样呢？’
verses.textZhCuv: 他们向神说：离开我们吧！ 又说：全能者能把我们怎么样呢？
verses.textEnNiv: They said to God, ‘Leave us alone! What can the Almighty do to us?’
verses.textEnEsv: They said to God, ‘Depart from us,’ and ‘What can the Almighty do to us?’
verses.textEnNkjv: They said to God, ‘Depart from us! What can the Almighty do to them?’
verses.textEnNlt: For they said to God, ‘Leave us alone! What can the Almighty do to us?’
verses.textEnNasb: "They said to God, ‘Go away from us!’ And ‘What can the Almighty do to them?’
verses.textEn: They said to God, ‘Leave us alone! What can the Almighty do to us?’

verses.textZh: 他用美物充满他们的房屋， 恶人的谋算远离我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他用美物充满他们的房屋， 恶人的谋算远离我。
verses.textZhCuv: 哪知神以美物充满他们的房屋； 但恶人所谋定的离我好远。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet it was he who filled their houses with good things, so I stand aloof from the plans of the wicked.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet he filled their houses with good things— but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet He filled their houses with good things; But the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
verses.textEnNlt: Yet he was the one who filled their homes with good things, so I will have nothing to do with that kind of thinking.
verses.textEnNasb: "Yet He filled their houses with good things; But the advice of the wicked is far from me.
verses.textEn: Yet it was he who filled their houses with good things, so I stand aloof from the plans of the wicked.

verses.textZh: 义人看见了，就欢喜； 无辜的人嘲笑他们，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人看见了，就欢喜； 无辜的人嘲笑他们，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 义人看见他们的结局就欢喜； 无辜的人嗤笑他们，
verses.textEnNiv: The righteous see their ruin and rejoice; the innocent mock them, saying,
verses.textEnEsv: The righteous see it and are glad; the innocent one mocks at them,
verses.textEnNkjv: "The righteous see it and are glad, And the innocent laugh at them:
verses.textEnNlt: "The righteous will be happy to see the wicked destroyed, and the innocent will laugh in contempt.
verses.textEnNasb: "The righteous see and are glad, And the innocent mock them, saying,
verses.textEn: The righteous see their ruin and rejoice; the innocent mock them, saying,

verses.textZh: ‘我们的对头必被剪除， 他们剥下来的有火吞灭了。’
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘我们的对头必被剪除， 他们剥下来的有火吞灭了。’
verses.textZhCuv: 说：那起来攻击我们的果然被剪除， 其余的都被火烧灭。
verses.textEnNiv: ‘Surely our foes are destroyed, and fire devours their wealth.’
verses.textEnEsv: saying, ‘Surely our adversaries are cut off, and what they left the fire has consumed.’
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Surely our adversaries are cut down, And the fire consumes their remnant.’
verses.textEnNlt: They will say, ‘See how our enemies have been destroyed. The last of them have been consumed in the fire.’
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Truly our enemies are eliminated, And fire has consumed their abundance.’
verses.textEn: ‘Surely our foes are destroyed, and fire devours their wealth.’

verses.textZh: 你与神和好，就可以得平安， 这样，福乐就必临到你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你与神和好，就可以得平安， 这样，福乐就必临到你。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要认识神，就得平安； 福气也必临到你。
verses.textEnNiv: "Submit to God and be at peace with him; in this way prosperity will come to you.
verses.textEnEsv: "Agree with God, and be at peace; thereby good will come to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now acquaint yourself with Him, and be at peace; Thereby good will come to you.
verses.textEnNlt: "Submit to God, and you will have peace; then things will go well for you.
verses.textEnNasb: "Be reconciled with Him, and be at peace; Thereby good will come to you.
verses.textEn: "Submit to God and be at peace with him; in this way prosperity will come to you.

verses.textZh: 你该从他口中领受训诲， 把他的话放在心里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你该从他口中领受训诲， 把他的话放在心里。
verses.textZhCuv: 你当领受他口中的教训， 将他的言语存在心里。
verses.textEnNiv: Accept instruction from his mouth and lay up his words in your heart.
verses.textEnEsv: Receive instruction from his mouth, and lay up his words in your heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: Receive, please, instruction from His mouth, And lay up His words in your heart.
verses.textEnNlt: Listen to his instructions, and store them in your heart.
verses.textEnNasb: "Please receive instruction from His mouth, And put His words in your heart.
verses.textEn: Accept instruction from his mouth and lay up his words in your heart.

verses.textZh: 你若归向全能者，就必得建立； 你若使不义远离你的帐棚，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你若归向全能者，就必得建立； 你若使不义远离你的帐棚，
verses.textZhCuv: 你若归向全能者，从你帐棚中远除不义， 就必得建立。
verses.textEnNiv: If you return to the Almighty, you will be restored: If you remove wickedness far from your tent
verses.textEnEsv: If you return to the Almighty you will be built up; if you remove injustice far from your tents,
verses.textEnNkjv: If you return to the Almighty, you will be built up; You will remove iniquity far from your tents.
verses.textEnNlt: If you return to the Almighty, you will be restored— so clean up your life.
verses.textEnNasb: "If you return to the Almighty, you will be restored; If you remove injustice far from your tent,
verses.textEn: If you return to the Almighty, you will be restored: If you remove wickedness far from your tent

verses.textZh: 把你的金块丢在尘土中， 把俄斐的金块丢在河流的石头间，
verses.textZhCnvs: 把你的金块丢在尘土中， 把俄斐的金块丢在河流的石头间，
verses.textZhCuv: 要将你的珍宝丢在尘土里， 将俄斐的黄金丢在溪河石头之间；
verses.textEnNiv: and assign your nuggets to the dust, your gold of Ophir to the rocks in the ravines,
verses.textEnEsv: if you lay gold in the dust, and gold of Ophir among the stones of the torrent-bed,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then you will lay your gold in the dust, And the gold of Ophir among the stones of the brooks.
verses.textEnNlt: If you give up your lust for money and throw your precious gold into the river,
verses.textEnNasb: And put your gold in the dust, And the gold of Ophir among the stones of the brooks,
verses.textEn: and assign your nuggets to the dust, your gold of Ophir to the rocks in the ravines,

verses.textZh: 全能者就必作你的金块， 作你的银堆，
verses.textZhCnvs: 全能者就必作你的金块， 作你的银堆，
verses.textZhCuv: 全能者就必为你的珍宝， 作你的宝银。
verses.textEnNiv: then the Almighty will be your gold, the choicest silver for you.
verses.textEnEsv: then the Almighty will be your gold and your precious silver.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yes, the Almighty will be your gold And your precious silver;
verses.textEnNlt: the Almighty himself will be your treasure. He will be your precious silver!
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Almighty will be your gold And abundant silver to you.
verses.textEn: then the Almighty will be your gold, the choicest silver for you.

verses.textZh: 你就必以全能者为乐， 向神仰起脸来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你就必以全能者为乐， 向神仰起脸来。
verses.textZhCuv: 你就要以全能者为喜乐， 向神仰起脸来。
verses.textEnNiv: Surely then you will find delight in the Almighty and will lift up your face to God.
verses.textEnEsv: For then you will delight yourself in the Almighty and lift up your face to God.
verses.textEnNkjv: For then you will have your delight in the Almighty, And lift up your face to God.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then you will take delight in the Almighty and look up to God.
verses.textEnNasb: "For then you will take pleasure in the Almighty And lift up your face to God.
verses.textEn: Surely then you will find delight in the Almighty and will lift up your face to God.

verses.textZh: 你向他祈求，他就垂听你， 你也要还你的愿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你向他祈求，他就垂听你， 你也要还你的愿。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要祷告他，他就听你； 你也要还你的愿。
verses.textEnNiv: You will pray to him, and he will hear you, and you will fulfill your vows.
verses.textEnEsv: You will make your prayer to him, and he will hear you, and you will pay your vows.
verses.textEnNkjv: You will make your prayer to Him, He will hear you, And you will pay your vows.
verses.textEnNlt: You will pray to him, and he will hear you, and you will fulfill your vows to him.
verses.textEnNasb: "You will pray to Him, and He will hear you; And you will pay your vows.
verses.textEn: You will pray to him, and he will hear you, and you will fulfill your vows.

verses.textZh: 你决定的计划，他必为你成全， 光明必照在你的路上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你决定的计划，他必为你成全， 光明必照在你的路上。
verses.textZhCuv: 你定意要做何事，必然给你成就； 亮光也必照耀你的路。
verses.textEnNiv: What you decide on will be done, and light will shine on your ways.
verses.textEnEsv: You will decide on a matter, and it will be established for you, and light will shine on your ways.
verses.textEnNkjv: You will also declare a thing, And it will be established for you; So light will shine on your ways.
verses.textEnNlt: You will succeed in whatever you choose to do, and light will shine on the road ahead of you.
verses.textEnNasb: "You will also decide something, and it will be established for you; And light will shine on your ways.
verses.textEn: What you decide on will be done, and light will shine on your ways.

verses.textZh: 人谦卑的时候，你就说：‘升高吧！’ 眼中谦卑的他必拯救，
verses.textZhCnvs: 人谦卑的时候，你就说：‘升高吧！’ 眼中谦卑的他必拯救，
verses.textZhCuv: 人使你降卑，你仍可说：必得高升； 谦卑的人，神必然拯救。
verses.textEnNiv: When people are brought low and you say, ‘Lift them up!’ then he will save the downcast.
verses.textEnEsv: For when they are humbled you say, ‘It is because of pride’; but he saves the lowly.
verses.textEnNkjv: When they cast you down, and you say, ‘Exaltation willcome!’ Then He will save the humble person.
verses.textEnNlt: If people are in trouble and you say, ‘Help them,’ God will save them.
verses.textEnNasb: "When they have brought you low, you will speak with confidence, And He will save the humble person.
verses.textEn: When people are brought low and you say, ‘Lift them up!’ then he will save the downcast.

verses.textZh: 并非无辜的人，神尚且搭救他； 他要因你手中的洁净得救拔。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 并非无辜的人，神尚且搭救他； 他要因你手中的洁净得救拔。"
verses.textZhCuv: 人非无辜，神且要搭救他； 他因你手中清洁，必蒙拯救。
verses.textEnNiv: He will deliver even one who is not innocent, who will be delivered through the cleanness of your hands."
verses.textEnEsv: He delivers even the one who is not innocent, who will be delivered through the cleanness of your hands."
verses.textEnNkjv: He will even deliver one who is not innocent; Yes, he will be delivered by the purity of your hands."
verses.textEnNlt: Even sinners will be rescued; they will be rescued because your hands are pure."
verses.textEnNasb: "He will rescue one who is not innocent, And he will be rescued due to the cleanness of your hands."
verses.textEn: He will deliver even one who is not innocent, who will be delivered through the cleanness of your hands."

verses.textZh: 约伯回答说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 约伯回答说：
verses.textZhCuv: 约伯回答说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then Job replied:
verses.textEnEsv: Then Job answered and said:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Job answered and said:
verses.textEnNlt: Then Job spoke again:
verses.textEnNasb: Then Job responded,
verses.textEn: Then Job replied:

verses.textZh: "直到今日我还有苦情要申诉， 我虽然叹息，他的手仍然沉重。
verses.textZhCnvs: "直到今日我还有苦情要申诉， 我虽然叹息，他的手仍然沉重。
verses.textZhCuv: 如今我的哀告还算为悖逆； 我的责罚比我的唉哼还重。
verses.textEnNiv: "Even today my complaint is bitter; his hand is heavy in spite of my groaning.
verses.textEnEsv: "Today also my complaint is bitter; my hand is heavy on account of my groaning.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Even today my complaint is bitter; My hand is listless because of my groaning.
verses.textEnNlt: "My complaint today is still a bitter one, and I try hard not to groan aloud.
verses.textEnNasb: "Even today my complaint is rebellion; His hand is heavy despite my groaning.
verses.textEn: "Even today my complaint is bitter; his hand is heavy in spite of my groaning.

verses.textZh: 但愿我知道怎样能寻见神， 能到他的台前来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但愿我知道怎样能寻见神， 能到他的台前来。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟愿我能知道在哪里可以寻见神， 能到他的台前，
verses.textEnNiv: If only I knew where to find him; if only I could go to his dwelling!
verses.textEnEsv: Oh, that I knew where I might find him, that I might come even to his seat!
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, that I knew where I might find Him, That I might come to His seat!
verses.textEnNlt: If only I knew where to find God, I would go to his court.
verses.textEnNasb: "Oh that I knew how to find Him, That I might come to His home!
verses.textEn: If only I knew where to find him; if only I could go to his dwelling!

verses.textZh: 好让我在他面前呈上我的案件， 满口辩论向他申诉；
verses.textZhCnvs: 好让我在他面前呈上我的案件， 满口辩论向他申诉；
verses.textZhCuv: 我就在他面前将我的案件陈明， 满口辩白。
verses.textEnNiv: I would state my case before him and fill my mouth with arguments.
verses.textEnEsv: I would lay my case before him and fill my mouth with arguments.
verses.textEnNkjv: I would present my case before Him, And fill my mouth with arguments.
verses.textEnNlt: I would lay out my case and present my arguments.
verses.textEnNasb: "I would present my case before Him And fill my mouth with arguments.
verses.textEn: I would state my case before him and fill my mouth with arguments.

verses.textZh: 知道他要回答我的话， 明白他对我说甚么。
verses.textZhCnvs: 知道他要回答我的话， 明白他对我说甚么。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必知道他回答我的言语， 明白他向我所说的话。
verses.textEnNiv: I would find out what he would answer me, and consider what he would say to me.
verses.textEnEsv: I would know what he would answer me and understand what he would say to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: I would know the words which He would answer me, And understand what He would say to me.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I would listen to his reply and understand what he says to me.
verses.textEnNasb: "I would learn the words which He would answer, And perceive what He would tell me.
verses.textEn: I would find out what he would answer me, and consider what he would say to me.

verses.textZh: 他会以大能与我相争吗？ 必不会这样，他必关怀我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他会以大能与我相争吗？ 必不会这样，他必关怀我。
verses.textZhCuv: 他岂用大能与我争辩吗？ 必不这样！他必理会我。
verses.textEnNiv: Would he vigorously oppose me? No, he would not press charges against me.
verses.textEnEsv: Would he contend with me in the greatness of his power? No; he would pay attention to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Would He contend with me in His great power? No! But He would take note of me.
verses.textEnNlt: Would he use his great power to argue with me? No, he would give me a fair hearing.
verses.textEnNasb: "Would He contend with me by the greatness of His power? No, surely He would pay attention to me.
verses.textEn: Would he vigorously oppose me? No, he would not press charges against me.

verses.textZh: 在他那里正直人可以与他彼此辩论， 这样，我就必永远摆脱那审判我的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在他那里正直人可以与他彼此辩论， 这样，我就必永远摆脱那审判我的。
verses.textZhCuv: 在他那里正直人可以与他辩论； 这样，我必永远脱离那审判我的。
verses.textEnNiv: There the upright can establish their innocence before him, and there I would be delivered forever from my judge.
verses.textEnEsv: There an upright man could argue with him, and I would be acquitted forever by my judge.
verses.textEnNkjv: There the upright could reason with Him, And I would be delivered forever from my Judge.
verses.textEnNlt: Honest people can reason with him, so I would be forever acquitted by my judge.
verses.textEnNasb: "There the upright would argue with Him; And I would be free of my Judge forever.
verses.textEn: There the upright can establish their innocence before him, and there I would be delivered forever from my judge.

verses.textZh: 可是我往前走，他不在那里； 我若往后退，我也不能见他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是我往前走，他不在那里； 我若往后退，我也不能见他。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是，我往前行，他不在那里， 往后退，也不能见他。
verses.textEnNiv: "But if I go to the east, he is not there; if I go to the west, I do not find him.
verses.textEnEsv: "Behold, I go forward, but he is not there, and backward, but I do not perceive him;
verses.textEnNkjv: "Look, I go forward, but He is not there, And backward, but I cannot perceive Him;
verses.textEnNlt: I go east, but he is not there. I go west, but I cannot find him.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, I go forward but He is not there, And backward, but I cannot perceive Him;
verses.textEn: "But if I go to the east, he is not there; if I go to the west, I do not find him.

verses.textZh: 他在左边行事，我却见不到； 他在右边隐藏，我却看不见。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在左边行事，我却见不到； 他在右边隐藏，我却看不见。
verses.textZhCuv: 他在左边行事，我却不能看见， 在右边隐藏，我也不能见他。
verses.textEnNiv: When he is at work in the north, I do not see him; when he turns to the south, I catch no glimpse of him.
verses.textEnEsv: on the left hand when he is working, I do not behold him; he turns to the right hand, but I do not see him.
verses.textEnNkjv: When He works on the left hand, I cannot behold Him; When He turns to the right hand, I cannot see Him.
verses.textEnNlt: I do not see him in the north, for he is hidden. I look to the south, but he is concealed.
verses.textEnNasb: When He acts on the left, I cannot see Him; He turns to the right, but I cannot see Him.
verses.textEn: When he is at work in the north, I do not see him; when he turns to the south, I catch no glimpse of him.

verses.textZh: 可是他知道我所行的道路， 他试炼我以后，我必像精金出现。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是他知道我所行的道路， 他试炼我以后，我必像精金出现。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而他知道我所行的路； 他试炼我之后，我必如精金。
verses.textEnNiv: But he knows the way that I take; when he has tested me, I will come forth as gold.
verses.textEnEsv: But he knows the way that I take; when he has tried me, I shall come out as gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: But He knows the way that I take; When He has tested me, I shall come forth as gold.
verses.textEnNlt: "But he knows where I am going. And when he tests me, I will come out as pure as gold.
verses.textEnNasb: "But He knows the way I take; When He has put me to the test, I will come out as gold.
verses.textEn: But he knows the way that I take; when he has tested me, I will come forth as gold.

verses.textZh: 我的脚紧随他的脚步， 我谨守他的道，并不偏离。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的脚紧随他的脚步， 我谨守他的道，并不偏离。
verses.textZhCuv: 我脚追随他的步履； 我谨守他的道，并不偏离。
verses.textEnNiv: My feet have closely followed his steps; I have kept to his way without turning aside.
verses.textEnEsv: My foot has held fast to his steps; I have kept his way and have not turned aside.
verses.textEnNkjv: My foot has held fast to His steps; I have kept His way and not turned aside.
verses.textEnNlt: For I have stayed on God’s paths; I have followed his ways and not turned aside.
verses.textEnNasb: "My foot has held on to His path; I have kept His way and not turned aside.
verses.textEn: My feet have closely followed his steps; I have kept to his way without turning aside.

verses.textZh: 他嘴唇的命令我没有离弃， 我珍藏他口中的言语， 胜过我需用的饮食 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他嘴唇的命令我没有离弃， 我珍藏他口中的言语， 胜过我需用的饮食 。
verses.textZhCuv: 他嘴唇的命令，我未曾背弃； 我看重他口中的言语，过于我需用的饮食。
verses.textEnNiv: I have not departed from the commands of his lips; I have treasured the words of his mouth more than my daily bread.
verses.textEnEsv: I have not departed from the commandment of his lips; I have treasured the words of his mouth more than my portion of food.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have not departed from the commandment of His lips; I have treasured the words of His mouth More than my necessary food.
verses.textEnNlt: I have not departed from his commands, but have treasured his words more than daily food.
verses.textEnNasb: "I have not failed the command of His lips; I have treasured the words of His mouth more than my necessary food.
verses.textEn: I have not departed from the commands of his lips; I have treasured the words of his mouth more than my daily bread.

verses.textZh: 但是他既已定意，谁能使他转意呢？ 他心里所愿的，就行出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是他既已定意，谁能使他转意呢？ 他心里所愿的，就行出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是他心志已定，谁能使他转意呢？ 他心里所愿的，就行出来。
verses.textEnNiv: "But he stands alone, and who can oppose him? He does whatever he pleases.
verses.textEnEsv: But he is unchangeable, and who can turn him back? What he desires, that he does.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But He is unique, and who can make Him change? And whatever His soul desires, that He does.
verses.textEnNlt: But once he has made his decision, who can change his mind? Whatever he wants to do, he does.
verses.textEnNasb: "But He is unique, and who can make Him turn? Whatever His soul desires, He does it.
verses.textEn: "But he stands alone, and who can oppose him? He does whatever he pleases.

verses.textZh: 他为我所定的，他必成全， 这类的事情，他还有许多。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他为我所定的，他必成全， 这类的事情，他还有许多。
verses.textZhCuv: 他向我所定的，就必做成； 这类的事他还有许多。
verses.textEnNiv: He carries out his decree against me, and many such plans he still has in store.
verses.textEnEsv: For he will complete what he appoints for me, and many such things are in his mind.
verses.textEnNkjv: For He performs whatis appointed for me, And many such thingsare with Him.
verses.textEnNlt: So he will do to me whatever he has planned. He controls my destiny.
verses.textEnNasb: "For He carries out what is destined for me, And many such destinies are with Him.
verses.textEn: He carries out his decree against me, and many such plans he still has in store.

verses.textZh: 因此我在他面前惊惶， 一想到这事，我就惧怕他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此我在他面前惊惶， 一想到这事，我就惧怕他。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以我在他面前惊惶； 我思念这事便惧怕他。
verses.textEnNiv: That is why I am terrified before him; when I think of all this, I fear him.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore I am terrified at his presence; when I consider, I am in dread of him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I am terrified at His presence; When I consider this, I am afraid of Him.
verses.textEnNlt: No wonder I am so terrified in his presence. When I think of it, terror grips me.
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore, I would be terrified at His presence; When I consider this, I am frightened of Him.
verses.textEn: That is why I am terrified before him; when I think of all this, I fear him.

verses.textZh: 神使我心里胆怯， 全能者使我惊惶，
verses.textZhCnvs: 神使我心里胆怯， 全能者使我惊惶，
verses.textZhCuv: 神使我丧胆； 全能者使我惊惶。
verses.textEnNiv: God has made my heart faint; the Almighty has terrified me.
verses.textEnEsv: God has made my heart faint; the Almighty has terrified me;
verses.textEnNkjv: For God made my heart weak, And the Almighty terrifies me;
verses.textEnNlt: God has made me sick at heart; the Almighty has terrified me.
verses.textEnNasb: "It is God who has made my heart faint, And the Almighty who has terrified me,
verses.textEn: God has made my heart faint; the Almighty has terrified me.

verses.textZh: 因为我在黑暗面前并没有被消灭， 也不怕幽暗遮盖着我的脸。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我在黑暗面前并没有被消灭， 也不怕幽暗遮盖着我的脸。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我的恐惧不是因为黑暗， 也不是因为幽暗蒙蔽我的脸。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet I am not silenced by the darkness, by the thick darkness that covers my face.
verses.textEnEsv: yet I am not silenced because of the darkness, nor because thick darkness covers my face.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because I was not cut off from the presence of darkness, And He did not hide deep darkness from my face.
verses.textEnNlt: Darkness is all around me; thick, impenetrable darkness is everywhere.
verses.textEnNasb: But I am not destroyed by darkness, Nor by deep gloom which covers me.
verses.textEn: Yet I am not silenced by the darkness, by the thick darkness that covers my face.

verses.textZh: "为甚么全能者不保留赏善罚恶的时间？ 为甚么认识他的人不能看见他的日子？
verses.textZhCnvs: "为甚么全能者不保留赏善罚恶的时间？ 为甚么认识他的人不能看见他的日子？
verses.textZhCuv: 全能者既定期罚恶， 为何不使认识他的人看见那日子呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "Why does the Almighty not set times for judgment? Why must those who know him look in vain for such days?
verses.textEnEsv: "Why are not times of judgment kept by the Almighty, and why do those who know him never see his days?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Since times are not hidden from the Almighty, Why do those who know Him see not His days?
verses.textEnNlt: "Why doesn’t the Almighty bring the wicked to judgment? Why must the godly wait for him in vain?
verses.textEnNasb: "Why are times not stored up by the Almighty, And why do those who know Him not see His days?
verses.textEn: "Why does the Almighty not set times for judgment? Why must those who know him look in vain for such days?

verses.textZh: 恶人挪移地界， 抢夺群畜去牧养。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人挪移地界， 抢夺群畜去牧养。
verses.textZhCuv: 有人挪移地界， 抢夺群畜而牧养。
verses.textEnNiv: There are those who move boundary stones; they pasture flocks they have stolen.
verses.textEnEsv: Some move landmarks; they seize flocks and pasture them.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Some remove landmarks; They seize flocks violently and feed onthem;
verses.textEnNlt: Evil people steal land by moving the boundary markers. They steal livestock and put them in their own pastures.
verses.textEnNasb: "People remove landmarks; They seize and devour flocks.
verses.textEn: There are those who move boundary stones; they pasture flocks they have stolen.

verses.textZh: 他们赶走孤儿的驴， 强取寡妇的牛作抵押。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们赶走孤儿的驴， 强取寡妇的牛作抵押。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们拉去孤儿的驴， 强取寡妇的牛为当头。
verses.textEnNiv: They drive away the orphan’s donkey and take the widow’s ox in pledge.
verses.textEnEsv: They drive away the donkey of the fatherless; they take the widow’s ox for a pledge.
verses.textEnNkjv: They drive away the donkey of the fatherless; They take the widow’s ox as a pledge.
verses.textEnNlt: They take the orphan’s donkey and demand the widow’s ox as security for a loan.
verses.textEnNasb: "They drive away the donkeys of orphans; They seize the widow’s ox as a pledge.
verses.textEn: They drive away the orphan’s donkey and take the widow’s ox in pledge.

verses.textZh: 他们使穷人离开大道， 世上的贫民都一起躲藏起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们使穷人离开大道， 世上的贫民都一起躲藏起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们使穷人离开正道； 世上的贫民尽都隐藏。
verses.textEnNiv: They thrust the needy from the path and force all the poor of the land into hiding.
verses.textEnEsv: They thrust the poor off the road; the poor of the earth all hide themselves.
verses.textEnNkjv: They push the needy off the road; All the poor of the land are forced to hide.
verses.textEnNlt: The poor are pushed off the path; the needy must hide together for safety.
verses.textEnNasb: "They push the needy aside from the road; The poor of the land have to hide themselves together.
verses.textEn: They thrust the needy from the path and force all the poor of the land into hiding.

verses.textZh: 这些贫穷人像旷野的野驴， 出外劳碌，殷勤寻觅食物， 野地为他们和他们的孩子供应食物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些贫穷人像旷野的野驴， 出外劳碌，殷勤寻觅食物， 野地为他们和他们的孩子供应食物。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些贫穷人如同野驴出到旷野，殷勤寻找食物； 他们靠着野地给儿女糊口，
verses.textEnNiv: Like wild donkeys in the desert, the poor go about their labor of foraging food; the wasteland provides food for their children.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, like wild donkeys in the desert the poor go out to their toil, seeking game; the wasteland yields food for their children.
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed, like wild donkeys in the desert, They go out to their work, searching for food. The wilderness yields food for them and for their children.
verses.textEnNlt: Like wild donkeys in the wilderness, the poor must spend all their time looking for food, searching even in the desert for food for their children.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, like wild donkeys in the wilderness They go out scavenging for food in their activity, As bread for their children in the desert.
verses.textEn: Like wild donkeys in the desert, the poor go about their labor of foraging food; the wasteland provides food for their children.

verses.textZh: 他们在田里收割草料， 在恶人的葡萄园中摘取剩余的葡萄。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在田里收割草料， 在恶人的葡萄园中摘取剩余的葡萄。
verses.textZhCuv: 收割别人田间的禾稼， 摘取恶人余剩的葡萄，
verses.textEnNiv: They gather fodder in the fields and glean in the vineyards of the wicked.
verses.textEnEsv: They gather their fodder in the field, and they glean the vineyard of the wicked man.
verses.textEnNkjv: They gather their fodder in the field And glean in the vineyard of the wicked.
verses.textEnNlt: They harvest a field they do not own, and they glean in the vineyards of the wicked.
verses.textEnNasb: "They harvest their feed in the field And glean the vineyard of the wicked.
verses.textEn: They gather fodder in the fields and glean in the vineyards of the wicked.

verses.textZh: 他们赤身露体无衣过夜， 在寒冷中毫无遮盖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们赤身露体无衣过夜， 在寒冷中毫无遮盖。
verses.textZhCuv: 终夜赤身无衣， 天气寒冷毫无遮盖，
verses.textEnNiv: Lacking clothes, they spend the night naked; they have nothing to cover themselves in the cold.
verses.textEnEsv: They lie all night naked, without clothing, and have no covering in the cold.
verses.textEnNkjv: They spend the night naked, without clothing, And have no covering in the cold.
verses.textEnNlt: All night they lie naked in the cold, without clothing or covering.
verses.textEnNasb: "They spend the night naked, without clothing, And have no covering against the cold.
verses.textEn: Lacking clothes, they spend the night naked; they have nothing to cover themselves in the cold.

verses.textZh: 他被山上的大雨淋湿， 因为没有躲避之处就紧抱盘石。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他被山上的大雨淋湿， 因为没有躲避之处就紧抱盘石。
verses.textZhCuv: 在山上被大雨淋湿， 因没有避身之处就挨近磐石。
verses.textEnNiv: They are drenched by mountain rains and hug the rocks for lack of shelter.
verses.textEnEsv: They are wet with the rain of the mountains and cling to the rock for lack of shelter.
verses.textEnNkjv: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, And huddle around the rock for want of shelter.
verses.textEnNlt: They are soaked by mountain showers, and they huddle against the rocks for want of a home.
verses.textEnNasb: "They are wet from the mountain rains, And they hug the rock for lack of a shelter.
verses.textEn: They are drenched by mountain rains and hug the rocks for lack of shelter.

verses.textZh: 有人从母亲的怀中抢走孤儿， 又强取穷人的衣物作抵押，
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人从母亲的怀中抢走孤儿， 又强取穷人的衣物作抵押，
verses.textZhCuv: 又有人从母怀中抢夺孤儿， 强取穷人的衣服为当头，
verses.textEnNiv: The fatherless child is snatched from the breast; the infant of the poor is seized for a debt.
verses.textEnEsv: (There are those who snatch the fatherless child from the breast, and they take a pledge against the poor.)
verses.textEnNkjv: "Some snatch the fatherless from the breast, And take a pledge from the poor.
verses.textEnNlt: "The wicked snatch a widow’s child from her breast, taking the baby as security for a loan.
verses.textEnNasb: "Others snatch an orphan from the breast, And they seize it as a pledge against the poor.
verses.textEn: The fatherless child is snatched from the breast; the infant of the poor is seized for a debt.

verses.textZh: 因此穷人赤身露体流浪， 他们因饥饿就抬走禾捆；
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此穷人赤身露体流浪， 他们因饥饿就抬走禾捆；
verses.textZhCuv: 使人赤身无衣，到处流行， 且因饥饿扛抬禾捆，
verses.textEnNiv: Lacking clothes, they go about naked; they carry the sheaves, but still go hungry.
verses.textEnEsv: They go about naked, without clothing; hungry, they carry the sheaves;
verses.textEnNkjv: They cause thepoor to go naked, without clothing; And they take away the sheaves from the hungry.
verses.textEnNlt: The poor must go about naked, without any clothing. They harvest food for others while they themselves are starving.
verses.textEnNasb: "The poor move about naked without clothing, And they carry sheaves, while going hungry.
verses.textEn: Lacking clothes, they go about naked; they carry the sheaves, but still go hungry.

verses.textZh: 他们在那些人的橄榄树行列内榨油 ， 又在葡萄园里踹酒 ，但自己仍然口渴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在那些人的橄榄树行列内榨油 ， 又在葡萄园里踹酒 ，但自己仍然口渴。
verses.textZhCuv: 在那些人的围墙内造油，榨酒， 自己还口渴。
verses.textEnNiv: They crush olives among the terraces ; they tread the winepresses, yet suffer thirst.
verses.textEnEsv: among the olive rows of the wicked they make oil; they tread the winepresses, but suffer thirst.
verses.textEnNkjv: They press out oil within their walls, And tread winepresses, yet suffer thirst.
verses.textEnNlt: They press out olive oil without being allowed to taste it, and they tread in the winepress as they suffer from thirst.
verses.textEnNasb: "Within the walls they produce oil; They tread wine presses but go thirsty.
verses.textEn: They crush olives among the terraces ; they tread the winepresses, yet suffer thirst.

verses.textZh: 有人从城里唉哼， 受伤的人呼求，神却不理会恶人的愚妄。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人从城里唉哼， 受伤的人呼求，神却不理会恶人的愚妄。
verses.textZhCuv: 在多民的城内有人唉哼， 受伤的人哀号；神却不理会那恶人的愚妄。
verses.textEnNiv: The groans of the dying rise from the city, and the souls of the wounded cry out for help. But God charges no one with wrongdoing.
verses.textEnEsv: From out of the city the dying groan, and the soul of the wounded cries for help; yet God charges no one with wrong.
verses.textEnNkjv: The dying groan in the city, And the souls of the wounded cry out; Yet God does not charge them with wrong.
verses.textEnNlt: The groans of the dying rise from the city, and the wounded cry for help, yet God ignores their moaning.
verses.textEnNasb: "From the city people groan, And the souls of the wounded cry for help; Yet God does not pay attention to the offensiveness.
verses.textEn: The groans of the dying rise from the city, and the souls of the wounded cry out for help. But God charges no one with wrongdoing.

verses.textZh: 又有人与光为敌， 不认识光明的道， 不留在光明的路中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有人与光为敌， 不认识光明的道， 不留在光明的路中。
verses.textZhCuv: 又有人背弃光明， 不认识光明的道， 不住在光明的路上。
verses.textEnNiv: "There are those who rebel against the light, who do not know its ways or stay in its paths.
verses.textEnEsv: "There are those who rebel against the light, who are not acquainted with its ways, and do not stay in its paths.
verses.textEnNkjv: "There are those who rebel against the light; They do not know its ways Nor abide in its paths.
verses.textEnNlt: "Wicked people rebel against the light. They refuse to acknowledge its ways or stay in its paths.
verses.textEnNasb: " Others have been with those who rebel against the light; They do not want to know its ways Nor stay in its paths.
verses.textEn: "There are those who rebel against the light, who do not know its ways or stay in its paths.

verses.textZh: 杀人的黎明起来， 杀戮困苦人与穷人， 夜间又去作盗贼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 杀人的黎明起来， 杀戮困苦人与穷人， 夜间又去作盗贼。
verses.textZhCuv: 杀人的黎明起来， 杀害困苦穷乏人， 夜间又作盗贼。
verses.textEnNiv: When daylight is gone, the murderer rises up, kills the poor and needy, and in the night steals forth like a thief.
verses.textEnEsv: The murderer rises before it is light, that he may kill the poor and needy, and in the night he is like a thief.
verses.textEnNkjv: The murderer rises with the light; He kills the poor and needy; And in the night he is like a thief.
verses.textEnNlt: The murderer rises in the early dawn to kill the poor and needy; at night he is a thief.
verses.textEnNasb: "The murderer arises at dawn; He kills the poor and the needy, And at night he is like a thief.
verses.textEn: When daylight is gone, the murderer rises up, kills the poor and needy, and in the night steals forth like a thief.

verses.textZh: 奸夫的眼睛等待黄昏， 说：‘没有眼可以看见我’， 就把自己的脸蒙起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 奸夫的眼睛等待黄昏， 说：‘没有眼可以看见我’， 就把自己的脸蒙起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 奸夫等候黄昏， 说：必无眼能见我， 就把脸蒙蔽。
verses.textEnNiv: The eye of the adulterer watches for dusk; he thinks, ‘No eye will see me,’ and he keeps his face concealed.
verses.textEnEsv: The eye of the adulterer also waits for the twilight, saying, ‘No eye will see me’; and he veils his face.
verses.textEnNkjv: The eye of the adulterer waits for the twilight, Saying, ‘No eye will see me’; And he disguises his face.
verses.textEnNlt: The adulterer waits for the twilight, saying, ‘No one will see me then.’ He hides his face so no one will know him.
verses.textEnNasb: "The eye of the adulterer watches for twilight, Saying, ‘No eye will see me.’ And he disguises his face.
verses.textEn: The eye of the adulterer watches for dusk; he thinks, ‘No eye will see me,’ and he keeps his face concealed.

verses.textZh: 盗贼黑夜挖穿屋子， 白天却躲藏起来， 他们不想认识光明。
verses.textZhCnvs: 盗贼黑夜挖穿屋子， 白天却躲藏起来， 他们不想认识光明。
verses.textZhCuv: 盗贼黑夜挖窟窿； 白日躲藏， 并不认识光明。
verses.textEnNiv: In the dark, thieves break into houses, but by day they shut themselves in; they want nothing to do with the light.
verses.textEnEsv: In the dark they dig through houses; by day they shut themselves up; they do not know the light.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the dark they break into houses Which they marked for themselves in the daytime; They do not know the light.
verses.textEnNlt: Thieves break into houses at night and sleep in the daytime. They are not acquainted with the light.
verses.textEnNasb: "In the darkness they dig into houses, They shut themselves up by day; They do not know the light.
verses.textEn: In the dark, thieves break into houses, but by day they shut themselves in; they want nothing to do with the light.

verses.textZh: 他们看晨光如死荫， 因为他们认识死荫的惊骇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们看晨光如死荫， 因为他们认识死荫的惊骇。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们看早晨如幽暗， 因为他们晓得幽暗的惊骇。
verses.textEnNiv: For all of them, midnight is their morning; they make friends with the terrors of darkness.
verses.textEnEsv: For deep darkness is morning to all of them; for they are friends with the terrors of deep darkness.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the morning is the same to them as the shadow of death; If someone recognizes them, Theyarein the terrors of the shadow of death.
verses.textEnNlt: The black night is their morning. They ally themselves with the terrors of the darkness.
verses.textEnNasb: "For the morning is the same to him as thick darkness, For he is familiar with the terrors of thick darkness.
verses.textEn: For all of them, midnight is their morning; they make friends with the terrors of darkness.

verses.textZh: 这些恶人如水面上飘浮的东西迅速流逝， 他们在世上所得的分被咒诅， 他们不能再走葡萄园的路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些恶人如水面上飘浮的东西迅速流逝， 他们在世上所得的分被咒诅， 他们不能再走葡萄园的路。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些恶人犹如浮萍快快飘去。 他们所得的分在世上被咒诅； 他们不得再走葡萄园的路。
verses.textEnNiv: "Yet they are foam on the surface of the water; their portion of the land is cursed, so that no one goes to the vineyards.
verses.textEnEsv: "You say, ‘Swift are they on the face of the waters; their portion is cursed in the land; no treader turns toward their vineyards.
verses.textEnNkjv: "They shouldbe swift on the face of the waters, Their portion shouldbe cursed in the earth, Sothat no one would turn into the way of their vineyards.
verses.textEnNlt: "But they disappear like foam down a river. Everything they own is cursed, and they are afraid to enter their own vineyards.
verses.textEnNasb: "They are insignificant on the surface of the water; Their plot of land on the earth is cursed. They do not turn toward the vineyards.
verses.textEn: "Yet they are foam on the surface of the water; their portion of the land is cursed, so that no one goes to the vineyards.

verses.textZh: 干旱与炎热怎样消除雪水， 阴间也这样除去犯罪的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 干旱与炎热怎样消除雪水， 阴间也这样除去犯罪的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 干旱炎热消没雪水； 阴间也如此消没犯罪之辈。
verses.textEnNiv: As heat and drought snatch away the melted snow, so the grave snatches away those who have sinned.
verses.textEnEsv: Drought and heat snatch away the snow waters; so does Sheol those who have sinned.
verses.textEnNkjv: As drought and heat consume the snow waters, So the grave consumesthosewho have sinned.
verses.textEnNlt: The grave consumes sinners just as drought and heat consume snow.
verses.textEnNasb: "Dryness and heat snatch away the snow waters, As Sheol snatches those who have sinned.
verses.textEn: As heat and drought snatch away the melted snow, so the grave snatches away those who have sinned.

verses.textZh: 怀他的母胎忘记他， 虫子要以他为甘甜， 他不再被人记念， 不义的人必如树折断。
verses.textZhCnvs: 怀他的母胎忘记他， 虫子要以他为甘甜， 他不再被人记念， 不义的人必如树折断。
verses.textZhCuv: 怀他的母 要忘记他； 虫子要吃他，觉得甘甜； 他不再被人记念。 不义的人必如树折断。
verses.textEnNiv: The womb forgets them, the worm feasts on them; the wicked are no longer remembered but are broken like a tree.
verses.textEnEsv: The womb forgets them; the worm finds them sweet; they are no longer remembered, so wickedness is broken like a tree.’
verses.textEnNkjv: The womb should forget him, The worm should feed sweetly on him; He should be remembered no more, And wickedness should be broken like a tree.
verses.textEnNlt: Their own mothers will forget them. Maggots will find them sweet to eat. No one will remember them. Wicked people are broken like a tree in the storm.
verses.textEnNasb: "A mother will forget him; The maggot feeds sweetly until he is no longer remembered. And injustice will be broken like a tree.
verses.textEn: The womb forgets them, the worm feasts on them; the wicked are no longer remembered but are broken like a tree.

verses.textZh: 他恶待不能生育，没有孩子的妇人， 也不善待寡妇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他恶待不能生育，没有孩子的妇人， 也不善待寡妇。
verses.textZhCuv: 他恶待 不怀孕不生养的妇人， 不善待寡妇。
verses.textEnNiv: They prey on the barren and childless woman, and to the widow they show no kindness.
verses.textEnEsv: "They wrong the barren, childless woman, and do no good to the widow.
verses.textEnNkjv: For he preys on the barren who do not bear, And does no good for the widow.
verses.textEnNlt: They cheat the woman who has no son to help her. They refuse to help the needy widow.
verses.textEnNasb: "He wrongs the infertile woman, And does no good for the widow.
verses.textEn: They prey on the barren and childless woman, and to the widow they show no kindness.

verses.textZh: 神却用自己的能力延长强暴的人的性命， 生命难保的仍然兴起。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神却用自己的能力延长强暴的人的性命， 生命难保的仍然兴起。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而神用能力保全有势力的人； 那性命难保的人仍然兴起。
verses.textEnNiv: But God drags away the mighty by his power; though they become established, they have no assurance of life.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet God prolongs the life of the mighty by his power; they rise up when they despair of life.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But God draws the mighty away with His power; He rises up, but no man is sure of life.
verses.textEnNlt: "God, in his power, drags away the rich. They may rise high, but they have no assurance of life.
verses.textEnNasb: "But He drags off the mighty by His power; He rises, but no one has assurance of life.
verses.textEn: But God drags away the mighty by his power; though they become established, they have no assurance of life.

verses.textZh: 神使他们安稳，他们就有所倚靠， 他的眼也看顾他们的道路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神使他们安稳，他们就有所倚靠， 他的眼也看顾他们的道路。
verses.textZhCuv: 神使他们安稳，他们就有所倚靠；神的眼目也看顾他们的道路。
verses.textEnNiv: He may let them rest in a feeling of security, but his eyes are on their ways.
verses.textEnEsv: He gives them security, and they are supported, and his eyes are upon their ways.
verses.textEnNkjv: He gives them security, and they rely onit; Yet His eyes are on their ways.
verses.textEnNlt: They may be allowed to live in security, but God is always watching them.
verses.textEnNasb: "He provides them with security, and they are supported; And His eyes are on their ways.
verses.textEn: He may let them rest in a feeling of security, but his eyes are on their ways.

verses.textZh: 他们被高举不过片时，就没有了， 他们降为卑，如众人一样被收拾起来， 他们又如谷穗枯干。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们被高举不过片时，就没有了， 他们降为卑，如众人一样被收拾起来， 他们又如谷穗枯干。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们被高举，不过片时就没有了； 他们降为卑，被除灭，与众人一样， 又如谷穗被割。
verses.textEnNiv: For a little while they are exalted, and then they are gone; they are brought low and gathered up like all others; they are cut off like heads of grain.
verses.textEnEsv: They are exalted a little while, and then are gone; they are brought low and gathered up like all others; they are cut off like the heads of grain.
verses.textEnNkjv: They are exalted for a little while, Then they are gone. They are brought low; They are taken out of the way like all others; They dry out like the heads of grain.
verses.textEnNlt: And though they are great now, in a moment they will be gone like all others, cut off like heads of grain.
verses.textEnNasb: "They are exalted a little while, then they are gone; Moreover, they are brought low, and like everything they are gathered up; Like the heads of grain they wither.
verses.textEn: For a little while they are exalted, and then they are gone; they are brought low and gathered up like all others; they are cut off like heads of grain.

verses.textZh: 如果不是这样，谁能证明我是撒谎的， 指出我的言语为空虚的呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果不是这样，谁能证明我是撒谎的， 指出我的言语为空虚的呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 若不是这样，谁能证实我是说谎的， 将我的言语驳为虚空呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "If this is not so, who can prove me false and reduce my words to nothing?"
verses.textEnEsv: If it is not so, who will prove me a liar and show that there is nothing in what I say?"
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now if itis not so, who will prove me a liar, And make my speech worth nothing?"
verses.textEnNlt: Can anyone claim otherwise? Who can prove me wrong?"
verses.textEnNasb: "Now if it is not so, who can prove me a liar, And make my speech worthless?"
verses.textEn: "If this is not so, who can prove me false and reduce my words to nothing?"

verses.textZh: 书亚人比勒达回答说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 书亚人比勒达回答说：
verses.textZhCuv: 书亚人比勒达回答说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then Bildad the Shuhite replied:
verses.textEnEsv: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered and said:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered and said:
verses.textEnNlt: Then Bildad the Shuhite replied:
verses.textEnNasb: Then Bildad the Shuhite responded,
verses.textEn: Then Bildad the Shuhite replied:

verses.textZh: "神有治理之权，威严可畏， 他在高天之处施行和平。
verses.textZhCnvs: "神有治理之权，威严可畏， 他在高天之处施行和平。
verses.textZhCuv: 神有治理之权，有威严可畏； 他在高处施行和平。
verses.textEnNiv: "Dominion and awe belong to God; he establishes order in the heights of heaven.
verses.textEnEsv: "Dominion and fear are with God; he makes peace in his high heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Dominion and fear belong to Him; He makes peace in His high places.
verses.textEnNlt: "God is powerful and dreadful. He enforces peace in the heavens.
verses.textEnNasb: "Dominion and awe belong to Him Who makes peace in His heights.
verses.textEn: "Dominion and awe belong to God; he establishes order in the heights of heaven.

verses.textZh: 他的天军怎能数算？ 他的光一发谁不被照耀呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的天军怎能数算？ 他的光一发谁不被照耀呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 他的诸军岂能数算？ 他的光亮一发，谁不蒙照呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Can his forces be numbered? On whom does his light not rise?
verses.textEnEsv: Is there any number to his armies? Upon whom does his light not arise?
verses.textEnNkjv: Is there any number to His armies? Upon whom does His light not rise?
verses.textEnNlt: Who is able to count his heavenly army? Doesn’t his light shine on all the earth?
verses.textEnNasb: "Is there any number to His troops? And upon whom does His light not rise?
verses.textEn: Can his forces be numbered? On whom does his light not rise?

verses.textZh: 这样在神面前，人怎能称为义呢？ 妇人所生的，怎能算为洁净呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样在神面前，人怎能称为义呢？ 妇人所生的，怎能算为洁净呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 这样在神面前，人怎能称义？ 妇人所生的怎能洁净？
verses.textEnNiv: How then can a mortal be righteous before God? How can one born of woman be pure?
verses.textEnEsv: How then can man be in the right before God? How can he who is born of woman be pure?
verses.textEnNkjv: How then can man be righteous before God? Or how can he be pure whois born of a woman?
verses.textEnNlt: How can a mortal be innocent before God? Can anyone born of a woman be pure?
verses.textEnNasb: "How then can mankind be righteous with God? Or how can anyone who is born of woman be pure?
verses.textEn: How then can a mortal be righteous before God? How can one born of woman be pure?

verses.textZh: 在神的眼中，月亮都不明亮， 星星也不皎洁，
verses.textZhCnvs: 在神的眼中，月亮都不明亮， 星星也不皎洁，
verses.textZhCuv: 在神眼前，月亮也无光亮， 星宿也不清洁。
verses.textEnNiv: If even the moon is not bright and the stars are not pure in his eyes,
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, even the moon is not bright, and the stars are not pure in his eyes;
verses.textEnNkjv: If even the moon does not shine, And the stars are not pure in His sight,
verses.textEnNlt: God is more glorious than the moon; he shines brighter than the stars.
verses.textEnNasb: "If even the moon has no brightness And the stars are not pure in His sight,
verses.textEn: If even the moon is not bright and the stars are not pure in his eyes,

verses.textZh: 更何况如虫的人， 像蛆的世人呢！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 更何况如虫的人， 像蛆的世人呢！"
verses.textZhCuv: 何况如虫的人， 如蛆的世人呢！
verses.textEnNiv: how much less a mortal, who is but a maggot— a human being, who is only a worm!"
verses.textEnEsv: how much less man, who is a maggot, and the son of man, who is a worm!"
verses.textEnNkjv: How much less man, whois a maggot, And a son of man, whois a worm?"
verses.textEnNlt: In comparison, people are maggots; we mortals are mere worms."
verses.textEnNasb: How much less man, that maggot, And a son of man, that worm!"
verses.textEn: how much less a mortal, who is but a maggot— a human being, who is only a worm!"

verses.textZh: 约伯回答说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 约伯回答说：
verses.textZhCuv: 约伯回答说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then Job replied:
verses.textEnEsv: Then Job answered and said:
verses.textEnNkjv: But Job answered and said:
verses.textEnNlt: Then Job spoke again:
verses.textEnNasb: Then Job responded,
verses.textEn: Then Job replied:

verses.textZh: "无能力的，你怎样帮助他， 膀臂无力的，你怎样拯救他！
verses.textZhCnvs: "无能力的，你怎样帮助他， 膀臂无力的，你怎样拯救他！
verses.textZhCuv: 无能的人蒙你何等的帮助！ 膀臂无力的人蒙你何等的拯救！
verses.textEnNiv: "How you have helped the powerless! How you have saved the arm that is feeble!
verses.textEnEsv: "How you have helped him who has no power! How you have saved the arm that has no strength!
verses.textEnNkjv: "How have you helped himwhois without power? How have you saved the arm thathas no strength?
verses.textEnNlt: "How you have helped the powerless! How you have saved the weak!
verses.textEnNasb: "What a help you are to the weak! You have saved the arm without strength!
verses.textEn: "How you have helped the powerless! How you have saved the arm that is feeble!

verses.textZh: 无智慧的，你怎样教导他， 显明你丰盛的智慧！
verses.textZhCnvs: 无智慧的，你怎样教导他， 显明你丰盛的智慧！
verses.textZhCuv: 无智慧的人蒙你何等的指教！ 你向他多显大知识！
verses.textEnNiv: What advice you have offered to one without wisdom! And what great insight you have displayed!
verses.textEnEsv: How you have counseled him who has no wisdom, and plentifully declared sound knowledge!
verses.textEnNkjv: How have you counseled onewhohas no wisdom? And how have you declared sound advice to many?
verses.textEnNlt: How you have enlightened my stupidity! What wise advice you have offered!
verses.textEnNasb: "What advice you have given to one without wisdom! What helpful insight you have abundantly provided!
verses.textEn: What advice you have offered to one without wisdom! And what great insight you have displayed!

verses.textZh: 你靠谁发言呢？ 谁的灵从你而出呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你靠谁发言呢？ 谁的灵从你而出呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你向谁发出言语来？ 谁的灵从你而出？
verses.textEnNiv: Who has helped you utter these words? And whose spirit spoke from your mouth?
verses.textEnEsv: With whose help have you uttered words, and whose breath has come out from you?
verses.textEnNkjv: To whom have you uttered words? And whose spirit came from you?
verses.textEnNlt: Where have you gotten all these wise sayings? Whose spirit speaks through you?
verses.textEnNasb: "To whom have you uttered words? And whose spirit was expressed through you?
verses.textEn: Who has helped you utter these words? And whose spirit spoke from your mouth?

verses.textZh: 阴魂和在水中居住的，都在水下痛苦不堪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 阴魂和在水中居住的，都在水下痛苦不堪。
verses.textZhCuv: 在大水和水族以下的阴魂战兢。
verses.textEnNiv: "The dead are in deep anguish, those beneath the waters and all that live in them.
verses.textEnEsv: The dead tremble under the waters and their inhabitants.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The dead tremble, Those under the waters and those inhabiting them.
verses.textEnNlt: "The dead tremble— those who live beneath the waters.
verses.textEnNasb: "The departed spirits are made to tremble Under the waters and their inhabitants.
verses.textEn: "The dead are in deep anguish, those beneath the waters and all that live in them.

verses.textZh: 阴间在神面前赤露敞开， 灭亡之处也没有遮盖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 阴间在神面前赤露敞开， 灭亡之处也没有遮盖。
verses.textZhCuv: 在神面前，阴间显露； 灭亡也不得遮掩。
verses.textEnNiv: The realm of the dead is naked before God; Destruction lies uncovered.
verses.textEnEsv: Sheol is naked before God, and Abaddon has no covering.
verses.textEnNkjv: Sheol is naked before Him, And Destruction has no covering.
verses.textEnNlt: The underworld is naked in God’s presence. The place of destruction is uncovered.
verses.textEnNasb: " Sheol is naked before Him, And Abaddon has no covering.
verses.textEn: The realm of the dead is naked before God; Destruction lies uncovered.

verses.textZh: 他把北极铺在空间， 把地球挂在太空。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把北极铺在空间， 把地球挂在太空。
verses.textZhCuv: 神将北极铺在空中， 将大地悬在虚空；
verses.textEnNiv: He spreads out the northern skies over empty space; he suspends the earth over nothing.
verses.textEnEsv: He stretches out the north over the void and hangs the earth on nothing.
verses.textEnNkjv: He stretches out the north over empty space; He hangs the earth on nothing.
verses.textEnNlt: God stretches the northern sky over empty space and hangs the earth on nothing.
verses.textEnNasb: "He stretches out the north over empty space And hangs the earth on nothing.
verses.textEn: He spreads out the northern skies over empty space; he suspends the earth over nothing.

verses.textZh: 他把水包在密云中， 水下面的云却不破裂。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把水包在密云中， 水下面的云却不破裂。
verses.textZhCuv: 将水包在密云中， 云却不破裂；
verses.textEnNiv: He wraps up the waters in his clouds, yet the clouds do not burst under their weight.
verses.textEnEsv: He binds up the waters in his thick clouds, and the cloud is not split open under them.
verses.textEnNkjv: He binds up the water in His thick clouds, Yet the clouds are not broken under it.
verses.textEnNlt: He wraps the rain in his thick clouds, and the clouds don’t burst with the weight.
verses.textEnNasb: "He wraps up the waters in His clouds, And the cloud does not burst under them.
verses.textEn: He wraps up the waters in his clouds, yet the clouds do not burst under their weight.

verses.textZh: 他遮蔽自己宝座的正面， 把云铺在上面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他遮蔽自己宝座的正面， 把云铺在上面。
verses.textZhCuv: 遮蔽他的宝座， 将云铺在其上；
verses.textEnNiv: He covers the face of the full moon, spreading his clouds over it.
verses.textEnEsv: He covers the face of the full moon and spreads over it his cloud.
verses.textEnNkjv: He covers the face of His throne, And spreads His cloud over it.
verses.textEnNlt: He covers the face of the moon, shrouding it with his clouds.
verses.textEnNasb: "He obscures the face of the full moon And spreads His cloud over it.
verses.textEn: He covers the face of the full moon, spreading his clouds over it.

verses.textZh: 在水面划出界限， 直到光与暗的交界。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在水面划出界限， 直到光与暗的交界。
verses.textZhCuv: 在水面的周围划出界限， 直到光明黑暗的交界。
verses.textEnNiv: He marks out the horizon on the face of the waters for a boundary between light and darkness.
verses.textEnEsv: He has inscribed a circle on the face of the waters at the boundary between light and darkness.
verses.textEnNkjv: He drew a circular horizon on the face of the waters, At the boundary of light and darkness.
verses.textEnNlt: He created the horizon when he separated the waters; he set the boundary between day and night.
verses.textEnNasb: "He has inscribed a circle on the surface of the waters At the boundary of light and darkness.
verses.textEn: He marks out the horizon on the face of the waters for a boundary between light and darkness.

verses.textZh: 天的柱子都因他的斥责 震动惊奇；
verses.textZhCnvs: 天的柱子都因他的斥责 震动惊奇；
verses.textZhCuv: 天的柱子因他的斥责震动惊奇。
verses.textEnNiv: The pillars of the heavens quake, aghast at his rebuke.
verses.textEnEsv: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astounded at his rebuke.
verses.textEnNkjv: The pillars of heaven tremble, And are astonished at His rebuke.
verses.textEnNlt: The foundations of heaven tremble; they shudder at his rebuke.
verses.textEnNasb: "The pillars of heaven tremble And are amazed at His rebuke.
verses.textEn: The pillars of the heavens quake, aghast at his rebuke.

verses.textZh: 他以能力搅动大海， 以聪明击伤拉哈伯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他以能力搅动大海， 以聪明击伤拉哈伯。
verses.textZhCuv: 他以能力搅动 大海； 他藉知识打伤拉哈伯，
verses.textEnNiv: By his power he churned up the sea; by his wisdom he cut Rahab to pieces.
verses.textEnEsv: By his power he stilled the sea; by his understanding he shattered Rahab.
verses.textEnNkjv: He stirs up the sea with His power, And by His understanding He breaks up the storm.
verses.textEnNlt: By his power the sea grew calm. By his skill he crushed the great sea monster.
verses.textEnNasb: "With His power He quieted the sea, And by His understanding He shattered Rahab.
verses.textEn: By his power he churned up the sea; by his wisdom he cut Rahab to pieces.

verses.textZh: 他以自己的气使天晴朗， 他的手刺穿逃跑的蛇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他以自己的气使天晴朗， 他的手刺穿逃跑的蛇。
verses.textZhCuv: 藉他的灵使天有妆饰； 他的手刺杀快蛇。
verses.textEnNiv: By his breath the skies became fair; his hand pierced the gliding serpent.
verses.textEnEsv: By his wind the heavens were made fair; his hand pierced the fleeing serpent.
verses.textEnNkjv: By His Spirit He adorned the heavens; His hand pierced the fleeing serpent.
verses.textEnNlt: His Spirit made the heavens beautiful, and his power pierced the gliding serpent.
verses.textEnNasb: "By His breath the heavens are cleared; His hand has pierced the fleeing serpent.
verses.textEn: By his breath the skies became fair; his hand pierced the gliding serpent.

verses.textZh: 这些不过是他的作为的一点点， 我们从他那里所听到的，是多么的微小！ 他大能的雷声谁能够明白呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些不过是他的作为的一点点， 我们从他那里所听到的，是多么的微小！ 他大能的雷声谁能够明白呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，这不过是神工作的些微； 我们所听于他的是何等细微的声音！ 他大能的雷声谁能明透呢？
verses.textEnNiv: And these are but the outer fringe of his works; how faint the whisper we hear of him! Who then can understand the thunder of his power?"
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, these are but the outskirts of his ways, and how small a whisper do we hear of him! But the thunder of his power who can understand?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed these are the mere edges of His ways, And how small a whisper we hear of Him! But the thunder of His power who can understand?"
verses.textEnNlt: These are just the beginning of all that he does, merely a whisper of his power. Who, then, can comprehend the thunder of his power?"
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, these are the fringes of His ways; And how faint a word we hear of Him! But His mighty thunder, who can understand?"
verses.textEn: And these are but the outer fringe of his works; how faint the whisper we hear of him! Who then can understand the thunder of his power?"

verses.textZh: 约伯继续他的讲论，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 约伯继续他的讲论，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 约伯接着说：
verses.textEnNiv: And Job continued his discourse:
verses.textEnEsv: And Job again took up his discourse, and said:
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover Job continued his discourse, and said:
verses.textEnNlt: Job continued speaking:
verses.textEnNasb: Job again took up his discourse and said,
verses.textEn: And Job continued his discourse:

verses.textZh: "永活的神夺去我的公理， 全能者使我心中痛苦。
verses.textZhCnvs: "永活的神夺去我的公理， 全能者使我心中痛苦。
verses.textZhCuv: 神夺去我的理，全能者使我心中愁苦。 我指着永生的神起誓：
verses.textEnNiv: "As surely as God lives, who has denied me justice, the Almighty, who has made my life bitter,
verses.textEnEsv: "As God lives, who has taken away my right, and the Almighty, who has made my soul bitter,
verses.textEnNkjv: "As God lives, who has taken away my justice, And the Almighty, who has made my soul bitter,
verses.textEnNlt: "I vow by the living God, who has taken away my rights, by the Almighty who has embittered my soul—
verses.textEnNasb: "As God lives, who has taken away my right, And the Almighty, who has embittered my soul,
verses.textEn: "As surely as God lives, who has denied me justice, the Almighty, who has made my life bitter,

verses.textZh: 只要我的生命还在我里面，神赐我的气息还在我鼻孔里，
verses.textZhCnvs: 只要我的生命还在我里面，神赐我的气息还在我鼻孔里，
verses.textZhCuv: 我的生命尚在我里面；神所赐呼吸之气仍在我的鼻孔内。
verses.textEnNiv: as long as I have life within me, the breath of God in my nostrils,
verses.textEnEsv: as long as my breath is in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils,
verses.textEnNkjv: As long as my breath is in me, And the breath of God in my nostrils,
verses.textEnNlt: As long as I live, while I have breath from God,
verses.textEnNasb: For as long as life is in me, And the breath of God is in my nostrils,
verses.textEn: as long as I have life within me, the breath of God in my nostrils,

verses.textZh: 我的嘴唇决不说不义之言， 我的舌头也不讲诡诈之语。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的嘴唇决不说不义之言， 我的舌头也不讲诡诈之语。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的嘴决不说非义之言； 我的舌也不说诡诈之语。
verses.textEnNiv: my lips will not say anything wicked, and my tongue will not utter lies.
verses.textEnEsv: my lips will not speak falsehood, and my tongue will not utter deceit.
verses.textEnNkjv: My lips will not speak wickedness, Nor my tongue utter deceit.
verses.textEnNlt: my lips will speak no evil, and my tongue will speak no lies.
verses.textEnNasb: My lips certainly will not speak unjustly, Nor will my tongue mutter deceit.
verses.textEn: my lips will not say anything wicked, and my tongue will not utter lies.

verses.textZh: 我绝对不以你们为是， 我到死也不放弃我的纯全；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我绝对不以你们为是， 我到死也不放弃我的纯全；
verses.textZhCuv: 我断不以你们为是； 我至死必不以自己为不正！
verses.textEnNiv: I will never admit you are in the right; till I die, I will not deny my integrity.
verses.textEnEsv: Far be it from me to say that you are right; till I die I will not put away my integrity from me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Far be it from me That I should say you are right; Till I die I will not put away my integrity from me.
verses.textEnNlt: I will never concede that you are right; I will defend my integrity until I die.
verses.textEnNasb: "Far be it from me that I should declare you right; Until I die, I will not give up my integrity.
verses.textEn: I will never admit you are in the right; till I die, I will not deny my integrity.

verses.textZh: 我坚守我的义决不放松， 我一生的日子我的心必不责备我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我坚守我的义决不放松， 我一生的日子我的心必不责备我。
verses.textZhCuv: 我持定我的义，必不放松； 在世的日子，我心必不责备我。
verses.textEnNiv: I will maintain my innocence and never let go of it; my conscience will not reproach me as long as I live.
verses.textEnEsv: I hold fast my righteousness and will not let it go; my heart does not reproach me for any of my days.
verses.textEnNkjv: My righteousness I hold fast, and will not let it go; My heart shall not reproach me as long as I live.
verses.textEnNlt: I will maintain my innocence without wavering. My conscience is clear for as long as I live.
verses.textEnNasb: "I have kept hold of my righteousness and will not let it go. My heart does not rebuke any of my days.
verses.textEn: I will maintain my innocence and never let go of it; my conscience will not reproach me as long as I live.

verses.textZh: 愿我的敌人如恶人一般， 愿那起来攻击我的像不义的人一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿我的敌人如恶人一般， 愿那起来攻击我的像不义的人一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿我的仇敌如恶人一样； 愿那起来攻击我的，如不义之人一般。
verses.textEnNiv: "May my enemy be like the wicked, my adversary like the unjust!
verses.textEnEsv: "Let my enemy be as the wicked, and let him who rises up against me be as the unrighteous.
verses.textEnNkjv: "May my enemy be like the wicked, And he who rises up against me like the unrighteous.
verses.textEnNlt: "May my enemy be punished like the wicked, my adversary like those who do evil.
verses.textEnNasb: "May my enemy be as the wicked, And my opponent as the criminal.
verses.textEn: "May my enemy be like the wicked, my adversary like the unjust!

verses.textZh: 不敬虔的人被剪除，神夺去他性命的时候还有甚么指望呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 不敬虔的人被剪除，神夺去他性命的时候还有甚么指望呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 不敬虔的人虽然得利，神夺取其命的时候还有什么指望呢？
verses.textEnNiv: For what hope have the godless when they are cut off, when God takes away their life?
verses.textEnEsv: For what is the hope of the godless when God cuts him off, when God takes away his life?
verses.textEnNkjv: For what is the hope of the hypocrite, Though he may gain much, If God takes away his life?
verses.textEnNlt: For what hope do the godless have when God cuts them off and takes away their life?
verses.textEnNasb: "For what is the hope of the godless when he makes an end of life, When God requires his life?
verses.textEn: For what hope have the godless when they are cut off, when God takes away their life?

verses.textZh: 患难临到他身上的时候，神会垂听他的哀求吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 患难临到他身上的时候，神会垂听他的哀求吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 患难临到他，神岂能听他的呼求？
verses.textEnNiv: Does God listen to their cry when distress comes upon them?
verses.textEnEsv: Will God hear his cry when distress comes upon him?
verses.textEnNkjv: Will God hear his cry When trouble comes upon him?
verses.textEnNlt: Will God listen to their cry when trouble comes upon them?
verses.textEnNasb: "Will God hear his cry When distress comes upon him?
verses.textEn: Does God listen to their cry when distress comes upon them?

verses.textZh: 他以全能者为乐， 时时求告神吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 他以全能者为乐， 时时求告神吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 他岂以全能者为乐， 随时求告神呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Will they find delight in the Almighty? Will they call on God at all times?
verses.textEnEsv: Will he take delight in the Almighty? Will he call upon God at all times?
verses.textEnNkjv: Will he delight himself in the Almighty? Will he always call on God?
verses.textEnNlt: Can they take delight in the Almighty? Can they call to God at any time?
verses.textEnNasb: "Or will he take pleasure in the Almighty? Will he call on God at all times?
verses.textEn: Will they find delight in the Almighty? Will they call on God at all times?

verses.textZh: 我藉神的能力教导你们， 我不向你们隐瞒全能者的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我藉神的能力教导你们， 我不向你们隐瞒全能者的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 神的作为，我要指教你们； 全能者所行的，我也不隐瞒。
verses.textEnNiv: "I will teach you about the power of God; the ways of the Almighty I will not conceal.
verses.textEnEsv: I will teach you concerning the hand of God; what is with the Almighty I will not conceal.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I will teach you about the hand of God; What is with the Almighty I will not conceal.
verses.textEnNlt: I will teach you about God’s power. I will not conceal anything concerning the Almighty.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will instruct you in the power of God; What is with the Almighty I will not conceal.
verses.textEn: "I will teach you about the power of God; the ways of the Almighty I will not conceal.

verses.textZh: 你们都亲自见过， 你们为甚么成了这么虚妄呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们都亲自见过， 你们为甚么成了这么虚妄呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们自己也都见过， 为何全然变为虚妄呢？
verses.textEnNiv: You have all seen this yourselves. Why then this meaningless talk?
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, all of you have seen it yourselves; why then have you become altogether vain?
verses.textEnNkjv: Surely all of you have seen it; Why then do you behave with complete nonsense?
verses.textEnNlt: But you have seen all this, yet you say all these useless things to me.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, all of you have seen it; Why then do you talk of nothing?
verses.textEn: You have all seen this yourselves. Why then this meaningless talk?

verses.textZh: 这是恶人从神所得的分， 强暴的人从全能者所得的业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是恶人从神所得的分， 强暴的人从全能者所得的业。
verses.textZhCuv: 神为恶人所定的分， 强暴人从全能者所得的报 乃是这样：
verses.textEnNiv: "Here is the fate God allots to the wicked, the heritage a ruthless man receives from the Almighty:
verses.textEnEsv: "This is the portion of a wicked man with God, and the heritage that oppressors receive from the Almighty:
verses.textEnNkjv: "This is the portion of a wicked man with God, And the heritage of oppressors, received from the Almighty:
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the wicked will receive from God; this is their inheritance from the Almighty.
verses.textEnNasb: "This is the portion of a wicked person from God, And the inheritance which tyrants receive from the Almighty:
verses.textEn: "Here is the fate God allots to the wicked, the heritage a ruthless man receives from the Almighty:

verses.textZh: 即使他的儿女增多，还是被刀剑所杀， 他的子孙也必永不得饱食；
verses.textZhCnvs: 即使他的儿女增多，还是被刀剑所杀， 他的子孙也必永不得饱食；
verses.textZhCuv: 倘或他的儿女增多，还是被刀所杀； 他的子孙必不得饱食。
verses.textEnNiv: However many his children, their fate is the sword; his offspring will never have enough to eat.
verses.textEnEsv: If his children are multiplied, it is for the sword, and his descendants have not enough bread.
verses.textEnNkjv: If his children are multiplied, itis for the sword; And his offspring shall not be satisfied with bread.
verses.textEnNlt: They may have many children, but the children will die in war or starve to death.
verses.textEnNasb: Though his sons are many, they are destined for the sword; And his descendants will not be satisfied with bread.
verses.textEn: However many his children, their fate is the sword; his offspring will never have enough to eat.

verses.textZh: 他的遗族在死人中埋葬， 他的寡妇也都不哀哭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的遗族在死人中埋葬， 他的寡妇也都不哀哭。
verses.textZhCuv: 他所遗留的人必死而埋葬； 他的寡妇也不哀哭。
verses.textEnNiv: The plague will bury those who survive him, and their widows will not weep for them.
verses.textEnEsv: Those who survive him the pestilence buries, and his widows do not weep.
verses.textEnNkjv: Those who survive him shall be buried in death, And their widows shall not weep,
verses.textEnNlt: Those who survive will die of a plague, and not even their widows will mourn them.
verses.textEnNasb: "His survivors will be buried because of the plague, And their widows will not be able to weep.
verses.textEn: The plague will bury those who survive him, and their widows will not weep for them.

verses.textZh: 他虽然堆积银子如尘沙， 预备衣服如泥土，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他虽然堆积银子如尘沙， 预备衣服如泥土，
verses.textZhCuv: 他虽积蓄银子如尘沙， 预备衣服如泥土；
verses.textEnNiv: Though he heaps up silver like dust and clothes like piles of clay,
verses.textEnEsv: Though he heap up silver like dust, and pile up clothing like clay,
verses.textEnNkjv: Though he heaps up silver like dust, And piles up clothing like clay—
verses.textEnNlt: "Evil people may have piles of money and may store away mounds of clothing.
verses.textEnNasb: "Though he piles up silver like dust, And prepares garments as plentiful as the clay,
verses.textEn: Though he heaps up silver like dust and clothes like piles of clay,

verses.textZh: 他尽管预备，义人却要穿上； 他的银子，无辜的人也要瓜分。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他尽管预备，义人却要穿上； 他的银子，无辜的人也要瓜分。
verses.textZhCuv: 他只管预备，义人却要穿上； 他的银子，无辜的人要分取。
verses.textEnNiv: what he lays up the righteous will wear, and the innocent will divide his silver.
verses.textEnEsv: he may pile it up, but the righteous will wear it, and the innocent will divide the silver.
verses.textEnNkjv: He may pile it up, but the just will wear it, And the innocent will divide the silver.
verses.textEnNlt: But the righteous will wear that clothing, and the innocent will divide that money.
verses.textEnNasb: He may prepare it, but the righteous will wear it And the innocent will divide the silver.
verses.textEn: what he lays up the righteous will wear, and the innocent will divide his silver.

verses.textZh: 他建造房屋如蜘蛛结网， 又如守望者所搭的棚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他建造房屋如蜘蛛结网， 又如守望者所搭的棚。
verses.textZhCuv: 他建造房屋如虫做窝， 又如守望者所搭的棚。
verses.textEnNiv: The house he builds is like a moth’s cocoon, like a hut made by a watchman.
verses.textEnEsv: He builds his house like a moth’s, like a booth that a watchman makes.
verses.textEnNkjv: He builds his house like a moth, Like a booth which a watchman makes.
verses.textEnNlt: The wicked build houses as fragile as a spider’s web, as flimsy as a shelter made of branches.
verses.textEnNasb: "He has built his house like the spider’s web, Or a hut which the watchman has made.
verses.textEn: The house he builds is like a moth’s cocoon, like a hut made by a watchman.

verses.textZh: 他虽然躺下的时候富有，却不再这样； 他一张开双眼，财富就不在了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他虽然躺下的时候富有，却不再这样； 他一张开双眼，财富就不在了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他虽富足躺卧，却不得收殓， 转眼之间就不在了。
verses.textEnNiv: He lies down wealthy, but will do so no more; when he opens his eyes, all is gone.
verses.textEnEsv: He goes to bed rich, but will do so no more; he opens his eyes, and his wealth is gone.
verses.textEnNkjv: The rich man will lie down, But not be gathered up; He opens his eyes, And he is no more.
verses.textEnNlt: The wicked go to bed rich but wake to find that all their wealth is gone.
verses.textEnNasb: "He lies down rich, but never again; He opens his eyes, and it no longer exists.
verses.textEn: He lies down wealthy, but will do so no more; when he opens his eyes, all is gone.

verses.textZh: 惊恐必如众水追上他， 暴风在夜间把他刮去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 惊恐必如众水追上他， 暴风在夜间把他刮去。
verses.textZhCuv: 惊恐如波涛将他追上； 暴风在夜间将他刮去。
verses.textEnNiv: Terrors overtake him like a flood; a tempest snatches him away in the night.
verses.textEnEsv: Terrors overtake him like a flood; in the night a whirlwind carries him off.
verses.textEnNkjv: Terrors overtake him like a flood; A tempest steals him away in the night.
verses.textEnNlt: Terror overwhelms them like a flood, and they are blown away in the storms of the night.
verses.textEnNasb: "Terrors overtake him like a flood; A storm steals him away in the night.
verses.textEn: Terrors overtake him like a flood; a tempest snatches him away in the night.

verses.textZh: 东风把他吹起，他就消逝； 又把他卷起，离开原来的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 东风把他吹起，他就消逝； 又把他卷起，离开原来的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 东风把他飘去， 又刮他离开本处。
verses.textEnNiv: The east wind carries him off, and he is gone; it sweeps him out of his place.
verses.textEnEsv: The east wind lifts him up and he is gone; it sweeps him out of his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: The east wind carries him away, and he is gone; It sweeps him out of his place.
verses.textEnNlt: The east wind carries them away, and they are gone. It sweeps them away.
verses.textEnNasb: "The east wind carries him away, and he is gone; For it sweeps him away from his place.
verses.textEn: The east wind carries him off, and he is gone; it sweeps him out of his place.

verses.textZh: 神射击他，毫不留情， 他甚愿快快逃脱神的手。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神射击他，毫不留情， 他甚愿快快逃脱神的手。
verses.textZhCuv: 神要向他射箭，并不留情； 他恨不得逃脱神的手。
verses.textEnNiv: It hurls itself against him without mercy as he flees headlong from its power.
verses.textEnEsv: It hurls at him without pity; he flees from its power in headlong flight.
verses.textEnNkjv: It hurls against him and does not spare; He flees desperately from its power.
verses.textEnNlt: It whirls down on them without mercy. They struggle to flee from its power.
verses.textEnNasb: "For it will hurl at him without mercy; He will certainly try to flee from its power.
verses.textEn: It hurls itself against him without mercy as he flees headlong from its power.

verses.textZh: 有人向他拍掌， 发咝声赶他离开原来的地方。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人向他拍掌， 发咝声赶他离开原来的地方。"
verses.textZhCuv: 人要向他拍掌， 并要发叱声，使他离开本处。
verses.textEnNiv: It claps its hands in derision and hisses him out of his place."
verses.textEnEsv: It claps its hands at him and hisses at him from its place.
verses.textEnNkjv: Men shall clap their hands at him, And shall hiss him out of his place.
verses.textEnNlt: But everyone jeers at them and mocks them.
verses.textEnNasb: "People will clap their hands at him, And will whistle at him from their places.
verses.textEn: It claps its hands in derision and hisses him out of his place."

verses.textZh: "银子有矿， 金子有冶炼的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: "银子有矿， 金子有冶炼的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 银子有矿； 炼金有方。
verses.textEnNiv: There is a mine for silver and a place where gold is refined.
verses.textEnEsv: "Surely there is a mine for silver, and a place for gold that they refine.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Surely there is a mine for silver, And a place where gold is refined.
verses.textEnNlt: "People know where to mine silver and how to refine gold.
verses.textEnNasb: "Certainly there is a mine for silver And a place for refining gold.
verses.textEn: There is a mine for silver and a place where gold is refined.

verses.textZh: 铁从土中取出， 熔化石头而得铜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 铁从土中取出， 熔化石头而得铜。
verses.textZhCuv: 铁从地里挖出； 铜从石中熔化。
verses.textEnNiv: Iron is taken from the earth, and copper is smelted from ore.
verses.textEnEsv: Iron is taken out of the earth, and copper is smelted from the ore.
verses.textEnNkjv: Iron is taken from the earth, And copper is smelted from ore.
verses.textEnNlt: They know where to dig iron from the earth and how to smelt copper from rock.
verses.textEnNasb: "Iron is taken from the dust, And copper is smelted from rock.
verses.textEn: Iron is taken from the earth, and copper is smelted from ore.

verses.textZh: 人探求黑暗的尽头， 查明在阴暗中的石矿，直到极处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人探求黑暗的尽头， 查明在阴暗中的石矿，直到极处。
verses.textZhCuv: 人为黑暗定界限， 查究幽暗阴翳的石头，直到极处，
verses.textEnNiv: Mortals put an end to the darkness; they search out the farthest recesses for ore in the blackest darkness.
verses.textEnEsv: Man puts an end to darkness and searches out to the farthest limit the ore in gloom and deep darkness.
verses.textEnNkjv: Man puts an end to darkness, And searches every recess For ore in the darkness and the shadow of death.
verses.textEnNlt: They know how to shine light in the darkness and explore the farthest regions of the earth as they search in the dark for ore.
verses.textEnNasb: "Man puts an end to darkness, And to the farthest limit he searches out The rock in gloom and deep shadow.
verses.textEn: Mortals put an end to the darkness; they search out the farthest recesses for ore in the blackest darkness.

verses.textZh: 在无人居住之处， 足迹罕至之地开坑探矿， 他们与人远离，悬在坑中摇来摇去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在无人居住之处， 足迹罕至之地开坑探矿， 他们与人远离，悬在坑中摇来摇去。
verses.textZhCuv: 在无人居住之处刨开矿穴， 过路的人也想不到他们； 又与人远离，悬在空中摇来摇去。
verses.textEnNiv: Far from human dwellings they cut a shaft, in places untouched by human feet; far from other people they dangle and sway.
verses.textEnEsv: He opens shafts in a valley away from where anyone lives; they are forgotten by travelers; they hang in the air, far away from mankind; they swing to and fro.
verses.textEnNkjv: He breaks open a shaft away from people; Inplaces forgotten by feet They hang far away from men; They swing to and fro.
verses.textEnNlt: They sink a mine shaft into the earth far from where anyone lives. They descend on ropes, swinging back and forth.
verses.textEnNasb: "He sinks a shaft away from inhabited areas, Forgotten by the foot; They hang and swing, away from people.
verses.textEn: Far from human dwellings they cut a shaft, in places untouched by human feet; far from other people they dangle and sway.

verses.textZh: 至于地，粮食从它而出， 地底下却好象被火翻转过来一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于地，粮食从它而出， 地底下却好象被火翻转过来一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于地，能出粮食， 地内好像被火翻起来。
verses.textEnNiv: The earth, from which food comes, is transformed below as by fire;
verses.textEnEsv: As for the earth, out of it comes bread, but underneath it is turned up as by fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: Asfor the earth, from it comes bread, But underneath it is turned up as by fire;
verses.textEnNlt: Food is grown on the earth above, but down below, the earth is melted as by fire.
verses.textEnNasb: " From the earth comes food, And underneath, it is turned over like fire.
verses.textEn: The earth, from which food comes, is transformed below as by fire;

verses.textZh: 石中有蓝宝石， 也有金沙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 石中有蓝宝石， 也有金沙。
verses.textZhCuv: 地中的石头有蓝宝石， 并有金沙。
verses.textEnNiv: lapis lazuli comes from its rocks, and its dust contains nuggets of gold.
verses.textEnEsv: Its stones are the place of sapphires, and it has dust of gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: Its stones are the source of sapphires, And it contains gold dust.
verses.textEnNlt: Here the rocks contain precious lapis lazuli, and the dust contains gold.
verses.textEnNasb: "Its rocks are the source of sapphires, And its dust contains gold.
verses.textEn: lapis lazuli comes from its rocks, and its dust contains nuggets of gold.

verses.textZh: 矿坑中的路，鸷鸟不知道， 连鹰的眼也未曾见过；
verses.textZhCnvs: 矿坑中的路，鸷鸟不知道， 连鹰的眼也未曾见过；
verses.textZhCuv: 矿中的路鸷鸟不得知道； 鹰眼也未见过。
verses.textEnNiv: No bird of prey knows that hidden path, no falcon’s eye has seen it.
verses.textEnEsv: "That path no bird of prey knows, and the falcon’s eye has not seen it.
verses.textEnNkjv: That path no bird knows, Nor has the falcon’s eye seen it.
verses.textEnNlt: These are treasures no bird of prey can see, no falcon’s eye observe.
verses.textEnNasb: "No bird of prey knows the path, Nor has the falcon’s eye caught sight of it.
verses.textEn: No bird of prey knows that hidden path, no falcon’s eye has seen it.

verses.textZh: 狂傲的野兽未曾行过， 猛狮也未曾经过。
verses.textZhCnvs: 狂傲的野兽未曾行过， 猛狮也未曾经过。
verses.textZhCuv: 狂傲的野兽未曾行过； 猛烈的狮子也未曾经过。
verses.textEnNiv: Proud beasts do not set foot on it, and no lion prowls there.
verses.textEnEsv: The proud beasts have not trodden it; the lion has not passed over it.
verses.textEnNkjv: The proud lions have not trodden it, Nor has the fierce lion passed over it.
verses.textEnNlt: No wild animal has walked upon these treasures; no lion has ever set his paw there.
verses.textEnNasb: "The proud animals have not trodden it, Nor has the lion passed over it.
verses.textEn: Proud beasts do not set foot on it, and no lion prowls there.

verses.textZh: 人伸手击凿坚石，使山脚翻倒过来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人伸手击凿坚石，使山脚翻倒过来。
verses.textZhCuv: 人伸手凿开坚石， 倾倒山根，
verses.textEnNiv: People assault the flinty rock with their hands and lay bare the roots of the mountains.
verses.textEnEsv: "Man puts his hand to the flinty rock and overturns mountains by the roots.
verses.textEnNkjv: He puts his hand on the flint; He overturns the mountains at the roots.
verses.textEnNlt: People know how to tear apart flinty rocks and overturn the roots of mountains.
verses.textEnNasb: "He puts his hand on the flint; He overturns the mountains at the base.
verses.textEn: People assault the flinty rock with their hands and lay bare the roots of the mountains.

verses.textZh: 在盘石中凿出坑道， 亲眼看见各样宝物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在盘石中凿出坑道， 亲眼看见各样宝物。
verses.textZhCuv: 在磐石中凿出水道， 亲眼看见各样宝物。
verses.textEnNiv: They tunnel through the rock; their eyes see all its treasures.
verses.textEnEsv: He cuts out channels in the rocks, and his eye sees every precious thing.
verses.textEnNkjv: He cuts out channels in the rocks, And his eye sees every precious thing.
verses.textEnNlt: They cut tunnels in the rocks and uncover precious stones.
verses.textEnNasb: "He carves out channels through the rocks, And his eye sees anything precious.
