verses.textEnNkjv: "If my land cries out against me, And its furrows weep together;
verses.textEnNlt: "If my land accuses me and all its furrows cry out together,
verses.textEnNasb: "If my land cries out against me, And its furrows weep together;
verses.textEn: "if my land cries out against me and all its furrows are wet with tears,

verses.textZh: 我若吃地里的出产而不给价银， 或使地主气绝身亡，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我若吃地里的出产而不给价银， 或使地主气绝身亡，
verses.textZhCuv: 我若吃地的出产不给价值， 或叫原主丧命；
verses.textEnNiv: if I have devoured its yield without payment or broken the spirit of its tenants,
verses.textEnEsv: if I have eaten its yield without payment and made its owners breathe their last,
verses.textEnNkjv: If I have eaten its fruit without money, Or caused its owners to lose their lives;
verses.textEnNlt: or if I have stolen its crops or murdered its owners,
verses.textEnNasb: If I have eaten its fruit without money, Or have caused its owners to lose their lives,
verses.textEn: if I have devoured its yield without payment or broken the spirit of its tenants,

verses.textZh: 就愿蒺藜长出来代替小麦， 臭草代替大麦。" 约伯的话说完了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就愿蒺藜长出来代替小麦， 臭草代替大麦。" 约伯的话说完了。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿这地长蒺藜代替麦子， 长恶草代替大麦。 约伯的话说完了。
verses.textEnNiv: then let briers come up instead of wheat and stinkweed instead of barley." The words of Job are ended.
verses.textEnEsv: let thorns grow instead of wheat, and foul weeds instead of barley." The words of Job are ended.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then let thistles grow instead of wheat, And weeds instead of barley." The words of Job are ended.
verses.textEnNlt: then let thistles grow on that land instead of wheat, and weeds instead of barley." Job’s words are ended.
verses.textEnNasb: May the thorn-bush grow instead of wheat, And stinkweed instead of barley." The words of Job are ended.
verses.textEn: then let briers come up instead of wheat and stinkweed instead of barley." The words of Job are ended.

verses.textZh: 因为约伯自以为义，于是这三个人就不再回答他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为约伯自以为义，于是这三个人就不再回答他。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是这三个人，因约伯自以为义就不再回答他。
verses.textEnNiv: So these three men stopped answering Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.
verses.textEnEsv: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.
verses.textEnNkjv: So these three men ceased answering Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.
verses.textEnNlt: Job’s three friends refused to reply further to him because he kept insisting on his innocence.
verses.textEnNasb: Then these three men stopped answering Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.
verses.textEn: So these three men stopped answering Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.

verses.textZh: 那时，布西人兰族巴拉迦的儿子以利户发怒了；他向约伯发怒，因为他在神面前自以为义。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，布西人兰族巴拉迦的儿子以利户发怒了；他向约伯发怒，因为他在神面前自以为义。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时有布西人兰族巴拉迦的儿子以利户向约伯发怒；因约伯自以为义，不以神为义。
verses.textEnNiv: But Elihu son of Barakel the Buzite, of the family of Ram, became very angry with Job for justifying himself rather than God.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the family of Ram, burned with anger. He burned with anger at Job because he justified himself rather than God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the wrath of Elihu, the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the family of Ram, was aroused against Job; his wrath was aroused because he justified himself rather than God.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Elihu son of Barakel the Buzite, of the clan of Ram, became angry. He was angry because Job refused to admit that he had sinned and that God was right in punishing him.
verses.textEnNasb: But the anger of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the family of Ram, burned against Job; his anger burned because he justified himself before God.
verses.textEn: But Elihu son of Barakel the Buzite, of the family of Ram, became very angry with Job for justifying himself rather than God.

verses.textZh: 他又向约伯的三个朋友发怒，因为他们虽然仍以约伯为有罪，却找不到回答的话来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又向约伯的三个朋友发怒，因为他们虽然仍以约伯为有罪，却找不到回答的话来。
verses.textZhCuv: 他又向约伯的三个朋友发怒；因为他们想不出回答的话来，仍以约伯为有罪。
verses.textEnNiv: He was also angry with the three friends, because they had found no way to refute Job, and yet had condemned him.
verses.textEnEsv: He burned with anger also at Job’s three friends because they had found no answer, although they had declared Job to be in the wrong.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also against his three friends his wrath was aroused, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.
verses.textEnNlt: He was also angry with Job’s three friends, for they made God appear to be wrong by their inability to answer Job’s arguments.
verses.textEnNasb: And his anger burned against his three friends because they had found no answer, yet they had condemned Job.
verses.textEn: He was also angry with the three friends, because they had found no way to refute Job, and yet had condemned him.

verses.textZh: 以利户等待着要向约伯说话，因为他们的年纪都比以利户大。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利户等待着要向约伯说话，因为他们的年纪都比以利户大。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利户要与约伯说话，就等候他们，因为他们比自己年老。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Elihu had waited before speaking to Job because they were older than he.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Elihu had waited to speak to Job because they were older than he.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now because they were years older than he, Elihu had waited to speak to Job.
verses.textEnNlt: Elihu had waited for the others to speak to Job because they were older than he.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Elihu had waited to speak to Job because they were years older than he.
verses.textEn: Now Elihu had waited before speaking to Job because they were older than he.

verses.textZh: 以利户一见这三个人的口里无话回答，他就发怒了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利户一见这三个人的口里无话回答，他就发怒了。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利户见这三个人口中无话回答，就怒气发作。
verses.textEnNiv: But when he saw that the three men had nothing more to say, his anger was aroused.
verses.textEnEsv: And when Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, he burned with anger.
verses.textEnNkjv: When Elihu saw that therewas no answer in the mouth of these three men, his wrath was aroused.
verses.textEnNlt: But when he saw that they had no further reply, he spoke out angrily.
verses.textEnNasb: But when Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of the three men, his anger burned.
verses.textEn: But when he saw that the three men had nothing more to say, his anger was aroused.

verses.textZh: 布西人巴拉迦的儿子以利户回答说： "我年纪轻，你们年纪大， 因此我拘束畏惧，不敢向你们表达我的意见。
verses.textZhCnvs: 布西人巴拉迦的儿子以利户回答说： "我年纪轻，你们年纪大， 因此我拘束畏惧，不敢向你们表达我的意见。
verses.textZhCuv: 布西人巴拉迦的儿子以利户回答说： 我年轻，你们老迈； 因此我退让，不敢向你们陈说我的意见。
verses.textEnNiv: So Elihu son of Barakel the Buzite said: "I am young in years, and you are old; that is why I was fearful, not daring to tell you what I know.
verses.textEnEsv: And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said: "I am young in years, and you are aged; therefore I was timid and afraid to declare my opinion to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Elihu, the son of Barachel the Buzite, answered and said: "I am young in years, and you are very old; Therefore I was afraid, And dared not declare my opinion to you.
verses.textEnNlt: Elihu son of Barakel the Buzite said, "I am young and you are old, so I held back from telling you what I think.
verses.textEnNasb: So Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite spoke out and said, "I am young in years and you are old; Therefore I was shy and afraid to tell you what I think.
verses.textEn: So Elihu son of Barakel the Buzite said: "I am young in years, and you are old; that is why I was fearful, not daring to tell you what I know.

verses.textZh: 我心里想：‘年长的当先说话， 寿高的当以智慧教训人。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我心里想：‘年长的当先说话， 寿高的当以智慧教训人。’
verses.textZhCuv: 我说，年老的当先说话； 寿高的当以智慧教训人。
verses.textEnNiv: I thought, ‘Age should speak; advanced years should teach wisdom.’
verses.textEnEsv: I said, ‘Let days speak, and many years teach wisdom.’
verses.textEnNkjv: I said, ‘Age should speak, And multitude of years should teach wisdom.’
verses.textEnNlt: I thought, ‘Those who are older should speak, for wisdom comes with age.’
verses.textEnNasb: "I thought age should speak, And increased years should teach wisdom.
verses.textEn: I thought, ‘Age should speak; advanced years should teach wisdom.’

verses.textZh: 但是在人心里面有灵， 全能者的气息使人有聪明。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是在人心里面有灵， 全能者的气息使人有聪明。
verses.textZhCuv: 但在人里面有灵； 全能者的气使人有聪明。
verses.textEnNiv: But it is the spirit in a person, the breath of the Almighty, that gives them understanding.
verses.textEnEsv: But it is the spirit in man, the breath of the Almighty, that makes him understand.
verses.textEnNkjv: But thereis a spirit in man, And the breath of the Almighty gives him understanding.
verses.textEnNlt: But there is a spirit within people, the breath of the Almighty within them, that makes them intelligent.
verses.textEnNasb: "But it is a spirit that is in mankind, And the breath of the Almighty gives them understanding.
verses.textEn: But it is the spirit in a person, the breath of the Almighty, that gives them understanding.

verses.textZh: 年纪大的不都有智慧， 年老的不都能明白是非，
verses.textZhCnvs: 年纪大的不都有智慧， 年老的不都能明白是非，
verses.textZhCuv: 尊贵的不都有智慧； 寿高的不都能明白公平。
verses.textEnNiv: It is not only the old who are wise, not only the aged who understand what is right.
verses.textEnEsv: It is not the old who are wise, nor the aged who understand what is right.
verses.textEnNkjv: Great men are not always wise, Nor do the aged always understand justice.
verses.textEnNlt: Sometimes the elders are not wise. Sometimes the aged do not understand justice.
verses.textEnNasb: "The abundant in years may not be wise, Nor may elders understand justice.
verses.textEn: It is not only the old who are wise, not only the aged who understand what is right.

verses.textZh: 因此我说：‘你们要听我说话， 我也要说出我的意见。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此我说：‘你们要听我说话， 我也要说出我的意见。’
verses.textZhCuv: 因此我说：你们要听我言； 我也要陈说我的意见。
verses.textEnNiv: "Therefore I say: Listen to me; I too will tell you what I know.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore I say, ‘Listen to me; let me also declare my opinion.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore I say, ‘Listen to me, I also will declare my opinion.’
verses.textEnNlt: So listen to me, and let me tell you what I think.
verses.textEnNasb: "So I say, ‘Listen to me, I too will tell what I think.’
verses.textEn: "Therefore I say: Listen to me; I too will tell you what I know.

verses.textZh: 你们砌词说话的时候， 我等待着你们的话， 留心听你们的理论。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们砌词说话的时候， 我等待着你们的话， 留心听你们的理论。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们查究所要说的话； 那时我等候你们的话， 侧耳听你们的辩论，
verses.textEnNiv: I waited while you spoke, I listened to your reasoning; while you were searching for words,
verses.textEnEsv: "Behold, I waited for your words, I listened for your wise sayings, while you searched out what to say.
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed I waited for your words, I listened to your reasonings, while you searched out what to say.
verses.textEnNlt: "I have waited all this time, listening very carefully to your arguments, listening to you grope for words.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, I waited for your words, I listened to your skillful speech, While you pondered what to say.
verses.textEn: I waited while you spoke, I listened to your reasoning; while you were searching for words,

verses.textZh: 我留意听你们， 不料，你们中间没有人能驳倒约伯， 驳回他所说的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我留意听你们， 不料，你们中间没有人能驳倒约伯， 驳回他所说的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 留心听你们； 谁知你们中间无一人折服约伯， 驳倒他的话。
verses.textEnNiv: I gave you my full attention. But not one of you has proved Job wrong; none of you has answered his arguments.
verses.textEnEsv: I gave you my attention, and, behold, there was none among you who refuted Job or who answered his words.
verses.textEnNkjv: I paid close attention to you; And surely not one of you convinced Job, Or answered his words—
verses.textEnNlt: I have listened, but not one of you has refuted Job or answered his arguments.
verses.textEnNasb: "I also paid close attention to you; But indeed, there was no one who refuted Job, Not one of you who answered his words.
verses.textEn: I gave you my full attention. But not one of you has proved Job wrong; none of you has answered his arguments.

verses.textZh: 你们不要说：‘我们寻得了智慧； 能胜过他的，是神，不是人。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们不要说：‘我们寻得了智慧； 能胜过他的，是神，不是人。’
verses.textZhCuv: 你们切不可说：我们寻得智慧；神能胜他，人却不能。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not say, ‘We have found wisdom; let God, not a man, refute him.’
verses.textEnEsv: Beware lest you say, ‘We have found wisdom; God may vanquish him, not a man.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Lest you say, ‘We have found wisdom’; God will vanquish him, not man.
verses.textEnNlt: And don’t tell me, ‘He is too wise for us. Only God can convince him.’
verses.textEnNasb: "So do not say, ‘We have found wisdom: God will defeat him, not man.’
verses.textEn: Do not say, ‘We have found wisdom; let God, not a man, refute him.’

verses.textZh: 约伯没有用他的话攻击我， 我也不用你们的话回答他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约伯没有用他的话攻击我， 我也不用你们的话回答他。
verses.textZhCuv: 约伯没有向我争辩； 我也不用你们的话回答他。
verses.textEnNiv: But Job has not marshaled his words against me, and I will not answer him with your arguments.
verses.textEnEsv: He has not directed his words against me, and I will not answer him with your speeches.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now he has not directed his words against me; So I will not answer him with your words.
verses.textEnNlt: If Job had been arguing with me, I would not answer with your kind of logic!
verses.textEnNasb: "But he has not presented his words against me, Nor will I reply to him with your arguments.
verses.textEn: But Job has not marshaled his words against me, and I will not answer him with your arguments.

verses.textZh: 他们惊惶失措，不再回应， 他们没有甚么可说的话了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们惊惶失措，不再回应， 他们没有甚么可说的话了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们惊奇不再回答， 一言不发。
verses.textEnNiv: "They are dismayed and have no more to say; words have failed them.
verses.textEnEsv: "They are dismayed; they answer no more; they have not a word to say.
verses.textEnNkjv: "They are dismayed and answer no more; Words escape them.
verses.textEnNlt: You sit there baffled, with nothing more to say.
verses.textEnNasb: "They are dismayed, they no longer answer; Words have failed them.
verses.textEn: "They are dismayed and have no more to say; words have failed them.

verses.textZh: 因为他们不说话，因为他们站着不再回应， 我就等待吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们不说话，因为他们站着不再回应， 我就等待吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 我岂因他们不说话， 站住不再回答，仍旧等候呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Must I wait, now that they are silent, now that they stand there with no reply?
verses.textEnEsv: And shall I wait, because they do not speak, because they stand there, and answer no more?
verses.textEnNkjv: And I have waited, because they did not speak, Because they stood still and answered no more.
verses.textEnNlt: Should I continue to wait, now that you are silent? Must I also remain silent?
verses.textEnNasb: "Should I wait, because they are not speaking, Because they have stopped and no longer answer?
verses.textEn: Must I wait, now that they are silent, now that they stand there with no reply?

verses.textZh: 我也要回答我的一份话， 我也要表达我的意见，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我也要回答我的一份话， 我也要表达我的意见，
verses.textZhCuv: 我也要回答我的一分话， 陈说我的意见。
verses.textEnNiv: I too will have my say; I too will tell what I know.
verses.textEnEsv: I also will answer with my share; I also will declare my opinion.
verses.textEnNkjv: I also will answer my part, I too will declare my opinion.
verses.textEnNlt: No, I will say my piece. I will speak my mind.
verses.textEnNasb: "I too will give my share of answers; I also will tell my opinion.
verses.textEn: I too will have my say; I too will tell what I know.

verses.textZh: 因为我充满了要说的话， 我里面的灵催逼我说出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我充满了要说的话， 我里面的灵催逼我说出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我的言语满怀； 我里面的灵激动我。
verses.textEnNiv: For I am full of words, and the spirit within me compels me;
verses.textEnEsv: For I am full of words; the spirit within me constrains me.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I am full of words; The spirit within me compels me.
verses.textEnNlt: For I am full of pent-up words, and the spirit within me urges me on.
verses.textEnNasb: "For I am full of words; The spirit within me compels me.
verses.textEn: For I am full of words, and the spirit within me compels me;

verses.textZh: 我里面如盛酒的囊，没有出气的地方， 又如新酒袋，快要破裂。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我里面如盛酒的囊，没有出气的地方， 又如新酒袋，快要破裂。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的胸怀如盛酒之囊没有出气之缝， 又如新皮袋快要破裂。
verses.textEnNiv: inside I am like bottled-up wine, like new wineskins ready to burst.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, my belly is like wine that has no vent; like new wineskins ready to burst.
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed my belly is like wine that has no vent; It is ready to burst like new wineskins.
verses.textEnNlt: I am like a cask of wine without a vent, like a new wineskin ready to burst!
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, my belly is like unvented wine; Like new wineskins, it is about to burst.
verses.textEn: inside I am like bottled-up wine, like new wineskins ready to burst.

verses.textZh: 我要说话，使我可以舒畅， 我要开口回答。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要说话，使我可以舒畅， 我要开口回答。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要说话，使我舒畅； 我要开口回答。
verses.textEnNiv: I must speak and find relief; I must open my lips and reply.
verses.textEnEsv: I must speak, that I may find relief; I must open my lips and answer.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will speak, that I may find relief; I must open my lips and answer.
verses.textEnNlt: I must speak to find relief, so let me give my answers.
verses.textEnNasb: "Let me speak so that I may get relief; Let me open my lips and answer.
verses.textEn: I must speak and find relief; I must open my lips and reply.

verses.textZh: 我必不徇人的情面， 也不奉承人，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必不徇人的情面， 也不奉承人，
verses.textZhCuv: 我必不看人的情面， 也不奉承人。
verses.textEnNiv: I will show no partiality, nor will I flatter anyone;
verses.textEnEsv: I will not show partiality to any man or use flattery toward any person.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let me not, I pray, show partiality to anyone; Nor let me flatter any man.
verses.textEnNlt: I won’t play favorites or try to flatter anyone.
verses.textEnNasb: "Let me be partial to no one, Nor flatter any man.
verses.textEn: I will show no partiality, nor will I flatter anyone;

verses.textZh: 因为我不晓得怎样奉承。 不然，我的创造主很快就把我除去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我不晓得怎样奉承。 不然，我的创造主很快就把我除去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我不晓得奉承； 若奉承，造我的主必快快除灭我。
verses.textEnNiv: for if I were skilled in flattery, my Maker would soon take me away.
verses.textEnEsv: For I do not know how to flatter, else my Maker would soon take me away.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I do not know how to flatter, Else my Maker would soon take me away.
verses.textEnNlt: For if I tried flattery, my Creator would soon destroy me.
verses.textEnNasb: "For I do not know how to flatter, Otherwise my Maker would quickly take me away.
verses.textEn: for if I were skilled in flattery, my Maker would soon take me away.

verses.textZh: "可是，约伯啊，请听我的言语， 留心听我的一切话。
verses.textZhCnvs: "可是，约伯啊，请听我的言语， 留心听我的一切话。
verses.textZhCuv: 约伯啊，请听我的话， 留心听我一切的言语。
verses.textEnNiv: "But now, Job, listen to my words; pay attention to everything I say.
verses.textEnEsv: "But now, hear my speech, O Job, and listen to all my words.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But please, Job, hear my speech, And listen to all my words.
verses.textEnNlt: "Listen to my words, Job; pay attention to what I have to say.
verses.textEnNasb: "However, please hear my speech, Job, And listen to all my words.
verses.textEn: "But now, Job, listen to my words; pay attention to everything I say.

verses.textZh: 我现在开口， 用舌头发言；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我现在开口， 用舌头发言；
verses.textZhCuv: 我现在开口， 用舌发言。
verses.textEnNiv: I am about to open my mouth; my words are on the tip of my tongue.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, I open my mouth; the tongue in my mouth speaks.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now, I open my mouth; My tongue speaks in my mouth.
verses.textEnNlt: Now that I have begun to speak, let me continue.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold now, I open my mouth, My tongue in my mouth speaks.
verses.textEn: I am about to open my mouth; my words are on the tip of my tongue.

verses.textZh: 我的话表明我心中的正直， 我所知道的，我的嘴唇就诚诚实实地说出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的话表明我心中的正直， 我所知道的，我的嘴唇就诚诚实实地说出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的言语要发明心中所存的正直； 我所知道的，我嘴唇要诚实地说出。
verses.textEnNiv: My words come from an upright heart; my lips sincerely speak what I know.
verses.textEnEsv: My words declare the uprightness of my heart, and what my lips know they speak sincerely.
verses.textEnNkjv: My words come from my upright heart; My lips utter pure knowledge.
verses.textEnNlt: I speak with all sincerity; I speak the truth.
verses.textEnNasb: "My words are from the integrity of my heart, And my lips speak knowledge sincerely.
verses.textEn: My words come from an upright heart; my lips sincerely speak what I know.

verses.textZh: 神的灵创造了我， 全能者的气使我存活。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神的灵创造了我， 全能者的气使我存活。
verses.textZhCuv: 神的灵造我； 全能者的气使我得生。
verses.textEnNiv: The Spirit of God has made me; the breath of the Almighty gives me life.
verses.textEnEsv: The Spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Almighty gives me life.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Spirit of God has made me, And the breath of the Almighty gives me life.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Almighty gives me life.
verses.textEnNasb: "The Spirit of God has made me, And the breath of the Almighty gives me life.
verses.textEn: The Spirit of God has made me; the breath of the Almighty gives me life.

verses.textZh: 你若能够办得到，就回答我， 用话语攻击我， 表明立场，当面攻击我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你若能够办得到，就回答我， 用话语攻击我， 表明立场，当面攻击我。
verses.textZhCuv: 你若回答我， 就站起来，在我面前陈明。
verses.textEnNiv: Answer me then, if you can; stand up and argue your case before me.
verses.textEnEsv: Answer me, if you can; set your words in order before me; take your stand.
verses.textEnNkjv: If you can answer me, Set yourwords in order before me; Take your stand.
verses.textEnNlt: Answer me, if you can; make your case and take your stand.
verses.textEnNasb: "Refute me if you can; Line up against me, take your stand.
verses.textEn: Answer me then, if you can; stand up and argue your case before me.

verses.textZh: 在神面前我与你一样， 也是用土捏造的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在神面前我与你一样， 也是用土捏造的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我在神面前与你一样， 也是用土造成。
verses.textEnNiv: I am the same as you in God’s sight; I too am a piece of clay.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, I am toward God as you are; I too was pinched off from a piece of clay.
verses.textEnNkjv: Truly I am as your spokesman before God; I also have been formed out of clay.
verses.textEnNlt: Look, you and I both belong to God. I, too, was formed from clay.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, I belong to God, like you; I too have been formed out of the clay.
verses.textEn: I am the same as you in God’s sight; I too am a piece of clay.

verses.textZh: 我的威严必不惊吓你， 我的压力也不加重在你身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的威严必不惊吓你， 我的压力也不加重在你身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 我不用威严惊吓你， 也不用势力重压你。
verses.textEnNiv: No fear of me should alarm you, nor should my hand be heavy on you.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, no fear of me need terrify you; my pressure will not be heavy upon you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Surely no fear of me will terrify you, Nor will my hand be heavy on you.
verses.textEnNlt: So you don’t need to be afraid of me. I won’t come down hard on you.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, no fear of me should terrify you, Nor should my pressure weigh heavily on you.
verses.textEn: No fear of me should alarm you, nor should my hand be heavy on you.

verses.textZh: 你所说的，我已经听见了，也听到你言语的声音，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 你所说的，我已经听见了，也听到你言语的声音，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 你所说的，我听见了， 也听见你的言语，说：
verses.textEnNiv: "But you have said in my hearing— I heard the very words—
verses.textEnEsv: "Surely you have spoken in my ears, and I have heard the sound of your words.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Surely you have spoken in my hearing, And I have heard the sound of your words, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: "You have spoken in my hearing, and I have heard your very words.
verses.textEnNasb: "You have in fact spoken while I listened, And I heard the sound of your words:
verses.textEn: "But you have said in my hearing— I heard the very words—

verses.textZh: ‘我是洁净的，毫无过犯； 我是清白的，没有罪孽。
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘我是洁净的，毫无过犯； 我是清白的，没有罪孽。
verses.textZhCuv: 我是清洁无过的，我是无辜的； 在我里面也没有罪孽。
verses.textEnNiv: ‘I am pure, I have done no wrong; I am clean and free from sin.
verses.textEnEsv: You say, ‘I am pure, without transgression; I am clean, and there is no iniquity in me.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘I am pure, without transgression; I am innocent, and thereis no iniquity in me.
verses.textEnNlt: You said, ‘I am pure; I am without sin; I am innocent; I have no guilt.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘I am pure, without wrongdoing; I am innocent and there is no guilt in me.
verses.textEn: ‘I am pure, I have done no wrong; I am clean and free from sin.

verses.textZh: 神找机会攻击我， 把我当作仇敌；
verses.textZhCnvs: 神找机会攻击我， 把我当作仇敌；
verses.textZhCuv: 神找机会攻击我， 以我为仇敌，
verses.textEnNiv: Yet God has found fault with me; he considers me his enemy.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, he finds occasions against me, he counts me as his enemy,
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet He finds occasions against me, He counts me as His enemy;
verses.textEnNlt: God is picking a quarrel with me, and he considers me his enemy.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Behold, He invents criticisms against me; He counts me as His enemy.
verses.textEn: Yet God has found fault with me; he considers me his enemy.

verses.textZh: 他把我的两脚上了木狗， 又鉴察我一切所行的。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把我的两脚上了木狗， 又鉴察我一切所行的。’
verses.textZhCuv: 把我的脚上了木狗， 窥察我一切的道路。
verses.textEnNiv: He fastens my feet in shackles; he keeps close watch on all my paths.’
verses.textEnEsv: he puts my feet in the stocks and watches all my paths.’
verses.textEnNkjv: He puts my feet in the stocks, He watches all my paths.’
verses.textEnNlt: He puts my feet in the stocks and watches my every move.’
verses.textEnNasb: ‘He puts my feet in the stocks; He watches all my paths.’
verses.textEn: He fastens my feet in shackles; he keeps close watch on all my paths.’

verses.textZh: 我要告诉你，你这话错了， 因为神比世人大。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要告诉你，你这话错了， 因为神比世人大。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要回答你说：你这话无理， 因神比世人更大。
verses.textEnNiv: "But I tell you, in this you are not right, for God is greater than any mortal.
verses.textEnEsv: "Behold, in this you are not right. I will answer you, for God is greater than man.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Look, in this you are not righteous. I will answer you, For God is greater than man.
verses.textEnNlt: "But you are wrong, and I will show you why. For God is greater than any human being.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, let me respond to you, you are not right in this, For God is greater than mankind.
verses.textEn: "But I tell you, in this you are not right, for God is greater than any mortal.

verses.textZh: 你为甚么对神争辩， 说：‘无论世人的甚么话，他都不回答’呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你为甚么对神争辩， 说：‘无论世人的甚么话，他都不回答’呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你为何与他争论呢？ 因他的事都不对人解说？
verses.textEnNiv: Why do you complain to him that he responds to no one’s words ?
verses.textEnEsv: Why do you contend against him, saying, ‘He will answer none of man’s words’?
verses.textEnNkjv: Why do you contend with Him? For He does not give an accounting of any of His words.
verses.textEnNlt: So why are you bringing a charge against him? Why say he does not respond to people’s complaints?
verses.textEnNasb: "Why do you complain to Him That He does not give an account of all His doings?
verses.textEn: Why do you complain to him that he responds to no one’s words ?

verses.textZh: 原来神用这个方法或那个方法说了， 只是，世人没有留意。
verses.textZhCnvs: 原来神用这个方法或那个方法说了， 只是，世人没有留意。
verses.textZhCuv: 神说一次、两次， 世人却不理会。
verses.textEnNiv: For God does speak—now one way, now another— though no one perceives it.
verses.textEnEsv: For God speaks in one way, and in two, though man does not perceive it.
verses.textEnNkjv: For God may speak in one way, or in another, Yetman does not perceive it.
verses.textEnNlt: For God speaks again and again, though people do not recognize it.
verses.textEnNasb: "Indeed God speaks once, Or twice, yet no one notices it.
verses.textEn: For God does speak—now one way, now another— though no one perceives it.

verses.textZh: 世人都在床上打盹， 沉睡临到他们的时候，神用异梦与夜间的异象，
verses.textZhCnvs: 世人都在床上打盹， 沉睡临到他们的时候，神用异梦与夜间的异象，
verses.textZhCuv: 人躺在床上沉睡的时候，神就用梦和夜间的异象，
verses.textEnNiv: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falls on people as they slumber in their beds,
verses.textEnEsv: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falls on men, while they slumber on their beds,
verses.textEnNkjv: In a dream, in a vision of the night, When deep sleep falls upon men, While slumbering on their beds,
verses.textEnNlt: He speaks in dreams, in visions of the night, when deep sleep falls on people as they lie in their beds.
verses.textEnNasb: "In a dream, a vision of the night, When deep sleep falls on people, While they slumber in their beds,
verses.textEn: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falls on people as they slumber in their beds,

verses.textZh: 告诉他们， 他坚定他们所得的训诲，
verses.textZhCnvs: 告诉他们， 他坚定他们所得的训诲，
verses.textZhCuv: 开通他们的耳朵， 将当受的教训印在他们心上，
verses.textEnNiv: he may speak in their ears and terrify them with warnings,
verses.textEnEsv: then he opens the ears of men and terrifies them with warnings,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He opens the ears of men, And seals their instruction.
verses.textEnNlt: He whispers in their ears and terrifies them with warnings.
verses.textEnNasb: Then He opens the ears of people, And horrifies them with warnings,
verses.textEn: he may speak in their ears and terrify them with warnings,

verses.textZh: 好叫人离开自己的恶行， 又叫人与骄傲隔绝，
verses.textZhCnvs: 好叫人离开自己的恶行， 又叫人与骄傲隔绝，
verses.textZhCuv: 好叫人不从自己的谋算， 不行骄傲的事 ，
verses.textEnNiv: to turn them from wrongdoing and keep them from pride,
verses.textEnEsv: that he may turn man aside from his deed and conceal pride from a man;
verses.textEnNkjv: In order to turn man fromhis deed, And conceal pride from man,
verses.textEnNlt: He makes them turn from doing wrong; he keeps them from pride.
verses.textEnNasb: So that He may turn a person away from bad conduct, And keep a man from pride;
verses.textEn: to turn them from wrongdoing and keep them from pride,

verses.textZh: 拦阻人的性命不下在坑里， 又阻止他的生命不死在刀下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拦阻人的性命不下在坑里， 又阻止他的生命不死在刀下。
verses.textZhCuv: 拦阻人不陷于坑里， 不死在刀下。
verses.textEnNiv: to preserve them from the pit, their lives from perishing by the sword.
verses.textEnEsv: he keeps back his soul from the pit, his life from perishing by the sword.
verses.textEnNkjv: He keeps back his soul from the Pit, And his life from perishing by the sword.
verses.textEnNlt: He protects them from the grave, from crossing over the river of death.
verses.textEnNasb: He keeps his soul back from the pit, And his life from perishing by the spear.
verses.textEn: to preserve them from the pit, their lives from perishing by the sword.

verses.textZh: 人在床上被痛苦惩治， 他的骨头不住地痛苦挣扎，
verses.textZhCnvs: 人在床上被痛苦惩治， 他的骨头不住地痛苦挣扎，
verses.textZhCuv: 人在床上被惩治， 骨头中不住地疼痛，
verses.textEnNiv: "Or someone may be chastened on a bed of pain with constant distress in their bones,
verses.textEnEsv: "Man is also rebuked with pain on his bed and with continual strife in his bones,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Man is also chastened with pain on his bed, And with strong pain in many of his bones,
verses.textEnNlt: "Or God disciplines people with pain on their sickbeds, with ceaseless aching in their bones.
verses.textEnNasb: "A person is also rebuked by pain in his bed, And with constant complaint in his bones,
verses.textEn: "Or someone may be chastened on a bed of pain with constant distress in their bones,

verses.textZh: 以致他的生命厌恶食物， 他的胃口也厌恶美食，
verses.textZhCnvs: 以致他的生命厌恶食物， 他的胃口也厌恶美食，
verses.textZhCuv: 以致他的口厌弃食物， 心厌恶美味。
verses.textEnNiv: so that their body finds food repulsive and their soul loathes the choicest meal.
verses.textEnEsv: so that his life loathes bread, and his appetite the choicest food.
verses.textEnNkjv: So that his life abhors bread, And his soul succulent food.
verses.textEnNlt: They lose their appetite for even the most delicious food.
verses.textEnNasb: So that his life loathes bread, And his soul, food that he should crave.
verses.textEn: so that their body finds food repulsive and their soul loathes the choicest meal.

verses.textZh: 他的肌肉消瘦以致看不见， 以前看不见的骨头，现在都凸出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的肌肉消瘦以致看不见， 以前看不见的骨头，现在都凸出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的肉消瘦，不得再见； 先前不见的骨头都凸出来。
verses.textEnNiv: Their flesh wastes away to nothing, and their bones, once hidden, now stick out.
verses.textEnEsv: His flesh is so wasted away that it cannot be seen, and his bones that were not seen stick out.
verses.textEnNkjv: His flesh wastes away from sight, And his bones stick out whichonce were not seen.
verses.textEnNlt: Their flesh wastes away, and their bones stick out.
verses.textEnNasb: "His flesh wastes away from sight, And his bones, which were not seen, stick out.
verses.textEn: Their flesh wastes away to nothing, and their bones, once hidden, now stick out.

verses.textZh: 他的性命接近深坑， 他的生命靠近灭命的天使。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的性命接近深坑， 他的生命靠近灭命的天使。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的灵魂临近深坑； 他的生命近于灭命的。
verses.textEnNiv: They draw near to the pit, and their life to the messengers of death.
verses.textEnEsv: His soul draws near the pit, and his life to those who bring death.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yes, his soul draws near the Pit, And his life to the executioners.
verses.textEnNlt: They are at death’s door; the angels of death wait for them.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then his soul comes near to the pit, And his life to those who bring death.
verses.textEn: They draw near to the pit, and their life to the messengers of death.

verses.textZh: 在一千位天使之中， 若有一位作人的中保，指示人当行的事，
verses.textZhCnvs: 在一千位天使之中， 若有一位作人的中保，指示人当行的事，
verses.textZhCuv: 一千天使中， 若有一个作传话的与神同在， 指示人所当行的事，
verses.textEnNiv: Yet if there is an angel at their side, a messenger, one out of a thousand, sent to tell them how to be upright,
verses.textEnEsv: If there be for him an angel, a mediator, one of the thousand, to declare to man what is right for him,
verses.textEnNkjv: "If there is a messenger for him, A mediator, one among a thousand, To show man His uprightness,
verses.textEnNlt: "But if an angel from heaven appears— a special messenger to intercede for a person and declare that he is upright—
verses.textEnNasb: "If there is an interceding angel for him, One out of a thousand, To remind a person of what is right for him,
verses.textEn: Yet if there is an angel at their side, a messenger, one out of a thousand, sent to tell them how to be upright,

verses.textZh: 恩待他，说： ‘救赎他免下深坑； 我已经得到了赎价。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 恩待他，说： ‘救赎他免下深坑； 我已经得到了赎价。’
verses.textZhCuv: 神就给他开恩， 说：救赎他免得下坑； 我已经得了赎价。
verses.textEnNiv: and he is gracious to that person and says to God, ‘Spare them from going down to the pit; I have found a ransom for them—
verses.textEnEsv: and he is merciful to him, and says, ‘Deliver him from going down into the pit; I have found a ransom;
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He is gracious to him, and says, ‘Deliver him from going down to the Pit; I have found a ransom’;
verses.textEnNlt: he will be gracious and say, ‘Rescue him from the grave, for I have found a ransom for his life.’
verses.textEnNasb: And he is gracious to him, and says, ‘Free him from going down to the pit, I have found a ransom’;
verses.textEn: and he is gracious to that person and says to God, ‘Spare them from going down to the pit; I have found a ransom for them—

verses.textZh: 他的肌肉就比孩童的更嫩， 他更恢复满有青春活力的日子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的肌肉就比孩童的更嫩， 他更恢复满有青春活力的日子。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的肉要比孩童的肉更嫩； 他就返老还童。
verses.textEnNiv: let their flesh be renewed like a child’s; let them be restored as in the days of their youth’—
verses.textEnEsv: let his flesh become fresh with youth; let him return to the days of his youthful vigor’;
verses.textEnNkjv: His flesh shall be young like a child’s, He shall return to the days of his youth.
verses.textEnNlt: Then his body will become as healthy as a child’s, firm and youthful again.
verses.textEnNasb: Let his flesh become fresher than in youth, Let him return to the days of his youthful vigor;
verses.textEn: let their flesh be renewed like a child’s; let them be restored as in the days of their youth’—

verses.textZh: 他向神祈求，神就喜悦他， 他也欢呼着朝见神的面， 人又恢复自己的义。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他向神祈求，神就喜悦他， 他也欢呼着朝见神的面， 人又恢复自己的义。
verses.textZhCuv: 他祷告神，神就喜悦他， 使他欢呼朝见神的面；神又看他为义。
verses.textEnNiv: then that person can pray to God and find favor with him, they will see God’s face and shout for joy; he will restore them to full well-being.
verses.textEnEsv: then man prays to God, and he accepts him; he sees his face with a shout of joy, and he restores to man his righteousness.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall pray to God, and He will delight in him, He shall see His face with joy, For He restores to man His righteousness.
verses.textEnNlt: When he prays to God, he will be accepted. And God will receive him with joy and restore him to good standing.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he will pray to God, and He will accept him, So that he may see His face with joy, And He will restore His righteousness to that person.
verses.textEn: then that person can pray to God and find favor with him, they will see God’s face and shout for joy; he will restore them to full well-being.

verses.textZh: 他在人面前歌唱，说： ‘我犯了罪，颠倒是非， 但我没有受到应得的报应。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在人面前歌唱，说： ‘我犯了罪，颠倒是非， 但我没有受到应得的报应。
verses.textZhCuv: 他在人前歌唱说： 我犯了罪，颠倒是非， 这竟与我无益。
verses.textEnNiv: And they will go to others and say, ‘I have sinned, I have perverted what is right, but I did not get what I deserved.
verses.textEnEsv: He sings before men and says: ‘I sinned and perverted what was right, and it was not repaid to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he looks at men and says, ‘I have sinned, and perverted whatwas right, And it did not profit me.’
verses.textEnNlt: He will declare to his friends, ‘I sinned and twisted the truth, but it was not worth it.
verses.textEnNasb: "He will sing to people and say, ‘I have sinned and perverted what is right, And it is not proper for me.
verses.textEn: And they will go to others and say, ‘I have sinned, I have perverted what is right, but I did not get what I deserved.

verses.textZh: 他救赎我的性命免入深坑， 我的生命必得见光明。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 他救赎我的性命免入深坑， 我的生命必得见光明。’
verses.textZhCuv: 神救赎我的灵魂免入深坑； 我的生命也必见光。
verses.textEnNiv: God has delivered me from going down to the pit, and I shall live to enjoy the light of life.’
verses.textEnEsv: He has redeemed my soul from going down into the pit, and my life shall look upon the light.’
verses.textEnNkjv: He will redeem his soul from going down to the Pit, And his life shall see the light.
verses.textEnNlt: God rescued me from the grave, and now my life is filled with light.’
verses.textEnNasb: ‘He has redeemed my soul from going to the pit, And my life will see the light.’
verses.textEn: God has delivered me from going down to the pit, and I shall live to enjoy the light of life.’

verses.textZh: 神总是三番四次， 向人行这一切事，
verses.textZhCnvs: 神总是三番四次， 向人行这一切事，
verses.textZhCuv: 神两次、三次向人行这一切的事，
verses.textEnNiv: "God does all these things to a person— twice, even three times—
verses.textEnEsv: "Behold, God does all these things, twice, three times, with a man,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, God works all these things, Twice, infact, three times with a man,
verses.textEnNlt: "Yes, God does these things again and again for people.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, God does all these things for a man two or three times,
verses.textEn: "God does all these things to a person— twice, even three times—

verses.textZh: 要把人的性命从深坑里救回来， 好使活人之光光照他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要把人的性命从深坑里救回来， 好使活人之光光照他。
verses.textZhCuv: 为要从深坑救回人的灵魂， 使他被光照耀，与活人一样。
verses.textEnNiv: to turn them back from the pit, that the light of life may shine on them.
verses.textEnEsv: to bring back his soul from the pit, that he may be lighted with the light of life.
verses.textEnNkjv: To bring back his soul from the Pit, That he may be enlightened with the light of life.
verses.textEnNlt: He rescues them from the grave so they may enjoy the light of life.
verses.textEnNasb: To bring back his soul from the pit, So that he may be enlightened with the light of life.
verses.textEn: to turn them back from the pit, that the light of life may shine on them.

verses.textZh: 约伯啊，你当留心听我， 当默不作声，我要说话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约伯啊，你当留心听我， 当默不作声，我要说话。
verses.textZhCuv: 约伯啊，你当侧耳听我的话， 不要作声，等我讲说。
verses.textEnNiv: "Pay attention, Job, and listen to me; be silent, and I will speak.
verses.textEnEsv: Pay attention, O Job, listen to me; be silent, and I will speak.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Give ear, Job, listen to me; Hold your peace, and I will speak.
verses.textEnNlt: Mark this well, Job. Listen to me, for I have more to say.
verses.textEnNasb: "Pay attention, Job, listen to me; Keep silent, and let me speak.
verses.textEn: "Pay attention, Job, and listen to me; be silent, and I will speak.

verses.textZh: 你若有话说，就请回答我； 你只管说吧，因为我愿意以你为义。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你若有话说，就请回答我； 你只管说吧，因为我愿意以你为义。
verses.textZhCuv: 你若有话说，就可以回答我； 你只管说，因我愿以你为是。
verses.textEnNiv: If you have anything to say, answer me; speak up, for I want to vindicate you.
verses.textEnEsv: If you have any words, answer me; speak, for I desire to justify you.
verses.textEnNkjv: If you have anything to say, answer me; Speak, for I desire to justify you.
verses.textEnNlt: But if you have anything to say, go ahead. Speak, for I am anxious to see you justified.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then if you have anything to say, answer me; Speak, for I would take pleasure in justifying you.
verses.textEn: If you have anything to say, answer me; speak up, for I want to vindicate you.

verses.textZh: 你若没有话说，就要听我说， 你当默不作声，我就把智慧教导你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你若没有话说，就要听我说， 你当默不作声，我就把智慧教导你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 若不然，你就听我说； 你不要作声，我便将智慧教训你。
verses.textEnNiv: But if not, then listen to me; be silent, and I will teach you wisdom."
verses.textEnEsv: If not, listen to me; be silent, and I will teach you wisdom."
verses.textEnNkjv: If not, listen to me; Hold your peace, and I will teach you wisdom."
verses.textEnNlt: But if not, then listen to me. Keep silent and I will teach you wisdom!"
verses.textEnNasb: "If not, listen to me; Keep silent, and I will teach you wisdom."
verses.textEn: But if not, then listen to me; be silent, and I will teach you wisdom."

verses.textZh: 以利户回答，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利户回答，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 以利户又说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then Elihu said:
verses.textEnEsv: Then Elihu answered and said:
verses.textEnNkjv: Elihu further answered and said:
verses.textEnNlt: Then Elihu said:
verses.textEnNasb: Then Elihu continued and said,
verses.textEn: Then Elihu said:

verses.textZh: "智慧人哪！你们要听我的话； 有知识的人哪！你们要侧耳听我。
verses.textZhCnvs: "智慧人哪！你们要听我的话； 有知识的人哪！你们要侧耳听我。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们智慧人要听我的话； 有知识的人要留心听我说。
verses.textEnNiv: "Hear my words, you wise men; listen to me, you men of learning.
verses.textEnEsv: "Hear my words, you wise men, and give ear to me, you who know;
verses.textEnNkjv: "Hear my words, you wise men; Give ear to me, you who have knowledge.
verses.textEnNlt: "Listen to me, you wise men. Pay attention, you who have knowledge.
verses.textEnNasb: "Hear my words, you wise men, And listen to me, you who understand.
verses.textEn: "Hear my words, you wise men; listen to me, you men of learning.

verses.textZh: 因为耳朵试验言语， 好象上膛尝试食物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耳朵试验言语， 好象上膛尝试食物。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为耳朵试验话语， 好像上膛尝食物。
verses.textEnNiv: For the ear tests words as the tongue tastes food.
verses.textEnEsv: for the ear tests words as the palate tastes food.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the ear tests words As the palate tastes food.
verses.textEnNlt: Job said, ‘The ear tests the words it hears just as the mouth distinguishes between foods.’
verses.textEnNasb: "For the ear tests words As the palate tastes food.
verses.textEn: For the ear tests words as the tongue tastes food.

verses.textZh: 我们要选择何为是， 让我们彼此知道何为善。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们要选择何为是， 让我们彼此知道何为善。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们当选择何为是， 彼此知道何为善。
verses.textEnNiv: Let us discern for ourselves what is right; let us learn together what is good.
verses.textEnEsv: Let us choose what is right; let us know among ourselves what is good.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let us choose justice for ourselves; Let us know among ourselves what is good.
verses.textEnNlt: So let us discern for ourselves what is right; let us learn together what is good.
verses.textEnNasb: "Let us choose for ourselves what is right; Let us understand among ourselves what is good.
verses.textEn: Let us discern for ourselves what is right; let us learn together what is good.

verses.textZh: 约伯说：‘我是有理的，神却夺去我的公理；
verses.textZhCnvs: 约伯说：‘我是有理的，神却夺去我的公理；
verses.textZhCuv: 约伯曾说：我是公义，神夺去我的理；
verses.textEnNiv: "Job says, ‘I am innocent, but God denies me justice.
verses.textEnEsv: For Job has said, ‘I am in the right, and God has taken away my right;
verses.textEnNkjv: "For Job has said, ‘I am righteous, But God has taken away my justice;
verses.textEnNlt: For Job also said, ‘I am innocent, but God has taken away my rights.
verses.textEnNasb: "For Job has said, ‘I am righteous, But God has taken away my right;
verses.textEn: "Job says, ‘I am innocent, but God denies me justice.

verses.textZh: 我虽然有公理，却被认为是说谎的； 我虽然毫无过犯，我所受的箭伤却无法医治。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我虽然有公理，却被认为是说谎的； 我虽然毫无过犯，我所受的箭伤却无法医治。’
verses.textZhCuv: 我虽有理，还算为说谎言的； 我虽无过，受的伤还不能医治。
verses.textEnNiv: Although I am right, I am considered a liar; although I am guiltless, his arrow inflicts an incurable wound.’
verses.textEnEsv: in spite of my right I am counted a liar; my wound is incurable, though I am without transgression.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Should I lie concerning my right? My wound is incurable, thoughIam without transgression.’
verses.textEnNlt: I am innocent, but they call me a liar. My suffering is incurable, though I have not sinned.’
verses.textEnNasb: Should I lie about my right? My wound is incurable, though I am without wrongdoing.’
verses.textEn: Although I am right, I am considered a liar; although I am guiltless, his arrow inflicts an incurable wound.’

verses.textZh: 有哪一个人像约伯呢？ 他喝亵慢如同喝水，
verses.textZhCnvs: 有哪一个人像约伯呢？ 他喝亵慢如同喝水，
verses.textZhCuv: 谁像约伯， 喝讥诮如同喝水呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Is there anyone like Job, who drinks scorn like water?
verses.textEnEsv: What man is like Job, who drinks up scoffing like water,
verses.textEnNkjv: What man is like Job, Who drinks scorn like water,
verses.textEnNlt: "Tell me, has there ever been a man like Job, with his thirst for irreverent talk?
verses.textEnNasb: "What man is like Job, Who drinks up derision like water,
verses.textEn: Is there anyone like Job, who drinks scorn like water?

verses.textZh: 他与作孽的同伙， 他与恶人同行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他与作孽的同伙， 他与恶人同行。
verses.textZhCuv: 他与作孽的结伴， 和恶人同行。
verses.textEnNiv: He keeps company with evildoers; he associates with the wicked.
verses.textEnEsv: who travels in company with evildoers and walks with wicked men?
verses.textEnNkjv: Who goes in company with the workers of iniquity, And walks with wicked men?
verses.textEnNlt: He chooses evil people as companions. He spends his time with wicked men.
verses.textEnNasb: Who goes in company with the workers of injustice, And walks with wicked people?
verses.textEn: He keeps company with evildoers; he associates with the wicked.

verses.textZh: 因为他说过：‘人讨神的喜悦， 对他并无益处。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他说过：‘人讨神的喜悦， 对他并无益处。’
verses.textZhCuv: 他说：人以神为乐， 总是无益。
verses.textEnNiv: For he says, ‘There is no profit in trying to please God.’
verses.textEnEsv: For he has said, ‘It profits a man nothing that he should take delight in God.’
verses.textEnNkjv: For he has said, ‘It profits a man nothing That he should delight in God.’
verses.textEnNlt: He has even said, ‘Why waste time trying to please God?’
verses.textEnNasb: "For he has said, ‘It is of no use to a man When he becomes friends with God.’
verses.textEn: For he says, ‘There is no profit in trying to please God.’

verses.textZh: 所以，明理的人哪！你们要听我的话，神决不至作恶，全能者断不至行不义，
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，明理的人哪！你们要听我的话，神决不至作恶，全能者断不至行不义，
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，你们明理的人要听我的话。神断不致行恶； 全能者断不致作孽。
verses.textEnNiv: "So listen to me, you men of understanding. Far be it from God to do evil, from the Almighty to do wrong.
verses.textEnEsv: "Therefore, hear me, you men of understanding: far be it from God that he should do wickedness, and from the Almighty that he should do wrong.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore listen to me, you men of understanding: Far be it from God todo wickedness, And from the Almighty to commit iniquity.
verses.textEnNlt: "Listen to me, you who have understanding. Everyone knows that God doesn’t sin! The Almighty can do no wrong.
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore, listen to me, you men of understanding. Far be it from God to do evil, And from the Almighty to do wrong.
verses.textEn: "So listen to me, you men of understanding. Far be it from God to do evil, from the Almighty to do wrong.

verses.textZh: 因为神必照着人所作的报应他， 使各人按照所行的得报应。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为神必照着人所作的报应他， 使各人按照所行的得报应。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必按人所做的报应人， 使各人照所行的得报。
verses.textEnNiv: He repays everyone for what they have done; he brings on them what their conduct deserves.
verses.textEnEsv: For according to the work of a man he will repay him, and according to his ways he will make it befall him.
verses.textEnNkjv: For He repays man accordingto his work, And makes man to find a reward according to his way.
verses.textEnNlt: He repays people according to their deeds. He treats people as they deserve.
verses.textEnNasb: "For He repays a person for his work, And lets things happen in correspondence to a man’s behavior.
verses.textEn: He repays everyone for what they have done; he brings on them what their conduct deserves.

verses.textZh: 真的，神必不作恶， 全能者也必不颠倒是非。
verses.textZhCnvs: 真的，神必不作恶， 全能者也必不颠倒是非。
verses.textZhCuv: 神必不作恶； 全能者也不偏离公平。
verses.textEnNiv: It is unthinkable that God would do wrong, that the Almighty would pervert justice.
verses.textEnEsv: Of a truth, God will not do wickedly, and the Almighty will not pervert justice.
verses.textEnNkjv: Surely God will never do wickedly, Nor will the Almighty pervert justice.
verses.textEnNlt: Truly, God will not do wrong. The Almighty will not twist justice.
verses.textEnNasb: "God certainly will not act wickedly, And the Almighty will not pervert justice.
verses.textEn: It is unthinkable that God would do wrong, that the Almighty would pervert justice.

verses.textZh: 谁派他管理大地？ 谁设立全世界呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁派他管理大地？ 谁设立全世界呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 谁派他治理地， 安定全世界呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Who appointed him over the earth? Who put him in charge of the whole world?
verses.textEnEsv: Who gave him charge over the earth, and who laid on him the whole world?
verses.textEnNkjv: Who gave Him charge over the earth? Or who appointed Himover the whole world?
verses.textEnNlt: Did someone else put the world in his care? Who set the whole world in place?
verses.textEnNasb: "Who gave Him authority over the earth? And who has placed the whole world on Him?
verses.textEn: Who appointed him over the earth? Who put him in charge of the whole world?

verses.textZh: 他若对人决心这样作， 他若把灵与气收归自己，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他若对人决心这样作， 他若把灵与气收归自己，
verses.textZhCuv: 他若专心为己， 将灵和气收归自己，
verses.textEnNiv: If it were his intention and he withdrew his spirit and breath,
verses.textEnEsv: If he should set his heart to it and gather to himself his spirit and his breath,
verses.textEnNkjv: If He should set His heart on it, If He should gather to Himself His Spirit and His breath,
verses.textEnNlt: If God were to take back his spirit and withdraw his breath,
verses.textEnNasb: "If He were to determine to do so, If He were to gather His spirit and His breath to Himself,
verses.textEn: If it were his intention and he withdrew his spirit and breath,

verses.textZh: 有血肉生命的就都一同气绝身亡， 世人都归回尘土。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有血肉生命的就都一同气绝身亡， 世人都归回尘土。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡有血气的就必一同死亡； 世人必仍归尘土。
verses.textEnNiv: all humanity would perish together and mankind would return to the dust.
verses.textEnEsv: all flesh would perish together, and man would return to dust.
verses.textEnNkjv: All flesh would perish together, And man would return to dust.
verses.textEnNlt: all life would cease, and humanity would turn again to dust.
verses.textEnNasb: Humanity would perish together, And mankind would return to dust.
verses.textEn: all humanity would perish together and mankind would return to the dust.

verses.textZh: 你若明理，就请听这话， 留心听我说话的声音。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你若明理，就请听这话， 留心听我说话的声音。
verses.textZhCuv: 你若明理，就当听我的话， 留心听我言语的声音。
verses.textEnNiv: "If you have understanding, hear this; listen to what I say.
verses.textEnEsv: "If you have understanding, hear this; listen to what I say.
verses.textEnNkjv: "If youhave understanding, hear this; Listen to the sound of my words:
verses.textEnNlt: "Now listen to me if you are wise. Pay attention to what I say.
verses.textEnNasb: "But if you have understanding, hear this; Listen to the sound of my words.
verses.textEn: "If you have understanding, hear this; listen to what I say.

verses.textZh: 恨恶公平的真的可以掌权吗？ 那有公义与大能的，你定他为有罪吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 恨恶公平的真的可以掌权吗？ 那有公义与大能的，你定他为有罪吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 难道恨恶公平的可以掌权吗？ 那有公义的、有大能的，岂可定他有罪吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Can someone who hates justice govern? Will you condemn the just and mighty One?
verses.textEnEsv: Shall one who hates justice govern? Will you condemn him who is righteous and mighty,
verses.textEnNkjv: Should one who hates justice govern? Will you condemn Himwhois most just?
verses.textEnNlt: Could God govern if he hated justice? Are you going to condemn the almighty judge?
verses.textEnNasb: "Shall one who hates justice rule? And will you condemn the righteous mighty One,
verses.textEn: Can someone who hates justice govern? Will you condemn the just and mighty One?

verses.textZh: 他不是对君王说：‘你是匪徒’， 又对贵族说：‘你们是恶人’吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 他不是对君王说：‘你是匪徒’， 又对贵族说：‘你们是恶人’吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 他对君王说：你是鄙陋的； 对贵臣说：你是邪恶的。
verses.textEnNiv: Is he not the One who says to kings, ‘You are worthless,’ and to nobles, ‘You are wicked,’
verses.textEnEsv: who says to a king, ‘Worthless one,’ and to nobles, ‘Wicked man,’
verses.textEnNkjv: Isitfitting to say to a king, ‘Youare worthless,’ And to nobles, ‘Youare wicked’?
verses.textEnNlt: For he says to kings, ‘You are wicked,’ and to nobles, ‘You are unjust.’
verses.textEnNasb: Who says to a king, ‘You worthless one,’ To nobles, ‘You wicked one’;
verses.textEn: Is he not the One who says to kings, ‘You are worthless,’ and to nobles, ‘You are wicked,’

verses.textZh: 他不徇王子的情面， 也不看重富人过于穷人， 因为他们都是他手所造的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他不徇王子的情面， 也不看重富人过于穷人， 因为他们都是他手所造的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他待王子不徇情面， 也不看重富足的过于贫穷的， 因为都是他手所造。
verses.textEnNiv: who shows no partiality to princes and does not favor the rich over the poor, for they are all the work of his hands?
verses.textEnEsv: who shows no partiality to princes, nor regards the rich more than the poor, for they are all the work of his hands?
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet He is not partial to princes, Nor does He regard the rich more than the poor; For they are all the work of His hands.
verses.textEnNlt: He doesn’t care how great a person may be, and he pays no more attention to the rich than to the poor. He made them all.
verses.textEnNasb: Who shows no partiality to the prominent, Nor regards the rich as above the poor, Since they are all the work of His hands?
verses.textEn: who shows no partiality to princes and does not favor the rich over the poor, for they are all the work of his hands?

verses.textZh: 他们在半夜之中剎那之间死亡， 平民因遭受震动而去世， 有权势的被除灭非借人手。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在半夜之中剎那之间死亡， 平民因遭受震动而去世， 有权势的被除灭非借人手。
verses.textZhCuv: 在转眼之间，半夜之中， 他们就死亡。 百姓被震动而去世； 有权力的被夺去非藉人手。
verses.textEnNiv: They die in an instant, in the middle of the night; the people are shaken and they pass away; the mighty are removed without human hand.
verses.textEnEsv: In a moment they die; at midnight the people are shaken and pass away, and the mighty are taken away by no human hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: In a moment they die, in the middle of the night; The people are shaken and pass away; The mighty are taken away without a hand.
verses.textEnNlt: In a moment they die. In the middle of the night they pass away; the mighty are removed without human hand.
verses.textEnNasb: "In a moment they die, and at midnight People are shaken and pass away, And the powerful are taken away without a hand.
verses.textEn: They die in an instant, in the middle of the night; the people are shaken and they pass away; the mighty are removed without human hand.

verses.textZh: 神的眼看顾人的道路， 察看他每一步，
verses.textZhCnvs: 神的眼看顾人的道路， 察看他每一步，
verses.textZhCuv: 神注目观看人的道路， 看明人的脚步。
verses.textEnNiv: "His eyes are on the ways of mortals; he sees their every step.
verses.textEnEsv: "For his eyes are on the ways of a man, and he sees all his steps.
verses.textEnNkjv: "For His eyes are on the ways of man, And He sees all his steps.
verses.textEnNlt: "For God watches how people live; he sees everything they do.
verses.textEnNasb: "For His eyes are upon the ways of a person, And He sees all his steps.
verses.textEn: "His eyes are on the ways of mortals; he sees their every step.

verses.textZh: 没有黑暗，又没有死荫的地方， 可以给作孽的在那里藏身。
verses.textZhCnvs: 没有黑暗，又没有死荫的地方， 可以给作孽的在那里藏身。
verses.textZhCuv: 没有黑暗、阴翳能给作孽的藏身。
verses.textEnNiv: There is no deep shadow, no utter darkness, where evildoers can hide.
verses.textEnEsv: There is no gloom or deep darkness where evildoers may hide themselves.
verses.textEnNkjv: There is no darkness nor shadow of death Where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.
verses.textEnNlt: No darkness is thick enough to hide the wicked from his eyes.
verses.textEnNasb: "There is no darkness or deep shadow Where the workers of injustice can hide themselves.
verses.textEn: There is no deep shadow, no utter darkness, where evildoers can hide.

verses.textZh: 神不必进一步鉴察人， 使人到他面前去受审判。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神不必进一步鉴察人， 使人到他面前去受审判。
verses.textZhCuv: 神审判人，不必使人到他面前再三鉴察。
verses.textEnNiv: God has no need to examine people further, that they should come before him for judgment.
verses.textEnEsv: For God has no need to consider a man further, that he should go before God in judgment.
verses.textEnNkjv: For He need not further consider a man, That he should go before God in judgment.
verses.textEnNlt: We don’t set the time when we will come before God in judgment.
verses.textEnNasb: "For He does not need to consider a person further, That he should go before God in judgment.
verses.textEn: God has no need to examine people further, that they should come before him for judgment.

verses.textZh: 他不必查究就可以打碎有权势的人， 并且设立别人代替他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他不必查究就可以打碎有权势的人， 并且设立别人代替他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 他用难测之法打破有能力的人， 设立别人代替他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Without inquiry he shatters the mighty and sets up others in their place.
verses.textEnEsv: He shatters the mighty without investigation and sets others in their place.
verses.textEnNkjv: He breaks in pieces mighty men without inquiry, And sets others in their place.
verses.textEnNlt: He brings the mighty to ruin without asking anyone, and he sets up others in their place.
verses.textEnNasb: "He breaks in pieces the mighty without investigation, And sets others in their place.
verses.textEn: Without inquiry he shatters the mighty and sets up others in their place.

verses.textZh: 他原来留心他们所行的， 在夜间倾覆他们，他们就被压碎；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他原来留心他们所行的， 在夜间倾覆他们，他们就被压碎；
verses.textZhCuv: 他原知道他们的行为， 使他们在夜间倾倒灭亡。
verses.textEnNiv: Because he takes note of their deeds, he overthrows them in the night and they are crushed.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus, knowing their works, he overturns them in the night, and they are crushed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore He knows their works; He overthrows them in the night, And they are crushed.
verses.textEnNlt: He knows what they do, and in the night he overturns and destroys them.
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore He knows their deeds, And He overthrows them in the night, And they are crushed.
verses.textEn: Because he takes note of their deeds, he overthrows them in the night and they are crushed.

verses.textZh: 他在观众面前击打他们， 有如击打恶人一样；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在观众面前击打他们， 有如击打恶人一样；
verses.textZhCuv: 他在众人眼前击打他们， 如同击打恶人一样。
verses.textEnNiv: He punishes them for their wickedness where everyone can see them,
verses.textEnEsv: He strikes them for their wickedness in a place for all to see,
verses.textEnNkjv: He strikes them as wicked men In the open sight of others,
verses.textEnNlt: He strikes them down because they are wicked, doing it openly for all to see.
verses.textEnNasb: "He strikes them like the wicked In a public place,
verses.textEn: He punishes them for their wickedness where everyone can see them,

verses.textZh: 因为他们偏离正道不跟从他， 也不留心他的一切道路，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们偏离正道不跟从他， 也不留心他的一切道路，
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他们偏行不跟从他， 也不留心他的道，
verses.textEnNiv: because they turned from following him and had no regard for any of his ways.
verses.textEnEsv: because they turned aside from following him and had no regard for any of his ways,
verses.textEnNkjv: Because they turned back from Him, And would not consider any of His ways,
verses.textEnNlt: For they turned away from following him. They have no respect for any of his ways.
verses.textEnNasb: Because they turned aside from following Him, And had no regard for any of His ways,
verses.textEn: because they turned from following him and had no regard for any of his ways.

verses.textZh: 以致穷人的哀求达到他那里， 他也垂听了困苦人的哀求。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以致穷人的哀求达到他那里， 他也垂听了困苦人的哀求。
verses.textZhCuv: 甚至使贫穷人的哀声达到他那里； 他也听了困苦人的哀声。
verses.textEnNiv: They caused the cry of the poor to come before him, so that he heard the cry of the needy.
verses.textEnEsv: so that they caused the cry of the poor to come to him, and he heard the cry of the afflicted—
verses.textEnNkjv: So that they caused the cry of the poor to come to Him; For He hears the cry of the afflicted.
verses.textEnNlt: They cause the poor to cry out, catching God’s attention. He hears the cries of the needy.
verses.textEnNasb: So that they caused the cry of the poor to come to Him, And that He would hear the cry of the afflicted—
verses.textEn: They caused the cry of the poor to come before him, so that he heard the cry of the needy.

verses.textZh: 他若安静不动，谁能定他有罪呢？ 他若掩面，谁能看见他呢？ 无论对待一国或一人，都是这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他若安静不动，谁能定他有罪呢？ 他若掩面，谁能看见他呢？ 无论对待一国或一人，都是这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 他使人安静，谁能扰乱 呢？ 他掩面，谁能见他呢？ 无论待一国或一人都是如此－
verses.textEnNiv: But if he remains silent, who can condemn him? If he hides his face, who can see him? Yet he is over individual and nation alike,
verses.textEnEsv: When he is quiet, who can condemn? When he hides his face, who can behold him, whether it be a nation or a man?—
verses.textEnNkjv: When He gives quietness, who then can make trouble? And when He hides His face, who then can see Him, Whether itis against a nation or a man alone?—
verses.textEnNlt: But if he chooses to remain quiet, who can criticize him? When he hides his face, no one can find him, whether an individual or a nation.
verses.textEnNasb: When He keeps quiet, who can condemn? And when He hides His face, who then can look at Him, That is, regarding both nation and a person?—
verses.textEn: But if he remains silent, who can condemn him? If he hides his face, who can see him? Yet he is over individual and nation alike,

verses.textZh: 别让不敬虔的人作王， 免得他危害人民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 别让不敬虔的人作王， 免得他危害人民。
verses.textZhCuv: 使不虔敬的人不得作王， 免得有人牢笼百姓。
verses.textEnNiv: to keep the godless from ruling, from laying snares for the people.
verses.textEnEsv: that a godless man should not reign, that he should not ensnare the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: That the hypocrite should not reign, Lest the people be ensnared.
verses.textEnNlt: He prevents the godless from ruling so they cannot be a snare to the people.
verses.textEnNasb: "So that godless people would not rule, Nor be snares for the people.
verses.textEn: to keep the godless from ruling, from laying snares for the people.

verses.textZh: 有人对神说： ‘我忍受了管教，不再有败坏的行为了，
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人对神说： ‘我忍受了管教，不再有败坏的行为了，
verses.textZhCuv: 有谁对神说： 我受了责罚，不再犯罪；
verses.textEnNiv: "Suppose someone says to God, ‘I am guilty but will offend no more.
verses.textEnEsv: "For has anyone said to God, ‘I have borne punishment; I will not offend any more;
verses.textEnNkjv: "For has anyone said to God, ‘I have borne chastening; I will offend no more;
verses.textEnNlt: "Why don’t people say to God, ‘I have sinned, but I will sin no more’?
verses.textEnNasb: "For has anyone said to God, ‘I have endured punishment; I will not offend anymore;
verses.textEn: "Suppose someone says to God, ‘I am guilty but will offend no more.

verses.textZh: 我所看不到的求你指教我， 我若行了罪孽，必不再行’。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我所看不到的求你指教我， 我若行了罪孽，必不再行’。
verses.textZhCuv: 我所看不明的，求你指教我； 我若作了孽，必不再作？
verses.textEnNiv: Teach me what I cannot see; if I have done wrong, I will not do so again.’
verses.textEnEsv: teach me what I do not see; if I have done iniquity, I will do it no more’?
verses.textEnNkjv: Teach me what I do not see; If I have done iniquity, I will do no more’?
verses.textEnNlt: Or ‘I don’t know what evil I have done—tell me. If I have done wrong, I will stop at once’?
verses.textEnNasb: Teach me what I do not see; If I have done wrong, I will not do it again’?
verses.textEn: Teach me what I cannot see; if I have done wrong, I will not do so again.’

verses.textZh: 神会因你拒绝悔改， 就遵照你的心意吗？ 要作抉择的是你，不是我， 你所知道的，只管说出来吧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神会因你拒绝悔改， 就遵照你的心意吗？ 要作抉择的是你，不是我， 你所知道的，只管说出来吧。
verses.textZhCuv: 他施行报应， 岂要随你的心愿、叫你推辞不受吗？ 选定的是你，不是我。 你所知道的只管说吧！
verses.textEnNiv: Should God then reward you on your terms, when you refuse to repent? You must decide, not I; so tell me what you know.
verses.textEnEsv: Will he then make repayment to suit you, because you reject it? For you must choose, and not I; therefore declare what you know.
verses.textEnNkjv: Should He repay it according to your terms, Just because you disavow it? You must choose, and not I; Therefore speak what you know.
verses.textEnNlt: "Must God tailor his justice to your demands? But you have rejected him! The choice is yours, not mine. Go ahead, share your wisdom with us.
verses.textEnNasb: "Shall God repay on your terms, because you have rejected His? For you must choose, and not I; Therefore declare what you know.
verses.textEn: Should God then reward you on your terms, when you refuse to repent? You must decide, not I; so tell me what you know.

verses.textZh: 明理的人必对我说， 智慧的人要听我的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 明理的人必对我说， 智慧的人要听我的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 明理的人和听我话的智慧人必对我说：
verses.textEnNiv: "Men of understanding declare, wise men who hear me say to me,
verses.textEnEsv: Men of understanding will say to me, and the wise man who hears me will say:
verses.textEnNkjv: "Men of understanding say to me, Wise men who listen to me:
verses.textEnNlt: After all, bright people will tell me, and wise people will hear me say,
verses.textEnNasb: "Men of understanding will say to me, And a wise man who hears me,
verses.textEn: "Men of understanding declare, wise men who hear me say to me,

verses.textZh: 约伯说话毫无知识， 他的言语没有智慧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约伯说话毫无知识， 他的言语没有智慧。
verses.textZhCuv: 约伯说话没有知识， 言语中毫无智慧。
verses.textEnNiv: ‘Job speaks without knowledge; his words lack insight.’
verses.textEnEsv: ‘Job speaks without knowledge; his words are without insight.’
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Job speaks without knowledge, His words are without wisdom.’
verses.textEnNlt: ‘Job speaks out of ignorance; his words lack insight.’
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Job speaks without knowledge, And his words are without wisdom.
verses.textEn: ‘Job speaks without knowledge; his words lack insight.’

verses.textZh: 但愿约伯被试验到底， 因为他的回答像恶人一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但愿约伯被试验到底， 因为他的回答像恶人一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿约伯被试验到底， 因他回答像恶人一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Oh, that Job might be tested to the utmost for answering like a wicked man!
verses.textEnEsv: Would that Job were tried to the end, because he answers like wicked men.
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, that Job were tried to the utmost, Because his answers arelike those of wicked men!
verses.textEnNlt: Job, you deserve the maximum penalty for the wicked way you have talked.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Oh that Job were tested to the limit, Because he answers like sinners.
verses.textEn: Oh, that Job might be tested to the utmost for answering like a wicked man!

verses.textZh: 他在自己的罪上又加过犯， 在我们中间鼓掌嘲笑神， 用许多话敌对神。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在自己的罪上又加过犯， 在我们中间鼓掌嘲笑神， 用许多话敌对神。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他在罪上又加悖逆； 在我们中间拍手， 用许多言语轻慢神。
verses.textEnNiv: To his sin he adds rebellion; scornfully he claps his hands among us and multiplies his words against God."
verses.textEnEsv: For he adds rebellion to his sin; he claps his hands among us and multiplies his words against God."
verses.textEnNkjv: For he adds rebellion to his sin; He claps hishands among us, And multiplies his words against God."
verses.textEnNlt: For you have added rebellion to your sin; you show no respect, and you speak many angry words against God."
verses.textEnNasb: ‘For he adds rebellion to his sin; He claps his hands among us, And multiplies his words against God.’ "
verses.textEn: To his sin he adds rebellion; scornfully he claps his hands among us and multiplies his words against God."

verses.textZh: 以利户回答说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利户回答说：
verses.textZhCuv: 以利户又说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then Elihu said:
verses.textEnEsv: And Elihu answered and said:
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover Elihu answered and said:
verses.textEnNlt: Then Elihu said:
verses.textEnNasb: Then Elihu continued and said,
verses.textEn: Then Elihu said:

verses.textZh: "你说：‘我在神面前更显为义’， 你自以为这话有理吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: "你说：‘我在神面前更显为义’， 你自以为这话有理吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你以为有理， 或以为你的公义胜于神的公义，
verses.textEnNiv: "Do you think this is just? You say, ‘I am in the right, not God.’
verses.textEnEsv: "Do you think this to be just? Do you say, ‘It is my right before God,’
verses.textEnNkjv: "Do you think this is right? Do you say, ‘My righteousness is more than God’s’?
verses.textEnNlt: "Do you think it is right for you to claim, ‘I am righteous before God’?
verses.textEnNasb: "Do you think this is in accordance with justice? Do you say, ‘My righteousness is more than God’s’?
verses.textEn: "Do you think this is just? You say, ‘I am in the right, not God.’

verses.textZh: 你还说：‘你有甚么益处呢？ 我不犯罪有甚么好处？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 你还说：‘你有甚么益处呢？ 我不犯罪有甚么好处？’
verses.textZhCuv: 才说这与我有什么益处？ 我不犯罪比犯罪有什么好处呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Yet you ask him, ‘What profit is it to me, and what do I gain by not sinning?’
verses.textEnEsv: that you ask, ‘What advantage have I? How am I better off than if I had sinned?’
verses.textEnNkjv: For you say, ‘What advantage will it be to You? What profit shall I have, more than if I had sinned?’
verses.textEnNlt: For you also ask, ‘What’s in it for me? What’s the use of living a righteous life?’
verses.textEnNasb: "For you say, ‘What advantage will it be to You? What benefit will I have, more than if I had sinned?’
verses.textEn: Yet you ask him, ‘What profit is it to me, and what do I gain by not sinning?’

verses.textZh: 我要用言语回答你， 和与你在一起的朋友。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要用言语回答你， 和与你在一起的朋友。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要回答你和在你这里的朋友。
verses.textEnNiv: "I would like to reply to you and to your friends with you.
verses.textEnEsv: I will answer you and your friends with you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I will answer you, And your companions with you.
verses.textEnNlt: "I will answer you and all your friends, too.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will answer you, And your friends with you.
verses.textEn: "I would like to reply to you and to your friends with you.

verses.textZh: 你要往天仰望观看， 细看高过你的云天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要往天仰望观看， 细看高过你的云天。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要向天观看， 瞻望那高于你的穹苍。
verses.textEnNiv: Look up at the heavens and see; gaze at the clouds so high above you.
verses.textEnEsv: Look at the heavens, and see; and behold the clouds, which are higher than you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Look to the heavens and see; And behold the clouds— They are higher than you.
verses.textEnNlt: Look up into the sky, and see the clouds high above you.
verses.textEnNasb: "Look at the heavens and see; And look at the clouds—they are higher than you.
verses.textEn: Look up at the heavens and see; gaze at the clouds so high above you.

verses.textZh: 你若犯罪，你能使神受害吗？ 你的过犯若增多，你又能使他受损吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你若犯罪，你能使神受害吗？ 你的过犯若增多，你又能使他受损吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你若犯罪，能使神受何害呢？ 你的过犯加增，能使神受何损呢？
verses.textEnNiv: If you sin, how does that affect him? If your sins are many, what does that do to him?
verses.textEnEsv: If you have sinned, what do you accomplish against him? And if your transgressions are multiplied, what do you do to him?
verses.textEnNkjv: If you sin, what do you accomplish against Him? Or, if your transgressions are multiplied, what do you do to Him?
verses.textEnNlt: If you sin, how does that affect God? Even if you sin again and again, what effect will it have on him?
verses.textEnNasb: "If you have sinned, what do you accomplish against Him? And if your wrongdoings are many, what do you do to Him?
verses.textEn: If you sin, how does that affect him? If your sins are many, what does that do to him?

verses.textZh: 你若为人正义，你能给他甚么呢？ 他从你手里能领受甚么呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你若为人正义，你能给他甚么呢？ 他从你手里能领受甚么呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你若是公义，还能加增他什么呢？ 他从你手里还接受什么呢？
verses.textEnNiv: If you are righteous, what do you give to him, or what does he receive from your hand?
verses.textEnEsv: If you are righteous, what do you give to him? Or what does he receive from your hand?
verses.textEnNkjv: If you are righteous, what do you give Him? Or what does He receive from your hand?
verses.textEnNlt: If you are good, is this some great gift to him? What could you possibly give him?
verses.textEnNasb: "If you are righteous, what do you give to Him, Or what does He receive from your hand?
verses.textEn: If you are righteous, what do you give to him, or what does he receive from your hand?

verses.textZh: 你的邪恶只能害像你的人， 你的公义也只能叫世人得益。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的邪恶只能害像你的人， 你的公义也只能叫世人得益。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的过恶或能害你这类的人； 你的公义或能叫世人得益处。
verses.textEnNiv: Your wickedness only affects humans like yourself, and your righteousness only other people.
verses.textEnEsv: Your wickedness concerns a man like yourself, and your righteousness a son of man.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your wickedness affects a man such as you, And your righteousness a son of man.
verses.textEnNlt: No, your sins affect only people like yourself, and your good deeds also affect only humans.
verses.textEnNasb: "Your wickedness is for a man like yourself, And your righteousness is for a son of man.
verses.textEn: Your wickedness only affects humans like yourself, and your righteousness only other people.

verses.textZh: 他们因多受欺压而呼叫， 因受强权者的压制而呼求。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们因多受欺压而呼叫， 因受强权者的压制而呼求。
verses.textZhCuv: 人因多受欺压就哀求， 因受能者的辖制 便求救，
verses.textEnNiv: "People cry out under a load of oppression; they plead for relief from the arm of the powerful.
verses.textEnEsv: "Because of the multitude of oppressions people cry out; they call for help because of the arm of the mighty.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Because of the multitude of oppressions they cry out; They cry out for help because of the arm of the mighty.
verses.textEnNlt: "People cry out when they are oppressed. They groan beneath the power of the mighty.
verses.textEnNasb: "Because of the multitude of oppressions they cry out; They cry for help because of the arm of the mighty.
verses.textEn: "People cry out under a load of oppression; they plead for relief from the arm of the powerful.

verses.textZh: 却没有说：‘神我的创造主在哪里呢？ 他使人在夜间歌唱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 却没有说：‘神我的创造主在哪里呢？ 他使人在夜间歌唱。
verses.textZhCuv: 却无人说：造我的神在哪里？ 他使人夜间歌唱，
verses.textEnNiv: But no one says, ‘Where is God my Maker, who gives songs in the night,
verses.textEnEsv: But none says, ‘Where is God my Maker, who gives songs in the night,
verses.textEnNkjv: But no one says, ‘Where is God my Maker, Who gives songs in the night,
verses.textEnNlt: Yet they don’t ask, ‘Where is God my Creator, the one who gives songs in the night?
verses.textEnNasb: "But no one says, ‘Where is God my Maker, Who gives songs in the night,
verses.textEn: But no one says, ‘Where is God my Maker, who gives songs in the night,

verses.textZh: 他教导我们过于教导地上的走兽， 使我们有智慧胜于空中的飞鸟。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 他教导我们过于教导地上的走兽， 使我们有智慧胜于空中的飞鸟。’
verses.textZhCuv: 教训我们胜于地上的走兽， 使我们有聪明胜于空中的飞鸟。
verses.textEnNiv: who teaches us more than he teaches the beasts of the earth and makes us wiser than the birds in the sky?’
verses.textEnEsv: who teaches us more than the beasts of the earth and makes us wiser than the birds of the heavens?’
verses.textEnNkjv: Who teaches us more than the beasts of the earth, And makes us wiser than the birds of heaven?’
verses.textEnNlt: Where is the one who makes us smarter than the animals and wiser than the birds of the sky?’
verses.textEnNasb: Who teaches us more than the animals of the earth And makes us wiser than the birds of the sky?’
verses.textEn: who teaches us more than he teaches the beasts of the earth and makes us wiser than the birds in the sky?’

verses.textZh: 因为恶人骄傲的缘故， 他们在那里呼求，神却不回答。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为恶人骄傲的缘故， 他们在那里呼求，神却不回答。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们在那里， 因恶人的骄傲呼求，却无人答应。
verses.textEnNiv: He does not answer when people cry out because of the arrogance of the wicked.
verses.textEnEsv: There they cry out, but he does not answer, because of the pride of evil men.
verses.textEnNkjv: There they cry out, but He does not answer, Because of the pride of evil men.
verses.textEnNlt: And when they cry out, God does not answer because of their pride.
verses.textEnNasb: "There they cry out, but He does not answer Because of the pride of evil people.
verses.textEn: He does not answer when people cry out because of the arrogance of the wicked.

verses.textZh: 真的，神必不垂听虚妄的呼求， 全能者也必不留意，
verses.textZhCnvs: 真的，神必不垂听虚妄的呼求， 全能者也必不留意，
verses.textZhCuv: 虚妄的呼求，神必不垂听； 全能者也必不眷顾。
verses.textEnNiv: Indeed, God does not listen to their empty plea; the Almighty pays no attention to it.
verses.textEnEsv: Surely God does not hear an empty cry, nor does the Almighty regard it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Surely God will not listen to empty talk, Nor will the Almighty regard it.
verses.textEnNlt: But it is wrong to say God doesn’t listen, to say the Almighty isn’t concerned.
verses.textEnNasb: "God certainly will not listen to an empty cry, Nor will the Almighty regard it.
verses.textEn: Indeed, God does not listen to their empty plea; the Almighty pays no attention to it.

verses.textZh: 更何况你说你不得见他。 你的案件在他面前，你忍耐地等候他吧！
verses.textZhCnvs: 更何况你说你不得见他。 你的案件在他面前，你忍耐地等候他吧！
verses.textZhCuv: 何况你说，你不得见他； 你的案件在他面前，你等候他吧。
verses.textEnNiv: How much less, then, will he listen when you say that you do not see him, that your case is before him and you must wait for him,
verses.textEnEsv: How much less when you say that you do not see him, that the case is before him, and you are waiting for him!
verses.textEnNkjv: Although you say you do not see Him, Yet justice is before Him, and you must wait for Him.
verses.textEnNlt: You say you can’t see him, but he will bring justice if you will only wait.
verses.textEnNasb: "How much less when you say you do not look at Him, The case is before Him, and you must wait for Him!
verses.textEn: How much less, then, will he listen when you say that you do not see him, that your case is before him and you must wait for him,

verses.textZh: 但现在因为他还没有在忿怒中降罚， 也不大理会人的过犯；
verses.textZhCnvs: 但现在因为他还没有在忿怒中降罚， 也不大理会人的过犯；
verses.textZhCuv: 但如今因他未曾发怒降罚， 也不甚理会狂傲，
verses.textEnNiv: and further, that his anger never punishes and he does not take the least notice of wickedness.
verses.textEnEsv: And now, because his anger does not punish, and he does not take much note of transgression,
verses.textEnNkjv: And now, because He has not punished in His anger, Nor taken much notice of folly,
verses.textEnNlt: You say he does not respond to sinners with anger and is not greatly concerned about wickedness.
verses.textEnNasb: "And now, because He has not avenged His anger, Nor has He acknowledged wrongdoing well,
verses.textEn: and further, that his anger never punishes and he does not take the least notice of wickedness.

verses.textZh: 所以约伯开口说空话， 多说无知识的话。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以约伯开口说空话， 多说无知识的话。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所以约伯开口说虚妄的话， 多发无知识的言语。
verses.textEnNiv: So Job opens his mouth with empty talk; without knowledge he multiplies words."
verses.textEnEsv: Job opens his mouth in empty talk; he multiplies words without knowledge."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore Job opens his mouth in vain; He multiplies words without knowledge."
verses.textEnNlt: But you are talking nonsense, Job. You have spoken like a fool."
verses.textEnNasb: So Job opens his mouth with empty words; He multiplies words without knowledge."
