verses.textEn: So Job opens his mouth with empty talk; without knowledge he multiplies words."

verses.textZh: 以利户又接着说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利户又接着说：
verses.textZhCuv: 以利户又接着说：
verses.textEnNiv: Elihu continued:
verses.textEnEsv: And Elihu continued, and said:
verses.textEnNkjv: Elihu also proceeded and said:
verses.textEnNlt: Elihu continued speaking:
verses.textEnNasb: Then Elihu continued and said,
verses.textEn: Elihu continued:

verses.textZh: "你再等我片刻我就指示你， 因为我还有话要为神说。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你再等我片刻我就指示你， 因为我还有话要为神说。
verses.textZhCuv: 你再容我片时，我就指示你， 因我还有话为神说。
verses.textEnNiv: "Bear with me a little longer and I will show you that there is more to be said in God’s behalf.
verses.textEnEsv: "Bear with me a little, and I will show you, for I have yet something to say on God’s behalf.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Bear with me a little, and I will show you That thereare yet words to speak on God’s behalf.
verses.textEnNlt: "Let me go on, and I will show you the truth. For I have not finished defending God!
verses.textEnNasb: "Wait for me a little, and I will show you That there is still more to be said on God’s behalf.
verses.textEn: "Bear with me a little longer and I will show you that there is more to be said in God’s behalf.

verses.textZh: 我要从远处引来我的意见， 把公义归给我的创造主。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要从远处引来我的意见， 把公义归给我的创造主。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要将所知道的从远处引来， 将公义归给造我的主。
verses.textEnNiv: I get my knowledge from afar; I will ascribe justice to my Maker.
verses.textEnEsv: I will get my knowledge from afar and ascribe righteousness to my Maker.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will fetch my knowledge from afar; I will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.
verses.textEnNlt: I will present profound arguments for the righteousness of my Creator.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will bring my knowledge from afar, And ascribe righteousness to my Maker.
verses.textEn: I get my knowledge from afar; I will ascribe justice to my Maker.

verses.textZh: 我的话真的不是谎言， 有一位知识全备的与你同在。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的话真的不是谎言， 有一位知识全备的与你同在。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的言语真不虚谎； 有知识全备的与你同在。
verses.textEnNiv: Be assured that my words are not false; one who has perfect knowledge is with you.
verses.textEnEsv: For truly my words are not false; one who is perfect in knowledge is with you.
verses.textEnNkjv: For truly my words are not false; One who is perfect in knowledge is with you.
verses.textEnNlt: I am telling you nothing but the truth, for I am a man of great knowledge.
verses.textEnNasb: "For truly my words are not false; One who is perfect in knowledge is with you.
verses.textEn: Be assured that my words are not false; one who has perfect knowledge is with you.

verses.textZh: 神大有能力，并且不藐视人， 他的智慧大有能力。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神大有能力，并且不藐视人， 他的智慧大有能力。
verses.textZhCuv: 神有大能，并不藐视人； 他的智慧甚广。
verses.textEnNiv: "God is mighty, but despises no one; he is mighty, and firm in his purpose.
verses.textEnEsv: "Behold, God is mighty, and does not despise any; he is mighty in strength of understanding.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, God is mighty, but despises noone; Heis mighty in strength of understanding.
verses.textEnNlt: "God is mighty, but he does not despise anyone! He is mighty in both power and understanding.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, God is mighty but does not reject anyone; He is mighty in strength of understanding.
verses.textEn: "God is mighty, but despises no one; he is mighty, and firm in his purpose.

verses.textZh: 他不容恶人生存， 却为困苦人主持公道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他不容恶人生存， 却为困苦人主持公道。
verses.textZhCuv: 他不保护恶人的性命， 却为困苦人伸冤。
verses.textEnNiv: He does not keep the wicked alive but gives the afflicted their rights.
verses.textEnEsv: He does not keep the wicked alive, but gives the afflicted their right.
verses.textEnNkjv: He does not preserve the life of the wicked, But gives justice to the oppressed.
verses.textEnNlt: He does not let the wicked live but gives justice to the afflicted.
verses.textEnNasb: "He does not keep the wicked alive, But gives justice to the afflicted.
verses.textEn: He does not keep the wicked alive but gives the afflicted their rights.

verses.textZh: 他的眼目时常看顾义人， 他使他们与君王同坐宝座， 他们永远被高举。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的眼目时常看顾义人， 他使他们与君王同坐宝座， 他们永远被高举。
verses.textZhCuv: 他时常看顾义人， 使他们和君王同坐宝座， 永远要被高举。
verses.textEnNiv: He does not take his eyes off the righteous; he enthrones them with kings and exalts them forever.
verses.textEnEsv: He does not withdraw his eyes from the righteous, but with kings on the throne he sets them forever, and they are exalted.
verses.textEnNkjv: He does not withdraw His eyes from the righteous; But theyare on the throne with kings, For He has seated them forever, And they are exalted.
verses.textEnNlt: He never takes his eyes off the innocent, but he sets them on thrones with kings and exalts them forever.
verses.textEnNasb: "He does not withdraw His eyes from the righteous, But with kings on the throne He has seated them forever, and they are exalted.
verses.textEn: He does not take his eyes off the righteous; he enthrones them with kings and exalts them forever.

verses.textZh: 他们若被锁炼捆住， 被苦难的绳索缠住，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们若被锁炼捆住， 被苦难的绳索缠住，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们若被锁链捆住， 被苦难的绳索缠住，
verses.textEnNiv: But if people are bound in chains, held fast by cords of affliction,
verses.textEnEsv: And if they are bound in chains and caught in the cords of affliction,
verses.textEnNkjv: And if theyare bound in fetters, Held in the cords of affliction,
verses.textEnNlt: If they are bound in chains and caught up in a web of trouble,
verses.textEnNasb: "And if they are bound in shackles, And are caught in the snares of misery,
verses.textEn: But if people are bound in chains, held fast by cords of affliction,

verses.textZh: 他就把他们的作为和过犯都显示， 使他们知道他们骄傲自大。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他就把他们的作为和过犯都显示， 使他们知道他们骄傲自大。
verses.textZhCuv: 他就把他们的作为和过犯指示他们， 叫他们知道有骄傲的行动。
verses.textEnNiv: he tells them what they have done— that they have sinned arrogantly.
verses.textEnEsv: then he declares to them their work and their transgressions, that they are behaving arrogantly.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He tells them their work and their transgressions— That they have acted defiantly.
verses.textEnNlt: he shows them the reason. He shows them their sins of pride.
verses.textEnNasb: Then He declares to them their work And their wrongdoings, that they have been arrogant.
verses.textEn: he tells them what they have done— that they have sinned arrogantly.

verses.textZh: 他开启他们的耳朵可以领受教训， 吩咐他们离开罪孽而悔改。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他开启他们的耳朵可以领受教训， 吩咐他们离开罪孽而悔改。
verses.textZhCuv: 他也开通他们的耳朵得受教训， 吩咐他们离开罪孽转回。
verses.textEnNiv: He makes them listen to correction and commands them to repent of their evil.
verses.textEnEsv: He opens their ears to instruction and commands that they return from iniquity.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also opens their ear to instruction, And commands that they turn from iniquity.
verses.textEnNlt: He gets their attention and commands that they turn from evil.
verses.textEnNasb: "He opens their ears to instruction, And commands that they return from injustice.
verses.textEn: He makes them listen to correction and commands them to repent of their evil.

verses.textZh: 他们若听从他、事奉他， 就必幸福地度尽他们的日子， 也必快乐地度过他们的岁月。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们若听从他、事奉他， 就必幸福地度尽他们的日子， 也必快乐地度过他们的岁月。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们若听从事奉他， 就必度日亨通，历年福乐；
verses.textEnNiv: If they obey and serve him, they will spend the rest of their days in prosperity and their years in contentment.
verses.textEnEsv: If they listen and serve him, they complete their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasantness.
verses.textEnNkjv: If they obey and serve Him, They shall spend their days in prosperity, And their years in pleasures.
verses.textEnNlt: "If they listen and obey God, they will be blessed with prosperity throughout their lives. All their years will be pleasant.
verses.textEnNasb: "If they listen and serve Him, They will end their days in prosperity, And their years in happiness.
verses.textEn: If they obey and serve him, they will spend the rest of their days in prosperity and their years in contentment.

verses.textZh: 他们若不听从，就必死在刀下， 毫无知识地气绝身亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们若不听从，就必死在刀下， 毫无知识地气绝身亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 若不听从， 就要被刀杀灭，无知无识而死。
verses.textEnNiv: But if they do not listen, they will perish by the sword and die without knowledge.
verses.textEnEsv: But if they do not listen, they perish by the sword and die without knowledge.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if they do not obey, They shall perish by the sword, And they shall die without knowledge.
verses.textEnNlt: But if they refuse to listen to him, they will cross over the river of death, dying from lack of understanding.
verses.textEnNasb: "But if they do not listen, they will perish by the sword, And die without knowledge.
verses.textEn: But if they do not listen, they will perish by the sword and die without knowledge.

verses.textZh: 那些心里不敬虔的人积存怒气，神捆绑他们，他们竟不呼求。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些心里不敬虔的人积存怒气，神捆绑他们，他们竟不呼求。
verses.textZhCuv: 那心中不敬虔的人积蓄怒气；神捆绑他们，他们竟不求救；
verses.textEnNiv: "The godless in heart harbor resentment; even when he fetters them, they do not cry for help.
verses.textEnEsv: "The godless in heart cherish anger; they do not cry for help when he binds them.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But the hypocrites in heart store up wrath; They do not cry for help when He binds them.
verses.textEnNlt: For the godless are full of resentment. Even when he punishes them, they refuse to cry out to him for help.
verses.textEnNasb: "But the godless in heart nurture anger; They do not call for help when He binds them.
verses.textEn: "The godless in heart harbor resentment; even when he fetters them, they do not cry for help.

verses.textZh: 他必早年丧命， 丧命如庙妓一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必早年丧命， 丧命如庙妓一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 必在青年时死亡， 与污秽人一样丧命。
verses.textEnNiv: They die in their youth, among male prostitutes of the shrines.
verses.textEnEsv: They die in youth, and their life ends among the cult prostitutes.
verses.textEnNkjv: They die in youth, And their life ends among the perverted persons.
verses.textEnNlt: They die when they are young, after wasting their lives in immoral living.
verses.textEnNasb: " They die in youth, And their life perishes among the cult prostitutes.
verses.textEn: They die in their youth, among male prostitutes of the shrines.

verses.textZh: 神借着苦难救拔困苦人， 以他们所受的压迫开启他们的耳朵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神借着苦难救拔困苦人， 以他们所受的压迫开启他们的耳朵。
verses.textZhCuv: 神藉着困苦救拔困苦人， 趁他们受欺压开通他们的耳朵。
verses.textEnNiv: But those who suffer he delivers in their suffering; he speaks to them in their affliction.
verses.textEnEsv: He delivers the afflicted by their affliction and opens their ear by adversity.
verses.textEnNkjv: He delivers the poor in their affliction, And opens their ears in oppression.
verses.textEnNlt: But by means of their suffering, he rescues those who suffer. For he gets their attention through adversity.
verses.textEnNasb: "He rescues the afflicted in their misery, And opens their ears in time of oppression.
verses.textEn: But those who suffer he delivers in their suffering; he speaks to them in their affliction.

verses.textZh: 他也诱导你脱离患难的虎口， 到宽阔不狭窄之地， 到你摆满肥甘的席上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他也诱导你脱离患难的虎口， 到宽阔不狭窄之地， 到你摆满肥甘的席上。
verses.textZhCuv: 神也必引你出离患难， 进入宽阔不狭窄之地； 摆在你席上的必满有肥甘。
verses.textEnNiv: "He is wooing you from the jaws of distress to a spacious place free from restriction, to the comfort of your table laden with choice food.
verses.textEnEsv: He also allured you out of distress into a broad place where there was no cramping, and what was set on your table was full of fatness.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Indeed He would have brought you out of dire distress, Into a broad place where thereis no restraint; And what is set on your table wouldbe full of richness.
verses.textEnNlt: "God is leading you away from danger, Job, to a place free from distress. He is setting your table with the best food.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then indeed, He induced you away from the mouth of distress, And instead of it, a broad place with no constraint; And your table was full of rich food.
verses.textEn: "He is wooing you from the jaws of distress to a spacious place free from restriction, to the comfort of your table laden with choice food.

verses.textZh: 你却满有恶人所当受的审判， 审断和刑罚把你抓住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你却满有恶人所当受的审判， 审断和刑罚把你抓住。
verses.textZhCuv: 但你满口有恶人批评的言语； 判断和刑罚抓住你。
verses.textEnNiv: But now you are laden with the judgment due the wicked; judgment and justice have taken hold of you.
verses.textEnEsv: "But you are full of the judgment on the wicked; judgment and justice seize you.
verses.textEnNkjv: But you are filled with the judgment due the wicked; Judgment and justice take hold ofyou.
verses.textEnNlt: But you are obsessed with whether the godless will be judged. Don’t worry, judgment and justice will be upheld.
verses.textEnNasb: "But you were full of judgment on the wicked; Judgment and justice take hold of you.
verses.textEn: But now you are laden with the judgment due the wicked; judgment and justice have taken hold of you.

verses.textZh: 你要小心不可让忿怒激动你，以致侮慢神， 也不要因赎价大而偏离正道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要小心不可让忿怒激动你，以致侮慢神， 也不要因赎价大而偏离正道。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可容忿怒触动你，使你不服责罚； 也不可因赎价大就偏行。
verses.textEnNiv: Be careful that no one entices you by riches; do not let a large bribe turn you aside.
verses.textEnEsv: Beware lest wrath entice you into scoffing, and let not the greatness of the ransom turn you aside.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because thereis wrath, beware lest He take you away with one blow; For a large ransom would not help you avoid it.
verses.textEnNlt: But watch out, or you may be seduced by wealth. Don’t let yourself be bribed into sin.
verses.textEnNasb: "Beware that wrath does not entice you to mockery; And do not let the greatness of the ransom turn you aside.
verses.textEn: Be careful that no one entices you by riches; do not let a large bribe turn you aside.

verses.textZh: 你的呼求、或一切势力， 能使你不受患难吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的呼求、或一切势力， 能使你不受患难吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你的呼求 ，或是你一切的势力， 果有灵验，叫你不受患难吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Would your wealth or even all your mighty efforts sustain you so you would not be in distress?
verses.textEnEsv: Will your cry for help avail to keep you from distress, or all the force of your strength?
verses.textEnNkjv: Will your riches, Or all the mighty forces, Keep you from distress?
verses.textEnNlt: Could all your wealth or all your mighty efforts keep you from distress?
verses.textEnNasb: "Will your cry for help keep you from distress, Or all the exertions of your strength?
verses.textEn: Would your wealth or even all your mighty efforts sustain you so you would not be in distress?

verses.textZh: 你不可切慕黑夜来临， 就是众人在他们的住处被除灭的时候。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不可切慕黑夜来临， 就是众人在他们的住处被除灭的时候。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要切慕黑夜， 就是众民在本处被除灭的时候。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not long for the night, to drag people away from their homes.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not long for the night, when peoples vanish in their place.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not desire the night, When people are cut off in their place.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not long for the cover of night, for that is when people will be destroyed.
verses.textEnNasb: "Do not long for the night, When people vanish in their places.
verses.textEn: Do not long for the night, to drag people away from their homes.

verses.textZh: 你要小心，不可转向罪孽， 因为你选择罪孽而不选择患难。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要小心，不可转向罪孽， 因为你选择罪孽而不选择患难。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要谨慎，不可重看罪孽， 因你选择罪孽过于选择苦难。
verses.textEnNiv: Beware of turning to evil, which you seem to prefer to affliction.
verses.textEnEsv: Take care; do not turn to iniquity, for this you have chosen rather than affliction.
verses.textEnNkjv: Take heed, do not turn to iniquity, For you have chosen this rather than affliction.
verses.textEnNlt: Be on guard! Turn back from evil, for God sent this suffering to keep you from a life of evil.
verses.textEnNasb: "Be careful, do not turn to evil, For you preferred this to misery.
verses.textEn: Beware of turning to evil, which you seem to prefer to affliction.

verses.textZh: 神靠自己的能力高高在上， 有谁像神指教人呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 神靠自己的能力高高在上， 有谁像神指教人呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 神行事有高大的能力； 教训人的有谁像他呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "God is exalted in his power. Who is a teacher like him?
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, God is exalted in his power; who is a teacher like him?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, God is exalted by His power; Who teaches like Him?
verses.textEnNlt: "Look, God is all-powerful. Who is a teacher like him?
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, God is exalted in His power; Who is a teacher like Him?
verses.textEn: "God is exalted in his power. Who is a teacher like him?

verses.textZh: 谁把他所行的道路派给他？ 谁能说：‘你所行的不义’呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁把他所行的道路派给他？ 谁能说：‘你所行的不义’呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 谁派定他的道路？ 谁能说：你所行的不义？
verses.textEnNiv: Who has prescribed his ways for him, or said to him, ‘You have done wrong’?
verses.textEnEsv: Who has prescribed for him his way, or who can say, ‘You have done wrong’?
verses.textEnNkjv: Who has assigned Him His way, Or who has said, ‘You have done wrong’?
verses.textEnNlt: No one can tell him what to do, or say to him, ‘You have done wrong.’
verses.textEnNasb: "Who has appointed Him His way, And who has said, ‘You have done wrong’?
verses.textEn: Who has prescribed his ways for him, or said to him, ‘You have done wrong’?

verses.textZh: 你要记得称赞他所行的为大， 就是众人所歌颂的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要记得称赞他所行的为大， 就是众人所歌颂的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你不可忘记称赞他所行的为大， 就是人所歌颂的。
verses.textEnNiv: Remember to extol his work, which people have praised in song.
verses.textEnEsv: "Remember to extol his work, of which men have sung.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Remember to magnify His work, Of which men have sung.
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, glorify his mighty works, singing songs of praise.
verses.textEnNasb: "Remember that you are to exalt His work, Of which people have sung.
verses.textEn: Remember to extol his work, which people have praised in song.

verses.textZh: 他所行的，万人都看见， 世人都从远处观看。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他所行的，万人都看见， 世人都从远处观看。
verses.textZhCuv: 他所行的，万人都看见； 世人也从远处观看。
verses.textEnNiv: All humanity has seen it; mortals gaze on it from afar.
verses.textEnEsv: All mankind has looked on it; man beholds it from afar.
verses.textEnNkjv: Everyone has seen it; Man looks on it from afar.
verses.textEnNlt: Everyone has seen these things, though only from a distance.
verses.textEnNasb: "All people have seen it; Mankind looks at it from afar.
verses.textEn: All humanity has seen it; mortals gaze on it from afar.

verses.textZh: 神为至大，我们不能了解， 他的年数，无法测度。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神为至大，我们不能了解， 他的年数，无法测度。
verses.textZhCuv: 神为大，我们不能全知； 他的年数不能测度。
verses.textEnNiv: How great is God—beyond our understanding! The number of his years is past finding out.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, God is great, and we know him not; the number of his years is unsearchable.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, God is great, and we do not know Him; Nor can the number of His years be discovered.
verses.textEnNlt: "Look, God is greater than we can understand. His years cannot be counted.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, God is exalted, and we do not know Him; The number of His years is unsearchable.
verses.textEn: How great is God—beyond our understanding! The number of his years is past finding out.

verses.textZh: 他吸收滴滴水点， 使水滴在云雾中化成雨，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他吸收滴滴水点， 使水滴在云雾中化成雨，
verses.textZhCuv: 他吸取水点， 这水点从云雾中就变成雨；
verses.textEnNiv: "He draws up the drops of water, which distill as rain to the streams ;
verses.textEnEsv: For he draws up the drops of water; they distill his mist in rain,
verses.textEnNkjv: For He draws up drops of water, Which distill as rain from the mist,
verses.textEnNlt: He draws up the water vapor and then distills it into rain.
verses.textEnNasb: "For He draws up the drops of water; They distill rain from its celestial stream,
verses.textEn: "He draws up the drops of water, which distill as rain to the streams ;

verses.textZh: 云层倾下雨水， 沛然降在世人身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 云层倾下雨水， 沛然降在世人身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 云彩将雨落下，沛然降与世人。
verses.textEnNiv: the clouds pour down their moisture and abundant showers fall on mankind.
verses.textEnEsv: which the skies pour down and drop on mankind abundantly.
verses.textEnNkjv: Which the clouds drop down And pour abundantly on man.
verses.textEnNlt: The rain pours down from the clouds, and everyone benefits.
verses.textEnNasb: Which clouds pour down; They drip upon mankind abundantly.
verses.textEn: the clouds pour down their moisture and abundant showers fall on mankind.

verses.textZh: 谁能明白云彩的展开， 和神行宫的雷声呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁能明白云彩的展开， 和神行宫的雷声呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 谁能明白云彩如何铺张， 和神行宫的雷声呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Who can understand how he spreads out the clouds, how he thunders from his pavilion?
verses.textEnEsv: Can anyone understand the spreading of the clouds, the thunderings of his pavilion?
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed, can anyone understand the spreading of clouds, The thunder from His canopy?
verses.textEnNlt: Who can understand the spreading of the clouds and the thunder that rolls forth from heaven?
verses.textEnNasb: "Can anyone understand the spreading of the clouds, The thundering of His pavilion?
verses.textEn: Who can understand how he spreads out the clouds, how he thunders from his pavilion?

verses.textZh: 他在自己的周围展开电光， 又用水遮盖海底；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在自己的周围展开电光， 又用水遮盖海底；
verses.textZhCuv: 他将亮光普照在自己的四围； 他又遮覆海底。
verses.textEnNiv: See how he scatters his lightning about him, bathing the depths of the sea.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, he scatters his lightning about him and covers the roots of the sea.
verses.textEnNkjv: Look, He scatters His light upon it, And covers the depths of the sea.
verses.textEnNlt: See how he spreads the lightning around him and how it lights up the depths of the sea.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, He spreads His lightning about Him, And He covers the depths of the sea.
verses.textEn: See how he scatters his lightning about him, bathing the depths of the sea.

verses.textZh: 他用这些审断万人， 又赐予丰盛的粮食；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他用这些审断万人， 又赐予丰盛的粮食；
verses.textZhCuv: 他用这些审判众民， 且赐丰富的粮食。
verses.textEnNiv: This is the way he governs the nations and provides food in abundance.
verses.textEnEsv: For by these he judges peoples; he gives food in abundance.
verses.textEnNkjv: For by these He judges the peoples; He gives food in abundance.
verses.textEnNlt: By these mighty acts he nourishes the people, giving them food in abundance.
verses.textEnNasb: "For by them He judges peoples; He gives food in abundance.
verses.textEn: This is the way he governs the nations and provides food in abundance.

verses.textZh: 他以电光遮盖双手， 然后吩咐电光去攻击目标，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他以电光遮盖双手， 然后吩咐电光去攻击目标，
verses.textZhCuv: 他以电光遮手， 命闪电击中敌人 。
verses.textEnNiv: He fills his hands with lightning and commands it to strike its mark.
verses.textEnEsv: He covers his hands with the lightning and commands it to strike the mark.
verses.textEnNkjv: He covers His hands with lightning, And commands it to strike.
verses.textEnNlt: He fills his hands with lightning bolts and hurls each at its target.
verses.textEnNasb: "He covers His hands with the lightning, And commands it to strike the target.
verses.textEn: He fills his hands with lightning and commands it to strike its mark.

verses.textZh: 他以雷声宣扬自己， 甚至牲畜也注意将有甚么临近。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他以雷声宣扬自己， 甚至牲畜也注意将有甚么临近。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所发的雷声显明他的作为， 又向牲畜指明要起暴风。
verses.textEnNiv: His thunder announces the coming storm; even the cattle make known its approach.
verses.textEnEsv: Its crashing declares his presence; the cattle also declare that he rises.
verses.textEnNkjv: His thunder declares it, The cattle also, concerning the rising storm.
verses.textEnNlt: The thunder announces his presence; the storm announces his indignant anger.
verses.textEnNasb: "Its thundering voice declares His presence; The livestock also, concerning what is coming up.
verses.textEn: His thunder announces the coming storm; even the cattle make known its approach.

verses.textZh: "我的心因此战兢， 跳离原处。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我的心因此战兢， 跳离原处。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此我心战兢， 从原处移动。
verses.textEnNiv: "At this my heart pounds and leaps from its place.
verses.textEnEsv: "At this also my heart trembles and leaps out of its place.
verses.textEnNkjv: "At this also my heart trembles, And leaps from its place.
verses.textEnNlt: "My heart pounds as I think of this. It trembles within me.
verses.textEnNasb: "At this also my heart trembles, And leaps from its place.
verses.textEn: "At this my heart pounds and leaps from its place.

verses.textZh: 你们当细听他轰轰的声音， 他口中发出隆隆的雷声。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们当细听他轰轰的声音， 他口中发出隆隆的雷声。
verses.textZhCuv: 听啊，神轰轰的声音 是他口中所发的响声。
verses.textEnNiv: Listen! Listen to the roar of his voice, to the rumbling that comes from his mouth.
verses.textEnEsv: Keep listening to the thunder of his voice and the rumbling that comes from his mouth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Hear attentively the thunder of His voice, And the rumbling that comes from His mouth.
verses.textEnNlt: Listen carefully to the thunder of God’s voice as it rolls from his mouth.
verses.textEnNasb: "Listen closely to the thunder of His voice, And the rumbling that goes out from His mouth.
verses.textEn: Listen! Listen to the roar of his voice, to the rumbling that comes from his mouth.

verses.textZh: 他发雷声响遍天下， 也发电光闪到地极。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他发雷声响遍天下， 也发电光闪到地极。
verses.textZhCuv: 他发响声震遍天下， 发电光闪到地极。
verses.textEnNiv: He unleashes his lightning beneath the whole heaven and sends it to the ends of the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: Under the whole heaven he lets it go, and his lightning to the corners of the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: He sends it forth under the whole heaven, His lightning to the ends of the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: It rolls across the heavens, and his lightning flashes in every direction.
verses.textEnNasb: "Under the whole heaven He lets it loose, And His lightning travels to the ends of the earth.
verses.textEn: He unleashes his lightning beneath the whole heaven and sends it to the ends of the earth.

verses.textZh: 接着雷声霹雳，神以自己威严之声打雷， 人听到雷声的时候，神并没有留住风霜雨云 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 接着雷声霹雳，神以自己威严之声打雷， 人听到雷声的时候，神并没有留住风霜雨云 。
verses.textZhCuv: 随后人听见有雷声轰轰，大发威严， 雷电接连不断。
verses.textEnNiv: After that comes the sound of his roar; he thunders with his majestic voice. When his voice resounds, he holds nothing back.
verses.textEnEsv: After it his voice roars; he thunders with his majestic voice, and he does not restrain the lightnings when his voice is heard.
verses.textEnNkjv: After it a voice roars; He thunders with His majestic voice, And He does not restrain them when His voice is heard.
verses.textEnNlt: Then comes the roaring of the thunder— the tremendous voice of his majesty. He does not restrain it when he speaks.
verses.textEnNasb: "After it, a voice roars; He thunders with His majestic voice, And He does not restrain the lightning when His voice is heard.
verses.textEn: After that comes the sound of his roar; he thunders with his majestic voice. When his voice resounds, he holds nothing back.

verses.textZh: 神以奇妙的方法打雷， 他行大事，我们不能了解。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神以奇妙的方法打雷， 他行大事，我们不能了解。
verses.textZhCuv: 神发出奇妙的雷声； 他行大事，我们不能测透。
verses.textEnNiv: God’s voice thunders in marvelous ways; he does great things beyond our understanding.
verses.textEnEsv: God thunders wondrously with his voice; he does great things that we cannot comprehend.
verses.textEnNkjv: God thunders marvelously with His voice; He does great things which we cannot comprehend.
verses.textEnNlt: God’s voice is glorious in the thunder. We can’t even imagine the greatness of his power.
verses.textEnNasb: "God thunders wondrously with His voice, Doing great things which we do not comprehend.
verses.textEn: God’s voice thunders in marvelous ways; he does great things beyond our understanding.

verses.textZh: 他对雪说：‘降在地上’， 对大雨暴雨也是这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对雪说：‘降在地上’， 对大雨暴雨也是这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 他对雪说：要降在地上； 对大雨和暴雨也是这样说。
verses.textEnNiv: He says to the snow, ‘Fall on the earth,’ and to the rain shower, ‘Be a mighty downpour.’
verses.textEnEsv: For to the snow he says, ‘Fall on the earth,’ likewise to the downpour, his mighty downpour.
verses.textEnNkjv: For He says to the snow, ‘Fall on the earth’; Likewise to the gentle rain and the heavy rain of His strength.
verses.textEnNlt: "He directs the snow to fall on the earth and tells the rain to pour down.
verses.textEnNasb: "For to the snow He says, ‘Fall on the earth,’ And to the downpour and the rain, ‘Be strong.’
verses.textEn: He says to the snow, ‘Fall on the earth,’ and to the rain shower, ‘Be a mighty downpour.’

verses.textZh: 他封住各人的手， 叫万人知道他的作为。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他封住各人的手， 叫万人知道他的作为。
verses.textZhCuv: 他封住各人的手， 叫所造的万人都晓得他的作为。
verses.textEnNiv: So that everyone he has made may know his work, he stops all people from their labor.
verses.textEnEsv: He seals up the hand of every man, that all men whom he made may know it.
verses.textEnNkjv: He seals the hand of every man, That all men may know His work.
verses.textEnNlt: Then everyone stops working so they can watch his power.
verses.textEnNasb: "He seals the hand of every person, So that all people may know His work.
verses.textEn: So that everyone he has made may know his work, he stops all people from their labor.

verses.textZh: 野兽进入洞中， 留在穴里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 野兽进入洞中， 留在穴里。
verses.textZhCuv: 百兽进入穴中， 卧在洞内。
verses.textEnNiv: The animals take cover; they remain in their dens.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the beasts go into their lairs, and remain in their dens.
verses.textEnNkjv: The beasts go into dens, And remain in their lairs.
verses.textEnNlt: The wild animals take cover and stay inside their dens.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then the animal goes into its lair And remains in its den.
verses.textEn: The animals take cover; they remain in their dens.

verses.textZh: 风暴来自南宫， 寒冷出于北方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 风暴来自南宫， 寒冷出于北方。
verses.textZhCuv: 暴风出于南宫； 寒冷出于北方。
verses.textEnNiv: The tempest comes out from its chamber, the cold from the driving winds.
verses.textEnEsv: From its chamber comes the whirlwind, and cold from the scattering winds.
verses.textEnNkjv: From the chamber ofthesouth comes the whirlwind, And cold from the scattering winds ofthenorth.
verses.textEnNlt: The stormy wind comes from its chamber, and the driving winds bring the cold.
verses.textEnNasb: "From the south comes the storm, And from the north wind the cold.
verses.textEn: The tempest comes out from its chamber, the cold from the driving winds.

verses.textZh: 神所呼的气息结成冰， 广阔无边的水也凝结；
verses.textZhCnvs: 神所呼的气息结成冰， 广阔无边的水也凝结；
verses.textZhCuv: 神嘘气成冰； 宽阔之水也都凝结。
verses.textEnNiv: The breath of God produces ice, and the broad waters become frozen.
verses.textEnEsv: By the breath of God ice is given, and the broad waters are frozen fast.
verses.textEnNkjv: By the breath of God ice is given, And the broad waters are frozen.
verses.textEnNlt: God’s breath sends the ice, freezing wide expanses of water.
verses.textEnNasb: "From the breath of God ice is made, And the expanse of the waters is frozen.
verses.textEn: The breath of God produces ice, and the broad waters become frozen.

verses.textZh: 他使密云满载水气， 云彩布散他的电光。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他使密云满载水气， 云彩布散他的电光。
verses.textZhCuv: 他使密云盛满水气， 布散电光之云；
verses.textEnNiv: He loads the clouds with moisture; he scatters his lightning through them.
verses.textEnEsv: He loads the thick cloud with moisture; the clouds scatter his lightning.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also with moisture He saturates the thick clouds; He scatters His bright clouds.
verses.textEnNlt: He loads the clouds with moisture, and they flash with his lightning.
verses.textEnNasb: "He also loads the clouds with moisture; He disperses the cloud of His lightning.
verses.textEn: He loads the clouds with moisture; he scatters his lightning through them.

verses.textZh: 电光照着神的指引来往旋转， 在地球上行他一切所吩咐的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 电光照着神的指引来往旋转， 在地球上行他一切所吩咐的。
verses.textZhCuv: 这云是藉他的指引游行旋转， 得以在全地面上行他一切所吩咐的，
verses.textEnNiv: At his direction they swirl around over the face of the whole earth to do whatever he commands them.
verses.textEnEsv: They turn around and around by his guidance, to accomplish all that he commands them on the face of the habitable world.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they swirl about, being turned by His guidance, That they may do whatever He commands them On the face of the whole earth.
verses.textEnNlt: The clouds churn about at his direction. They do whatever he commands throughout the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: "It changes direction, turning around by His guidance, That it may do whatever He commands it On the face of the inhabited earth.
verses.textEn: At his direction they swirl around over the face of the whole earth to do whatever he commands them.

verses.textZh: 他使电光来临，是为施行责罚， 或为滋润大地，或为赐予慈爱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他使电光来临，是为施行责罚， 或为滋润大地，或为赐予慈爱。
verses.textZhCuv: 或为责罚，或为润地， 或为施行慈爱。
verses.textEnNiv: He brings the clouds to punish people, or to water his earth and show his love.
verses.textEnEsv: Whether for correction or for his land or for love, he causes it to happen.
verses.textEnNkjv: He causes it to come, Whether for correction, Or for His land, Or for mercy.
verses.textEnNlt: He makes these things happen either to punish people or to show his unfailing love.
verses.textEnNasb: "Whether for correction, or for His earth, Or for goodness, He causes it to happen.
verses.textEn: He brings the clouds to punish people, or to water his earth and show his love.

verses.textZh: 约伯啊！你当留心听这话， 要站立思想神奇妙的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约伯啊！你当留心听这话， 要站立思想神奇妙的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 约伯啊，你要留心听， 要站立思想神奇妙的作为。
verses.textEnNiv: "Listen to this, Job; stop and consider God’s wonders.
verses.textEnEsv: "Hear this, O Job; stop and consider the wondrous works of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Listen to this, O Job; Stand still and consider the wondrous works of God.
verses.textEnNlt: "Pay attention to this, Job. Stop and consider the wonderful miracles of God!
verses.textEnNasb: "Listen to this, Job; Stand and consider the wonders of God.
verses.textEn: "Listen to this, Job; stop and consider God’s wonders.

verses.textZh: 神怎样吩咐这些， 又怎样使云中的电光照耀，你知道吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 神怎样吩咐这些， 又怎样使云中的电光照耀，你知道吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 神如何吩咐这些， 如何使云中的电光照耀，你知道吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Do you know how God controls the clouds and makes his lightning flash?
verses.textEnEsv: Do you know how God lays his command upon them and causes the lightning of his cloud to shine?
verses.textEnNkjv: Do you know when God dispatches them, And causes the light of His cloud to shine?
verses.textEnNlt: Do you know how God controls the storm and causes the lightning to flash from his clouds?
verses.textEnNasb: "Do you know how God establishes them, And makes the lightning of His clouds to shine?
verses.textEn: Do you know how God controls the clouds and makes his lightning flash?

verses.textZh: 密云怎样浮于空中， 那知识全备者奇妙的作为，你知道吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 密云怎样浮于空中， 那知识全备者奇妙的作为，你知道吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 云彩如何浮于空中， 那知识全备者奇妙的作为，你知道吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Do you know how the clouds hang poised, those wonders of him who has perfect knowledge?
verses.textEnEsv: Do you know the balancings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him who is perfect in knowledge,
verses.textEnNkjv: Do you know how the clouds are balanced, Those wondrous works of Him who is perfect in knowledge?
verses.textEnNlt: Do you understand how he moves the clouds with wonderful perfection and skill?
verses.textEnNasb: "Do you know about the hovering of the clouds, The wonders of One who is perfect in knowledge,
verses.textEn: Do you know how the clouds hang poised, those wonders of him who has perfect knowledge?

verses.textZh: 地因南风而寂静的时候， 你的衣服怎样热起来，你知道吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 地因南风而寂静的时候， 你的衣服怎样热起来，你知道吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 南风使地寂静， 你的衣服就如火热，你知道吗？
verses.textEnNiv: You who swelter in your clothes when the land lies hushed under the south wind,
verses.textEnEsv: you whose garments are hot when the earth is still because of the south wind?
verses.textEnNkjv: Why are your garments hot, When He quiets the earth by the south wind?
verses.textEnNlt: When you are sweltering in your clothes and the south wind dies down and everything is still,
verses.textEnNasb: You whose garments are hot When the land is still because of the south wind?
verses.textEn: You who swelter in your clothes when the land lies hushed under the south wind,

verses.textZh: 你能与神同铺云天吗？ 这云天坚硬如铸成的镜子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你能与神同铺云天吗？ 这云天坚硬如铸成的镜子。
verses.textZhCuv: 你岂能与神同铺穹苍吗？ 这穹苍坚硬，如同铸成的镜子。
verses.textEnNiv: can you join him in spreading out the skies, hard as a mirror of cast bronze?
verses.textEnEsv: Can you, like him, spread out the skies, hard as a cast metal mirror?
verses.textEnNkjv: With Him, have you spread out the skies, Strong as a cast metal mirror?
verses.textEnNlt: he makes the skies reflect the heat like a bronze mirror. Can you do that?
verses.textEnNasb: "Can you, with Him, spread out the skies, Strong as a cast metal mirror?
verses.textEn: can you join him in spreading out the skies, hard as a mirror of cast bronze?

verses.textZh: 我们因愚昧无知的缘故，不能陈明我们的案件， 请你告诉我们应该对他说甚么话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们因愚昧无知的缘故，不能陈明我们的案件， 请你告诉我们应该对他说甚么话。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们愚昧不能陈说； 请你指教我们该对他说什么话。
verses.textEnNiv: "Tell us what we should say to him; we cannot draw up our case because of our darkness.
verses.textEnEsv: Teach us what we shall say to him; we cannot draw up our case because of darkness.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Teach us what we should say to Him, For we can prepare nothing because of the darkness.
verses.textEnNlt: "So teach the rest of us what to say to God. We are too ignorant to make our own arguments.
verses.textEnNasb: "Teach us what we are to say to Him; We cannot present our case because of darkness.
verses.textEn: "Tell us what we should say to him; we cannot draw up our case because of our darkness.

verses.textZh: 人怎能对他说：‘我要说话’？ 哪有人自愿灭亡呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 人怎能对他说：‘我要说话’？ 哪有人自愿灭亡呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 人岂可说：我愿与他说话？ 岂有人自愿灭亡吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Should he be told that I want to speak? Would anyone ask to be swallowed up?
verses.textEnEsv: Shall it be told him that I would speak? Did a man ever wish that he would be swallowed up?
verses.textEnNkjv: Should He be told that I wishto speak? If a man were to speak, surely he would be swallowed up.
verses.textEnNlt: Should God be notified that I want to speak? Can people even speak when they are confused?
verses.textEnNasb: "Shall it be told Him that I would speak? Or should a man say that he would be swallowed up?
verses.textEn: Should he be told that I want to speak? Would anyone ask to be swallowed up?

verses.textZh: 人不能看见云后的强光， 唯有经风一吹，天才晴朗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人不能看见云后的强光， 唯有经风一吹，天才晴朗。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在有云遮蔽，人不得见穹苍的光亮； 但风吹过，天又发晴。
verses.textEnNiv: Now no one can look at the sun, bright as it is in the skies after the wind has swept them clean.
verses.textEnEsv: "And now no one looks on the light when it is bright in the skies, when the wind has passed and cleared them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Even now men cannot look at the light whenitis bright in the skies, When the wind has passed and cleared them.
verses.textEnNlt: We cannot look at the sun, for it shines brightly in the sky when the wind clears away the clouds.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now people do not see the light which is bright in the skies; But the wind has passed and cleared them.
verses.textEn: Now no one can look at the sun, bright as it is in the skies after the wind has swept them clean.

verses.textZh: 金光来自北方， 在神的周围有可怕的威严。
verses.textZhCnvs: 金光来自北方， 在神的周围有可怕的威严。
verses.textZhCuv: 金光出于北方， 在神那里有可怕的威严。
verses.textEnNiv: Out of the north he comes in golden splendor; God comes in awesome majesty.
verses.textEnEsv: Out of the north comes golden splendor; God is clothed with awesome majesty.
verses.textEnNkjv: He comes from the north as golden splendor; With God is awesome majesty.
verses.textEnNlt: So also, golden splendor comes from the mountain of God. He is clothed in dazzling splendor.
verses.textEnNasb: "From the north comes golden splendor; Around God is awesome majesty.
verses.textEn: Out of the north he comes in golden splendor; God comes in awesome majesty.

verses.textZh: 论到全能者，我们无法把他查出； 他大有能力与公平， 又满有公义，他必不苦待人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 论到全能者，我们无法把他查出； 他大有能力与公平， 又满有公义，他必不苦待人。
verses.textZhCuv: 论到全能者，我们不能测度； 他大有能力，有公平和大义， 必不苦待人。
verses.textEnNiv: The Almighty is beyond our reach and exalted in power; in his justice and great righteousness, he does not oppress.
verses.textEnEsv: The Almighty—we cannot find him; he is great in power; justice and abundant righteousness he will not violate.
verses.textEnNkjv: Asfor the Almighty, we cannot find Him; Heis excellent in power, In judgment and abundant justice; He does not oppress.
verses.textEnNlt: We cannot imagine the power of the Almighty; but even though he is just and righteous, he does not destroy us.
verses.textEnNasb: "The Almighty—we cannot find Him; He is exalted in power And He will not violate justice and abundant righteousness.
verses.textEn: The Almighty is beyond our reach and exalted in power; in his justice and great righteousness, he does not oppress.

verses.textZh: 因此人人都应该敬畏他； 心中自以为有智慧的， 他都不看顾。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此人人都应该敬畏他； 心中自以为有智慧的， 他都不看顾。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，人敬畏他； 凡自以为心中有智慧的人，他都不顾念。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, people revere him, for does he not have regard for all the wise in heart? "
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore men fear him; he does not regard any who are wise in their own conceit."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore men fear Him; He shows no partiality to any whoare wise of heart."
verses.textEnNlt: No wonder people everywhere fear him. All who are wise show him reverence. "
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore people fear Him; He does not regard any who are wise of heart."
verses.textEn: Therefore, people revere him, for does he not have regard for all the wise in heart? "

verses.textZh: 那时，耶和华在旋风中回答约伯，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，耶和华在旋风中回答约伯，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，耶和华从旋风中回答约伯说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord spoke to Job out of the storm. He said:
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord answered Job out of the whirlwind and said:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said:
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord answered Job from the whirlwind:
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord answered Job from the whirlwind and said,
verses.textEn: Then the Lord spoke to Job out of the storm. He said:

verses.textZh: "这以无知无识的言语， 使我的旨意暗晦不明的是谁呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: "这以无知无识的言语， 使我的旨意暗晦不明的是谁呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 谁用无知的言语使我的旨意暗昧不明？
verses.textEnNiv: "Who is this that obscures my plans with words without knowledge?
verses.textEnEsv: "Who is this that darkens counsel by words without knowledge?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Who is this who darkens counsel By words without knowledge?
verses.textEnNlt: "Who is this that questions my wisdom with such ignorant words?
verses.textEnNasb: "Who is this who darkens the divine plan By words without knowledge?
verses.textEn: "Who is this that obscures my plans with words without knowledge?

verses.textZh: 现在你要如勇士束腰， 我要问你，你要告诉我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你要如勇士束腰， 我要问你，你要告诉我。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要如勇士束腰； 我问你，你可以指示我。
verses.textEnNiv: Brace yourself like a man; I will question you, and you shall answer me.
verses.textEnEsv: Dress for action like a man; I will question you, and you make it known to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now prepare yourself like a man; I will question you, and you shall answer Me.
verses.textEnNlt: Brace yourself like a man, because I have some questions for you, and you must answer them.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now tighten the belt on your waist like a man, And I shall ask you, and you inform Me!
verses.textEn: Brace yourself like a man; I will question you, and you shall answer me.

verses.textZh: 我奠定大地根基的时候，你在哪里呢？ 你若有聪明，就只管说吧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我奠定大地根基的时候，你在哪里呢？ 你若有聪明，就只管说吧。
verses.textZhCuv: 我立大地根基的时候，你在哪里呢？ 你若有聪明，只管说吧！
verses.textEnNiv: "Where were you when I laid the earth’s foundation? Tell me, if you understand.
verses.textEnEsv: "Where were you when I laid the foundation of the earth? Tell me, if you have understanding.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Tell Me, if you have understanding.
verses.textEnNlt: "Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Tell me, if you know so much.
verses.textEnNasb: "Where were you when I laid the foundation of the earth? Tell Me, if you have understanding,
verses.textEn: "Where were you when I laid the earth’s foundation? Tell me, if you understand.

verses.textZh: 你一定晓得是谁定大地的尺度， 是谁把准绳拉在大地之上？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你一定晓得是谁定大地的尺度， 是谁把准绳拉在大地之上？
verses.textZhCuv: 你若晓得就说，是谁定地的尺度？ 是谁把准绳拉在其上？
verses.textEnNiv: Who marked off its dimensions? Surely you know! Who stretched a measuring line across it?
verses.textEnEsv: Who determined its measurements—surely you know! Or who stretched the line upon it?
verses.textEnNkjv: Who determined its measurements? Surely you know! Or who stretched the line upon it?
verses.textEnNlt: Who determined its dimensions and stretched out the surveying line?
verses.textEnNasb: Who set its measurements? Since you know. Or who stretched the measuring line over it?
verses.textEn: Who marked off its dimensions? Surely you know! Who stretched a measuring line across it?

verses.textZh: 地的基础奠在哪里， 地的角石是谁安放的？
verses.textZhCnvs: 地的基础奠在哪里， 地的角石是谁安放的？
verses.textZhCuv: 地的根基安置在何处？ 地的角石是谁安放的？
verses.textEnNiv: On what were its footings set, or who laid its cornerstone—
verses.textEnEsv: On what were its bases sunk, or who laid its cornerstone,
verses.textEnNkjv: To what were its foundations fastened? Or who laid its cornerstone,
verses.textEnNlt: What supports its foundations, and who laid its cornerstone
verses.textEnNasb: "On what were its bases sunk? Or who laid its cornerstone,
verses.textEn: On what were its footings set, or who laid its cornerstone—

verses.textZh: 那时晨星一起歌唱，神的众子也都欢呼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时晨星一起歌唱，神的众子也都欢呼。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，晨星一同歌唱；神的众子也都欢呼。
verses.textEnNiv: while the morning stars sang together and all the angels shouted for joy?
verses.textEnEsv: when the morning stars sang together and all the sons of God shouted for joy?
verses.textEnNkjv: When the morning stars sang together, And all the sons of God shouted for joy?
verses.textEnNlt: as the morning stars sang together and all the angels shouted for joy?
verses.textEnNasb: When the morning stars sang together And all the sons of God shouted for joy?
verses.textEn: while the morning stars sang together and all the angels shouted for joy?

verses.textZh: 海水冲出如婴孩出母胎， 那时谁用门把海水关闭呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 海水冲出如婴孩出母胎， 那时谁用门把海水关闭呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 海水冲出，如出胎胞， 那时谁将它关闭呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "Who shut up the sea behind doors when it burst forth from the womb,
verses.textEnEsv: "Or who shut in the sea with doors when it burst out from the womb,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Or who shut in the sea with doors, When it burst forth and issued from the womb;
verses.textEnNlt: "Who kept the sea inside its boundaries as it burst from the womb,
verses.textEnNasb: "Or who enclosed the sea with doors When it went out from the womb, bursting forth;
verses.textEn: "Who shut up the sea behind doors when it burst forth from the womb,

verses.textZh: 是我以云彩当作海的衣服， 以幽暗当作包裹海的布；
verses.textZhCnvs: 是我以云彩当作海的衣服， 以幽暗当作包裹海的布；
verses.textZhCuv: 是我用云彩当海的衣服， 用幽暗当包裹它的布，
verses.textEnNiv: when I made the clouds its garment and wrapped it in thick darkness,
verses.textEnEsv: when I made clouds its garment and thick darkness its swaddling band,
verses.textEnNkjv: When I made the clouds its garment, And thick darkness its swaddling band;
verses.textEnNlt: and as I clothed it with clouds and wrapped it in thick darkness?
verses.textEnNasb: When I made a cloud its garment, And thick darkness its swaddling bands,
verses.textEn: when I made the clouds its garment and wrapped it in thick darkness,

verses.textZh: 我为海定界限， 又安置门闩和门户，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我为海定界限， 又安置门闩和门户，
verses.textZhCuv: 为它定界限， 又安门和闩，
verses.textEnNiv: when I fixed limits for it and set its doors and bars in place,
verses.textEnEsv: and prescribed limits for it and set bars and doors,
verses.textEnNkjv: When I fixed My limit for it, And set bars and doors;
verses.textEnNlt: For I locked it behind barred gates, limiting its shores.
verses.textEnNasb: And I placed boundaries on it And set a bolt and doors,
verses.textEn: when I fixed limits for it and set its doors and bars in place,

verses.textZh: 说：‘你只可到这里，不可越过， 你狂傲的波浪要在这里止住。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 说：‘你只可到这里，不可越过， 你狂傲的波浪要在这里止住。’
verses.textZhCuv: 说：你只可到这里，不可越过； 你狂傲的浪要到此止住。
verses.textEnNiv: when I said, ‘This far you may come and no farther; here is where your proud waves halt’?
verses.textEnEsv: and said, ‘Thus far shall you come, and no farther, and here shall your proud waves be stayed’?
verses.textEnNkjv: When I said, ‘This far you may come, but no farther, And here your proud waves must stop!’
verses.textEnNlt: I said, ‘This far and no farther will you come. Here your proud waves must stop!’
verses.textEnNasb: And I said, ‘As far as this point you shall come, but no farther; And here your proud waves shall stop’?
verses.textEn: when I said, ‘This far you may come and no farther; here is where your proud waves halt’?

verses.textZh: 自你有生以来，你何曾吩咐过晨光照耀， 使黎明的曙光知道自己的本位，
verses.textZhCnvs: 自你有生以来，你何曾吩咐过晨光照耀， 使黎明的曙光知道自己的本位，
verses.textZhCuv: 你自生以来，曾命定晨光， 使清晨的日光知道本位，
verses.textEnNiv: "Have you ever given orders to the morning, or shown the dawn its place,
verses.textEnEsv: "Have you commanded the morning since your days began, and caused the dawn to know its place,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Have you commanded the morning since your days began, And caused the dawn to know its place,
verses.textEnNlt: "Have you ever commanded the morning to appear and caused the dawn to rise in the east?
verses.textEnNasb: "Have you ever in your life commanded the morning, And made the dawn know its place,
verses.textEn: "Have you ever given orders to the morning, or shown the dawn its place,

verses.textZh: 叫这光照遍大地的四极， 把恶人从那里抖掉呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 叫这光照遍大地的四极， 把恶人从那里抖掉呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 叫这光普照地的四极， 将恶人从其中驱逐出来吗？
verses.textEnNiv: that it might take the earth by the edges and shake the wicked out of it?
verses.textEnEsv: that it might take hold of the skirts of the earth, and the wicked be shaken out of it?
verses.textEnNkjv: That it might take hold of the ends of the earth, And the wicked be shaken out of it?
verses.textEnNlt: Have you made daylight spread to the ends of the earth, to bring an end to the night’s wickedness?
verses.textEnNasb: So that it would take hold of the ends of the earth, And the wicked would be shaken off from it?
verses.textEn: that it might take the earth by the edges and shake the wicked out of it?

verses.textZh: 因着这光，地面改变如在泥上盖上印， 万象显出如衣服一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因着这光，地面改变如在泥上盖上印， 万象显出如衣服一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 因这光，地面改变如泥上印印， 万物出现如衣服一样。
verses.textEnNiv: The earth takes shape like clay under a seal; its features stand out like those of a garment.
verses.textEnEsv: It is changed like clay under the seal, and its features stand out like a garment.
verses.textEnNkjv: It takes on form like clay under a seal, And stands out like a garment.
verses.textEnNlt: As the light approaches, the earth takes shape like clay pressed beneath a seal; it is robed in brilliant colors.
verses.textEnNasb: "It is changed like clay under the seal; And they stand out like a garment.
verses.textEn: The earth takes shape like clay under a seal; its features stand out like those of a garment.

verses.textZh: 恶人必得不到亮光， 高举的膀臂必被折断。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人必得不到亮光， 高举的膀臂必被折断。
verses.textZhCuv: 亮光不照恶人； 强横的膀臂也必折断。
verses.textEnNiv: The wicked are denied their light, and their upraised arm is broken.
verses.textEnEsv: From the wicked their light is withheld, and their uplifted arm is broken.
verses.textEnNkjv: From the wicked their light is withheld, And the upraised arm is broken.
verses.textEnNlt: The light disturbs the wicked and stops the arm that is raised in violence.
verses.textEnNasb: "Their light is withheld from the wicked, And the uplifted arm is broken.
verses.textEn: The wicked are denied their light, and their upraised arm is broken.

verses.textZh: 你曾到过海的泉源， 在深渊的底处行走过吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你曾到过海的泉源， 在深渊的底处行走过吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你曾进到海源， 或在深渊的隐密处行走吗？
verses.textEnNiv: "Have you journeyed to the springs of the sea or walked in the recesses of the deep?
verses.textEnEsv: "Have you entered into the springs of the sea, or walked in the recesses of the deep?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Have you entered the springs of the sea? Or have you walked in search of the depths?
verses.textEnNlt: "Have you explored the springs from which the seas come? Have you explored their depths?
verses.textEnNasb: "Have you entered the springs of the sea, And walked in the depth of the ocean?
verses.textEn: "Have you journeyed to the springs of the sea or walked in the recesses of the deep?

verses.textZh: 死亡的门曾向你显露吗？ 死荫的门你曾见过吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 死亡的门曾向你显露吗？ 死荫的门你曾见过吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 死亡的门曾向你显露吗？ 死荫的门你曾见过吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Have the gates of death been shown to you? Have you seen the gates of the deepest darkness?
verses.textEnEsv: Have the gates of death been revealed to you, or have you seen the gates of deep darkness?
verses.textEnNkjv: Have the gates of death been revealed to you? Or have you seen the doors of the shadow of death?
verses.textEnNlt: Do you know where the gates of death are located? Have you seen the gates of utter gloom?
verses.textEnNasb: "Have the gates of death been revealed to you, And have you seen the gates of deep darkness?
verses.textEn: Have the gates of death been shown to you? Have you seen the gates of the deepest darkness?

verses.textZh: 地的广阔，你明白吗？ 你若完全知道，就只管说吧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 地的广阔，你明白吗？ 你若完全知道，就只管说吧。
verses.textZhCuv: 地的广大你能明透吗？ 你若全知道，只管说吧！
verses.textEnNiv: Have you comprehended the vast expanses of the earth? Tell me, if you know all this.
verses.textEnEsv: Have you comprehended the expanse of the earth? Declare, if you know all this.
verses.textEnNkjv: Have you comprehended the breadth of the earth? Tell Me, if you know all this.
verses.textEnNlt: Do you realize the extent of the earth? Tell me about it if you know!
verses.textEnNasb: "Have you understood the expanse of the earth? Tell Me, if you know all this.
verses.textEn: Have you comprehended the vast expanses of the earth? Tell me, if you know all this.

verses.textZh: 哪条是到光明居所的道路？ 黑暗的本位在哪里？
verses.textZhCnvs: 哪条是到光明居所的道路？ 黑暗的本位在哪里？
verses.textZhCuv: 光明的居所从何而至？ 黑暗的本位在于何处？
verses.textEnNiv: "What is the way to the abode of light? And where does darkness reside?
verses.textEnEsv: "Where is the way to the dwelling of light, and where is the place of darkness,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Where is the way to the dwelling of light? And darkness, where is its place,
verses.textEnNlt: "Where does light come from, and where does darkness go?
verses.textEnNasb: "Where is the way to the dwelling of light? And darkness, where is its place,
verses.textEn: "What is the way to the abode of light? And where does darkness reside?

verses.textZh: 你能把光与暗带到它们的境地吗？ 你晓得通到它们居所的路吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你能把光与暗带到它们的境地吗？ 你晓得通到它们居所的路吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你能带到本境， 能看明其室之路吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Can you take them to their places? Do you know the paths to their dwellings?
verses.textEnEsv: that you may take it to its territory and that you may discern the paths to its home?
verses.textEnNkjv: That you may take it to its territory, That you may know the paths to its home?
verses.textEnNlt: Can you take each to its home? Do you know how to get there?
verses.textEnNasb: That you would take it to its territory, And discern the paths to its home?
verses.textEn: Can you take them to their places? Do you know the paths to their dwellings?

verses.textZh: 你是知道的，因为那时你已经出生了， 你一生的日数也很多。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你是知道的，因为那时你已经出生了， 你一生的日数也很多。
verses.textZhCuv: 你总知道， 因为你早已生在世上， 你日子的数目也多。
verses.textEnNiv: Surely you know, for you were already born! You have lived so many years!
verses.textEnEsv: You know, for you were born then, and the number of your days is great!
verses.textEnNkjv: Do you know it, because you were born then, Or because the number of your days is great?
verses.textEnNlt: But of course you know all this! For you were born before it was all created, and you are so very experienced!
verses.textEnNasb: "You know, for you were born then, And the number of your days is great!
verses.textEn: Surely you know, for you were already born! You have lived so many years!

verses.textZh: 你曾入过雪库， 或见过雹仓吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你曾入过雪库， 或见过雹仓吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你曾进入雪库， 或见过雹仓吗？
verses.textEnNiv: "Have you entered the storehouses of the snow or seen the storehouses of the hail,
verses.textEnEsv: "Have you entered the storehouses of the snow, or have you seen the storehouses of the hail,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Have you entered the treasury of snow, Or have you seen the treasury of hail,
verses.textEnNlt: "Have you visited the storehouses of the snow or seen the storehouses of hail?
verses.textEnNasb: "Have you entered the storehouses of the snow, And have you seen the storehouses of the hail,
verses.textEn: "Have you entered the storehouses of the snow or seen the storehouses of the hail,

verses.textZh: 这些雪雹是我为降患难的时候， 为打仗和争战的日子所存留的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些雪雹是我为降患难的时候， 为打仗和争战的日子所存留的。
verses.textZhCuv: 这雪雹乃是我为降灾， 并打仗和争战的日子所预备的。
verses.textEnNiv: which I reserve for times of trouble, for days of war and battle?
verses.textEnEsv: which I have reserved for the time of trouble, for the day of battle and war?
verses.textEnNkjv: Which I have reserved for the time of trouble, For the day of battle and war?
verses.textEnNlt: (I have reserved them as weapons for the time of trouble, for the day of battle and war.)
verses.textEnNasb: Which I have reserved for a time of distress, For a day of war and battle?
verses.textEn: which I reserve for times of trouble, for days of war and battle?

verses.textZh: 光从哪条路散开， 东风从哪里分散在地上？
verses.textZhCnvs: 光从哪条路散开， 东风从哪里分散在地上？
verses.textZhCuv: 光亮从何路分开？ 东风从何路分散遍地？
verses.textEnNiv: What is the way to the place where the lightning is dispersed, or the place where the east winds are scattered over the earth?
verses.textEnEsv: What is the way to the place where the light is distributed, or where the east wind is scattered upon the earth?
verses.textEnNkjv: By what way is light diffused, Or the east wind scattered over the earth?
verses.textEnNlt: Where is the path to the source of light? Where is the home of the east wind?
verses.textEnNasb: "Where is the way that the light is divided, And the east wind scattered on the earth?
verses.textEn: What is the way to the place where the lightning is dispersed, or the place where the east winds are scattered over the earth?

verses.textZh: 谁为大雨分水道， 谁为雷电定道路？
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁为大雨分水道， 谁为雷电定道路？
verses.textZhCuv: 谁为雨水分道？ 谁为雷电开路？
verses.textEnNiv: Who cuts a channel for the torrents of rain, and a path for the thunderstorm,
verses.textEnEsv: "Who has cleft a channel for the torrents of rain and a way for the thunderbolt,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Who has divided a channel for the overflowing water, Or a path for the thunderbolt,
verses.textEnNlt: "Who created a channel for the torrents of rain? Who laid out the path for the lightning?
verses.textEnNasb: "Who has split open a channel for the flood, And a way for the thunderbolt,
verses.textEn: Who cuts a channel for the torrents of rain, and a path for the thunderstorm,

verses.textZh: 使雨降在无人之地， 落在无人居住的旷野，
verses.textZhCnvs: 使雨降在无人之地， 落在无人居住的旷野，
verses.textZhCuv: 使雨降在无人之地、 无人居住的旷野？
verses.textEnNiv: to water a land where no one lives, an uninhabited desert,
verses.textEnEsv: to bring rain on a land where no man is, on the desert in which there is no man,
verses.textEnNkjv: To cause it to rain on a land wherethereis no one, A wilderness in which thereis no man;
verses.textEnNlt: Who makes the rain fall on barren land, in a desert where no one lives?
verses.textEnNasb: To bring rain on a land without people, On a desert without a person in it,
verses.textEn: to water a land where no one lives, an uninhabited desert,

verses.textZh: 使荒废之地得着滋润， 使青草在干旱之地得以长起来呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 使荒废之地得着滋润， 使青草在干旱之地得以长起来呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 使荒废凄凉之地得以丰足， 青草得以发生？
verses.textEnNiv: to satisfy a desolate wasteland and make it sprout with grass?
verses.textEnEsv: to satisfy the waste and desolate land, and to make the ground sprout with grass?
verses.textEnNkjv: To satisfy the desolate waste, And cause to spring forth the growth of tender grass?
verses.textEnNlt: Who sends rain to satisfy the parched ground and make the tender grass spring up?
verses.textEnNasb: To satisfy the waste and desolate land, And to make the seeds of grass to sprout?
verses.textEn: to satisfy a desolate wasteland and make it sprout with grass?

verses.textZh: 雨有父亲吗？ 露珠是谁生的呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 雨有父亲吗？ 露珠是谁生的呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 雨有父吗？ 露水珠是谁生的呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Does the rain have a father? Who fathers the drops of dew?
verses.textEnEsv: "Has the rain a father, or who has begotten the drops of dew?
verses.textEnNkjv: Has the rain a father? Or who has begotten the drops of dew?
verses.textEnNlt: "Does the rain have a father? Who gives birth to the dew?
verses.textEnNasb: "Does the rain have a father? Or who has fathered the drops of dew?
verses.textEn: Does the rain have a father? Who fathers the drops of dew?

verses.textZh: 冰出自谁的胎？ 天上的霜是谁所生的呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 冰出自谁的胎？ 天上的霜是谁所生的呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 冰出于谁的胎？ 天上的霜是谁生的呢？
verses.textEnNiv: From whose womb comes the ice? Who gives birth to the frost from the heavens
verses.textEnEsv: From whose womb did the ice come forth, and who has given birth to the frost of heaven?
verses.textEnNkjv: From whose womb comes the ice? And the frost of heaven, who gives it birth?
verses.textEnNlt: Who is the mother of the ice? Who gives birth to the frost from the heavens?
verses.textEnNasb: "From whose womb has come the ice? And the frost of heaven, who has given it birth?
verses.textEn: From whose womb comes the ice? Who gives birth to the frost from the heavens

verses.textZh: 众水坚硬如石头， 深渊的表面冻结成冰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众水坚硬如石头， 深渊的表面冻结成冰。
verses.textZhCuv: 诸水坚硬 如石头； 深渊之面凝结成冰。
verses.textEnNiv: when the waters become hard as stone, when the surface of the deep is frozen?
verses.textEnEsv: The waters become hard like stone, and the face of the deep is frozen.
verses.textEnNkjv: The waters harden like stone, And the surface of the deep is frozen.
verses.textEnNlt: For the water turns to ice as hard as rock, and the surface of the water freezes.
verses.textEnNasb: "Water becomes hard like stone, And the surface of the deep is imprisoned.
verses.textEn: when the waters become hard as stone, when the surface of the deep is frozen?

verses.textZh: 你能系住昴星的结吗？ 你能解开参星的带吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你能系住昴星的结吗？ 你能解开参星的带吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你能系住昴星的结吗？ 能解开参星的带吗？
verses.textEnNiv: "Can you bind the chains of the Pleiades? Can you loosen Orion’s belt?
verses.textEnEsv: "Can you bind the chains of the Pleiades or loose the cords of Orion?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Can you bind the cluster of the Pleiades, Or loose the belt of Orion?
verses.textEnNlt: "Can you direct the movement of the stars— binding the cluster of the Pleiades or loosening the cords of Orion?
verses.textEnNasb: "Can you tie up the chains of the Pleiades, Or untie the cords of Orion?
verses.textEn: "Can you bind the chains of the Pleiades? Can you loosen Orion’s belt?

verses.textZh: 你能按时领出玛查鲁夫星系吗？ 你能引导北斗和随从它的众星吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你能按时领出玛查鲁夫星系吗？ 你能引导北斗和随从它的众星吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你能按时领出十二宫吗？ 能引导北斗和随它的众星 吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Can you bring forth the constellations in their seasons or lead out the Bear with its cubs?
verses.textEnEsv: Can you lead forth the Mazzaroth in their season, or can you guide the Bear with its children?
verses.textEnNkjv: Can you bring out Mazzaroth in its season? Or can you guide the Great Bear with its cubs?
verses.textEnNlt: Can you direct the constellations through the seasons or guide the Bear with her cubs across the heavens?
verses.textEnNasb: "Can you bring out a constellation in its season, And guide the Bear with her satellites?
verses.textEn: Can you bring forth the constellations in their seasons or lead out the Bear with its cubs?

verses.textZh: 你晓得天的定例吗？ 你能在地上建立天的权威吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你晓得天的定例吗？ 你能在地上建立天的权威吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你知道天的定例吗？ 能使地归在天的权下吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Do you know the laws of the heavens? Can you set up God’s dominion over the earth?
verses.textEnEsv: Do you know the ordinances of the heavens? Can you establish their rule on the earth?
verses.textEnNkjv: Do you know the ordinances of the heavens? Can you set their dominion over the earth?
verses.textEnNlt: Do you know the laws of the universe? Can you use them to regulate the earth?
verses.textEnNasb: "Do you know the ordinances of the heavens, Or do you establish their rule over the earth?
verses.textEn: Do you know the laws of the heavens? Can you set up God’s dominion over the earth?

verses.textZh: 你能向密云扬声吗？ 你能使洪水淹没你吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你能向密云扬声吗？ 你能使洪水淹没你吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你能向云彩扬起声来， 使倾盆的雨遮盖你吗？
verses.textEnNiv: "Can you raise your voice to the clouds and cover yourself with a flood of water?
verses.textEnEsv: "Can you lift up your voice to the clouds, that a flood of waters may cover you?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Can you lift up your voice to the clouds, That an abundance of water may cover you?
verses.textEnNlt: "Can you shout to the clouds and make it rain?
verses.textEnNasb: "Can you raise your voice to the clouds, So that an abundance of water will cover you?
verses.textEn: "Can you raise your voice to the clouds and cover yourself with a flood of water?

verses.textZh: 你能差派闪电，闪电就发出， 并且对你说：‘我们在这里’吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你能差派闪电，闪电就发出， 并且对你说：‘我们在这里’吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你能发出闪电，叫它行去， 使它对你说：我们在这里？
verses.textEnNiv: Do you send the lightning bolts on their way? Do they report to you, ‘Here we are’?
verses.textEnEsv: Can you send forth lightnings, that they may go and say to you, ‘Here we are’?
verses.textEnNkjv: Can you send out lightnings, that they may go, And say to you, ‘Here we are!’?
verses.textEnNlt: Can you make lightning appear and cause it to strike as you direct?
verses.textEnNasb: "Can you send flashes of lightning, so that they may go And say to you, ‘Here we are’?
verses.textEn: Do you send the lightning bolts on their way? Do they report to you, ‘Here we are’?

verses.textZh: 谁把智慧放在怀里， 或把聪明赐于人的心中？
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁把智慧放在怀里， 或把聪明赐于人的心中？
verses.textZhCuv: 谁将智慧放在怀中？ 谁将聪明赐于心内？
verses.textEnNiv: Who gives the ibis wisdom or gives the rooster understanding?
verses.textEnEsv: Who has put wisdom in the inward parts or given understanding to the mind?
verses.textEnNkjv: Who has put wisdom in the mind? Or who has given understanding to the heart?
verses.textEnNlt: Who gives intuition to the heart and instinct to the mind?
verses.textEnNasb: "Who has put wisdom in the innermost being, Or given understanding to the mind?
verses.textEn: Who gives the ibis wisdom or gives the rooster understanding?

verses.textZh: 尘土融合成团， 土块黏结在一起的时候，
verses.textZhCnvs: 尘土融合成团， 土块黏结在一起的时候，
verses.textZhCuv: 尘土聚集成团，土块紧紧结连； 那时，谁能倾倒天上的瓶呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Who has the wisdom to count the clouds? Who can tip over the water jars of the heavens
verses.textEnEsv: Who can number the clouds by wisdom? Or who can tilt the waterskins of the heavens,
verses.textEnNkjv: Who can number the clouds by wisdom? Or who can pour out the bottles of heaven,
verses.textEnNlt: Who is wise enough to count all the clouds? Who can tilt the water jars of heaven
verses.textEnNasb: "Who can count the clouds by wisdom, And pour out the water jars of the heavens,
verses.textEn: Who has the wisdom to count the clouds? Who can tip over the water jars of the heavens

verses.textZh: 谁能凭智慧数算云天呢？ 谁能把天上的水袋倾倒呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁能凭智慧数算云天呢？ 谁能把天上的水袋倾倒呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 少壮狮子在隐密处埋伏； 你能为它们抓取食物， 使它们饱足吗？
verses.textEnNiv: when the dust becomes hard and the clods of earth stick together?
verses.textEnEsv: when the dust runs into a mass and the clods stick fast together?
verses.textEnNkjv: When the dust hardens in clumps, And the clods cling together?
verses.textEnNlt: when the parched ground is dry and the soil has hardened into clods?
verses.textEnNasb: When the dust hardens into a mass And the clods stick together?
verses.textEn: when the dust becomes hard and the clods of earth stick together?

verses.textZh: 狮子在洞中蹲伏， 在藏身之处躺卧埋伏的时候，
verses.textZhCnvs: 狮子在洞中蹲伏， 在藏身之处躺卧埋伏的时候，
verses.textZhCuv: 乌鸦之雏因无食物飞来飞去，哀告神； 那时，谁为它预备食物呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "Do you hunt the prey for the lioness and satisfy the hunger of the lions
verses.textEnEsv: "Can you hunt the prey for the lion, or satisfy the appetite of the young lions,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Can you hunt the prey for the lion, Or satisfy the appetite of the young lions,
verses.textEnNlt: "Can you stalk prey for a lioness and satisfy the young lions’ appetites
verses.textEnNasb: "Can you hunt the prey for the lioness, Or satisfy the appetite of young lions,
verses.textEn: "Do you hunt the prey for the lioness and satisfy the hunger of the lions

verses.textZh: 你能为母狮猎取食物吗？ 你能使食欲饱足吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你能为母狮猎取食物吗？ 你能使食欲饱足吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你能为母狮猎取食物吗？ 你能使食欲饱足吗？
verses.textEnNiv: when they crouch in their dens or lie in wait in a thicket?
verses.textEnEsv: when they crouch in their dens or lie in wait in their thicket?
verses.textEnNkjv: When they crouch in their dens, Or lurk in their lairs to lie in wait?
verses.textEnNlt: as they lie in their dens or crouch in the thicket?
verses.textEnNasb: When they crouch in their hiding places, And lie in wait in their lair?
verses.textEn: when they crouch in their dens or lie in wait in a thicket?

verses.textZh: 乌鸦雏鸟因缺乏食物飞来飞去， 向神哀求的时候， 谁为乌鸦预备食物呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 乌鸦雏鸟因缺乏食物飞来飞去， 向神哀求的时候， 谁为乌鸦预备食物呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 乌鸦雏鸟因缺乏食物飞来飞去， 向神哀求的时候， 谁为乌鸦预备食物呢？"
verses.textEnNiv: Who provides food for the raven when its young cry out to God and wander about for lack of food?
verses.textEnEsv: Who provides for the raven its prey, when its young ones cry to God for help, and wander about for lack of food?
verses.textEnNkjv: Who provides food for the raven, When its young ones cry to God, And wander about for lack of food?
verses.textEnNlt: Who provides food for the ravens when their young cry out to God and wander about in hunger?
verses.textEnNasb: "Who prepares feed for the raven When its young cry to God, And wander about without food?
verses.textEn: Who provides food for the raven when its young cry out to God and wander about for lack of food?

verses.textZh: "山岩间的野山羊的产期你能晓得吗？ 母鹿下犊之期你能察出吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: "山岩间的野山羊的产期你能晓得吗？ 母鹿下犊之期你能察出吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 山岩间的野山羊几时生产，你知道吗？ 母鹿下犊之期，你能察定吗？
verses.textEnNiv: "Do you know when the mountain goats give birth? Do you watch when the doe bears her fawn?
verses.textEnEsv: "Do you know when the mountain goats give birth? Do you observe the calving of the does?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Do you know the time when the wild mountain goats bear young? Or can you mark when the deer gives birth?
verses.textEnNlt: "Do you know when the wild goats give birth? Have you watched as deer are born in the wild?
verses.textEnNasb: "Do you know the time the mountain goats give birth? Do you observe the calving of the deer?
verses.textEn: "Do you know when the mountain goats give birth? Do you watch when the doe bears her fawn?

verses.textZh: 牠们怀胎的月数你能计算吗？ 牠们生产的日期你能晓得吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠们怀胎的月数你能计算吗？ 牠们生产的日期你能晓得吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 它们怀胎的月数，你能数算吗？ 它们几时生产，你能晓得吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Do you count the months till they bear? Do you know the time they give birth?
verses.textEnEsv: Can you number the months that they fulfill, and do you know the time when they give birth,
verses.textEnNkjv: Can you number the months that they fulfill? Or do you know the time when they bear young?
verses.textEnNlt: Do you know how many months they carry their young? Are you aware of the time of their delivery?
verses.textEnNasb: "Can you count the months they fulfill, Or do you know the time they give birth?
verses.textEn: Do you count the months till they bear? Do you know the time they give birth?

verses.textZh: 牠们屈身，把子产下， 就除掉生产的疼痛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠们屈身，把子产下， 就除掉生产的疼痛。
verses.textZhCuv: 它们屈身，将子生下， 就除掉疼痛。
verses.textEnNiv: They crouch down and bring forth their young; their labor pains are ended.
verses.textEnEsv: when they crouch, bring forth their offspring, and are delivered of their young?
verses.textEnNkjv: They bow down, They bring forth their young, They deliver their offspring.
verses.textEnNlt: They crouch down to give birth to their young and deliver their offspring.
verses.textEnNasb: "They kneel down, they deliver their young, They get rid of their labor pains.
verses.textEn: They crouch down and bring forth their young; their labor pains are ended.

verses.textZh: 幼雏渐渐健壮，在荒野长大， 牠们一离群出去，就不再返回。
verses.textZhCnvs: 幼雏渐渐健壮，在荒野长大， 牠们一离群出去，就不再返回。
verses.textZhCuv: 这子渐渐肥壮，在荒野长大， 去而不回。
verses.textEnNiv: Their young thrive and grow strong in the wilds; they leave and do not return.
verses.textEnEsv: Their young ones become strong; they grow up in the open; they go out and do not return to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their young ones are healthy, They grow strong with grain; They depart and do not return to them.
verses.textEnNlt: Their young grow up in the open fields, then leave home and never return.
verses.textEnNasb: "Their offspring become strong, they grow up in the open field; They leave and do not return to them.
verses.textEn: Their young thrive and grow strong in the wilds; they leave and do not return.

verses.textZh: 谁放野驴自由出去呢？ 谁解开快驴的绳索呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁放野驴自由出去呢？ 谁解开快驴的绳索呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 谁放野驴出去自由？ 谁解开快驴的绳索？
verses.textEnNiv: "Who let the wild donkey go free? Who untied its ropes?
verses.textEnEsv: "Who has let the wild donkey go free? Who has loosed the bonds of the swift donkey,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Who set the wild donkey free? Who loosed the bonds of the onager,
verses.textEnNlt: "Who gives the wild donkey its freedom? Who untied its ropes?
verses.textEnNasb: "Who sent the wild donkey out free? And who opened the bonds of the swift donkey,
verses.textEn: "Who let the wild donkey go free? Who untied its ropes?

verses.textZh: 我使原野作牠的家， 使咸地作牠的居所。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我使原野作牠的家， 使咸地作牠的居所。
verses.textZhCuv: 我使旷野作它的住处， 使咸地当它的居所。
verses.textEnNiv: I gave it the wasteland as its home, the salt flats as its habitat.
verses.textEnEsv: to whom I have given the arid plain for his home and the salt land for his dwelling place?
verses.textEnNkjv: Whose home I have made the wilderness, And the barren land his dwelling?
verses.textEnNlt: I have placed it in the wilderness; its home is the wasteland.
verses.textEnNasb: To whom I gave the wilderness as his home, And the salt land as his dwelling place?
verses.textEn: I gave it the wasteland as its home, the salt flats as its habitat.

verses.textZh: 牠嗤笑城里的喧哗， 不听赶野驴的呼喝声；
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠嗤笑城里的喧哗， 不听赶野驴的呼喝声；
verses.textZhCuv: 它嗤笑城内的喧嚷， 不听赶牲口的喝声。
verses.textEnNiv: It laughs at the commotion in the town; it does not hear a driver’s shout.
verses.textEnEsv: He scorns the tumult of the city; he hears not the shouts of the driver.
verses.textEnNkjv: He scorns the tumult of the city; He does not heed the shouts of the driver.
verses.textEnNlt: It hates the noise of the city and has no driver to shout at it.
verses.textEnNasb: "He laughs at the turmoil of the city, He does not hear the shouting of the taskmaster.
verses.textEn: It laughs at the commotion in the town; it does not hear a driver’s shout.

verses.textZh: 牠探索群山作牠的草场， 寻觅各样青绿的东西。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠探索群山作牠的草场， 寻觅各样青绿的东西。
verses.textZhCuv: 遍山是它的草场； 它寻找各样青绿之物。
verses.textEnNiv: It ranges the hills for its pasture and searches for any green thing.
verses.textEnEsv: He ranges the mountains as his pasture, and he searches after every green thing.
verses.textEnNkjv: The range of the mountains is his pasture, And he searches after every green thing.
verses.textEnNlt: The mountains are its pastureland, where it searches for every blade of grass.
verses.textEnNasb: "He explores the mountains of his pasture, And searches after every green thing.
verses.textEn: It ranges the hills for its pasture and searches for any green thing.

verses.textZh: 野牛怎肯作你的仆人， 或在你的槽旁过夜呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 野牛怎肯作你的仆人， 或在你的槽旁过夜呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 野牛岂肯服事你？ 岂肯住在你的槽旁？
verses.textEnNiv: "Will the wild ox consent to serve you? Will it stay by your manger at night?
verses.textEnEsv: "Is the wild ox willing to serve you? Will he spend the night at your manger?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Will the wild ox be willing to serve you? Will he bed by your manger?
verses.textEnNlt: "Will the wild ox consent to being tamed? Will it spend the night in your stall?
verses.textEnNasb: "Will the wild bull be willing to serve you, Or will he spend the night at your feeding trough?
verses.textEn: "Will the wild ox consent to serve you? Will it stay by your manger at night?

verses.textZh: 你怎能用套绳把野牛系在犁沟呢？ 牠怎肯跟着你耙山谷之地呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你怎能用套绳把野牛系在犁沟呢？ 牠怎肯跟着你耙山谷之地呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你岂能用套绳将野牛笼在犁沟之间？ 它岂肯随你耙山谷之地？
verses.textEnNiv: Can you hold it to the furrow with a harness? Will it till the valleys behind you?
verses.textEnEsv: Can you bind him in the furrow with ropes, or will he harrow the valleys after you?
verses.textEnNkjv: Can you bind the wild ox in the furrow with ropes? Or will he plow the valleys behind you?
verses.textEnNlt: Can you hitch a wild ox to a plow? Will it plow a field for you?
verses.textEnNasb: "Can you tie down the wild bull in a furrow with ropes, Or will he plow the valleys after you?
verses.textEn: Can you hold it to the furrow with a harness? Will it till the valleys behind you?

verses.textZh: 你怎能因牠的力大就倚赖牠？ 怎能把你所作的交给牠作呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你怎能因牠的力大就倚赖牠？ 怎能把你所作的交给牠作呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 岂可因它的力大就倚靠它？ 岂可把你的工交给它做吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Will you rely on it for its great strength? Will you leave your heavy work to it?
verses.textEnEsv: Will you depend on him because his strength is great, and will you leave to him your labor?
verses.textEnNkjv: Will you trust him because his strength is great? Or will you leave your labor to him?
verses.textEnNlt: Given its strength, can you trust it? Can you leave and trust the ox to do your work?
verses.textEnNasb: "Will you trust him because his strength is great, And leave your labor to him?
verses.textEn: Will you rely on it for its great strength? Will you leave your heavy work to it?

verses.textZh: 怎能信任牠能把你的粮食运回来； 又收聚你禾场上的谷粒呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 怎能信任牠能把你的粮食运回来； 又收聚你禾场上的谷粒呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 岂可信靠它把你的粮食运到家， 又收聚你禾场上的谷吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Can you trust it to haul in your grain and bring it to your threshing floor?
verses.textEnEsv: Do you have faith in him that he will return your grain and gather it to your threshing floor?
verses.textEnNkjv: Will you trust him to bring home your grain, And gather it to your threshing floor?
verses.textEnNlt: Can you rely on it to bring home your grain and deliver it to your threshing floor?
verses.textEnNasb: "Will you have faith in him that he will return your grain And gather it from your threshing floor?
verses.textEn: Can you trust it to haul in your grain and bring it to your threshing floor?

verses.textZh: 鸵鸟的翅膀欣然鼓动， 但牠的翎毛和羽毛哪有慈爱呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 鸵鸟的翅膀欣然鼓动， 但牠的翎毛和羽毛哪有慈爱呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 鸵鸟的翅膀欢然搧展， 岂是显慈爱的翎毛和羽毛吗？
verses.textEnNiv: "The wings of the ostrich flap joyfully, though they cannot compare with the wings and feathers of the stork.
verses.textEnEsv: "The wings of the ostrich wave proudly, but are they the pinions and plumage of love?
verses.textEnNkjv: "The wings of the ostrich wave proudly, But are her wings and pinions likethe kindly stork’s?
verses.textEnNlt: "The ostrich flaps her wings grandly, but they are no match for the feathers of the stork.
verses.textEnNasb: "The wings of the ostrich flap joyously, With the pinion and feathers of love,
verses.textEn: "The wings of the ostrich flap joyfully, though they cannot compare with the wings and feathers of the stork.

verses.textZh: 牠把蛋都留在地上， 使它们在土里得温暖，
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠把蛋都留在地上， 使它们在土里得温暖，
verses.textZhCuv: 因它把蛋留在地上， 在尘土中使得温暖；
verses.textEnNiv: She lays her eggs on the ground and lets them warm in the sand,
verses.textEnEsv: For she leaves her eggs to the earth and lets them be warmed on the ground,
verses.textEnNkjv: For she leaves her eggs on the ground, And warms them in the dust;
verses.textEnNlt: She lays her eggs on top of the earth, letting them be warmed in the dust.
