verses.textEnNasb: For she abandons her eggs to the earth And warms them in the dust,
verses.textEn: She lays her eggs on the ground and lets them warm in the sand,

verses.textZh: 牠却忘记了人的脚可以把蛋踩碎， 野地的走兽会把蛋践踏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠却忘记了人的脚可以把蛋踩碎， 野地的走兽会把蛋践踏。
verses.textZhCuv: 却想不到被脚踹碎， 或被野兽践踏。
verses.textEnNiv: unmindful that a foot may crush them, that some wild animal may trample them.
verses.textEnEsv: forgetting that a foot may crush them and that the wild beast may trample them.
verses.textEnNkjv: She forgets that a foot may crush them, Or that a wild beast may break them.
verses.textEnNlt: She doesn’t worry that a foot might crush them or a wild animal might destroy them.
verses.textEnNasb: And she forgets that a foot may crush them, Or that a wild animal may trample them.
verses.textEn: unmindful that a foot may crush them, that some wild animal may trample them.

verses.textZh: 牠苛待幼雏，看牠们好象不是自己生的， 就算牠的劳苦白费了，也漠不关心，
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠苛待幼雏，看牠们好象不是自己生的， 就算牠的劳苦白费了，也漠不关心，
verses.textZhCuv: 它忍心待雏，似乎不是自己的； 虽然徒受劳苦，也不为雏惧怕；
verses.textEnNiv: She treats her young harshly, as if they were not hers; she cares not that her labor was in vain,
verses.textEnEsv: She deals cruelly with her young, as if they were not hers; though her labor be in vain, yet she has no fear,
verses.textEnNkjv: She treats her young harshly, as though theywere not hers; Her labor is in vain, without concern,
verses.textEnNlt: She is harsh toward her young, as if they were not her own. She doesn’t care if they die.
verses.textEnNasb: "She treats her young cruelly, as if they were not hers; Though her labor is for nothing, she is unconcerned,
verses.textEn: She treats her young harshly, as if they were not hers; she cares not that her labor was in vain,

verses.textZh: 因为神使牠忘记了智慧， 也没有把聪明分给牠。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为神使牠忘记了智慧， 也没有把聪明分给牠。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为神使它没有智慧， 也未将悟性赐给它。
verses.textEnNiv: for God did not endow her with wisdom or give her a share of good sense.
verses.textEnEsv: because God has made her forget wisdom and given her no share in understanding.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because God deprived her of wisdom, And did not endow her with understanding.
verses.textEnNlt: For God has deprived her of wisdom. He has given her no understanding.
verses.textEnNasb: Because God has made her forget wisdom, And has not given her a share of understanding.
verses.textEn: for God did not endow her with wisdom or give her a share of good sense.

verses.textZh: 牠挺身鼓翼奔跑的时候， 就讥笑马和骑马的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠挺身鼓翼奔跑的时候， 就讥笑马和骑马的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 它几时挺身展开翅膀， 就嗤笑马和骑马的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet when she spreads her feathers to run, she laughs at horse and rider.
verses.textEnEsv: When she rouses herself to flee, she laughs at the horse and his rider.
verses.textEnNkjv: When she lifts herself on high, She scorns the horse and its rider.
verses.textEnNlt: But whenever she jumps up to run, she passes the swiftest horse with its rider.
verses.textEnNasb: "When she rushes away on high, She laughs at the horse and his rider.
verses.textEn: Yet when she spreads her feathers to run, she laughs at horse and rider.

verses.textZh: 马的大力是你所赐的吗？ 牠颈上的鬃毛是你披上的吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 马的大力是你所赐的吗？ 牠颈上的鬃毛是你披上的吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 马的大力是你所赐的吗？ 它颈项上挓挲的鬃是你给它披上的吗？
verses.textEnNiv: "Do you give the horse its strength or clothe its neck with a flowing mane?
verses.textEnEsv: "Do you give the horse his might? Do you clothe his neck with a mane?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Have you given the horse strength? Have you clothed his neck with thunder?
verses.textEnNlt: "Have you given the horse its strength or clothed its neck with a flowing mane?
verses.textEnNasb: "Do you give the horse his might? Do you clothe his neck with a mane?
verses.textEn: "Do you give the horse its strength or clothe its neck with a flowing mane?

verses.textZh: 是你使牠跳跃像蝗虫吗？ 牠喷气之威使人惊惶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 是你使牠跳跃像蝗虫吗？ 牠喷气之威使人惊惶。
verses.textZhCuv: 是你叫它跳跃像蝗虫吗？ 它喷气之威使人惊惶。
verses.textEnNiv: Do you make it leap like a locust, striking terror with its proud snorting?
verses.textEnEsv: Do you make him leap like the locust? His majestic snorting is terrifying.
verses.textEnNkjv: Can you frighten him like a locust? His majestic snorting strikes terror.
verses.textEnNlt: Did you give it the ability to leap like a locust? Its majestic snorting is terrifying!
verses.textEnNasb: "Do you make him leap like locusts? His majestic snorting is frightening.
verses.textEn: Do you make it leap like a locust, striking terror with its proud snorting?

verses.textZh: 牠在谷中扒地，以己力为乐， 牠出去迎战手持武器的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠在谷中扒地，以己力为乐， 牠出去迎战手持武器的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 它在谷中刨地，自喜其力； 它出去迎接佩带兵器的人。
verses.textEnNiv: It paws fiercely, rejoicing in its strength, and charges into the fray.
verses.textEnEsv: He paws in the valley and exults in his strength; he goes out to meet the weapons.
verses.textEnNkjv: He paws in the valley, and rejoices in his strength; He gallops into the clash of arms.
verses.textEnNlt: It paws the earth and rejoices in its strength when it charges out to battle.
verses.textEnNasb: " He paws in the valley, and rejoices in his strength; He goes out to meet the battle.
verses.textEn: It paws fiercely, rejoicing in its strength, and charges into the fray.

verses.textZh: 牠讥笑可怕的事，并不惊慌， 也不在刀剑的面前退缩。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠讥笑可怕的事，并不惊慌， 也不在刀剑的面前退缩。
verses.textZhCuv: 它嗤笑可怕的事并不惊惶， 也不因刀剑退回。
verses.textEnNiv: It laughs at fear, afraid of nothing; it does not shy away from the sword.
verses.textEnEsv: He laughs at fear and is not dismayed; he does not turn back from the sword.
verses.textEnNkjv: He mocks at fear, and is not frightened; Nor does he turn back from the sword.
verses.textEnNlt: It laughs at fear and is unafraid. It does not run from the sword.
verses.textEnNasb: "He laughs at fear and is not dismayed; And he does not turn back from the sword.
verses.textEn: It laughs at fear, afraid of nothing; it does not shy away from the sword.

verses.textZh: 箭袋、闪烁的矛与枪， 都在牠的身上铮铮有声。
verses.textZhCnvs: 箭袋、闪烁的矛与枪， 都在牠的身上铮铮有声。
verses.textZhCuv: 箭袋和发亮的枪， 并短枪在它身上铮铮有声。
verses.textEnNiv: The quiver rattles against its side, along with the flashing spear and lance.
verses.textEnEsv: Upon him rattle the quiver, the flashing spear, and the javelin.
verses.textEnNkjv: The quiver rattles against him, The glittering spear and javelin.
verses.textEnNlt: The arrows rattle against it, and the spear and javelin flash.
verses.textEnNasb: "The quiver rattles against him, The flashing spear and javelin.
verses.textEn: The quiver rattles against its side, along with the flashing spear and lance.

verses.textZh: 牠震抖激动，驰骋大地， 一听见角声，就不能站定。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠震抖激动，驰骋大地， 一听见角声，就不能站定。
verses.textZhCuv: 它发猛烈的怒气将地吞下； 一听角声就不耐站立。
verses.textEnNiv: In frenzied excitement it eats up the ground; it cannot stand still when the trumpet sounds.
verses.textEnEsv: With fierceness and rage he swallows the ground; he cannot stand still at the sound of the trumpet.
verses.textEnNkjv: He devours the distance with fierceness and rage; Nor does he come to a halt because the trumpet has sounded.
verses.textEnNlt: It paws the ground fiercely and rushes forward into battle when the ram’s horn blows.
verses.textEnNasb: "He races over the ground with a roar and fury, And he does not stand still when he hears the sound of the trumpet.
verses.textEn: In frenzied excitement it eats up the ground; it cannot stand still when the trumpet sounds.

verses.textZh: 角声一响，牠就说‘呵哈’， 牠从远处闻到战争的气味， 又听见军长的雷声和战争的吶喊。
verses.textZhCnvs: 角声一响，牠就说‘呵哈’， 牠从远处闻到战争的气味， 又听见军长的雷声和战争的吶喊。
verses.textZhCuv: 角每发声，它说呵哈； 它从远处闻着战气， 又听见军长大发雷声和兵丁呐喊。
verses.textEnNiv: At the blast of the trumpet it snorts, ‘Aha!’ It catches the scent of battle from afar, the shout of commanders and the battle cry.
verses.textEnEsv: When the trumpet sounds, he says ‘Aha!’ He smells the battle from afar, the thunder of the captains, and the shouting.
verses.textEnNkjv: At theblastof the trumpet he says, ‘Aha!’ He smells the battle from afar, The thunder of captains and shouting.
verses.textEnNlt: It snorts at the sound of the horn. It senses the battle in the distance. It quivers at the captain’s commands and the noise of battle.
verses.textEnNasb: "As often as the trumpet sounds he says, ‘Aha!’ And he senses the battle from afar, And the thunder of the captains and the war cry.
verses.textEn: At the blast of the trumpet it snorts, ‘Aha!’ It catches the scent of battle from afar, the shout of commanders and the battle cry.

verses.textZh: 鹰鸟飞翔，展翅南飞， 是因着你的聪明吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 鹰鸟飞翔，展翅南飞， 是因着你的聪明吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 鹰雀飞翔，展开翅膀一直向南， 岂是藉你的智慧吗？
verses.textEnNiv: "Does the hawk take flight by your wisdom and spread its wings toward the south?
verses.textEnEsv: "Is it by your understanding that the hawk soars and spreads his wings toward the south?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Does the hawk fly by your wisdom, And spread its wings toward the south?
verses.textEnNlt: "Is it your wisdom that makes the hawk soar and spread its wings toward the south?
verses.textEnNasb: "Is it by your understanding that the hawk soars, Stretching his wings toward the south?
verses.textEn: "Does the hawk take flight by your wisdom and spread its wings toward the south?

verses.textZh: 大鹰上腾，在高处筑巢， 是听你的吩咐吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 大鹰上腾，在高处筑巢， 是听你的吩咐吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 大鹰上腾在高处搭窝， 岂是听你的吩咐吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Does the eagle soar at your command and build its nest on high?
verses.textEnEsv: Is it at your command that the eagle mounts up and makes his nest on high?
verses.textEnNkjv: Does the eagle mount up at your command, And make its nest on high?
verses.textEnNlt: Is it at your command that the eagle rises to the heights to make its nest?
verses.textEnNasb: "Is it at your command that the eagle flies high, And makes his nest on high?
verses.textEn: Does the eagle soar at your command and build its nest on high?

verses.textZh: 牠住在山岩之上， 栖息在岩崖与坚固所在之上，
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠住在山岩之上， 栖息在岩崖与坚固所在之上，
verses.textZhCuv: 它住在山岩， 以山峰和坚固之所为家，
verses.textEnNiv: It dwells on a cliff and stays there at night; a rocky crag is its stronghold.
verses.textEnEsv: On the rock he dwells and makes his home, on the rocky crag and stronghold.
verses.textEnNkjv: On the rock it dwells and resides, On the crag of the rock and the stronghold.
verses.textEnNlt: It lives on the cliffs, making its home on a distant, rocky crag.
verses.textEnNasb: "He dwells and spends his nights on the cliff, On the rocky cliff, an inaccessible place.
verses.textEn: It dwells on a cliff and stays there at night; a rocky crag is its stronghold.

verses.textZh: 从那里窥看猎物， 牠们的眼睛可以从远处观望。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从那里窥看猎物， 牠们的眼睛可以从远处观望。
verses.textZhCuv: 从那里窥看食物， 眼睛远远观望。
verses.textEnNiv: From there it looks for food; its eyes detect it from afar.
verses.textEnEsv: From there he spies out the prey; his eyes behold it from far away.
verses.textEnNkjv: From there it spies out the prey; Its eyes observe from afar.
verses.textEnNlt: From there it hunts its prey, keeping watch with piercing eyes.
verses.textEnNasb: "From there he tracks food; His eyes look at it from afar.
verses.textEn: From there it looks for food; its eyes detect it from afar.

verses.textZh: 牠的幼雏也都吮血； 被杀的人在哪里，鹰也在哪里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠的幼雏也都吮血； 被杀的人在哪里，鹰也在哪里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 它的雏也咂血； 被杀的人在哪里，它也在那里。
verses.textEnNiv: Its young ones feast on blood, and where the slain are, there it is."
verses.textEnEsv: His young ones suck up blood, and where the slain are, there is he."
verses.textEnNkjv: Its young ones suck up blood; And where the slain are, there it is."
verses.textEnNlt: Its young gulp down blood. Where there’s a carcass, there you’ll find it."
verses.textEnNasb: "His young ones also lick up blood greedily; And where the slain are, there he is."
verses.textEn: Its young ones feast on blood, and where the slain are, there it is."

verses.textZh: 耶和华又对约伯说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华又对约伯说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华又对约伯说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Job:
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Job:
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover the Lord answered Job, and said:
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Job,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to Job,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Job:

verses.textZh: "挑剔是非的，怎能与全能者争辩呢？ 责备神的，回答这个问题吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "挑剔是非的，怎能与全能者争辩呢？ 责备神的，回答这个问题吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 强辩的岂可与全能者争论吗？ 与神辩驳的可以回答这些吧！
verses.textEnNiv: "Will the one who contends with the Almighty correct him? Let him who accuses God answer him!"
verses.textEnEsv: "Shall a faultfinder contend with the Almighty? He who argues with God, let him answer it."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Shall the one who contends with the Almighty correct Him? He who rebukes God, let him answer it."
verses.textEnNlt: "Do you still want to argue with the Almighty? You are God’s critic, but do you have the answers?"
verses.textEnNasb: "Will the faultfinder contend with the Almighty? Let him who rebukes God give an answer."
verses.textEn: "Will the one who contends with the Almighty correct him? Let him who accuses God answer him!"

verses.textZh: 于是约伯回答耶和华说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是约伯回答耶和华说：
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，约伯回答耶和华说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then Job answered the Lord :
verses.textEnEsv: Then Job answered the Lord and said:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Job answered the Lord and said:
verses.textEnNlt: Then Job replied to the Lord ,
verses.textEnNasb: Then Job answered the Lord and said,
verses.textEn: Then Job answered the Lord :

verses.textZh: "我是微小的，可以回答你甚么呢？ 我只好用手掩口。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我是微小的，可以回答你甚么呢？ 我只好用手掩口。
verses.textZhCuv: 我是卑贱的！我用什么回答你呢？ 只好用手捂口。
verses.textEnNiv: "I am unworthy—how can I reply to you? I put my hand over my mouth.
verses.textEnEsv: "Behold, I am of small account; what shall I answer you? I lay my hand on my mouth.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, I am vile; What shall I answer You? I lay my hand over my mouth.
verses.textEnNlt: "I am nothing—how could I ever find the answers? I will cover my mouth with my hand.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, I am insignificant; what can I say in response to You? I put my hand on my mouth.
verses.textEn: "I am unworthy—how can I reply to you? I put my hand over my mouth.

verses.textZh: 这说了一次，不再回答； 说了二次就不再说。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这说了一次，不再回答； 说了二次就不再说。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我说了一次，再不回答； 说了两次，就不再说。
verses.textEnNiv: I spoke once, but I have no answer— twice, but I will say no more."
verses.textEnEsv: I have spoken once, and I will not answer; twice, but I will proceed no further."
verses.textEnNkjv: Once I have spoken, but I will not answer; Yes, twice, but I will proceed no further."
verses.textEnNlt: I have said too much already. I have nothing more to say."
verses.textEnNasb: "I have spoken once, and I will not reply; Or twice, and I will add nothing more."
verses.textEn: I spoke once, but I have no answer— twice, but I will say no more."

verses.textZh: 于是耶和华从旋风中回答约伯说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶和华从旋风中回答约伯说：
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，耶和华从旋风中回答约伯说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord spoke to Job out of the storm:
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord answered Job out of the whirlwind and said:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said:
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord answered Job from the whirlwind:
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord answered Job from the whirlwind and said,
verses.textEn: Then the Lord spoke to Job out of the storm:

verses.textZh: "你要如勇士束腰， 我要问你，你要告诉我。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要如勇士束腰， 我要问你，你要告诉我。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要如勇士束腰； 我问你，你可以指示我。
verses.textEnNiv: "Brace yourself like a man; I will question you, and you shall answer me.
verses.textEnEsv: "Dress for action like a man; I will question you, and you make it known to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now prepare yourself like a man; I will question you, and you shall answer Me:
verses.textEnNlt: "Brace yourself like a man, because I have some questions for you, and you must answer them.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now tighten the belt on your waist like a man; I will ask you, and you instruct Me.
verses.textEn: "Brace yourself like a man; I will question you, and you shall answer me.

verses.textZh: 你怎能废弃我所审断的？ 怎能定我为有罪，好显出你自己为义呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你怎能废弃我所审断的？ 怎能定我为有罪，好显出你自己为义呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你岂可废弃我所拟定的？ 岂可定我有罪，好显自己为义吗？
verses.textEnNiv: "Would you discredit my justice? Would you condemn me to justify yourself?
verses.textEnEsv: Will you even put me in the wrong? Will you condemn me that you may be in the right?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Would you indeed annul My judgment? Would you condemn Me that you may be justified?
verses.textEnNlt: "Will you discredit my justice and condemn me just to prove you are right?
verses.textEnNasb: "Will you really nullify My judgment? Will you condemn Me so that you may be justified?
verses.textEn: "Would you discredit my justice? Would you condemn me to justify yourself?

verses.textZh: 你有神那样的膀臂吗？ 你能用他那样的声音打雷吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你有神那样的膀臂吗？ 你能用他那样的声音打雷吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你有神那样的膀臂吗？ 你能像他发雷声吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Do you have an arm like God’s, and can your voice thunder like his?
verses.textEnEsv: Have you an arm like God, and can you thunder with a voice like his?
verses.textEnNkjv: Have you an arm like God? Or can you thunder with a voice like His?
verses.textEnNlt: Are you as strong as God? Can you thunder with a voice like his?
verses.textEnNasb: "Or do you have an arm like God, And can you thunder with a voice like His?
verses.textEn: Do you have an arm like God’s, and can your voice thunder like his?

verses.textZh: 你当以庄严与尊贵为装饰， 以尊荣与威严为衣服。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你当以庄严与尊贵为装饰， 以尊荣与威严为衣服。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要以荣耀庄严为妆饰， 以尊荣威严为衣服；
verses.textEnNiv: Then adorn yourself with glory and splendor, and clothe yourself in honor and majesty.
verses.textEnEsv: "Adorn yourself with majesty and dignity; clothe yourself with glory and splendor.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then adorn yourself with majesty and splendor, And array yourself with glory and beauty.
verses.textEnNlt: All right, put on your glory and splendor, your honor and majesty.
verses.textEnNasb: "Adorn yourself with pride and dignity, And clothe yourself with honor and majesty.
verses.textEn: Then adorn yourself with glory and splendor, and clothe yourself in honor and majesty.

verses.textZh: 要倒尽你忿激的怒气， 观看所有骄傲的人，使他们降卑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要倒尽你忿激的怒气， 观看所有骄傲的人，使他们降卑。
verses.textZhCuv: 要发出你满溢的怒气， 见一切骄傲的人，使他降卑；
verses.textEnNiv: Unleash the fury of your wrath, look at all who are proud and bring them low,
verses.textEnEsv: Pour out the overflowings of your anger, and look on everyone who is proud and abase him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Disperse the rage of your wrath; Look on everyone whois proud, and humble him.
verses.textEnNlt: Give vent to your anger. Let it overflow against the proud.
verses.textEnNasb: "Let out your outbursts of anger, And look at everyone who is arrogant, and humble him.
verses.textEn: Unleash the fury of your wrath, look at all who are proud and bring them low,

verses.textZh: 观看所有骄傲的人，把他制伏， 把恶人践踏在他们的地方，
verses.textZhCnvs: 观看所有骄傲的人，把他制伏， 把恶人践踏在他们的地方，
verses.textZhCuv: 见一切骄傲的人，将他制伏， 把恶人践踏在本处；
verses.textEnNiv: look at all who are proud and humble them, crush the wicked where they stand.
verses.textEnEsv: Look on everyone who is proud and bring him low and tread down the wicked where they stand.
verses.textEnNkjv: Look on everyone whois proud, and bring him low; Tread down the wicked in their place.
verses.textEnNlt: Humiliate the proud with a glance; walk on the wicked where they stand.
verses.textEnNasb: "Look at everyone who is arrogant, and humble him, And trample down the wicked where they stand.
verses.textEn: look at all who are proud and humble them, crush the wicked where they stand.

verses.textZh: 把他们一起掩藏在尘土里， 把他们本人捆绑在隐密处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 把他们一起掩藏在尘土里， 把他们本人捆绑在隐密处。
verses.textZhCuv: 将他们一同隐藏在尘土中， 把他们的脸蒙蔽在隐密处；
verses.textEnNiv: Bury them all in the dust together; shroud their faces in the grave.
verses.textEnEsv: Hide them all in the dust together; bind their faces in the world below.
verses.textEnNkjv: Hide them in the dust together, Bind their faces in hidden darkness.
verses.textEnNlt: Bury them in the dust. Imprison them in the world of the dead.
verses.textEnNasb: "Hide them together in the dust; Imprison them in the hidden place.
verses.textEn: Bury them all in the dust together; shroud their faces in the grave.

verses.textZh: 这样，我就要向你承认， 你的右手能拯救你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，我就要向你承认， 你的右手能拯救你。
verses.textZhCuv: 我就认你右手能以救自己。
verses.textEnNiv: Then I myself will admit to you that your own right hand can save you.
verses.textEnEsv: Then will I also acknowledge to you that your own right hand can save you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I will also confess to you That your own right hand can save you.
verses.textEnNlt: Then even I would praise you, for your own strength would save you.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then I will also confess to you, That your own right hand can save you.
verses.textEn: Then I myself will admit to you that your own right hand can save you.

verses.textZh: 你看看河马吧， 我造牠像造你一样， 牠吃草如牛一般。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你看看河马吧， 我造牠像造你一样， 牠吃草如牛一般。
verses.textZhCuv: 你且观看河马； 我造你也造它。 它吃草与牛一样；
verses.textEnNiv: "Look at Behemoth, which I made along with you and which feeds on grass like an ox.
verses.textEnEsv: "Behold, Behemoth, which I made as I made you; he eats grass like an ox.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Look now at the behemoth, which I made along with you; He eats grass like an ox.
verses.textEnNlt: "Take a look at Behemoth, which I made, just as I made you. It eats grass like an ox.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, Behemoth, which I made as well as you; He eats grass like an ox.
verses.textEn: "Look at Behemoth, which I made along with you and which feeds on grass like an ox.

verses.textZh: 你看，牠的力量在腰间， 牠的能力在肚腹的肌肉上，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你看，牠的力量在腰间， 牠的能力在肚腹的肌肉上，
verses.textZhCuv: 它的气力在腰间， 能力在肚腹的筋上。
verses.textEnNiv: What strength it has in its loins, what power in the muscles of its belly!
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, his strength in his loins, and his power in the muscles of his belly.
verses.textEnNkjv: See now, his strength is in his hips, And his power is in his stomach muscles.
verses.textEnNlt: See its powerful loins and the muscles of its belly.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, his strength in his waist, And his power in the muscles of his belly.
verses.textEn: What strength it has in its loins, what power in the muscles of its belly!

verses.textZh: 牠挺直尾巴硬如香柏树， 牠大腿的筋虬结在一起，
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠挺直尾巴硬如香柏树， 牠大腿的筋虬结在一起，
verses.textZhCuv: 它摇动尾巴如香柏树； 它大腿的筋互相联络。
verses.textEnNiv: Its tail sways like a cedar; the sinews of its thighs are close-knit.
verses.textEnEsv: He makes his tail stiff like a cedar; the sinews of his thighs are knit together.
verses.textEnNkjv: He moves his tail like a cedar; The sinews of his thighs are tightly knit.
verses.textEnNlt: Its tail is as strong as a cedar. The sinews of its thighs are knit tightly together.
verses.textEnNasb: "He hangs his tail like a cedar; The tendons of his thighs are knit together.
verses.textEn: Its tail sways like a cedar; the sinews of its thighs are close-knit.

verses.textZh: 牠的骨头仿佛铜管， 牠的骨干好象铁棍。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠的骨头仿佛铜管， 牠的骨干好象铁棍。
verses.textZhCuv: 它的骨头好像铜管； 它的肢体仿佛铁棍。
verses.textEnNiv: Its bones are tubes of bronze, its limbs like rods of iron.
verses.textEnEsv: His bones are tubes of bronze, his limbs like bars of iron.
verses.textEnNkjv: His bones arelike beams of bronze, His ribs like bars of iron.
verses.textEnNlt: Its bones are tubes of bronze. Its limbs are bars of iron.
verses.textEnNasb: "His bones are tubes of bronze; His limbs are like bars of iron.
verses.textEn: Its bones are tubes of bronze, its limbs like rods of iron.

verses.textZh: 牠在神所造的事工中居首 ， 只有创造牠的能使刀剑临到牠身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠在神所造的事工中居首 ， 只有创造牠的能使刀剑临到牠身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 它在神所造的物中为首； 创造它的给它刀剑。
verses.textEnNiv: It ranks first among the works of God, yet its Maker can approach it with his sword.
verses.textEnEsv: "He is the first of the works of God; let him who made him bring near his sword!
verses.textEnNkjv: He is the first of the ways of God; Only He who made him can bring near His sword.
verses.textEnNlt: It is a prime example of God’s handiwork, and only its Creator can threaten it.
verses.textEnNasb: "He is the first of the ways of God; Let his Maker bring His sword near.
verses.textEn: It ranks first among the works of God, yet its Maker can approach it with his sword.

verses.textZh: 群山为牠生出食物， 田野的百兽都在那里玩耍。
verses.textZhCnvs: 群山为牠生出食物， 田野的百兽都在那里玩耍。
verses.textZhCuv: 诸山给它出食物， 也是百兽游玩之处。
verses.textEnNiv: The hills bring it their produce, and all the wild animals play nearby.
verses.textEnEsv: For the mountains yield food for him where all the wild beasts play.
verses.textEnNkjv: Surely the mountains yield food for him, And all the beasts of the field play there.
verses.textEnNlt: The mountains offer it their best food, where all the wild animals play.
verses.textEnNasb: "Indeed the mountains bring him food, And all the animals of the field play there.
verses.textEn: The hills bring it their produce, and all the wild animals play nearby.

verses.textZh: 牠躺在莲叶之下， 躺在芦苇丛中与泥泽之间；
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠躺在莲叶之下， 躺在芦苇丛中与泥泽之间；
verses.textZhCuv: 它伏在莲叶之下， 卧在芦苇隐密处和水洼子里。
verses.textEnNiv: Under the lotus plants it lies, hidden among the reeds in the marsh.
verses.textEnEsv: Under the lotus plants he lies, in the shelter of the reeds and in the marsh.
verses.textEnNkjv: He lies under the lotus trees, In a covert of reeds and marsh.
verses.textEnNlt: It lies under the lotus plants, hidden by the reeds in the marsh.
verses.textEnNasb: "He lies down under the lotus plants, In the hiding place of the reeds and the marsh.
verses.textEn: Under the lotus plants it lies, hidden among the reeds in the marsh.

verses.textZh: 莲叶的阴影遮蔽牠， 溪旁的白杨树环绕牠。
verses.textZhCnvs: 莲叶的阴影遮蔽牠， 溪旁的白杨树环绕牠。
verses.textZhCuv: 莲叶的阴凉遮蔽它； 溪旁的柳树环绕它。
verses.textEnNiv: The lotuses conceal it in their shadow; the poplars by the stream surround it.
verses.textEnEsv: For his shade the lotus trees cover him; the willows of the brook surround him.
verses.textEnNkjv: The lotus trees cover him with their shade; The willows by the brook surround him.
verses.textEnNlt: The lotus plants give it shade among the willows beside the stream.
verses.textEnNasb: "The lotus plants cover him with shade; The willows of the brook surround him.
verses.textEn: The lotuses conceal it in their shadow; the poplars by the stream surround it.

verses.textZh: 江河泛滥，牠毫不慌张， 约旦河的水涨到牠的口边，牠还是安然。
verses.textZhCnvs: 江河泛滥，牠毫不慌张， 约旦河的水涨到牠的口边，牠还是安然。
verses.textZhCuv: 河水氾滥，它不发战； 就是约旦河的水涨到它口边，也是安然。
verses.textEnNiv: A raging river does not alarm it; it is secure, though the Jordan should surge against its mouth.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, if the river is turbulent he is not frightened; he is confident though Jordan rushes against his mouth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed the river may rage, Yet he is not disturbed; He is confident, though the Jordan gushes into his mouth,
verses.textEnNlt: It is not disturbed by the raging river, not concerned when the swelling Jordan rushes around it.
verses.textEnNasb: "If a river rages, he is not alarmed; He is confident, though the Jordan rushes to his mouth.
verses.textEn: A raging river does not alarm it; it is secure, though the Jordan should surge against its mouth.

verses.textZh: 牠警觉的时候谁能捉拿牠？ 谁能用铁圈穿牠的鼻子呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠警觉的时候谁能捉拿牠？ 谁能用铁圈穿牠的鼻子呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 在它防备的时候，谁能捉拿它？ 谁能牢笼它穿它的鼻子呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Can anyone capture it by the eyes, or trap it and pierce its nose?
verses.textEnEsv: Can one take him by his eyes, or pierce his nose with a snare?
verses.textEnNkjv: Though he takes it in his eyes, Or one pierces his nose with a snare.
verses.textEnNlt: No one can catch it off guard or put a ring in its nose and lead it away.
verses.textEnNasb: "Can anyone capture him when he is on watch, Can anyone pierce his nose with barbs?
verses.textEn: Can anyone capture it by the eyes, or trap it and pierce its nose?

verses.textZh: "你能用鱼钩钓上鳄鱼吗？ 能用绳子把牠的舌头压下吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: "你能用鱼钩钓上鳄鱼吗？ 能用绳子把牠的舌头压下吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你能用鱼钩钓上鳄鱼吗？ 能用绳子压下它的舌头吗？
verses.textEnNiv: "Can you pull in Leviathan with a fishhook or tie down its tongue with a rope?
verses.textEnEsv: "Can you draw out Leviathan with a fishhook or press down his tongue with a cord?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Can you draw out Leviathan with a hook, Or snare his tongue with a line which you lower?
verses.textEnNlt: "Can you catch Leviathan with a hook or put a noose around its jaw?
verses.textEnNasb: " Can you drag out Leviathan with a fishhook, And press down his tongue with a rope?
verses.textEn: "Can you pull in Leviathan with a fishhook or tie down its tongue with a rope?

verses.textZh: 能把草绳穿进牠的鼻子吗？ 能用刺钩穿透牠的腮骨吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 能把草绳穿进牠的鼻子吗？ 能用刺钩穿透牠的腮骨吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你能用绳索穿它的鼻子吗？ 能用钩穿它的腮骨吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Can you put a cord through its nose or pierce its jaw with a hook?
verses.textEnEsv: Can you put a rope in his nose or pierce his jaw with a hook?
verses.textEnNkjv: Can you put a reed through his nose, Or pierce his jaw with a hook?
verses.textEnNlt: Can you tie it with a rope through the nose or pierce its jaw with a spike?
verses.textEnNasb: "Can you put a rope in his nose, And pierce his jaw with a hook?
verses.textEn: Can you put a cord through its nose or pierce its jaw with a hook?

verses.textZh: 牠会向你再三恳求， 对你说温柔的话吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠会向你再三恳求， 对你说温柔的话吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 它岂向你连连恳求， 说柔和的话吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Will it keep begging you for mercy? Will it speak to you with gentle words?
verses.textEnEsv: Will he make many pleas to you? Will he speak to you soft words?
verses.textEnNkjv: Will he make many supplications to you? Will he speak softly to you?
verses.textEnNlt: Will it beg you for mercy or implore you for pity?
verses.textEnNasb: "Will he make many pleas to you, Or will he speak to you gentle words?
verses.textEn: Will it keep begging you for mercy? Will it speak to you with gentle words?

verses.textZh: 牠肯与你立约， 好使你永远奴役牠吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠肯与你立约， 好使你永远奴役牠吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 岂肯与你立约， 使你拿它永远作奴仆吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Will it make an agreement with you for you to take it as your slave for life?
verses.textEnEsv: Will he make a covenant with you to take him for your servant forever?
verses.textEnNkjv: Will he make a covenant with you? Will you take him as a servant forever?
verses.textEnNlt: Will it agree to work for you, to be your slave for life?
verses.textEnNasb: "Will he make a covenant with you? Will you take him as a servant forever?
verses.textEn: Will it make an agreement with you for you to take it as your slave for life?

verses.textZh: 你怎能玩弄牠，像玩弄雀鸟一样呢？ 怎能把牠拴住，给你的幼女取乐呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你怎能玩弄牠，像玩弄雀鸟一样呢？ 怎能把牠拴住，给你的幼女取乐呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你岂可拿它当雀鸟玩耍吗？ 岂可为你的幼女将它拴住吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Can you make a pet of it like a bird or put it on a leash for the young women in your house?
verses.textEnEsv: Will you play with him as with a bird, or will you put him on a leash for your girls?
verses.textEnNkjv: Will you play with him as with a bird, Or will you leash him for your maidens?
verses.textEnNlt: Can you make it a pet like a bird, or give it to your little girls to play with?
verses.textEnNasb: "Will you play with him as with a bird, And tie him down for your young girls?
verses.textEn: Can you make a pet of it like a bird or put it on a leash for the young women in your house?

verses.textZh: 结伙的渔夫怎能拿牠当货物买卖呢？ 怎能把牠分给商人呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 结伙的渔夫怎能拿牠当货物买卖呢？ 怎能把牠分给商人呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 搭伙的渔夫岂可拿它当货物吗？ 能把它分给商人吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Will traders barter for it? Will they divide it up among the merchants?
verses.textEnEsv: Will traders bargain over him? Will they divide him up among the merchants?
verses.textEnNkjv: Will your companions make a banquet of him? Will they apportion him among the merchants?
verses.textEnNlt: Will merchants try to buy it to sell it in their shops?
verses.textEnNasb: "Will the traders bargain for him? Will they divide him among the merchants?
verses.textEn: Will traders barter for it? Will they divide it up among the merchants?

verses.textZh: 你能用倒钩扎满牠的皮吗？ 能用鱼叉扎满牠的头吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你能用倒钩扎满牠的皮吗？ 能用鱼叉扎满牠的头吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你能用倒钩枪扎满它的皮， 能用鱼叉叉满它的头吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Can you fill its hide with harpoons or its head with fishing spears?
verses.textEnEsv: Can you fill his skin with harpoons or his head with fishing spears?
verses.textEnNkjv: Can you fill his skin with harpoons, Or his head with fishing spears?
verses.textEnNlt: Will its hide be hurt by spears or its head by a harpoon?
verses.textEnNasb: "Can you fill his skin with harpoons, Or his head with fishing spears?
verses.textEn: Can you fill its hide with harpoons or its head with fishing spears?

verses.textZh: 你把手按在牠身上， 想到与牠的战斗，你就不再是这样作了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你把手按在牠身上， 想到与牠的战斗，你就不再是这样作了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你按手在它身上，想与它争战， 就不再这样行吧！
verses.textEnNiv: If you lay a hand on it, you will remember the struggle and never do it again!
verses.textEnEsv: Lay your hands on him; remember the battle—you will not do it again!
verses.textEnNkjv: Lay your hand on him; Remember the battle— Never do it again!
verses.textEnNlt: If you lay a hand on it, you will certainly remember the battle that follows. You won’t try that again!
verses.textEnNasb: "Lay your hand on him. Remember the battle; you will not do it again!
verses.textEn: If you lay a hand on it, you will remember the struggle and never do it again!

verses.textZh: 人希望捉住牠是徒然的， 人一见牠，就心惊胆战。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人希望捉住牠是徒然的， 人一见牠，就心惊胆战。
verses.textZhCuv: 人指望捉拿它是徒然的； 一见它，岂不丧胆吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Any hope of subduing it is false; the mere sight of it is overpowering.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, the hope of a man is false; he is laid low even at the sight of him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed, any hope of overcoming him is false; Shall onenot be overwhelmed at the sight of him?
verses.textEnNlt: No, it is useless to try to capture it. The hunter who attempts it will be knocked down.
verses.textEnNasb: " Behold, your expectation is false; Will you be hurled down even at the sight of him?
verses.textEn: Any hope of subduing it is false; the mere sight of it is overpowering.

verses.textZh: 人惹牠的时候，牠不是很凶猛吗？ 这样，有谁人在我面前能站立得住呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 人惹牠的时候，牠不是很凶猛吗？ 这样，有谁人在我面前能站立得住呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 没有那么凶猛的人敢惹它。 这样，谁能在我面前站立得住呢？
verses.textEnNiv: No one is fierce enough to rouse it. Who then is able to stand against me?
verses.textEnEsv: No one is so fierce that he dares to stir him up. Who then is he who can stand before me?
verses.textEnNkjv: No one isso fierce that he would dare stir him up. Who then is able to stand against Me?
verses.textEnNlt: And since no one dares to disturb it, who then can stand up to me?
verses.textEnNasb: "No one is so reckless that he dares to stir him; Who then is he who opposes Me?
verses.textEn: No one is fierce enough to rouse it. Who then is able to stand against me?

verses.textZh: 谁先给了我，以致我要偿还呢？ 天下万物，都是我的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁先给了我，以致我要偿还呢？ 天下万物，都是我的。
verses.textZhCuv: 谁先给我什么，使我偿还呢？ 天下万物都是我的。
verses.textEnNiv: Who has a claim against me that I must pay? Everything under heaven belongs to me.
verses.textEnEsv: Who has first given to me, that I should repay him? Whatever is under the whole heaven is mine.
verses.textEnNkjv: Who has preceded Me, that I should pay him? Everything under heaven is Mine.
verses.textEnNlt: Who has given me anything that I need to pay back? Everything under heaven is mine.
verses.textEnNasb: "Who has been first to give to Me, that I should repay him? Whatever is under the entire heaven is Mine.
verses.textEn: Who has a claim against me that I must pay? Everything under heaven belongs to me.

verses.textZh: 论到鳄鱼的四肢和牠的力气， 以及美好的体态，我不能缄默不言。
verses.textZhCnvs: 论到鳄鱼的四肢和牠的力气， 以及美好的体态，我不能缄默不言。
verses.textZhCuv: 论到鳄鱼的肢体和其大力，并美好的骨骼， 我不能缄默不言。
verses.textEnNiv: "I will not fail to speak of Leviathan’s limbs, its strength and its graceful form.
verses.textEnEsv: "I will not keep silence concerning his limbs, or his mighty strength, or his goodly frame.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I will not conceal his limbs, His mighty power, or his graceful proportions.
verses.textEnNlt: "I want to emphasize Leviathan’s limbs and its enormous strength and graceful form.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will not be silent about his limbs, Or his mighty strength, or his graceful frame.
verses.textEn: "I will not fail to speak of Leviathan’s limbs, its strength and its graceful form.

verses.textZh: 谁能揭开牠的外皮呢？ 谁能进入牠上下两颚之间呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁能揭开牠的外皮呢？ 谁能进入牠上下两颚之间呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 谁能剥它的外衣？ 谁能进它上下牙骨之间呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Who can strip off its outer coat? Who can penetrate its double coat of armor ?
verses.textEnEsv: Who can strip off his outer garment? Who would come near him with a bridle?
verses.textEnNkjv: Who can remove his outer coat? Who can approach him with a double bridle?
verses.textEnNlt: Who can strip off its hide, and who can penetrate its double layer of armor?
verses.textEnNasb: "Who can strip off his outer covering? Who can pierce his double armor?
verses.textEn: Who can strip off its outer coat? Who can penetrate its double coat of armor ?

verses.textZh: 谁能打开牠的口呢？ 牠的牙齿令人战栗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁能打开牠的口呢？ 牠的牙齿令人战栗。
verses.textZhCuv: 谁能开它的腮颊？ 它牙齿四围是可畏的。
verses.textEnNiv: Who dares open the doors of its mouth, ringed about with fearsome teeth?
verses.textEnEsv: Who can open the doors of his face? Around his teeth is terror.
verses.textEnNkjv: Who can open the doors of his face, With his terrible teeth all around?
verses.textEnNlt: Who could pry open its jaws? For its teeth are terrible!
verses.textEnNasb: "Who can open the doors of his face? Around his teeth there is terror.
verses.textEn: Who dares open the doors of its mouth, ringed about with fearsome teeth?

verses.textZh: 牠的背有一行一行的鳞甲， 紧紧合闭着，像印得很紧的印章一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠的背有一行一行的鳞甲， 紧紧合闭着，像印得很紧的印章一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 它以坚固的鳞甲为可夸， 紧紧合闭，封得严密。
verses.textEnNiv: Its back has rows of shields tightly sealed together;
verses.textEnEsv: His back is made of rows of shields, shut up closely as with a seal.
verses.textEnNkjv: His rows of scales are his pride, Shut up tightly aswith a seal;
verses.textEnNlt: The scales on its back are like rows of shields tightly sealed together.
verses.textEnNasb: "His strong scales are his pride, Locked as with a tight seal.
verses.textEn: Its back has rows of shields tightly sealed together;

verses.textZh: 这鳞甲一一相连接， 连气也透不入其间，
verses.textZhCnvs: 这鳞甲一一相连接， 连气也透不入其间，
verses.textZhCuv: 这鳞甲一一相连， 甚至气不得透入其间，
verses.textEnNiv: each is so close to the next that no air can pass between.
verses.textEnEsv: One is so near to another that no air can come between them.
verses.textEnNkjv: One is so near another That no air can come between them;
verses.textEnNlt: They are so close together that no air can get between them.
verses.textEnNasb: "One is so close to another That no air can come between them.
verses.textEn: each is so close to the next that no air can pass between.

verses.textZh: 鳞甲一一互相连合， 互相紧贴，不能分离。
verses.textZhCnvs: 鳞甲一一互相连合， 互相紧贴，不能分离。
verses.textZhCuv: 都是互相联络、胶结， 不能分离。
verses.textEnNiv: They are joined fast to one another; they cling together and cannot be parted.
verses.textEnEsv: They are joined one to another; they clasp each other and cannot be separated.
verses.textEnNkjv: They are joined one to another, They stick together and cannot be parted.
verses.textEnNlt: Each scale sticks tight to the next. They interlock and cannot be penetrated.
verses.textEnNasb: "They are joined one to another; They clasp each other and cannot be separated.
verses.textEn: They are joined fast to one another; they cling together and cannot be parted.

verses.textZh: 牠打的喷嚏闪出光来， 牠的眼睛如同清晨的阳光；
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠打的喷嚏闪出光来， 牠的眼睛如同清晨的阳光；
verses.textZhCuv: 它打喷嚏就发出光来； 它眼睛好像早晨的光线 。
verses.textEnNiv: Its snorting throws out flashes of light; its eyes are like the rays of dawn.
verses.textEnEsv: His sneezings flash forth light, and his eyes are like the eyelids of the dawn.
verses.textEnNkjv: His sneezings flash forth light, And his eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.
verses.textEnNlt: "When it sneezes, it flashes light! Its eyes are like the red of dawn.
verses.textEnNasb: "His sneezes flash forth light, And his eyes are like the eye of dawn.
verses.textEn: Its snorting throws out flashes of light; its eyes are like the rays of dawn.

verses.textZh: 有火从牠的口中发出， 火星四射；
verses.textZhCnvs: 有火从牠的口中发出， 火星四射；
verses.textZhCuv: 从它口中发出烧着的火把， 与飞迸的火星；
verses.textEnNiv: Flames stream from its mouth; sparks of fire shoot out.
verses.textEnEsv: Out of his mouth go flaming torches; sparks of fire leap forth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Out of his mouth go burning lights; Sparks of fire shoot out.
verses.textEnNlt: Lightning leaps from its mouth; flames of fire flash out.
verses.textEnNasb: "From his mouth go burning torches; Sparks of fire leap forth.
verses.textEn: Flames stream from its mouth; sparks of fire shoot out.

verses.textZh: 有烟从牠的鼻孔里冒出来， 像从沸腾的锅中和烧着的芦苇里冒出来一样；
verses.textZhCnvs: 有烟从牠的鼻孔里冒出来， 像从沸腾的锅中和烧着的芦苇里冒出来一样；
verses.textZhCuv: 从它鼻孔冒出烟来， 如烧开的锅和点着的芦苇。
verses.textEnNiv: Smoke pours from its nostrils as from a boiling pot over burning reeds.
verses.textEnEsv: Out of his nostrils comes forth smoke, as from a boiling pot and burning rushes.
verses.textEnNkjv: Smoke goes out of his nostrils, As from a boiling pot and burning rushes.
verses.textEnNlt: Smoke streams from its nostrils like steam from a pot heated over burning rushes.
verses.textEnNasb: "From his nostrils smoke goes out As from a boiling pot and burning reeds.
verses.textEn: Smoke pours from its nostrils as from a boiling pot over burning reeds.

verses.textZh: 牠的气可以点着煤炭， 有火焰从牠的口里喷出来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠的气可以点着煤炭， 有火焰从牠的口里喷出来，
verses.textZhCuv: 它的气点着煤炭， 有火焰从它口中发出。
verses.textEnNiv: Its breath sets coals ablaze, and flames dart from its mouth.
verses.textEnEsv: His breath kindles coals, and a flame comes forth from his mouth.
verses.textEnNkjv: His breath kindles coals, And a flame goes out of his mouth.
verses.textEnNlt: Its breath would kindle coals, for flames shoot from its mouth.
verses.textEnNasb: "His breath sets coals aglow, And a flame goes forth from his mouth.
verses.textEn: Its breath sets coals ablaze, and flames dart from its mouth.

verses.textZh: 牠的颈项上存着能力， 惊恐在牠面前跳跃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠的颈项上存着能力， 惊恐在牠面前跳跃。
verses.textZhCuv: 它颈项中存着劲力； 在它面前的都恐吓蹦跳。
verses.textEnNiv: Strength resides in its neck; dismay goes before it.
verses.textEnEsv: In his neck abides strength, and terror dances before him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Strength dwells in his neck, And sorrow dances before him.
verses.textEnNlt: "The tremendous strength in Leviathan’s neck strikes terror wherever it goes.
verses.textEnNasb: "In his neck dwells strength, And dismay leaps before him.
verses.textEn: Strength resides in its neck; dismay goes before it.

verses.textZh: 牠下垂的肌肉紧贴在一起， 牢牢地贴在身上，不能摇动。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠下垂的肌肉紧贴在一起， 牢牢地贴在身上，不能摇动。
verses.textZhCuv: 它的肉块互相联络， 紧贴其身，不能摇动。
verses.textEnNiv: The folds of its flesh are tightly joined; they are firm and immovable.
verses.textEnEsv: The folds of his flesh stick together, firmly cast on him and immovable.
verses.textEnNkjv: The folds of his flesh are joined together; They are firm on him and cannot be moved.
verses.textEnNlt: Its flesh is hard and firm and cannot be penetrated.
verses.textEnNasb: "The folds of his flesh are joined together, Firm and immovable on him.
verses.textEn: The folds of its flesh are tightly joined; they are firm and immovable.

verses.textZh: 牠的心坚实如石头， 如下磨石那样坚实。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠的心坚实如石头， 如下磨石那样坚实。
verses.textZhCuv: 它的心结实如石头， 如下磨石那样结实。
verses.textEnNiv: Its chest is hard as rock, hard as a lower millstone.
verses.textEnEsv: His heart is hard as a stone, hard as the lower millstone.
verses.textEnNkjv: His heart is as hard as stone, Even as hard as the lower millstone.
verses.textEnNlt: Its heart is hard as rock, hard as a millstone.
verses.textEnNasb: "His heart is as firm as a stone, And as firm as a lower millstone.
verses.textEn: Its chest is hard as rock, hard as a lower millstone.

verses.textZh: 牠一起来，勇士都惊慌， 因惊惶过度举止失措。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠一起来，勇士都惊慌， 因惊惶过度举止失措。
verses.textZhCuv: 它一起来，勇士都惊恐， 心里慌乱，便都昏迷。
verses.textEnNiv: When it rises up, the mighty are terrified; they retreat before its thrashing.
verses.textEnEsv: When he raises himself up, the mighty are afraid; at the crashing they are beside themselves.
verses.textEnNkjv: When he raises himself up, the mighty are afraid; Because of his crashings they are beside themselves.
verses.textEnNlt: When it rises, the mighty are afraid, gripped by terror.
verses.textEnNasb: "When he rises up, the mighty are afraid; Because of the crashing they are bewildered.
verses.textEn: When it rises up, the mighty are terrified; they retreat before its thrashing.

verses.textZh: 追上牠的刀剑都没用， 矛枪、标枪、短枪也是这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 追上牠的刀剑都没用， 矛枪、标枪、短枪也是这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 人若用刀，用枪，用标枪， 用尖枪扎它，都是无用。
verses.textEnNiv: The sword that reaches it has no effect, nor does the spear or the dart or the javelin.
verses.textEnEsv: Though the sword reaches him, it does not avail, nor the spear, the dart, or the javelin.
verses.textEnNkjv: Though the sword reaches him, it cannot avail; Nor does spear, dart, or javelin.
verses.textEnNlt: No sword can stop it, no spear, dart, or javelin.
verses.textEnNasb: "The sword that reaches him cannot prevail, Nor the spear, the dart, or the javelin.
verses.textEn: The sword that reaches it has no effect, nor does the spear or the dart or the javelin.

verses.textZh: 牠把铁当作干草， 把铜当作朽木。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠把铁当作干草， 把铜当作朽木。
verses.textZhCuv: 它以铁为干草， 以铜为烂木。
verses.textEnNiv: Iron it treats like straw and bronze like rotten wood.
verses.textEnEsv: He counts iron as straw, and bronze as rotten wood.
verses.textEnNkjv: He regards iron as straw, And bronze as rotten wood.
verses.textEnNlt: Iron is nothing but straw to that creature, and bronze is like rotten wood.
verses.textEnNasb: "He regards iron as straw, Bronze as rotten wood.
verses.textEn: Iron it treats like straw and bronze like rotten wood.

verses.textZh: 弓箭不能使牠逃跑， 甩石机弦在牠看来不过是碎秸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弓箭不能使牠逃跑， 甩石机弦在牠看来不过是碎秸。
verses.textZhCuv: 箭不能恐吓它使它逃避； 弹石在它看为碎秸。
verses.textEnNiv: Arrows do not make it flee; slingstones are like chaff to it.
verses.textEnEsv: The arrow cannot make him flee; for him, sling stones are turned to stubble.
verses.textEnNkjv: The arrow cannot make him flee; Slingstones become like stubble to him.
verses.textEnNlt: Arrows cannot make it flee. Stones shot from a sling are like bits of grass.
verses.textEnNasb: "The arrow cannot make him flee; Slingstones are turned into stubble for him.
verses.textEn: Arrows do not make it flee; slingstones are like chaff to it.

verses.textZh: 棍棒被牠当作碎?， 短枪飕飕之声牠也讥笑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 棍棒被牠当作碎?， 短枪飕飕之声牠也讥笑。
verses.textZhCuv: 棍棒算为禾秸； 它嗤笑短枪飕的响声。
verses.textEnNiv: A club seems to it but a piece of straw; it laughs at the rattling of the lance.
verses.textEnEsv: Clubs are counted as stubble; he laughs at the rattle of javelins.
verses.textEnNkjv: Darts are regarded as straw; He laughs at the threat of javelins.
verses.textEnNlt: Clubs are like a blade of grass, and it laughs at the swish of javelins.
verses.textEnNasb: "Clubs are regarded as stubble; He laughs at the rattling of the javelin.
verses.textEn: A club seems to it but a piece of straw; it laughs at the rattling of the lance.

verses.textZh: 牠的腹下像锐利的瓦片， 牠在泥上碾过如同有利钉的耙犁田一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠的腹下像锐利的瓦片， 牠在泥上碾过如同有利钉的耙犁田一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 它肚腹下如尖瓦片； 它如钉耙经过淤泥。
verses.textEnNiv: Its undersides are jagged potsherds, leaving a trail in the mud like a threshing sledge.
verses.textEnEsv: His underparts are like sharp potsherds; he spreads himself like a threshing sledge on the mire.
verses.textEnNkjv: His undersides are like sharp potsherds; He spreads pointed marks in the mire.
verses.textEnNlt: Its belly is covered with scales as sharp as glass. It plows up the ground as it drags through the mud.
verses.textEnNasb: "His underparts are like sharp pieces of pottery; He spreads out like a threshing sledge on the mud.
verses.textEn: Its undersides are jagged potsherds, leaving a trail in the mud like a threshing sledge.

verses.textZh: 牠使深渊沸腾， 牠搅动海洋如在鼎中调制膏油。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠使深渊沸腾， 牠搅动海洋如在鼎中调制膏油。
verses.textZhCuv: 它使深渊开滚如锅， 使洋海如锅中的膏油。
verses.textEnNiv: It makes the depths churn like a boiling caldron and stirs up the sea like a pot of ointment.
verses.textEnEsv: He makes the deep boil like a pot; he makes the sea like a pot of ointment.
verses.textEnNkjv: He makes the deep boil like a pot; He makes the sea like a pot of ointment.
verses.textEnNlt: "Leviathan makes the water boil with its commotion. It stirs the depths like a pot of ointment.
verses.textEnNasb: "He makes the depths boil like a pot; He makes the sea like a jar of ointment.
verses.textEn: It makes the depths churn like a boiling caldron and stirs up the sea like a pot of ointment.

verses.textZh: 牠使自己行过的路发出白光， 令人把深渊当作白发老人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠使自己行过的路发出白光， 令人把深渊当作白发老人。
verses.textZhCuv: 它行的路随后发光， 令人想深渊如同白发。
verses.textEnNiv: It leaves a glistening wake behind it; one would think the deep had white hair.
verses.textEnEsv: Behind him he leaves a shining wake; one would think the deep to be white-haired.
verses.textEnNkjv: He leaves a shining wake behind him; One would think the deep had white hair.
verses.textEnNlt: The water glistens in its wake, making the sea look white.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behind him he illuminates a pathway; One would think the deep to be gray-haired.
verses.textEn: It leaves a glistening wake behind it; one would think the deep had white hair.

verses.textZh: 在世上没有一样像牠的， 牠是无所惧怕的动物；
verses.textZhCnvs: 在世上没有一样像牠的， 牠是无所惧怕的动物；
verses.textZhCuv: 在地上没有像它造的那样， 无所惧怕。
verses.textEnNiv: Nothing on earth is its equal— a creature without fear.
verses.textEnEsv: On earth there is not his like, a creature without fear.
verses.textEnNkjv: On earth there is nothing like him, Which is made without fear.
verses.textEnNlt: Nothing on earth is its equal, no other creature so fearless.
verses.textEnNasb: "Nothing on earth is like him, One made without fear.
verses.textEn: Nothing on earth is its equal— a creature without fear.

verses.textZh: 所有高大的动物，牠都藐视， 牠在一切狂傲的野兽之上作王。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有高大的动物，牠都藐视， 牠在一切狂傲的野兽之上作王。"
verses.textZhCuv: 凡高大的，它无不藐视； 它在骄傲的水族上作王。
verses.textEnNiv: It looks down on all that are haughty; it is king over all that are proud."
verses.textEnEsv: He sees everything that is high; he is king over all the sons of pride."
verses.textEnNkjv: He beholds every high thing; He is king over all the children of pride."
verses.textEnNlt: Of all the creatures, it is the proudest. It is the king of beasts."
verses.textEnNasb: " He looks on everything that is high; He is king over all the sons of pride."
verses.textEn: It looks down on all that are haughty; it is king over all that are proud."

verses.textZh: 约伯回答耶和华说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 约伯回答耶和华说：
verses.textZhCuv: 约伯回答耶和华说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then Job replied to the Lord :
verses.textEnEsv: Then Job answered the Lord and said:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Job answered the Lord and said:
verses.textEnNlt: Then Job replied to the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: Then Job answered the Lord and said,
verses.textEn: Then Job replied to the Lord :

verses.textZh: "我知道你万事都能作， 你的旨意是不能拦阻的。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我知道你万事都能作， 你的旨意是不能拦阻的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我知道，你万事都能做； 你的旨意不能拦阻。
verses.textEnNiv: "I know that you can do all things; no purpose of yours can be thwarted.
verses.textEnEsv: "I know that you can do all things, and that no purpose of yours can be thwarted.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I know that You can do everything, And that no purpose ofYours can be withheld from You.
verses.textEnNlt: "I know that you can do anything, and no one can stop you.
verses.textEnNasb: "I know that You can do all things, And that no plan is impossible for You.
verses.textEn: "I know that you can do all things; no purpose of yours can be thwarted.

verses.textZh: 这以无知无识的言语使神的旨意模糊不清的是谁呢？ 所以我说了我所不明白的； 这些事太奇妙，是我不晓得的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这以无知无识的言语使神的旨意模糊不清的是谁呢？ 所以我说了我所不明白的； 这些事太奇妙，是我不晓得的。
verses.textZhCuv: 谁用无知的言语使你的旨意隐藏呢？ 我所说的是我不明白的； 这些事太奇妙，是我不知道的。
verses.textEnNiv: You asked, ‘Who is this that obscures my plans without knowledge?’ Surely I spoke of things I did not understand, things too wonderful for me to know.
verses.textEnEsv: ‘Who is this that hides counsel without knowledge?’ Therefore I have uttered what I did not understand, things too wonderful for me, which I did not know.
verses.textEnNkjv: Youasked, ‘Who is this who hides counsel without knowledge?’ Therefore I have uttered what I did not understand, Things too wonderful for me, which I did not know.
verses.textEnNlt: You asked, ‘Who is this that questions my wisdom with such ignorance?’ It is I—and I was talking about things I knew nothing about, things far too wonderful for me.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Who is this who conceals advice without knowledge?’ Therefore I have declared that which I did not understand, Things too wonderful for me, which I do not know.
verses.textEn: You asked, ‘Who is this that obscures my plans without knowledge?’ Surely I spoke of things I did not understand, things too wonderful for me to know.

verses.textZh: 求你听我，我要说话； 我要问你，你要告诉我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你听我，我要说话； 我要问你，你要告诉我。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你听我，我要说话； 我问你，求你指示我。
verses.textEnNiv: "You said, ‘Listen now, and I will speak; I will question you, and you shall answer me.’
verses.textEnEsv: ‘Hear, and I will speak; I will question you, and you make it known to me.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Listen, please, and let me speak; Yousaid, ‘I will question you, and you shall answer Me.’
verses.textEnNlt: You said, ‘Listen and I will speak! I have some questions for you, and you must answer them.’
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Please listen, and I will speak; I will ask You, and You instruct me.’
verses.textEn: "You said, ‘Listen now, and I will speak; I will question you, and you shall answer me.’

verses.textZh: 我从前只是风闻有你， 但现在亲眼看见你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我从前只是风闻有你， 但现在亲眼看见你。
verses.textZhCuv: 我从前风闻有你， 现在亲眼看见你。
verses.textEnNiv: My ears had heard of you but now my eyes have seen you.
verses.textEnEsv: I had heard of you by the hearing of the ear, but now my eye sees you;
verses.textEnNkjv: "I have heard of You by the hearing of the ear, But now my eye sees You.
verses.textEnNlt: I had only heard about you before, but now I have seen you with my own eyes.
verses.textEnNasb: "I have heard of You by the hearing of the ear; But now my eye sees You;
verses.textEn: My ears had heard of you but now my eyes have seen you.

verses.textZh: 因此我厌恶自己， 在尘土和灰烬中懊悔。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此我厌恶自己， 在尘土和灰烬中懊悔。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因此我厌恶自己 ， 在尘土和炉灰中懊悔。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore I despise myself and repent in dust and ashes."
verses.textEnEsv: therefore I despise myself, and repent in dust and ashes."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I abhor myself, And repent in dust and ashes."
verses.textEnNlt: I take back everything I said, and I sit in dust and ashes to show my repentance."
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore I retract, And I repent, sitting on dust and ashes."
verses.textEn: Therefore I despise myself and repent in dust and ashes."

verses.textZh: 耶和华对约伯说了这些话以后，就对提幔人以利法说："我要向你和你的两个朋友生气，因为你们讲论我，不如我的仆人约伯说的对。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对约伯说了这些话以后，就对提幔人以利法说："我要向你和你的两个朋友生气，因为你们讲论我，不如我的仆人约伯说的对。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对约伯说话以后，就对提幔人以利法说：「我的怒气向你和你两个朋友发作，因为你们议论我不如我的仆人约伯说的是。
verses.textEnNiv: After the Lord had said these things to Job, he said to Eliphaz the Temanite, "I am angry with you and your two friends, because you have not spoken the truth about me, as my servant Job has.
verses.textEnEsv: After the Lord had spoken these words to Job, the Lord said to Eliphaz the Temanite: "My anger burns against you and against your two friends, for you have not spoken of me what is right, as my servant Job has.
verses.textEnNkjv: And so it was, after the Lord had spoken these words to Job, that the Lord said to Eliphaz the Temanite, "My wrath is aroused against you and your two friends, for you have not spoken of Me whatis right, as My servant Job has.
verses.textEnNlt: After the Lord had finished speaking to Job, he said to Eliphaz the Temanite: "I am angry with you and your two friends, for you have not spoken accurately about me, as my servant Job has.
verses.textEnNasb: It came about after the Lord had spoken these words to Job, that the Lord said to Eliphaz the Temanite, "My wrath is kindled against you and against your two friends, because you have not spoken of Me what is trustworthy, as My servant Job has.
verses.textEn: After the Lord had said these things to Job, he said to Eliphaz the Temanite, "I am angry with you and your two friends, because you have not spoken the truth about me, as my servant Job has.

verses.textZh: 现在你们要为自己取七头公牛、七只公羊，到我的仆人约伯那里去，为你们献上燔祭，我的仆人约伯就替你们祷告；我悦纳他的祷告，就不按照你们的愚昧待你们。你们讲论我，不如我的仆人约伯说的对。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你们要为自己取七头公牛、七只公羊，到我的仆人约伯那里去，为你们献上燔祭，我的仆人约伯就替你们祷告；我悦纳他的祷告，就不按照你们的愚昧待你们。你们讲论我，不如我的仆人约伯说的对。"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你们要取七只公牛，七只公羊，到我仆人约伯那里去，为自己献上燔祭，我的仆人约伯就为你们祈祷。我因悦纳他，就不按你们的愚妄办你们。你们议论我，不如我的仆人约伯说的是。」
verses.textEnNiv: So now take seven bulls and seven rams and go to my servant Job and sacrifice a burnt offering for yourselves. My servant Job will pray for you, and I will accept his prayer and not deal with you according to your folly. You have not spoken the truth about me, as my servant Job has."
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore take seven bulls and seven rams and go to my servant Job and offer up a burnt offering for yourselves. And my servant Job shall pray for you, for I will accept his prayer not to deal with you according to your folly. For you have not spoken of me what is right, as my servant Job has."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, take for yourselves seven bulls and seven rams, go to My servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; and My servant Job shall pray for you. For I will accept him, lest I deal with you accordingtoyour folly; because you have not spoken of Me whatis right, as My servant Job has."
verses.textEnNlt: So take seven bulls and seven rams and go to my servant Job and offer a burnt offering for yourselves. My servant Job will pray for you, and I will accept his prayer on your behalf. I will not treat you as you deserve, for you have not spoken accurately about me, as my servant Job has."
verses.textEnNasb: Now therefore, take for yourselves seven bulls and seven rams, and go to My servant Job, and offer up a burnt offering for yourselves, and My servant Job will pray for you. For I will accept him so as not to do with you as your foolishness deserves, because you have not spoken of Me what is trustworthy, as My servant Job has."
verses.textEn: So now take seven bulls and seven rams and go to my servant Job and sacrifice a burnt offering for yourselves. My servant Job will pray for you, and I will accept his prayer and not deal with you according to your folly. You have not spoken the truth about me, as my servant Job has."

verses.textZh: 于是提幔人以利法、书亚人比勒达、拿玛人琐法，照着耶和华吩咐他们的去行，耶和华就悦纳约伯的祷告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是提幔人以利法、书亚人比勒达、拿玛人琐法，照着耶和华吩咐他们的去行，耶和华就悦纳约伯的祷告。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是提幔人以利法、书亚人比勒达、拿玛人琐法照着耶和华所吩咐的去行；耶和华就悦纳约伯。
verses.textEnNiv: So Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite did what the Lord told them; and the Lord accepted Job’s prayer.
verses.textEnEsv: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went and did what the Lord had told them, and the Lord accepted Job’s prayer.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went and did as the Lord commanded them; for the Lord had accepted Job.
verses.textEnNlt: So Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite did as the Lord commanded them, and the Lord accepted Job’s prayer.
verses.textEnNasb: So Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite went and did as the Lord told them; and the Lord accepted Job.
verses.textEn: So Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite did what the Lord told them; and the Lord accepted Job’s prayer.

verses.textZh: 约伯替他的朋友祷告，耶和华就恢复约伯原来的景况，还照约伯以前所有的一切加倍赐给他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约伯替他的朋友祷告，耶和华就恢复约伯原来的景况，还照约伯以前所有的一切加倍赐给他。
verses.textZhCuv: 约伯为他的朋友祈祷。耶和华就使约伯从苦境 转回，并且耶和华赐给他的比他从前所有的加倍。
verses.textEnNiv: After Job had prayed for his friends, the Lord restored his fortunes and gave him twice as much as he had before.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord restored the fortunes of Job, when he had prayed for his friends. And the Lord gave Job twice as much as he had before.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord restored Job’s losses when he prayed for his friends. Indeed the Lord gave Job twice as much as he had before.
verses.textEnNlt: When Job prayed for his friends, the Lord restored his fortunes. In fact, the Lord gave him twice as much as before!
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord also restored the fortunes of Job when he prayed for his friends, and the Lord increased double all that Job had.
verses.textEn: After Job had prayed for his friends, the Lord restored his fortunes and gave him twice as much as he had before.

verses.textZh: 约伯的众兄弟姊妹和以前认识的人都来见他，在他家里与他一同吃饭，又因耶和华降予他的一切灾祸都对他表同情，安慰他，每人送他一块银子和一个金环。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约伯的众兄弟姊妹和以前认识的人都来见他，在他家里与他一同吃饭，又因耶和华降予他的一切灾祸都对他表同情，安慰他，每人送他一块银子和一个金环。
verses.textZhCuv: 约伯的弟兄、姊妹，和以先所认识的人都来见他，在他家里一同吃饭；又论到耶和华所降与他的一切灾祸，都为他悲伤安慰他。每人也送他一块银子和一个金环。
verses.textEnNiv: All his brothers and sisters and everyone who had known him before came and ate with him in his house. They comforted and consoled him over all the trouble the Lord had brought on him, and each one gave him a piece of silver and a gold ring.
verses.textEnEsv: Then came to him all his brothers and sisters and all who had known him before, and ate bread with him in his house. And they showed him sympathy and comforted him for all the evil that the Lord had brought upon him. And each of them gave him a piece of money and a ring of gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then all his brothers, all his sisters, and all those who had been his acquaintances before, came to him and ate food with him in his house; and they consoled him and comforted him for all the adversity that the Lord had brought upon him. Each one gave him a piece of silver and each a ring of gold.
verses.textEnNlt: Then all his brothers, sisters, and former friends came and feasted with him in his home. And they consoled him and comforted him because of all the trials the Lord had brought against him. And each of them brought him a gift of money and a gold ring.
verses.textEnNasb: Then all his brothers, all his sisters, and all who had known him before came to him, and they ate bread with him in his house; and they sympathized with him and comforted him for all the adversities that the Lord had brought on him. And each one gave him a piece of money, and each a ring of gold.
verses.textEn: All his brothers and sisters and everyone who had known him before came and ate with him in his house. They comforted and consoled him over all the trouble the Lord had brought on him, and each one gave him a piece of silver and a gold ring.

verses.textZh: 这样，耶和华后来赐给约伯的福比先前更多：他有一万四千只羊、六千匹骆驼、一千对牛、一千头母驴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，耶和华后来赐给约伯的福比先前更多：他有一万四千只羊、六千匹骆驼、一千对牛、一千头母驴。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，耶和华后来赐福给约伯比先前更多。他有一万四千羊，六千骆驼，一千对牛，一千母驴。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord blessed the latter part of Job’s life more than the former part. He had fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels, a thousand yoke of oxen and a thousand donkeys.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord blessed the latter days of Job more than his beginning. And he had 14,000 sheep, 6,000 camels, 1,000 yoke of oxen, and 1,000 female donkeys.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Lord blessed the latter days of Job more than his beginning; for he had fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels, one thousand yoke of oxen, and one thousand female donkeys.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Lord blessed Job in the second half of his life even more than in the beginning. For now he had 14,000 sheep, 6,000 camels, 1,000 teams of oxen, and 1,000 female donkeys.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord blessed the latter days of Job more than his beginning; and he had fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels, a thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand female donkeys.
verses.textEn: The Lord blessed the latter part of Job’s life more than the former part. He had fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels, a thousand yoke of oxen and a thousand donkeys.

verses.textZh: 他也有七个儿子和三个女儿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他也有七个儿子和三个女儿。
verses.textZhCuv: 他也有七个儿子，三个女儿。
verses.textEnNiv: And he also had seven sons and three daughters.
verses.textEnEsv: He had also seven sons and three daughters.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also had seven sons and three daughters.
verses.textEnNlt: He also gave Job seven more sons and three more daughters.
verses.textEnNasb: He also had seven sons and three daughters.
verses.textEn: And he also had seven sons and three daughters.

verses.textZh: 他给长女起名叫耶米玛，次女名叫基洗亚，三女名叫基连．哈朴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他给长女起名叫耶米玛，次女名叫基洗亚，三女名叫基连．哈朴。
verses.textZhCuv: 他给长女起名叫耶米玛，次女叫基洗亚，三女叫基连‧哈朴。
verses.textEnNiv: The first daughter he named Jemimah, the second Keziah and the third Keren-Happuch.
verses.textEnEsv: And he called the name of the first daughter Jemimah, and the name of the second Keziah, and the name of the third Keren-happuch.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he called the name of the first Jemimah, the name of the second Keziah, and the name of the third Keren-Happuch.
verses.textEnNlt: He named his first daughter Jemimah, the second Keziah, and the third Keren-happuch.
verses.textEnNasb: He named the first Jemimah, the second Keziah, and the third Keren-happuch.
verses.textEn: The first daughter he named Jemimah, the second Keziah and the third Keren-Happuch.

verses.textZh: 在那全地中，找不到像约伯女儿那么美貌的妇女。她们的父亲在她们兄弟中间把产业分给她们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那全地中，找不到像约伯女儿那么美貌的妇女。她们的父亲在她们兄弟中间把产业分给她们。
verses.textZhCuv: 在那全地的妇女中找不着像约伯的女儿那样美貌。她们的父亲使她们在弟兄中得产业。
verses.textEnNiv: Nowhere in all the land were there found women as beautiful as Job’s daughters, and their father granted them an inheritance along with their brothers.
verses.textEnEsv: And in all the land there were no women so beautiful as Job’s daughters. And their father gave them an inheritance among their brothers.
verses.textEnNkjv: In all the land were found no women so beautiful as the daughters of Job; and their father gave them an inheritance among their brothers.
verses.textEnNlt: In all the land no women were as lovely as the daughters of Job. And their father put them into his will along with their brothers.
verses.textEnNasb: In all the land no women were found as beautiful as Job’s daughters; and their father gave them inheritances among their brothers.
verses.textEn: Nowhere in all the land were there found women as beautiful as Job’s daughters, and their father granted them an inheritance along with their brothers.

verses.textZh: 此后，约伯又活了一百四十年，得见他的儿孙到四代。
verses.textZhCnvs: 此后，约伯又活了一百四十年，得见他的儿孙到四代。
verses.textZhCuv: 此后，约伯又活了一百四十年，得见他的儿孙，直到四代。
verses.textEnNiv: After this, Job lived a hundred and forty years; he saw his children and their children to the fourth generation.
verses.textEnEsv: And after this Job lived 140 years, and saw his sons, and his sons’ sons, four generations.
verses.textEnNkjv: After this Job lived one hundred and forty years, and saw his children and grandchildren for four generations.
verses.textEnNlt: Job lived 140 years after that, living to see four generations of his children and grandchildren.
verses.textEnNasb: After this, Job lived 140 years, and saw his sons and his grandsons, four generations.
verses.textEn: After this, Job lived a hundred and forty years; he saw his children and their children to the fourth generation.

verses.textZh: 这样，约伯年纪老迈，寿终而死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，约伯年纪老迈，寿终而死。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，约伯年纪老迈，日子满足而死。
verses.textEnNiv: And so Job died, an old man and full of years.
verses.textEnEsv: And Job died, an old man, and full of days.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Job died, old and full of days.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he died, an old man who had lived a long, full life.
verses.textEnNasb: And Job died, an old man and full of days.
verses.textEn: And so Job died, an old man and full of years.
